tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 26 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rting zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/ de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan nyi ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/ dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/ dpe thum gsol/ dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/ rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/ srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang / da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhug〉 ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/ de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang / 'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/ nang don rig pa dang / gso ba rig pa/ tshad ma rig pa/ sgra rig pa/ bzo rig pa/ lo rgyus/ rtsis rig sogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yin/ —1—

'a 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brdzid kyi 'os 'gan thig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung rga'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying gzhan pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'jug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gisanor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'byung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu sbungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo digs su grags wo gyi slob grwa wo mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod wo po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i zugad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi bai ro ska cog zhang / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ khangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'byung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su spyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyisaljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyams pa rnams gsos/ 'khru/gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/ —3—

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhra/na mche/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu zhi las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs tog 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu kho/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrig gsal bar/da/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bkos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod —1—

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras sbungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang zhib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 9rig ra phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhub/sa pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras sbungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras sprungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyone bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'byung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rja 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di( 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5—

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song stsi krin sogs kyi rgya'i sbyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas zhwang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legang lte kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen tho pa~X sgro 1 0 kye 'byurdo nga gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung //rdo rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mjad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gas yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi spyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ g.yin yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bzhas gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang /rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug lha hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591)la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ gzhan yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gshin rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhung bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bshes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta ga rta nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod wo po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni khyu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas g.yin stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor 'o sngom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang g.yin la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung mas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras sbungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khore bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635) la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon to mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—10—

sbyong rgyud kyi snying po'i don nyi ma'i stobs 'bar bzhugs/ 1dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bya ba'i rgyud mtha' dag la 'ju ga pa bzhugs/ 54gzu ngas grwa lnga'i dkyil chog bar chad kun sel bzhugs/ 155gzungs grwa lnga'i cho ga la brten nas byad 'grol byed tshul bzhugs/ 193tshe chog bdud rtsi'i chu gter gyi brgyud 'debs bzhugs/ 204tshe chog bdud rtsi'i chu gter bzhugs/ 206tshe dbang lha gcig bum gcig gi cho ga bdud rtsi'i bum pa bzhugs/ 246bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga nyung ngu rnam gsal bzhu/gas/ 259bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga'i zur 'debs 'jug bde rnam gsal bzhugs/ 290bcom ldan 'das mi 'khra/gas pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga las sgrib kun 'joms bzhugs/ 311gtor ma cha gsum gyi lag len bzhugs/ 322mngon par dga' ba'i zhing gi smon lam mdo sde'i dgongs don bzhugs/ 331—1—

tse khe swā skyi/bla ma dang dpal phyag na rdo rje dbyer ma mchis pa la phyag 'tshal lko/gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa las 'byung ba'i man ngag rgyud don bzhin 'khrul med du gsal bar zugad pa/nyi ma'i stobs 'bar zhes bya ba sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo//srid 'di thams cad glamed byang chub mchog la reg par gyur cig ces//gdung ba'i yid kyis shākya'i rigs kyi theg le de la gus btud nas//gang de'i yon tan rmad byung pha mtha' med pa yang yang sems bzhin du/de gsung 'dud rtsi sgro btags dug chus ma slad pa de 'dir gsal bya/de la 'dir sgrub pa'i rim paganyis las/dang po la spyir bsnyen pa dang /nye bsnyen dang /sgrub pa ste gsum mo/khyu ba pa chen poyang bsnan te bzhin bya ba las/rgyud 'dir sgrub pa sgrub chen so sor gsal bas bzhin bya/de las dang po ni/mdun du maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa bshams/de rjes gsang ba spyi'i lugs yin pas/oṃ.a mṛ te hū phaṭa/ces pa'am/bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzungs ring kyis/rang dang dzinas khangadang yo byad thams cad kyi bgegs bskrad/sangs rgyas la phyag 'tsha'/ 'e1//zhes sangasargyas rjes su dran bzhin pas ji ltar 'os pa'i khrus bya/chos thams cad bdag med stong pa nyid kyidon dang /sems can la 'bye ba'i sems nye bar 'jog bzhin du gdan la 'dug mchod pa rnamasabyin rlabs bya/stong pa'i ngang las pa las pad+ma dang /a las zla ba'i dkyil/'khor gyi steng du/rang sems hu gi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/rang nyid rdo rje khro bo me ltar 'bar ba sku mdog mthing nag/zhal gcig stag lpags kyi na bza' dang /sprul dang mi sdug pas brgyan pa/phyag gnyis kyi g.yas rdorje thugs kar

gtod pa dang g.yon dril bu dkur bsten sa cad sdi/pa/shin tu 'jigasa'aphros 'bar ba 'khrugs pa/ma rung pa thams cad gas par mdzad pa zho/lag pa g.yas steng du ba lhan pa'i hūṃ mdzad kyi phyag gyo bcas/phyogs kun tu bskor bzhin du.oṃbadz+ra satwa kro dha a na lwarka mahā badz+ra kro dha/dra ba dra ba/bi dra ba'i dra ba/sa sgolopa ya/nā sha ya nā shā ya/ha ra ha ra/paṇaX huX phaṭa/ni gsum gyis ha gag yang gsum gyi gnas dang /yang gsum gyi rnal 'byor bsrung ba byas/yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/sangs rgyas mu ge ge de cad dang rdorje sems dpa' dang phyag 'u rnams spyan drangs mdun gya maṇ+ḍal la bzhugs par bsam/dad pa dngan datshatshig gis/spyo sogs sam/ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon sum mdzad//mibazad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa//rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rangabazhin te//sems can snying po gag gyur 'dir gshegs shig/bcom ldan thugs rje byon pa legs/sogs ༵ḍi /oṃ badz+ra arnyaX sogs kyis mchod yon phulkapad+ma ka ma la ye stuX gyis gdan phul/ badz+ra pu the/ huX nas shaga'i bar gyis me chod pa phulkamagon po thugs rjes che ldan pa/sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi phyag 'tshal gyis brte/'jig rten dag gi phyogs kun na//de bzhin gshegs pa gang bzhugs dang//dgra bcom byang chub sems dpa' ste//de dag bdag la dgongs su gsol//bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa rnams//rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis mkhyen pa bzhin//de ltar bdag gis so sor bshags//slan chad de ltar yongasamibagyi//srog chags sdugs bsngal zhi bya'i phyir//bdag ni ji srid 'tshobayichibar//sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ༷//gus par yang dag skyabs su ma//

sems can khams ni mtha' yas pa'i//sdug bsngal nye bar zhi ba dang//phaga'agro rnams las bsgral ba dang //nyon mongs rnams las dgrol ba'i phyir//srid pa mi bde dogs pa na//sdug bsngal sna tsho gos ci mchis/ pa//de ltarardeyongs su skyabs pa'i phyir//bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed do//semasardecan phongs pa thams cad kyi//skyabs su bdag nyid rtag tu shog/bdaganimagon med rnams kyi mgon//rten med rnams kyi rten tu bdag khri kha/sa med rnams kyi skyabs 'gyur zhing //sdug bsngal bde bar byed pa dang //bdaganisems can thams cad kyi//wo mongs zhi bar byed par shog/dge ba'i lasani gang dang gang //bde dang gzhan du bsags pa rnams//bar de nams/yeshes zhes bya ba'i//tsho/lo ni rnam pa gnyis su shog/pha rol phyin pa drugabasgoms nas//bdag brtson 'gru/sa gang brtsams pa//de yang sems canam lus pa//thams cad la ni phan par shog/tshe yi mtha' klas byed pa dang/gang yang cung zad byed 'gyur pa/mdor na sems can bang cing sgyi/nyonamongs thams cad zhi ba dang //grol bar bya ba'i phyir 'bad nga //byang chubang)’spro/ /bye/ rnga ni tha(/sgyub ri 2pe//skyi(rdo bye ni che : sto/rde/ nyu/(rdezhes rgyun 4gags lan gsum bya/tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ ga bhāwashudha sarba dharma su bhā wa shurnyo3haX/stong pa'i pang las paX las pad+ma dang a 'ang/zla ba'i dkyil ge nar gyi go du/huX las rdo rje hūṃ gis mas pa de las go woga'aphags pa mchod/smos can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su 'gyur pa lasarang ṣ+ka dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga

pa thugs kar gtod cing / g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ sems/dpa'i skyiwamo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūX yig dkar po'o/ /rang gi lag pa gnyis su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khorarere/ de'i steng du g.yas par huX/ g.yon par a/ gnyis ka'i mtha' skor du/ a ā i sa a u pe skyur grwa '-i lī e mai o o aX a rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba 'od 'phro ba'o/ /mthe bong gnyis la oX/ mdzub mo gnyis la huX/ gung mo gnyis la traX/srin lag gnyis la sdiX mthe chung gnyis la a rnams de bzhin gshe/gas pa lnga'ingo bor gyur/ mnyam pa'i thal mo/ oṃ a no n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmaXrdorje thal yodang/pa ra spa ra a nu pra bi ni sarba dharmaX rdo rje sdam pa dang / a byan ta a nu pra lnga spyi sarba dharmaX zhes brjod cing / rgyud 'di'i dngos bstan la de tsam las med cing de yang dam rgyadang lasabacol sogs kyi phyag rgya chang ba'i don du lag pa byin gyis rlob pa kho na yin no/ /rang gi snyingag nas 'od zer 'phros/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaXrdorje sna thal las mdzub mo brkyang pa g.yab cing/ oṃ badz+ra satwa huX dzaX sngags de nyid kyi mchod yon phulka.oX badz+ra aX ku sha dzaX oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūX/ oX badz+ra h+pho ṭa baX/ oX badz+ra u be sha ho~X bsdun/ dzaXhūX baX hoX rang dang gnyis su med par thim/ phyag rgya nyid dmagung mo0nga ye dam rgya bcas la/ tso rna badz+ra satwa hūṃ/ mang du bzlas pas/ dam ye dbyer med par phyag tseXd bh+ri ta sgri ta sarba a ba ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba a ba ra ṇa ni hūX phaṭa/ oṃtshin+ta tshin+ta sarba a ba ra ṇa ni huX phaṭa/ ces gnas gsum du phyag rgya gtugs te byin gyisarlabs/ lha dbang bskur ba ni/ rgyal ba lnga'i phyag rgya spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar gtu kas te/—4—

oṃ budha a bha ( ñca o/oṃ badz+ra a bhi khri phu ni huX/oṃ rat+na a bhi khri mi traX/o pad+ma a nyi‘ri 0ri 'u sne pa rta rte/ṣañca nga hāX karma a ṣañca a/de dag ni rgyuX las/ tshe dpag med kyi skabs sa ze rgyas/rnams thams cad dngos med par//sdong gi kyis sgom pa byas nas kyang/skalas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sa ma snogo/pa/rang zhi sna gas de dbus su//bsna5nasadam tshig/ phyag rgya yang //bsam de ba de nyad du/gi/sgrub pa po bsgyurardebar bya//lha snyen 'byoja tshul du bsgyur/༷ ma ji rang sa sa bon dang//phyagargyas 'i rgya de byan rlaXrdzo///ltag 'og go ram bzhan du //sa/rmyums kyas dbang bskur bzhi//de nas nga rgyal bskyed nas kyang //mkhas pa yasan sgrubs byas na//de ba na gshe/gas kyang 'a sdo/ba 'gyur na//dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/go si gi' ba'i don te/dngos med pa go spos pakau.a las sogs kyi gdan dang /rang sa bon zhes pas sa bon dang /dam tshig phyag rgya go phyag mtshan no//sgrub pa po twar ba ni 'od zer spro ba/sogs lha skur twar shā thabs dang /lha'i rnal 'byore spyo pas lha bskyed pa dang /rang sa bon dang zhesaspothugs kar sa bon sgom pa dang /phyag rgyas phyag rgya zhes pa ni ye shes pas dam tshig pa rmi gyis rlobs pa ste/phyag rgya zhes pa gtso bor zhal phyag can gyi lha sku yin la/rnams gras/ su na/lag pa'i phyag rgya bcings pa'ang yin pas/dam tshig ni phyag rgya yang bstan no/ri/ltag 'og ces/pas/gnas gsum byin rlabs dang /gzugs bas sbyor ba sogs bstan/go ma zhes pa ni go rim ma 'khrugs pa ste/gzugs ba ho spyor ba dam rgya 'ching ba'i sngon du byed pa dang/༅sa gsum byin rlabs phyis byed pa la sogs pa'o//sangs rgyas rnams ni rigs lnga ste de'i phyag rgyasadabang skrar ba'o//de nas nga rgyal sogs ni5/de'i rjes su lha sku sgom pa dang/sngags bus pa

byed pa bsnya no//de'i phyir sa kyi don ni de kho na ltar shes par bya'o//de nas lha lamachod pa'i' du/ar+ghaṃ nas shasta'i bar kyis mar/sang sdos rgyas kun bas sngar sabs rgyas/sogs phyag na rdo rje'i mawo bas bstod/rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pagasnying gar zla ba la huX gi mtha' skor du sngags kyis bskor ba/de las 'od zera'aphros/mdun du bzhugs pa lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul//de dgagi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros//phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams/cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul//mchod pas mnyes par byas/yang cad zer 'dusate rang gi snying gar thim/bzlas pa'i mthar/ma rdzo pa dang /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/zhes pa lta bu'i bstod thung cig gis bstod/dge ba bsngo/thug dang po le bya ba'o//rdor sems las rdor sems chad/'phros pa'i rdor sems kyi las byed par bsam/thugamatshams su mdo sde klog pa dang /zas kyi bya ba sogs thun mtshams kyi spyod lam bya'o//4snangadu'ongs bdud rtsi 'khyil bas bgegs bsal nas/oṃ a sa me sogs kyis rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dang 'dres/mchod pa byin rlabs dang /ma rdzo bstod byas nas sngar bzhi bzlas pala'ajug cing /smon lam gyi bar bya'o//thun bar pa rnams kyis bya ba'o//thun mtshams su phyag rgyagrol pa ni mi dgos te/'di la rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs las 'byung ba'i rgyas btabs med pasaso//des na ye shes kyi lha nam mkhar bzhugs pa mchod bstod/bzod gsol/spyan len pakhrophyag gyo de phyir bskyed lagashegs gsol rnams bya'o//gong bzhin khro bo'i sngags kyis bsrung babyas te smon lam btab la nyal lo//tshu 'des dang po nyid du oṃ badz+ra satwa hūX/'bum phrag drug bzla'o//de nas kun rig gi gen pa yin na/oṃ sarba bid sarba a ba ra ṇa pi sgo dha yoha na huX phaṭa ces pa 'bum phrag bcu drugataX/ thub la sogs pa dkyilas bor gzhan rnams kyi

yin na de dang de'i snying po 'bru grangs kyi 'bum sogs ji ltar 'os pa'o//de'i rjes su dngos grubakyi mtshan ma ma mthong gi bar du rtsa rig nyid gtso bor bzla ba yin la/sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i spyi sngags/oṃ she( bhā ni sogs ring thung gnyis dang /sarba a ba ya sogs dngasarba tra ṭa dang /tsho( huX rnams kyang ji ltar 'os par bzla ste/de rnams thams cad dkyila'akhor brtaganyis kyi spyi sngags yin pas/kha cig kun rig gi sangs rgyas lnga la so sor spyor banimi legs so//de ltar rdo rje sems dpa' la brten nas bsnyen pa byed pa 'di ni/dkyil 'khorabacu gnyis ka'i thun mong yin la/yang so so tha dad la mos na/oṃ las 'khor lo tshe gyisamatshan pa las rnam snang /bskyed pa sogs sa bon dang ma/phyag mtshan dag lha dag phyagargyadang /snying po rnam twar/bstod pa spyi 'gro yin pas/mnyam nyid mi gos ma byed/rmi gyis rlobs shing sngags rgyud byed pa po'i lha phyag rdor yin zhin mdun du bzhugs pa'ang yin pas mtshan gyo yang bya'o//yang me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i bsnyen pa byed na'ang /sa bon phyag mtshan lha sngags phyag gyo ste lnga po bsgyur zhing /dgos bstod re bsnan pas cho ga snga ma nyid kyi grub bro//dbang bskur rab gnas/rgyud bshad tsam la dbang ba tsam gyi don du/bsnyen pa byed na grangs kyi bsnyen pa tsam gyis chog pas/lha gang sgoms kyang rung la/rtsa rig 'bum phrag bzhi tsam bzlas pas kyang rung zhing /dngos grub kyi don du ni lha dgyes pa'i mtshan ma byung gi bar du'o//gnyis pa nye bsnyen ni/rgyud las gsungs pa ltar/tha ga bas gtsang sbra dang ldan parabartags pa'i ras sam/dpa' bo'i rin gyi nyos pa'i ras la/sngags chus yang nas yang du bsangs shing /spos chus dkrus na/tshon rtsi dang dam tshig gtsang mas ras bris 'bri ste/lha bzo ba yang gtsang sbra dang bsnyen gnas laganas par bya'o//de yang steng star gyi dbus kyi cha la kun ris taṭa/par snang mdzad/g.yas su ston pa shāka thub rji 7 mdog rab byung chos 'chad dam sa gnon gang

mos/ g.yon du sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ bar star la dbus su bcom ldan 'das sman bla rab byung phyagagayas pus mo'i steng du mchog sbyin dang / g.yon mnyam bldan gi steng du a ru ra 'dzin ga sku mdog sngon po'o/ /de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ mchog sbyin dang pad+ma dkar po'i dzin pa/ g.yon du phyag na rdo rje ljang khu/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing / g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ 'og star gyi dbus kyi cha lasangs rgyas spyan ma/ mā ma gī gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma rnams dkyila'akhor du bkod pa bzhin dang / g.yas su rta mgrin dmar po dbu'i steng du rta mgo can/be conadakar po 'dzin pa dang / g.yon du khams gsum rnam rgyal sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/khro bo de gnyis stag lpags dang sprul gyon can/ khro bo'i cha byas rdzogs pa/ sems dpa' gnyis dge thoboganyis rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas bzhi rdo rje'i skyil grung ngo / /'og gi cha la pa zla khro mtsho me tog sna tshogs kyis gang ba chu srin dang nya dang rus sbal dang / sbal pa dkar po dag nya dkar po rnams chu nang du rgyu ba 'bri/ sa gzhi'i phyogs lamachod pa sna lnga dang / rin po tshe'i phrengabadang shing 'bras sna tshogs pa'i mchod pa dang / 'og phyogs su sgrub pa po thal mo spyi bor sbyar ba 'bri'o/ /yang lugs gcig la shāka thub kyang phyag chos 'chad/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/'kho ra los bsgyur ba'i cha lugs su mdzad pa'ang yod/ /sman bla ma gtogs gshe/gas pa gsum dang / phyag rdor lha mo bzhi rnams sku mdog dkar po byed pa dang / 'ga' zhig sman gla shethams cad dkar po byed zer ro/ /thang ka de ri mo g.yin rnams zin/ spyan 'byed pa'i nyin mo/thog mar bgegs sbyang ba dang / cha gsum lta bu'i gtor ma mang du sbyin/ bsrung ba byed bo zhen du spyan bris nas rab gnas ma tshar ba'i gong / ri mo grub ma thag pa de nyid du/ mchod pa dag rolamo dang / bden stobs brjod pa'i smon lam dang / bkra shis mang du byas nas bzo bo yang yon gyis mnyes par bya'o/ /de nyid kyi lngin par dang tam phyed la thugan bar du bzlas brjod bden pa'i byin —8—

rlabs kyi dmigs pa kho na yid la byed kyi/tha mal gyi rnam rtog dang /long gtam gyi dbang du mabatang bar/gtsang sbra dang bcas te nyal bar bya'o//de'i tshe dngos sam rmi lam du rtags 'byung bar 'gyur la/nub dang po la ma byung na gnyis pa dang gsum pa'i bar du brtag go/de dag tu mtshan mamathong na dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i ltas yin la/gal te mtshan ma ma mthong na/yin tu skal ba chung bas yun ring po zhig na 'grub pa'am/skye ba gzhan du 'grub par 'gyur ro//de nas thang ka de la rab gnas rdzogs par bya zhing /mchod pa yang rgya cher phul te/rlung dang nyi mas ma phog pa dgaskye bo g.yin gyis ma mthong bar/theg re bzhin rtag tu mchod pa ma chag par byas nas/shin tu rdedaben pa'i khang pa dge zhing bkra shis la gtsang ba zhig tu dkram/mdun du mchod pa rgya cherabashams/phyi rol tu cha gsum gtor ma dang /gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs btang nas/rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcas nas/oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hoXzhes nang du 'ongs nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis yungs kar gtor zhing bgegs bskrad/gong du ji skad smos pa ltar gyi bsnyen pa'i chog dang 'dra ba las khyad par ni/bsrung 'khor gyi nang du gnas khang dang yo byad byin gyis rlabs/bris sku shu rgyu tas stong par sbyang /oṃ bha zhes brjod pas/sangs rgyas kyi 'id khams/rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa pad+ma'i rdzing bu dang /mchod pa thams cad kyis gangababris sku'i yul bkod dang phyogs mthun pa re bskyed/lha'i gdan rnams kyang bas migasnying po'i rnam snang dang /oṃ sarba bid huX dang /oX sarba bid as g.yas g.yon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dang /ste ṣa dzu kyi gzungs kyi sman bla dang /na maXs man+ta budha naX/na mo ur+ya a ba lo ki te/ka ru ṇa ma ye ra ra ra ra huX dzaXswāhā/spyan ras gzigs dang /oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa huX phaṭa/phyag na rdo rje dang /oṃ ha ya kṛ ba hi ༷༷swatwa zhes pas cha dang /huX bzhi pa'i sngags kyi 'jig rten gsuX rgyal dang /lha mo bzhi po yang rang sngags kyis

bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ mchod yon/ sku khrug bzhugs gsog mchod bstod rnams rgyas par byas nas/ rang rang gi sngags brjod cing dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan/rgyun bshags man chad sngar dang 'dra/ bzlas pa'i skabs mdun bskyed la dmigs nas bcom ldana'adas kun rig gi dam rgya bcas la/ rtsa rig lan gsum brjod/ de nas khu tshur gnyis kha sbyarabaphye nye pad+ma'i skor ba dang bcas pas phyag rgya de nyid byed cing / rtsa rig gam snying po'i mthar phyag rgya de nyid gongs la/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa rnam par snang mdzad kyisasems can thams cad kyi don du bdag myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos grub stsol ba dang / de ma thob kyi bar du yang skal ba dang mthun pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ thugs kar 'khor lo'i lte bar sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa bsgom/ de nas/ rang gi thugs/kanasa'od zer 'phros/ 'od zer gyi rtse la mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul/ lha bstoganyis po gtso bor gyur pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams mchod cing / khyad par du yang thugs ka'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa lamachod pa phul/ tshur log ste rang gi snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim/ yang 'od zera'aphros/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas mchod/ snyems can gyi don byagathugs rgyud bskul te tshur 'dus snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim/ de rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi gzi byin 'od zer la gos pas/ snying ka'i sngags phreng 'od dang ge ze brjid 'bar bar bsam/ thun mtshams kyi spyod lam sogs sngar dang 'dra/ tshul des rtsa bo'i rig pa 'bum phrag drug bzla bar gsungs te/ deng sang bzhi 'dab tu byed dgos pa ga'abus phyaganyi shu rtsa bzhin/ khyad par du thun mtshams kyi spyod pa lhag por/ lha mnyes pa'i don du sbyin sreg—10—

dang / 'jig rten pa rnams lagator ma sbyin par bya'o/ /nyer sgrub 'di yang rgyud las thog mar bris sku 'dri tshul rgyas par gsungs/ de nas ri mo'i sku gzugs de mngon par mchod ces pa ni rab gnas ma byas gong spyan 'byed kyi skabs yin/ bzhad pa dang ni rnga sgra dang / /dril bu'i smadang 'brug de bzhin/ /dge slong bram ze bu mo dang / /'bras bu mthong na myur du ni/ /mchog dang par mthama'agrub/ /ces pa dngos grub kyi rtags te/ bris sku dngos su ba 'ad na rab/ sgra wa snya༅/ ge co/su thos na 'bring / dge slong sogs rmi lam du mthong ba tha ma'o/ /de nas gzugs te byin rlabs te sogasani bris sku rab gnas so/ /nyer sgrub la sgom bzlas kyi rim pa ni/ rtag tu mngon sum 'dun nas ni//'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyis/ /bdag bsrung la sogs byas nas kyang / /bdag ni de nyid dran byed cing / /'bum phrag gsum mam yang na drug /dngos grub mtshan ma byung bar du go/zhes so/ /bdag gi de nyid ces pa ni/ gdod ma'i ye shes mdun bskyed ni/ dam pe'i bdag yin zhing / sgrub pa po rang nyid ni tha mal pa'i bdag tu snang ba yin la/ de nyid nyi ma dang nyi me'i 'odabazhin du shes nas/ rto mas nyi ma'i 'od zer spro zhing bsdu bar byed pa bzhin du/ mdun bskyed kyilha'i byin rlabs las bdag nyid lhar gyur pa spro bdang / phyis rang nyid mdun bskyed lha'i ngo boragyur pa ni bsdud pa'i tshul te/ de'i don du bdag mdun gnyis ka la dmigs nas rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid du bsgom pa yin no/ /de ltar nyer sgrub 'di dngos grub nye ba'i mtshan ma mthong gi bar dusgom par bya'o/ /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ phyi dkyil la brten pa dang / bris sku tsam lang lhan pa gnyis/ kar rung mod kyi/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor ni gtso bor sgrub chen gyi skabs su yin pas sgrub snas/ pa'i skabs 'dir phal cher bris sku dang ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis lhan cig tu sgrub par bya'o/ /de yang nyer sgrub dang gzhi 'dra ba las/ dkyil 'bor rgyas pa sgom dgos pa yin pas/ de la kun rig gi dkyil 'khor ni/ skabs 'dir/ khagacig sgo rkyang du 'dod/ kha cig nyis sbrag tu 'dod/—11—

bod sngon rabs rang kha cig sgo sbrag shin tu mang por 'dod pa sogs byung yang / bla ma'i man bkagam rgyud gzhan la brten nas 'di'i dgongs pa bkral ba dang / kha 'gengs kyi khyad par la brten nas 'chad tshul mi 'dra ba du ma dag spyi ldog nas 'khrul lo/ /zhes 'gog par ni mi byed mos kyang/rgyud kyi dngos bstan ni sgo rkyang kho na yin la/ 'khyams ni kha cig phyogs mdog kha cig sna tsho gos pa zhes sogs 'dod pa/ yo ga'i lugs ltar na phyogs mdog yin mod/ 'dir bya spyod phal che ba dngamathun pa/ bi rje ru'i gzhi la gser gyi mig mangs ris su bris pa sogs tshon sna brgya rtsa gcig gis bkra ba la/ ri dang nags tshal mtsho rdzing sogs dang / yid du 'ong ba'i srog chags sna tshogs dngabacas pa zhing khams kyi tshul du byed de/ rgyud 'di nyid las gnas kyi khyad par lha'i dga' tshal du gsungs pa sogs/ rgyud kyi gleng gzhi dang yang mthun no/ /'khyams ni ri rab kyi rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas mtshon la/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol nasade'i phyi mtha'i bar ni/ rgyud las phyi'i dkyil 'khor zhes gsungs pa de yin te/ dkyil 'bor zhesapa maṇ+ḍal zlum por gnas pa'i don yin no/ /'jig rten pa'i khor yug 'dri na kha dog ser por byed pa ni/ gser gyi sa gzhi mtshon la sa de la gling bzhi po ni nges par 'bri dgos te/ 'dzam bre'i glingadu tshangs pa 'bri/ zhes sogs dngos su gsungs pas so/ /lha'i rnam par bzhag pa lka ge tsobo rnamapar snang mdzad ni/ sku lus gcig la zhal bzhi pa'am/ kun du zhal gang du sgom kyang 'dra mod k+shisnga ma sgom stabs bde la/ phyogs kyi rgyal ba bzhi po yang sku mdog dkar po kho na te/ rgyud las/gtso bo dang 'khor gyi thog ma sbyong rgyal dkar po gsungs nas/ gzhan rnams de'i zhor la go bo'i dbang du mdzad pa'o/ /yum bzhi dang mchod pa'i lha mo rnams dang / sgo ma rnams mchog sgrub dkyusakyi nyams len la kha dog so sor byed/ gshin don sogs zhi ba'i las la ni gtso 'khor thams cad kyang dkar po bsngags so/ /mchod pa'i lha mo ni/ rgyud las/ mkhas pas lā phya la so gos pogo—12—

mchod pa grwa'i phyogs su bri/ zhes kun rig gi skabs gsungs shing / shāka thub kyi skabs na/ shrīrmophyogs rnams thams cad du/ bdug pa la sogs bri bar bya/ zhes gsungs nas/ bas na spos masogs bzhi po'i sngags kyang skabs der gsungs pas/ phan tshun kha bskang na brgyad ka 'god pa yang mi 'gal mod kyi/ dngos bstan ni so sor bgo mug 'a mdzad pa lta bur snang bas/ waṃrabadug spos ma la sogs pa mi 'god pa gtso che'o/ /lha rnams kyi bzhugs tshul ni/ slob dpon kun snying gis rdor dbyings sogs su bshad pa ltar gyi spar bkab ma ni 'dir sbyor mi dgos la/ khyad par rdo rje gnod sbyin ni zhi ba rang yin no/ /de sbom thung du byas na/ skabs 'dir sems da0mi'agyur khro bor 'gyur ba'i skyon yod la/ rgyud 'di'i lugs kyi 'khor gyi khro bo kun la dbu phyag mtha' yas pa sogs 'byung bas/ de der byas na sems dpa' ma myong ba sogs rnam ga theg thams cad 'khrugs par 'gyur ro/ /byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan rang rnams kun rig gi dkyil 'khor pa ma yin gyi/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor pa yin pa dang / khro bophonya mngags pa bran rnams la bzhi bzhi ste/ bcu drug po rnams kyang / me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyila'akhor pa dngos yin gyi 'di'i ma yin la/ lha chen gza' skar rgyal chen phyogs skyong sogs rang rang gi dgos kyi dkyil 'khor dang / 'khore los bsgyur ba la gsal bar gsungs pa'i lha yin glidakyil 'khor 'di'i ma yin no/ /de'i phyir de rnams la sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang khro bo khro mo dkar phyogs skyong ba dang bcas pa zhes/ spyi'i mos pas 'jug pa tsam ma gtogs/ bskyed chog gis mi bskyed pa nyid kun rig gi dkyil 'khor gyis thob thang rgyud kyi dgongs don dngos yin zhing / so so'i bskyed chog gis bskyed dgos na so so'i sngags kyang dgos par 'gyur la/ thams cad dkyil 'khor 'di la bsdu༅na/ dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la cho ga so sor gsungs pa dgos pa chung bar 'gyur bas/ 'ga' —13—

zhig lha tshogs mang btsam skye bo'i sngon du ngom pa ni g.yas chung ngo //'on kyang de dag gang yin snyaman/byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bcu drug ni/rdor dbyings sogs dang mtshung༅par bskal bzang bcu drug gam/sgyu 'phrul dra ba 'am gtsug dgu'i dkyil chog sogs dang mthunapar byas kyang rung tsam lags mod/'on kyang 'di ltar bzang ste/byams pa dang /kun tu bzang podang /phyag na rdo rje dang /blo gros chen po dang /zhi bar gshegs pa dang /nas mkha'i mdzod dgasgrib pa rnam sel dang /spyan ras gzigs te bgyod dang /nyan thos kyang /shāri budang/mo 'galagyi bu dang/'od srung chen po dang/ra pa 'byor dang /sgra gcan 'dzin dang /kun dag 'bo dadabazang ldan dang /ka pi na'o//rgyud las/nyan thos rgyal ba thams cad dang /zhes 'byung bas/rgyalab ni sangs rgyas yin pas/de bzhin gshegs pa me tog yang dag par skyes pa'i rgyal po'i dbang po dang /rin chen gtsug tor dang /gtsug tor can dang /thams cad skyob dang /leg pa dad seladang /gser thub dang /'od srung dang //spyan bzang stobargyan do//rang rgyas yang brgyad de/sposakyi ngad ldan dang /dman pa dang /'chi ltas dang /nye ba'i 'chi ltas dang /dkarma sprodang/dkarapo'i tog dang /mu khyud dang /mu khyud bzang po rnams so//yang sems dpa' bcu drug tu byed na yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin du byas na legs par 'gyur ro//khro bo sogs rgyud 'di rang du gsal la/kun rig gis skabs 'deramagron thabs kyi lha lags la 'debs dgos nges shes pa/tshangs pa ser po gdong bzhi ral pa'icod pan can/lag na dbyug pa dang spyi blugs/stod g.yogs dang tshangs skud can/'dzam bu glingan gnas pa/shar du brgya byin phyogs skyong gi nang na yod pa bzhin dang /byang du dbang phyug che skepogayas rtse gsum dang ḍā ma sa g.yon thod pa dang mda' gzhu 'dzin pa mdog thal ka'o/snyub spyo ni khyab 'jug sngon po 'khor lo dbyug tho pad+ma dung 'dzin pa'o//4

skar ma ni ri byi dang brtan pa la sogs pa dang / phra men dang bud med ces pag mkha'/'gro ma dang ma mo zhes pa'ang yod de/ don la ni srin mo nag mo la sogs pa ni phra men ma yin zhing/bud med ni 'jigs byed dgu'i chung ma sogs yin par rgyud 'di nyid rang las byung / rnal 'byoramayang rnal 'byor ma drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa'am/ bkra shis lha mo brgyad la sogs pa go /des na phra men ma ni lha min srin mo'i rigs yin la/ bud med ni lha'i srin mo'o/ /rnal 'byor mni de dgagi nang tshan rig sngags kyi mthu dang 'dod pa'i khams kyi ting nge 'dzin grub pa'i mngon shes rdzu'aphrul mthu stobs tshes che ba rnams so/ /gzhan rnams go sla ste dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i dus kyaga'akhyams la sangs rgyas byang sems rang rgyal nyan thos khro bo sogs dang / gser gyi khor yug la lha chen bzhi dang / g.yin 'jig rten pa rnams kyi gdan/ rdul tshon gyi tshom bu nges med sna tshogos dga'agod par bya yi/ nges bzung can mi dgos so/ /de bzhin du rgyud las 'jig rten pa'i phyag rgya bshad pa rnams/ dngos ni 'khor los bsgyuraba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas nas/ dkyil 'khor de'i cho ga la de dag gi phyag rgya bcing bdagos pa dang / yang 'jig rten pa de dag sgrub par 'dod na'ang de dang de'i phyag rgya dgos pe'i dbang du byas kyi/ thams cad rig pa'i cho ga la ni phyag rgya de dag mi dgos so/ /yang 'de dpyad de/rgyud 'di ni yo ga'i rgyud yin no zhes rlung ltar grags kyang / ye shes thig lo'i rgyud dpang por bzhag na/ jo bo rje dang sa paṇa gyi bzhed pa ltar spyod rgyud du 'thad pa kho na te/ gleng gzhi'i gnas lha yul tha mal par gsungs pa dang / mi'i skye ba la brten pa'i las 'bras kyi gtam rgyud phal pa 'byung ba sogs brjod byed tshig gi sgo nas kyang / rnal 'byor rgyud yan chad du 'gro rgyu min lkabarjod bya don gyi sgo nas kyang spyod rgyu nyid du gsal te/ dkyil chog wo po'i bdag bskyed gtso yo 'ba' zhig gsungs pa dang / dam tshig gi phyag rgyas lha nye bar byed pa tsam zhig yod cing / phyag rgya'i —15—

rgyas btab kyi grangs nges 'dir med pas so/ /'o na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i skabs na/ las kyi phyag rgya gsal bar bstan pa ma yin nam/ ji skad du/ de nyid gnyis su byas na las kyi'o/ /zhe༅'byung ba gang yin snyam na/ de ni phyag rgya bzhi'i nang gi las rgya ston pa ma yin gyi/ las kyi'o zhes pa las 'chol ba'i don gyi phyag rgya'o/ /zhes pa'i don no/ /des na 'dir pre skad pa ltar/ dam tshig gi phyag gyo byin gyis brlabs pa dang / las bcol gyi skabs 'gar sngon 'gro'i dam tshig gi phyag rgyas/lha'i thugs rgyud bskul pa tsam yin gyi/ dam rgyas rgyas 'debs pa'i tha snyad kyang 'dir mi mdzad na/phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas btab lta ci smos la/ spyir lha so so'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya tsam ni/ bya ba'i rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud chen po rnams la rab tu grags so/ /des na 'di spyod rgyud nyid kyi cha nas ma shas yan lag gi rgyud yin gyi/ cho ga rgyas pa ston pa rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rigs min yang / spyi ldog nas rnamasnang mngon byang sogs las cung zad theg pa rigs mtho ba/ rgyud sde gong ma dang mtshams sbyor bapo'i spyod rgyud shes par bya'o/ /de la skabs 'dir rgyun bshags yan chad sngar dang 'dra bar bya/ bris sku la brtan bzhugs byas nas lha rnams bzhugs su gsol te/ tshad med bzhi'i don yid la bsam pa nas khyinyu khakhrig zhesapa'i bar bdag bskyed gong bzhin bya ste/ spyod rgyud lugs la bdag bskyed ni mdun bskyed kyi snga phyi gang du byed ma nges par yod pa las sgrub pa'i dus 'dir ni bris sku dang / dkyil 'khor gyi par du byed pa ste/ de rjes shu rgyu tas stong par sbyangs/ oṃ bha zhes brjod de/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su zin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang / gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa them skas bzhis brgyan pa/ nang nasarim pa bzhin du/ sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bskor ba/ de'i steng du dra ba dang drab —16—

phyed pa'i gzhi dang / shar bu dang mda' yab kyis bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i phyi ro' 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i gzungs ma dang bcas pa sgo khang bzhi'i steng du rta babs rgyan dang ldan pa/ 'degs byed kyi ka ba'i ngos la glang seng brtsegs pas brgyan pa/ sgo gdong gi ka ba brgyad dang / glang rgyab rnams kyi nang du/ shar du rdo rje/ ltor rin po che/ nub pad+ma/ byang du rgya gram mo/ /phyi rolagyi 'khyams la yang / skyed mos tshal dang / khrus kyi rdzing bu dang/ me tog dang /rin po che dang / mchod rdzas du mas gang ba'i/ rin po che'i gzhi la tshone snabagyortsas mig mang ris su bris pa'o/ /gzhal yas khang gi steng du rim par phub cing rtse mor tog gis brgyan pa/ steng 'og gi gzhi shar sngo/ lto ser nub dmar byang ljang dbus dkar ba gzhal yas khang gi nang du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu drug pa/ de'i dbus su 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad pa/ dbus kyi lte ba larin po che'i bzhugs khri/ mdun ngos su rdo rjes brgyan pa la pad+ma dang zla ba/ debazhin gshe/gas pa bzhi la pad zla'i gdan/ gzhan rnams la zla ba'i bdan rere'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du oX las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad zhal bzhi pa/ phyogs bzhin hāXphaṭa a traṭa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du rgyal mchog sbyong ba'i rgyalagoltor rgyal mchog rin po che/ nub tu rgyal mchog shākya thub pa/ byang du rgyalamachog me tog ste/ rgyal ba thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po mnyam ba thegagophyag rgya mdzad pa/ shar lhor spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo mig 'bras kyis mtshan —17

pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu mā ma gī sngon mo rdo rje 'dzin pa/ nub byang du gos dkaramo dmar mor pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sgrol ma ljang khu ut+pal 'dzin pa/rtsibs bcu drug po rnams la/ shar du spruX las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdorje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dzaXlas rdo rje rgyal po ser po lcags kyu hoXlas rdo rje chags pa dmar po mda' gzhu: dhu las rdo rje legs pa ljang khu se gol gyi smabyed pa: lho ru t+yāX las rdo rje rin chen ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ r+ya las rdo rje gzi brjid dmar so nyi ma'i dkyil ge rgor/ za las rdo rje tog tshu po rgyal mtshan: ha las rdo rje bzhad pa dkar po so'i 'phreng ba: nub tu gyiXlasardo rjes chos dmar po g.yon pad+ma mdzin zhing g.yas de'i kha 'byed pa2dhīXlasardo rje rnon po sngon po ral gri dang po ti kruX las rdo rje rgyu ser po rnya lo bha las rdo rjer smra ba zangs mdog rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ljags: byang du kaX las rdo rje las sna tshogs mdog sna tshogs gis rdo rje dang dril bu: raX las rdo rje bsrung ba go khrab k+ṣaX las rdo rje gnod sbyin nag po mche ba gnyis: saX las rdorje khuradam tshig gi khu tshur gyis rdo rje ser po rtse lnga pa 'dzin pa/ yang na rgyud 'edir gsung pa'i sems dpa' bcu drug po thams cad/ rdo rje sems dpa' kho na'i rnam 'gyur yin zhing/phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang sku mdog dkar po yod pa'i phyir/ sems dpa' bcu drug po thams cad sku mdog dkar po byas kyang legs so/ /phyi rol grwa bzhir shar lhor huX las sgeg mo dkar mo/ lho nub tu traX las 'phreng ba ma ser mo/ nub byang du khroXlas mar me ma dmar mo/ byang shar du a las dri chab ma ljang khre'o/rde /a kri dngosabastan ni bzhi po de rnams kho na yin la/ bdug spos ma la sogs pa bzhi po yang / sogs khong la—18—

brten nas 'god du rung ba'ang yin mod/ sgeg sogs bzhi kho nas chog go /sgo bzhir shar sgor dza las lcags kyu ma dkar mo/ lho sgor hū las zhags pa ma ser lo/ /nub sgor ba las lcags sgrog ma dmar mo/ byang sgor ho las dril bu ma ljang khu'o/ /phyi rol kyi 'byams la/ byams pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / sangs rgyas rnams dang / nyon thos rnams dang / ra pasangs rgyasarnams dang / khro bo/ mngags pa/ pho nya/ bran rnams dang / gling bzhi dang gser gyi khor yug la/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga pa sogs pa/ 'jig rten pa dkyil 'khor la mngon par dad pa dpag tu med pa rnams kyang gnas par gyur/gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ gdod nas grub pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khore la/ sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang 'phags tshogs dpagatumed pas bskor ba spyan drangs par mos/ dzigs cad kyi spros pa byed da lo rgom blodangasbyar/ dza / ba ho bha ga wān mahā kwa ru ṇa she ṣa dṛ shu ho zhes lan gsum la sogs pas ji ltar dmigs pa gsal zhing yid tshes pa'i bar du sbyan drangs/ yak+ṣa 'am/ a mṛ tas bsangs/mchod yon/ gdan 'bul/ nyer spyod la sogs pa phul nas/ oṃ badz+ra a kusha dza oṃ badz+rapā sha hū/ oṃ badz+ra spoṭa ba/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha hoX gnyis su med par thim/lharnams kyi thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon gsal btab/ gtso bo nas dril bu ma'i bar du so so'i dam rgya bcas sngags lan gsum gsum brjod/ dam la bzhag /gnas gsum byin rlabs dbangabaskur rgyas btab sngar bzhin bya/ bris sku'i yul bkod rnams rang rang gis sgom pa'i 'khyams dang 'dres shes/ bris sku'i lha rnams rang gi mdun du bzhugs pa ni/ bris sku'i gtso bo dang dkyila'akhor gyi gtso bo gcig gi gtso bo gcig tu gyur pa la/ sbyong rgyal shākya thub pa/ lha mo bzhi yang de —19—

dang 'dra/sman rgyal dang rang nyid thad mnyam/gtso bo kun rig rang bas cung zad mtho bdang/gzhan rnams gco bo'i drung na yod par bsam/de nas mchod pa gsar du bsham/byin gyisabasas te/mdun bskyed ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor dang /bdag dang brisasku'i lha thams cad la mchod par bsam nas/chu ga snya nyer spyod ma rdzo pa wo lngapasogs glo par phul/bstod pa/mnyam nyid mi g.yo ma dang /ma rmag brgyas bo stod da/rdorje sems dpa' sems dpa' che sogs/sems dpa' bcu drug gi mtshan brgyas kyang bstod na rung ste spyir rgyud sde gong ma'i cho gas 'og ma la kha mi skong ba yin kyang /bstod pa tsam la 'gal ba med cing /thun mong gi chos gzhan la'ang de dang 'dra rung ba mang du yod pa dang /rgyud rdze'i ngo bospyod pa'i rgyud yin kyang /ngan song spyong ba'i sgo dang /don gyi cha shas so so'i sgo nas rma sde ca tu'agro ba'ang yin pas/de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud tshig las skabs su babs pa dag 'dir drangs na mi 'gal ba'ang yod de/slar yang khu tshur kha phye khar sngon 'gro'i gtso bo nas dril bu ma'i bar dusoso'i dam rgya bcings la/sngags lan gsum mam re re song ba'i mthar phrin las bcog de nasabazlas pa ni/gtso bo'i bzlas pa'i dmigs pa dngos/nyer sgrub kyi skabs kyis rigs 'gre/'khor gyi bzlas pa la/gtso bo'i thugs ka'i snying po'i mthar 'khor ra gyi sngags kyi yig 'bru bkod/'khor so so nyid kyi thugs kar yang sa bon sngags kyi yiga'abru sgra dang bcas pa bsgom/de las 'od zer 'phros/mdun bskyed kyi lha dngathugs ka'i sngags la mchod pa sogs gong nyer sgrub dang 'dra/khyad par du ne la ba kho 'khor so so'i sngags bzla ba'i skabs yin yang rung /gtso bo kho na'i bzlas pa yin yang rung/thams cad kyi thun mong du rtsa rig bzla ba yin yang rung ste/sngags brgya rtsa bgyod re song ban/bgrang phreng bris sku'i mdun du 'jog pa'am/me tog gtor kyang rung /yang sngags de nyid tshar20

gcig bzlas pas/ snying ga'i sngags 'phreng las 'od kyi gong bu zhig byung ste/ de nyid gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ dngos su bshams pa dang yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod bstod byas la/ mgo bo sa la gtso/sa te/ bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed la bdag gis sngags kyi nor bu phul ba lags kyi/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag la myur du dngos grub stsaladu gsol/ zhes sogs gdung ba drag pos gsol ba btab/ yi dam lha'i thugs kanasa'od zer byung lus thams cad gang / snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim pagasngags 'bru rnams bkrag rgyas shing nyams bde ba dang ldan par gyur par bsam/thun mtshams kyi skabs dkyil lubor mchod cing gsol ba btang nas brtan bzhugs byas/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam pas thun mtshams kyi spyong byed par bsam/snang rnams la'ang / rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kar thim/mchod bstod byas te bzlas pa la 'jug /de nas thun tha ma bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mchod bstod byas nas gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od gsal du bsdud nas bsrung ba byed pa sogs gong dubashad pa'i rigs 'gre'o/ /de ltar wo re bzhin bslab cing thun mtshams kyi spyod pa sngar dnga'agasgrub pa 'di yang dus kyis 3 la nges pa med de/ dngos grub shin tu nye ba'i lhos byang gi bar tsugo/de ltar yang rgyud las/ de nas dben pa'i gnas su ni/ /brgya rtsa bgyod ni tshang bar sga de bo(grub ma byung bar du ni/ /sngags ni 'bral 'khrul med par bzlas/ /ces gsungs nag 'i deradaben pa'i gnas smos pa ni/ bsnyen pa nyer bsnyen gnyis kyi skabs gnas kyi mtshan nyid bka'ayangs la/ sgrub pa nas brtsams te gnas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gal che bar dgongs go tapemang po las brgyad brgya nyid du tshang bar bya/ zhes 'a glang ba ltar na/ sngags brgyad brgya brgyan bgyo—21—

song ba na/lhag pa'i lha la nor bu 'bul ba'i don yin pa'ang brgya rtsa zhes pa dag par mngon chod/gyo skad la ji ltar yod brtag dgos pa'ang yin no//dngos grub ma byung bar zhes pa ni/skra'i rgosapa ston pa la sogs pa dngos grub nye ba'i ltas ma byung bar zhes pa'o//'dir gang la brten mi gsal ba ni/bris sku'am phyi'i dkyil 'khom ra gang byas kyang rung gi gcig kho na nges bzung du mi dgos pa'i don no//bzhi pa sgrub wo la/kun rdzob mtshan bos kyi sgrub wo dang don dam mtshanamed kyi sgrub chen gnyis so//dang po ni/spyir btang tsam du phyi'i dkyil 'khor la nges par ltos pa yin la/dmigasagasal du gang zag sgrub pa po tshes dbang po rno bdang /sngon gyi bsod nams kyi stobs las dnga'aphral gyi bzlas brjod mchod pa sogs tshogs gyo chen pos/lha rnams shin tu nye bar gyur pa dgagasal snang 'grub pa tsam po ma yin par/gsal snang nus par shar ba ste gsum 'dzom pa g.yid kyi sgoms pa kho nas kyang phyi'i dkyil 'khor lam stos par 'grub bo//'on kyang phyi'i dkyil 'khore sgrub dgos pa spyir btangs kyi dbang du byas na/sa chog/stagon/dkyil 'khor 'bri ba/sgrub pa'i cho ga la 'jug pa dngos grub blang ba/rjes kyi bya ba ste drug go/dang po ni/rgyud las/gtsugardelag khang dang skyed mos tshal//mchod rten lha khang kun dga' sogag/dzibazhin pa yi cho ga yis//gnas ni byin gyi rlabs pa tsam/zhes lo tsho(zhin gsus/te/sa brtag pa ni spyi dang 'dra yang /gong du smos pa'i de rnams su brtag mi dgos so//dang por cha gsum nang gi 'byung po spyi'i gtor ma dang /dgos su gzhi bdag gtor ma btang ste/sal rgyu ba'i 'byung po dang /ces sogs sam/gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu go sogasakyi lan mang du gsol ba btab cing sa gzhi blang /de rjes bskor sbyangs byed pa sogs spyi dang 'dra ste/'on kyang gtsug lag khang sogs su mi dgos/༵ bas sngags kyi sbyang ba la bgegs gtor btang

zhing bgegs bskud/sa gzhi byi dor byas pa la yungs kar dang /chu dang shing thal rnams/kyi gtorazhing /badz+ra satwa kro dha'i sngags lan mang du bzlas/de nas bzung ba ni de phyogs te dri bzang gis byugs la/sgrub pa po'i lag gis rdo rje bzung bzhin pas/tso rna dza ya gi stiṣa/tshwa'/dzol/ban+ta ban+ta/da ma da ma/hūXhūX hūX/hoXhan huX/zhes pa rgyal ba'i gtsug tor gyi sngags dang /oṃ ru ru sbu ru dz+wa la rnga sogs/sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags mang du bzlas te/sna sgrub grags g.yin zhin gam med na rang nyid kyis bar bar pa'i rnam lnga dang dri bzang gi chus gsang gtor bya/slar yang satwa kro dha'i sngags bzlas te/dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i dbus dang mtshams bzhinaphus btab po/bsrung ba ni/rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra gur rnams kyis bskor sa mos/oṃkulwan dha ri ban+ta ban+ta huX phaṭa/ces mang du brjod/de ltar na sa brtag blangs sbyab༅bzungabasrung ba ni de tsam zhig go/dkyil 'khor sgom pas sa bzung ba ni thob tshod la mi dgos shing /choga'i sprod pa gzhan rnams kyang rnal 'byor rgyud yan chad kyi yin pas/'dir ni gsang ba spyi rgyud las ji skad gsungs pa tsam bya'o//gnyis pa sta gon la/sa lha sta gon spyi dang 'dra ba las/sa'i lha mo'i dam tshig pa bskyed pami dgos so//gtor ma nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas 'bul lo//lha sta gog ni/dkyil 'khoragyi sa gzhi'i gnas su bris sku bkram/ma chod pa bsham/khro bo'i sngags kyi bsangs/gnas dang yo byas byin gyi rlabs/yang na gdan gyi jon du lha tshogs dang mthun pa'i tshom bu bkod kyang legs/sangs rgyas byang chub sems da ri'/ thams cad spyan drangs par mos la/ma lusasogs brjod cing /gdan 'bul ba'i bar du bya/gtso bo'o snying po nas dril bu ma'i sngags kyi b.radang /lha so so'i grangs dang mthun pa'i rtsa rig bzlas/sangs rgyas byang chub sems / dpa' rnams gcig tu 'dus pa dkyil sprerwa sri gyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par gyur nas/

bris sku lugs sku sogs dang 'dres te bzhugs pa'am/tshom buX /steng du bzhugs par mos/rigs gas ltar mchod bstod phul la/thams cad 'igaX/pa bcom ldan 'das//ga she rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ lo//zhes pa nas/byan gyas rlabs par mdzad du gsal/gyi bar snyan gsan phab/yang mchod bstod gsol ba btab nas gshegs su gsol/bum pa sta gon ni/mchod bum la sta gon mi dgos pas/dbang gi busapa lnga dang rnam rgyal bum pa dri nga rdong ku rdo/ chus bkang /snying po dang ldan par byas/ri'i sa ga bhūX las bskyed pa sogs spyi dang 'dra/ ta ste ta ste mahā ta ste sogs lan bdun gyis lha'i chubasagang bar bsam/oX badz+ra shi ṣa re na ye/ ma ṭa/lo ma can gyi lcug ma'i kha brgyan bzhagathams cad la spos kyis bdugs te me tog dkar po gtor//me tog phreng ba'i gzungs thag busapa re re bzhin spos la/dang por rnam rgyal gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags brgya rtsa re bzla/sa mong du rtsa rig brgya rtsa bzlas/dbang bum lnga la gco bo'i snying po da/ spyong rgyal sogs bzhi'i sngags so sor ji ltar 'os pa bzla/thams cad kyi thun mong du a bhi ṣa ka bzla/bar chad bsrung ba'i don du gtsug tor rgyal ba'i sngags kyang bzla la/lha'i gzugs su bskyed pa med kyang sngags nyid lha yin pa'i phyir mthar mchod bstod gsol btab rnams bya'o//gsum pa dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/thig tshon gtsang ma ba byung dang dri bzang gi chus gtor/a tsho ta mang du bzlas pas bsangasa~Xbhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/thig tshon la huX gis mtshan par mos/te/ badz+ra satwa hūXdang /rtsa rig mang du bzlas pas byin gyis rlabs/a no n+ya sogs kyis thig skud sgril ba dang /'ig tshon byin rlabs kyi sngags sogs spyi dang mthun par byas na'ang rung bar me bi/ no//de nas thig gdab cing rdul tshon dgye bar bya ste/skabs 'dir rgyud las/phyi yi sgo 'khyud 9ri :sku/ ‘rirnams kyas brgyan//dgu char na /sngis pa las//sgo dang sgo khyud sum char

bya/ /zhes/ 'byung ba las/ bod snga phyi dag 'dod tshul mi gcig pa shin tu mang yag gzhud go tshigadon la zhugs pa ni ye ma snang ngo / /de dag gi nang nas sngon gyi 'dod tshul cig /dgu yis zhes byed pa'i sgra yod pa/ dgu yi zhes drug sgrar bco se nas/ dgu'i char bgos pa ni dbus le tse dgazhi mingayin la/ de'i rgya la cha chen gsum yod cing / sgo dang sgo 'byud la de'i gsum cha ste mchenas khrinayin no/ /zhes zer ba 'di/ gzhung chig thad ka de'i 'bru gnon 'grig rung tsam byug 'o dod tshulāgazhan thams cad ni tshig don gnyis ka la mi 'grig pa sha stag snang ngo / /de lta mod kyi gzhudagodagongs pa ni de yang ma yin te/ re mig dgur byed pa rgyud kyi dgongs pa ma yin pa dad 'i de ni dkyil 'khor ra gyi phyi gtan la 'bebs byed yin gyi/ nang gi dkyil 'bor gyi skabs ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /phyi dang nang gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa yang / rtsa 'ig gi phyi nang ngam rtsig pa'i phyi nang gi don yin gyi/ dkyil 'khor sgo sbrag gi don gtan nas min no/ /yang rnam pa cig tu na/ phyag na rdo rje dbangabaskur ba'i rgyud las/ ye shes 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor der/ /cha ni rnam pa gsum du bya/ /blo dang ldan pas cha gsum du/ /der ni sgo khrud rnams bya ste/ /der ni sgo yang bzhi gtod do/ /zhes 'byung ba dang / tshig lam phal cher mthun pa ltar 'dug pas/ sgo dkyil 'khor gyidagucha'i tshad du bshad pa dang bstun na rung ba tsam zhig kyang yod mod kyi/ re zhig spyi dang mthun parabarjod na/ dgu yi char bgos zhes pa ni/ sgo'i thad na dbus dang g.yas g.yon sdoms pas thigadagu yod ces bya'o/ /thig dgu po de'i gsum cha ni 'phred la sgo'i zheng dang / dpangs su sgo khyud kyidakyus yin no zhes pa'i don yin la/ des na 'di ni sgo dang sgo 'phyud dang sgo 'gram dang sgo logasatshad mnyam par byas pa har sgo yin no/ /sgo khang gi rgya tshad 'chad pa'i dbang du byas nas/ sgo logasanas sgo los sa kyi bar gyi nang mtha' la cha chen gsum yod cing / de'i gsum cha ste cha chen gcig ni rtsa thig gi thad kyi sgo dang / sgo 'khyud kyi nang mtha' nas phyi mtha'i bar dang / sgo khyud gnyis kyi bar—25—

stongs sgo phugs kyi zheng tshad yin no/ /'o na thig dgu po gang zhe na/ /cha dang po phyed gdab phyimagadab kyi dang po'i phyed rtsig pa'i nang thig dang / phyi ma gdab sgo khyud kyi rtsig pa'i phyi thig dang/de dang sgo logs kyi nang thig gi bar na cha chung gis mtshams su 'ig mnyam ste/ de ltar g.yas sungadzidang g.yon du bzhi/ dbus kyi tshangs thig dang dgu'o/ /des na sgo logs kyi thig gi nang du thig dgus cha brgyad du bgo zhing / thig dgus bgos pa'i bzhi sgo logs kyi nang mtha' gnyis la nimachen gsum gyi rgya yod la/ de'i gsum cha sgo yin zhes pa ste/ sgo logs kyi nang thig ni bgo ba'i gzhi yin gyi bgos byed ma yin pas thig dgu la mi bgrong ngo/ phyi'i sgo khyud rnams kyi gyon zhes pa ni rtsig pa'i phyi rol du/ /sgo khyud la sogs pa rnams kyis bgyon zhes pa'i don te/ sgo 'gram sgo logs rta babs la sogs pa glo 'bur du 'thon pa'i tshul du gnas pa'o/ /rnams zhes pa mang tshig lte sogasardesgra dang 'dra'o/ /yang rgyud las/ dbus kyi dkyil ga bor thig btab pa/ /chos kyi dkyil 'khor 'dre ba la/ /lte bar bcas shing rtsibs bcu drug /rim pa gsum dang ldan pa la/ /rtsibs ni nyis 'gyuranyid du bya/ / dbus kyi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nang gi zlum skor te/ rtsibs nyis 'gyur zhes pasa'akhor ra lo rim pa gnyis yod pa gsal lo/ /rim pa gsum zhes pa/ gtso bo'i gnas dag de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i gnas dang / sems dpa' bcu drug gi gnas te gsum po'i mthar mu khyud re res bskor ba'o/ /'o na 'dis 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug pa'i lte ba dang / rtsibs dngayukhyud de gsum bstan pa min nam zhe na/ ma yin te de ltar na/ rim pa bzhi yin par 'gyur bdagadabus su le tshe'i phyi skor gyi gdung zlum po yod pa yin na/ rtsibs nyis 'gyur du byas pa don med par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /ci ste lte ba'i thad kyi rgya khyon rtsibs kyi nyis 'gyur zhes smra ba yin na/rigs lnga'i gnas shin du chung ba'i skyon du 'gyur zhing / dbus kyi re mig dgu ston byed zur tsa5yang med pas/ de sgrub byed du 'god pa/ sgrub byed sgrub bya dang mtshungs te ma grub pa go /dgu yi —26—

char ni bgos zhes pas de 'dra bstan pa ma yin no/ /le tshe dgu ni dbus dang phyogs mtshamasasugling dgur byas pa yin gyi/ / cha dgur bgos zhes pa ni/ dgu po 'phred dam dkyus gang lartsiyang / mu de la dgu yod pa zhig dgos so/ /dper na cha bcu drug tu bgos zhes pa bzhin no/ /remig dgu la ni/ mu ded gcig la thig bzhi re las med cing / g.yas g.yon gnyis ka le go kyang thig brgyad las med pa'i phyir/ cha shas dgur ji ltar bgos/ de bas na 'di ltar bya ste/ rtsa thig gi nang du lha snam 'jog pa dang mi 'jog pa gnyis las/ 'jog na lte ba nas g.yas g.yon du cha chen gsum pa bzhi pa gnyis kyi mtshams dang / gnyis pa'i steng dang /dang po'i steng nas skor thig bya/de dag re re bzhin gyi nang du/ cha chung phyed kyi mu 'byud dang / /nang ma nang ma'i phyi rol du de tsam gyi lteb re yang skor/ /rtsibs kyi thig spyi dang 'dra'o/ /lha snam mi byed na/ dbus kyi lte bskor lugs bshad ma thag pa de dang 'dra ba las/ cha chung gcig phyi rol khor yug tu skor/ de'i phyi rol mchungalnga nas/ 'khor lo nang ma'i mu khyud kyi nang thig skor zhing / de nas cha chung phyed nas mu khyud kyi phyi thig skor ro/ /de nas cha chung phyed kyis 'khor lo phyi ma'i lte bskor/ de nas cha chung lnga rtsa thigaldoreg mtshams su 'khor lo phyi ma'i mu khyud kyi phyi thig dang / de'i nang du cha chung phyed kyi nang thig skor/gtso bo'i gnas kyi phyi rol tu cha chung phyed kyi 'khor lonang ma'i lte ba skor ro/ /gzhal yas khangaṣ+ka'abyams kyi phyi rol du/ 'jig rten pa'i khor yug cha chen gcig gis tshad tsam skor zhing/de'i stengadu phyogs bzhi gling bzhi gling phran brtaganyis kyi gzugs bya'o/ /rta babs snam bu'i grangs ni dmigs bsal med pas ci bder bya la/ gzhan rnams spyi dang mthun no/ /de nas tshon dgye ba ni/'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ zhes sogs brjod cing 'bri ste/ 'jig rten pa'i khor yug ser ge'abyams ljang khu/ rtsig pa nang nas rim pas sngo ljang ser dmar dkar ba/ glang rgyab kyi nang sngonasgo'akhor lo phyi nang gnyis kyi rtsibs kyis bar rnams phyogs mdog /gtso bo'i gnas kyi gzhi dkar—27—
