po'o//dbus kyi sangs rgyas lnga la lha mawo/'khor lo rdo rje rin po che/pas rgya gram rnams bri/gzhan rnams go sla'o//de ltar bris zin ma thag tu/thig tshon lhag ma yig brgya bzla bzhenapubakur bsti 'byung ba'i gnas su bzhag go/bzhi pa sgrub pa'i cho ga la 'jug pa ni/bod kyi 'tha/len dang mthun par dkyil 'bor la bgegs sbyangs pa yang byas na legs/gang ltar yang khro bo me ltar 'bar ba'i sngags dang /gtsug tor rgyal nga dang /lha mo sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags rnamasakyidakyil 'khor dang /gnas khang dang yo byad thams cad la bsangs gtor bya/mchod pa tshwa/pa sna tshogs pa rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin bshams/mchod pa'i bum pa bcu drug gis mtha' bskor/mawor na bam do//yig brgya bzla bzhi du rol mo'i sgra dang thos te/bum pa rnams dkyila'akhor lag yas skor du bskodzor zhing /dbang bum lnga po rang rang gi sngags bzla bzhin pas bzhugs/ su gsol ba las/sbyong rgyal sogs bzhi po phyogs bzhi dang /gtso bo'i de de'i mdun du stegs mtho pal bzhag go/de dag bskyod du rung la rnam rgyal bum pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su le gi/ pa'am/de mi bde na shar sgo'i phyi rol ma ni la sogs pa'i steng du bas/re ṣ+ka rdza swod mibyed do//gzhan sa gyon gnam gyon sogs kyang bkram/bdug spos btul/zhing byur bsal ba o/de yang tso par na drug bzhi ldan dang /bsdu na til sbyangs tsam mo//snyud rtsi 'khyil ba bzlasapa'i khrus bum gyi khrus gsol bya/dkyila'akhorder khang pa'i nang mtha' la kha zas bzang rgu'i gtoramasna tshogs pa'ang bsham mo//ma rdzo pa sa mi 'chad pa 'bul dgos pas ma rdzo rdzas kyi rgyu tshogasadang /sbyin sreg dpa phyi rol gtor ma'i tho rnams kyang ltas 'og tu chud par bya'o/de nasabadag nyid bsnyen pa'am nyer sgrub kyi snabs su bshad pa ltar gyi nyams len byas nas/rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/oṃ badz+ra sam ya hūṃ/zhes rdo rje shugs kyi 'jug pas ga kha po yas28

khang gi nang du zhugs par mos/shar gyi lha snam la 'dug nas/mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khorabasangs/shu rgyu tas stongs par sbyangs ba nas/bzlas pa'i bar du gong sgrub pa'i skabs dang tsā ba las/gal te ras bris ma bkram na/de la dmigs pa de mi dgos so//las bo 'khru/bamathag/oṃ badz+ra sam ya'i sngags dang /rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgyas gtso bo'i drung du rtsi/rdo rje sems dpa 'a'am me tog phog pa'i lha'am rnam snang gi nga rgyal laganas pas/bzlas pa byed tshulasogs dmigs pa phal cher sgrub pa'i skabs dang 'dra/bzlas pa ji ltar 'os pa song ban/mchod pa rnying pa kha gso/gsar pa bshams shing byin gyis brlabs nas//sngags dang phyag rgyadang ting nge'adzin gyi mchod pa rgyas pa re 'bul//mnyam nyid mi g.yo ma dpa/mtshan brgya gnyis lta ga rgyud las 'byung ba'i bstod pa res bstod//dngos grub kyi don dug sol ba drag tu btab//sngar gyi nor bu 'bul ba skabs 'dir mi dgos/lha thams cad kyi thugs ka nas sngags 'phreng 'od zer dngabacas pa byung ste/rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la bsdu ba'i dmigs pa yang yang bya/bzlas(pastong sogs ji ltar 'os pa song ba na/gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du phyin par mos te/sbyin sreg gi/ cho gas sbyin sreg phul/sgrub khang gi phyi rol du song nas/cha gsum lta bus 'byung po'i tshogs lagator ma rgya cher byin/yang nye reg byas nas nang du 'ongs/rdo rje 'dzin mas bzhugs bdaga'ajug ltar cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa'am/nang 'jug man chad dam/dbang dngos gzhi tsam ngesapar blangs te/sngon bzhin bzlas pa bya'o//thun bzhin dbang blang thub na bzang /de tsam ma grubarden/tho rangs nas nam langs kyi bar de la ldan re bzhin tshar re nges par blang bar bya'o/khrina'ajog khar gsol ba drag tu btab ste/rang nyid phyi rol du byung bar bsam/gzhan sngar gyi rna5sadang 'dra/der bzlas pa 'bum tsam song spun/skal ldan mchog yin na/'phral mkhon ra des/ grub 'byung ba'i ltas 'gyung bas/skya rengs shar ba nas brtsams te/lngin gcig mtshan gcig hril29

gyi bzlas brjod thun gcig bar ma chad par bya/ mchod pa yang yid kyis bya ba kho na las gsang pa gzhams pa'i spros pa mi dgos/ de'i skya rengs dang po ma shar tshun chad du/ lhag pa'i lha gang yin pa de'i zhal ston zhing / gter la sogs pa'i dngos grub lha nyid kyis dngos su stsol bar 'gyur rdo /yang gal te cung zad dbang po dman pa'am 'bring tsam yin na/ snga rol bzlas pa 'bum tsam byed pa'i skabs der/ lhag pa'i lhas rmi lam du dngos grub lung ston par 'gyur la/ shin tu dbang podaman pa la khyod kyis dngos grub mi 'grub ste/ zhi sogs phra mo'i las 'di lta bu 'grub ces pa'am/blo gros thogs pa med pa'am/ rgyal srid thob par lung ston pa'ang yod do/ /'bring po yin na rdzas la brten pa'i dngos grub ral gri mig sman la sogs pa 'di lta bu sgrub cig ces gsungs pa'ang yod do/ /rdzas kyi dngos grub de yang lhas lung bstan pa zhig sgrub dgos pas/ dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang ma 'brel ba yang yod/ dkyil 'khor gzhan la brten nas sgrub dgos pa'ang yod/ kun rig nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas sgrub chog pa srid kyang / dkyil 'khor gsar du bzhengs pa labarten nas sgrub dgos pa'ang yod pa/ phra mo ni de tsam gyis 'grub la/ dngos grub mi sgrub pa'idabang du byas pa dang / dkyil 'khor rgyas pa lam brten pa'i dngos grub dang / dkyil 'khor gzhan la brten pa dang / dkyil 'kho ra gsar pa bzhengs dgos pa yin na/ lung bstan pa byung mthag shāsngar gyi mchod gtor sbyin sreg gi rgyu la dmigs pa thams cad/ dus cig tu nyer spyod dang gtoramadang spyi sreg la phul/ nam phyed nas tho rangs kyi bar du bzlas pa dang / gsol btab drag tu byasanas/ rjes chog gi rim pas nyi ma ma shar ba nyid du dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol grub par bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gsar pa bzhengs rgyu yin na/ zhag 'ga' bzlas brjod dang bcas ngal gsobar byas nas/ slar yang dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas las la sbyor te/ dkyil 'boragazhan la brten nas byed kyang rim pa de dang 'dra'o/ /dkyil 'khor rgyas pa la ma brten pa'i do so/ —30—

grub sgrub tshul ni/ so so'i sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar bya yi/ 'dir bri bar mi lag de rigasal dngos grub kyi don du las la sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i sgrub chen dngos ma yin no/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi 'phros las sgrub pa'am/ dkyil 'khor gsar pa bzhengs te sgrub kyang rung / rdzas kyi ge sdosagrub la dper mchon na/ snod gtsang ma la bsangs gtor byas/ dri zhim pos byugs la ba maragasar pa 'o ma srub pa'i dus nas bsangs gtor dang bsrung ba byas bzhin pa'i mar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzla bzhin pa dang / gu gul gyis bdug cing / khro bo'i sngags bzlas pe khro ras gtsang mas g.yogs/ rang gi grib ma dang ma bral bar byas te/ sgrub khang du de bzhu nas zhun mar gyi snying khur byas pa/ sngar gyi snod bzang po der blug snod ma khengs pa dang / srang ga khrig ni tshad lasanyung ba mi rung / snod du blug ma zin par la sems ma yengs par khro bo'i sngags rgyun du bzla dgos/snod du blug ma thag bsrung ba byas te/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus sam shar sgo'i nang du bzhan go /de nas sngar bzhin las bzlas pa'i dus na/ lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas yig 'bru 'od zer dang bcas pa byung nas rdzas la char bab pa bzhin du gyur par bsam/ lag pa g.yon rdo rje dang bcas pas/rdzas de dngos su gnon pa'am mnan par bsam nas/ yun srings te bzla/ 'di skabs zhan rerasbyin sreg lan re dang / phyi rol gyi gtor ma lan res chog nyer spyod rgya cher bshams pa dang / yid kyi sprul pa'i mchod pa dang / bzlas sgom la gtso bor byed/ de nas mi ring bar dngos grub 'byo/pa'i mtshan ma rang gi mthong bar 'gyur te/ sngon bzhin zhag gcig sgrubs pas rtags mtshan 'byung ste/ zhun mar khol ba'am rlangs pa byung na tha ma dri zhim ldang ba'am/ du ba byung na 'bring / 'od dang me 'bar ba sogs mchog yin te/ de byung na sngags bzlas pa'i mar gsar zhig de'i nang du blug lasngags bzla bzhin rdo rje'am shing bus g.yas skor du dkrugs pa lta bu byas te/ da dung brtan byed du sngags mang du bzla bzhin du rang ngam gtso lnga'i sdigs mdzub kyis mnan par bsam/ nam langs —31—

ma thag tu bsrung ba byas nas/ dkyil 'khor la mchod pa phul/ rdzas kyi dang po nas snoco/ sam yid kyi dkyil 'khor ra la phul/ lhag pa'i lhas rdzas de bdag la stsal bar bsam ste/ 'thu pas na dbos grub tu 'gyur te/ mtshan ma rab kyis tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa'i lha'i lus su 'gyur ba dad 'bring gis kyang mi snang bar 'gyur ba dang / tha mas kyang gter dang longs spyong dbang du byed pa sogasadang / las bzhi 'grub par 'gyur/ mtshan ma ma byung na yang cho ga 'dis de ltar sgrubs na/ tshe ringazhing rgas pa med pa dang shes rab 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /dang por dngos grub zhugs pa'i rtags ni/dkyil 'khor dang rdzas la 'od yul yul ba dang / sgra ci rigs su 'byung ba yin/ rdzas la drod skye bsogs kyang yin no/ rdzas dngos la thun mong ma yin pa'i rtags ma byung rung bris sku bzhad pa dbālha'i rol mo dang / me tog gi char 'bab pa sogs kyang rtags yin pas cho ga snga ma bzhin du spyad do/ /rdzas la sgra 'od 'byung ba 'ga' zhig gi yal bar dogs na mnan par bya'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba ni/ rdzas kyi dngos sgrub de yang / yid kyi dmigs pas sems can thams cad la sbyin/ dngos su'ang grogs la bgo bsha' byed pa sogs bshad kyang / sgrub grogs rgaco/gruba'agrub rung la yin gyi/ snod du gyur pa rnyed dka' na yid kyis sbyin no/ /de bzhin du ril lu migasman ral gri la sogs pa yi dam gyi lhas bdag la gnang ba'am/ rdzas kyi sgo nas sgrub kyang rugabago bsha' byed lugs de dang 'dra la/ gter dang nor gyi dngos grub yin na/ dngos su bgo skalargya cher sbyin dgos kyi/ yid kyi bsam pa kho nas mi mchog go/slar yang dngos grub brtan byed du dkyil 'bor du zhugs shing dbang bskur ba blangs nas/ bsrung ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyidon du smon lam mang du btab/ yang rjes chog gi cho gas mchod pa rgya che la lan mang ba phugasems can gyis don du dngos grub mchog la rnga/sol ba btab nas/ gshegs su gsol ba sogs byas la/ slar yang nyi ma gzhan la dkyil 'khore gyi sa gzhir sbyin sregs sogs byas pas/ grub pa—32—

gzhan gyis dngos grub de mi 'phrog cing / nyams par yang mi 'gyur la gong nas gong du 'phel bo'i dgos pa yo‘ / do/ /rdzas kyi dngos grub kyi skal ba dkyil 'khor lha dang dkon mchog gsum la phul ba de/ de nyid du mi snang bar 'gro ba shas che zhing / song na legs/ ma song na rdzas dman pa de sbyin sreg tu 'bul ba'am/ chu bo chen por dor par bya'o/ /sgrub chen las sbyor dang bcas pa 'di/dkyil 'khor ni yid kyis bsams/ rten ni sngar gyi bris sku la brten te sgrubs na/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang bris sku'i gtso bo dbyer med du sgom pa sogs sgrub pa'i skabs dang 'dra/ yang phyi'i dkyil 'khor dang bris sku gnyis kar la brten te sgrubs na/ bris sku bkram pa'i mdun du dkyila'akhor bzhongs pa yin kyang / dmigs pa ni bshad ma thag pa bzhin te/ sha kā thub sbyong rgyal lha mo bzhi rnams la dmigs pa'i brten tshar gnyis re byung kyang sgom bya gcig kho na'o/ /de ltar yang rgyud las/ de nas bzlas pa'i 'jug tu ni/ /dkyil 'kho1ra snga ma bzhin bsam la/ /mchod pa rgya chen byas nas kyang / /mtshan gcig thog thag bzlas pa bya/ /ci snyegatso bo'am de yis sras/ ldang na lha rnams mthong gyur na/ /bsod nams snod las ci dga' bar/ dngos grub mchog ni gsol bar bya/ /lha yi dngos grub 'bras bu ni/ /de la rtag tu dges nas stsole/ /phyag 'tshal dbos grub la sogs blang / /bla ma dkon mchog gsum dag la/ /skal ba re re phul nas ni/ /de nas rtagatubadag spyod cing / /med na mkhas pa bdag nyid kyis/ /blangs nas yongs su spyad par bya/ ldemasacan kun la phan brtson pas/ /bskal pa du mar gnas par 'gyur/ /ci ste dngos grub mgyurana'ang / /las rnams thams cad nus par 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin skar ma'i gdong la sogs/ khrid pas bcad cing bka' tsam gyis/ /zhi ba la sogs las kun gyi/ /bran bzhin las kun byed para'agyur/ /zhes gsungs te bzlas pa'i 'jug tu zhes pa/ sgrub pa chen po mthar phyin nas/ de'i rjesasu zhes pa'i don yin la/ dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bsam zhes pa bris pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyasapa—33—

snga ma bzhin zhes pa ste/yid kyis sgom pa'i dkyil 'bor gyi dpe yin la/'di la yid kyis/sgom pa 'ba' zhig gi dkyil 'khor dang /dngos su ni ras bris bkod nas dkyil 'khor yid kyi ba4/pa'i lugs gnyis kyang yod pas/dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs yid kyi bsam pa de rnam pa kun tudagos pa'i phyir/snga ma bzhin bsam zhes gsungs/'on kyang phyi'i dkyil 'khor 'gog pa ni mayin par ma zad/yid kyis ji ltar bsgoms pa de'i dmigs rten du sgom bya dang 'brel ba'i dkyilarde'akhor bri dgos pa rang shas che zhing /phyi'i dkyil 'khor 'bri shor la'ang 'phangs pa yin no//yangarnam pa gcig tu na 'dir dkyil 'khor sgom dgos na dkyil 'khor ci 'dra sgom snyam na/sngaragrubazhi pa la sgo bzhi pa zhes pa nas/dur khrod grong khyer gnas pa rnams/zhes pa'i bar du bshad zin pa de bzhin du dran par byas te 'bri'o//zhes pas don yang yin pas/snga ma bzhin bas5pa nyebasam pa'i don dran pa'am/blo la bzhan pa yin pas/snga ma bzhin du go bar byas nas 'bri zhes pa'o//mtshan gcig ni las sbyor gyi skabs su'o//'ga' zhig gi 'di bsnyen pa'o gsung pa ni/mtshan gcig thog thag ces pas bkag go/gtso bo ni rnam snang sogs sangs rgyas lnga/de'i sras zhi 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha/lha rnams zhes pa ni tshangs pa la sogs pa'o//bsod nams snod las zhes pa ni/mchog dang 'bring dang phra mo'i skal pa so sor yod pa'o//de la rtag tu dges nas stolazhes pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi lha nyid kyis dngos grub rnams stsol ba'o//phyag 'tshal dngos grub lasogs blang zhes pa ni/dngos grub len tshul yin la/bla ma dkon mchog sogs kyi rjes kyi bya ba bstan no//sems can kun la sogs 'bras bu mchog dman gyi dbye ba'o//gnod sbyin skar ma'i gdong zhes pa la/lo tsā ba nam mkha' smon lam gyi 'gyur gsar las/gnod sbyin skar ma gza' la sogs/zhes bsgyur ba de ltar bden na gza'i skad dod gra ha zhes pa gdon la'ang 'jug pagaganod sbyin skar ma gdon la sogs//zhes pa la yig nor brgyud pas skar ma gdong du song bar34

byed dgos mos/yang gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong zhes 'chad pa'ang yod na/skar mda' dnga'abar ba skad dod gcig pa'i skabs kyang yod pas/mdo sde dran pa nyer bzhag las/lus kha thamasakhacad 'bar ba'i gnod sbyin zhes gsung pa de lta bu dang /gtsug tor dri med las 'byung ba lta bu yin par mngon la/de ni sde bgyod mthu bo che shin tu gnod pa che ba drang srong gza' mchog tu grags pal sogs pa de 'dra'i rig pa can mang po zhig ste/de dag la sgrub pa pos chad pa gcod pa nye ci gar sdigs te dam 'og tu bcug nas las la bskul ba sogs byed pa'o//de ltar na 'di kun rig la brten nas dngos grub sgrub tshul de bzhin yin la/lhag ma 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyila'akhor gzhan lnga po la brten nas sgrub na'ang des rigs 'gre'o//'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas sgrub pa ni/phyag rdor gco bor ni bsngags lgagayin 'jig rten 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gang yin yang rung ste/bsnyen pa/nyer sgrubasgrugapagasum mam/ma mtha' yang bsnyen pa nyer sgrub gnyis mthar phyin nas/'jig rten pa'i dkyila'akhor rnams sgrub pa/sgrub chen nam/sgrub chen rkyang pa'i tshul gyis sgrub na/de dang de'i tswarma grusa'agrub par 'gyur ba yin no//de thams cad cho ga rgyas pa'i lugs yin la/bsdus pas sgrubasanabasnyen pa nyer sgrub gong bzhin btang la/sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang khro bo mngags pa pho nya bran/'jig rten pa'i lha la sogs pa gang sgrub par 'dod pa de nyid/dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lospangs te/cho ga lhag ma sgrub chen dang 'dra ba'i sgrub pa yun srings nas sgrubs nas/mtshanamabartan po byung ba na las la sbyor ro//yang 'di snyam du da lta'i gang zag skal ba dman pa rnams kyis/dngos grub thob par mi 'gyur bas yan lag bzhi'i rnam gzhag 'di mi mkho'o snyam na/da lha'i gang rdezag la tshad 'jog tu mi btub ste/mdo sngags kyi chos phal che ba mi mkhe'o//yang lag len lamimakho yang /bag chags bzang po 'jog pa'i phyir go yul gyi sgo nas slob snyam na/'dir yang de kho35

na bzhin no/ /gzhan yang lag len mi mkho ba yang ma yin te/ da lta'i gang zag gis rgyud lasabashad pa bzhin mi 'byung yang bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa 'di dag thams cad kyi 'dra 'bag tshang bar nyams su blangs na/ de dang de'i byin rlabs dang nyams myong rjes mthun pa 'jug par 'gyur bas/rang la don chen po 'grub cing / lag len ma chad pas gzhan don khyad par can du 'gyur bangangashes par bya ste/ da lta'i sngags pa blun po dag /sbyong rgyud kyi cho ga med mi rung du khas len zhigade'i dgos pa grong chog rgyug pa kho na la blo rtse gtod pa ni/ sngags pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi gsangasngags kyi bstan pa sun 'byin pa'o/ /yang phyag na rdo rje'i skabs su tshe bsgrub pa'i bris sku tsamamagatogs/ dkyil 'kho ra phyi ma rnams la gzhan ci ltar 'bri ba'i tshul gsal ka ma byung yang/shwakya thub pa'i skabs su 'jig rten gsum rgyal lhag por 'bri ba dang / yang na dkyil 'khor ras brisabyed par gsung pa ni dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la'ang rigs 'gre'o/ des na gtso bo so so la snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / khro bo gsum rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor la da thos su chad pa rnams la de yang bri bar bya ba nyid do/ /'on kyang rgyud 'di thams cad rigs pa nyid rga so grub mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor yin pa'i phyir/ skabs der bsnyen sgrub kyi rim pa rgyas paragasungs te/ mchog sgrub par dgongs shing gzhan rnams la so so'i skabs su babs pa'i las nye tshe ba rnams gtso bor gsungs pa yin no/ /nges par na 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gang la brten kyang / rgyud 'di nyid las gsungs pa'i las dang grub pa thams cad 'grub par ma zad/ rgyud kyi rgyal po gzhan nas gsungs pa'i las dang grub pa rnams kyang sgrub par nus go /yang gong du bshad pa ltar/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor dngos sam 'dra 'bag tshang bar byas na/ zhi sogasaphramo rnams 'grub par the tshom med pa yin la/ de yang dngos kyis sgogs med du 'grub cig 'dra'abag gis rjes mthun pa 'grub bo/ /de bzhin du bsnyen pa tsam mthar phyung ba dang / bsnyen pa nye —36—

bsnyen tsam dang / sgrub pa'i 'dra 'bag rnams ji ltar 'os pas kyang / spyin sregs la sogs paphramo'i las rnams rjes mthun pa 'grub par nus so/ /yang bsnyen pa'i cho ga la brten nas rtsa riga'abum phrag bzhi dang / snying po 'bum phrag bcu bzhi'am bcu drug bzlas pas kyang / dkyil 'khora'abri ba dang dbang bskur ba dang / gshin don gyi bya ba sogs sgrub par dbang ngo / /'khor rnams kyi bzlas pa ni 'gru/ba na legs la/ ma 'grum ba kyang 'gal ba med/ de la rje grags pa la so gos khacig rdo rje sems dpa' sgom nas lha gzhan gyi sngags bzlas pa mi rung ngo snyam du sems pa ni/gnad ma go ba ste/ rtsa rig ni lha thams cad kyi sngags yin la/ snying po ni gtso bo nyid kyi yin yabāgatso bo ni 'bor lo kun la khyab pa yin pa'i phyir/ bdag bskyed kyi bzlas pa la yang/ rang gakhobor sgoms nas 'khor gyi bzlas pa rung ba bzhin du/ 'khor du sgom nas gtso bo'i sngags bzlas pa la yang ni rung ba med de/ 'di ni thams cad du shes par bya la/ rgyud 'dir ni brtag pa dang po rtsaba'i rgyud ni ston pa nyid rnam snang du gyur pas gsungs shing / de man chad phyag na rdo rje nyid ston par byin gyis rlabs te gsungs la/ 'di skabs kyi phyag na rdo rje dang / rdo rje sems dpa' don gcinacing / der ma zad sems dpa' bcu drug gi nang na/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi sems dpa'i mchog lasathams cad byed pa po de ni phyag na rdo rje nyid do/ /de'i phyir phyag na rdo rje la/ sangs rgyas kun bsasngar sangs rgyas/ ces sogs rdo rje sems dpa' yin pa'i sgo nas bstod do/ /de bas na sngagasakyilha rnams la/ rgyud gang gang du ji ltar byin rlabs mdzad pa dang / sgrub lugs ji ltar byed kyi sgo nas gcig pa dang tha dad pa'i rnam gzhag byed de/ dper na 'jam dpal lta bu cig nyid rnam snang gi tshul du sgrubs pa'i tshe/ rnam snang dang 'jam dpal gcig la/ mi bskyod pa dang 'jam dpalamigacig pa'i tha snyad dang / 'jam dpal mi bskyod par sgrubs pa'i tshe/ de las ldog pa'i rnam gzhanadang / sangs rgyas su sgrub pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' ma yin pa'i rnam gzhag dang / byang chub —37—

sems dpar sgrubs pa'i tshe sangs rgyas ma yin pa'i rnam gzhag dang /'bor lo'i dbang phyug tu sgrubs pa'i tshe 'khor ma yin pa dang /'khor du sgrub pa'i tshe de ma yin pa dang /'jam dpas nyid thugs kyi sgrub pa'i tshul gyis bsgrubs na/thugs kyi rigs su 'gyur zhing thugs rdo rje yin pa dadagasung dang sku'i sgrub pas sgrubs kyang de dang de'i rigs su 'gyur bsogs kyi phyir/tha mal gyimil sogs pa dper bzhag nas/ma skyes dgra dang mthong ldan ni gcig la/de dang shar pa'i bumigacig go bsam pa lta bu tha mal gyi rgyas bkab mi rung ngo //de bas na spyi ldog nas gsang bdagaphyag na rdo rje dang /rdo rje sems dpa' lamatha' gcig tu gcig pa dang tha dad pa mi skya yi/sbyong rgyud gsungs pa'i skabs 'dir rgyud gcig ste/de nyid gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad nyid kyi rnam 'phrulayin pa'i phyir dang /rdo rje sems dpa' kun gyi khyab bdag yin pa'i phyir/rdor sems sgo mes nasasangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags bzla ba sogs la pan pa'o snyam pa'i log rtog 'di bor shig/de ni bdag bskyed nyid la dpyad pa yin la/gas yang rgyud 'dir nyer sgrub sogs la smos ci dgogabasnyen pa la yang mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa buld pas bag yod par bya'o//de bas na rgyud las/phyag na rdo rje'i sku bor te/rdo rje sems dpa'i skur zhugs te/zhes gsungs pa sogs kyang sngon rtsa gi rnam 'phrul la de ltar bstan zhing /dgos don skabs der me ltar 'bar ba rdo rje sems dpa'i khroboyin zhing /phyag rdor nyid de'i sku bzhengs pa'i phyir yin pas/de dag gcig par byin gyis rlabs pa'i wo yin no//gnyis pa don dam tshad med kyi sgrub chen ni/phyag rgya'i ye shes mchog gi sgrub pa zhes bya snyergyud kyi rgyal po 'di nyid las//sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems//bla na med pa rtegs 'gyurab//rgyal bas gsungs ba'i ye shes gang //'di ni dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs//zhes paskespyir btangs su bsnyen pa sogs mawo cas bzhi po sngon du song ba'i sgrub r+pā tha ma la 'di sgom 38

pa yin/ dbang po rnon pos phyi'i nyer sgrub sogs med par yang 'grub bo/ /de yang dang por sngagasalas bskyed pa'i lha'i sku la gsal snang thob par bya zhing / gsal snang de yang shin tu brtan pa thobapar bya'o/ /de yang sngon nas stong pa nyid kyi don la sems rtse gcig par nus pa zhig yin na ni/skabs der lha sku'i snang ba la stong nyid kyi rgyas btab nye sgoms pas/ mi ring bar lha sku sgom pa na/stong pa nyid du rang shar ba dang / stong nyid sgom na'ang lha sku rtsol med du 'char thub pa 'byung rdo /yang sngar stong nyid la rtsa gcig pa ma thob na/ /thun re tsam re sngar gyi rgyun las lha sku sgoms shibāphal cher stong nyid kyi don go bar byas te de la dmigs nas rtse gcig tu sgrub bo/ /'di ni sngaralhasku'i steng du gsal snang dang rtse gcig pa sgrubs zin yin pas/ gsal snang dang gnas pa de'i shugs las skabs 'dir yang / stong nyid la yang myur du rtse gcig pa dang gsal snang dus gcig tu thob par 'gyur ro/ /de nas sngar bzhin rgyas btab ste bsgoms pas/ lha sku dang stong pa zung 'jugatu 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha sku gsal stong de nyid gsang sngags kyi ngo bo sgrub pa'i phyir du/ lha skra zhi thugs kar zla ba la sngags phreng gi gzugs bkod na/ sngags kyi sgra gzugs gnyis kar la dmigs dgos shing / /ma bkod na lha sku gsal stong de nyid sngags kyi sgra rang bzhin du mos dgos pa yin te/ 'on kyang sngags kyi gzugs bkod pa nyid bzang ngo / /de ltar dmigs nas yid bzlas sam 'gog pa'i bzlas pa/ khri phrag gam/ 'bum phrag gam/ 'bum phrag drug gam/ bye bo'i bar du skal pa dang mtshams par bzlas pas lha sku dang stong pa de nyid rig sngags su 'grub ste/ nus mthudang yon tan dpag tu med pa'i gzhi 'gyur ro/ /'di ni bsnyen sgrub phal pa'i dus kyi rnal 'khyoramayin te/ mtshan ma med pa'i rnal 'byor yin la/ don dam sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang rjes su mthun pa'i phyir/ don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi ming 'dogs pa dang / dngos grub kyi snying po legapho phyir snying po'i dkyil 'khor dang / lha sku phyag rgya chen po dngos su grub byed yin pa'i phyir/ /phyan—39—

rgya'i ye shes zhes rgyal ba bcom 'das kyis gsungs so//de yang sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes/sku snang stong /gsung grag stong /thugs gsal stong gsum po ngo bo gcig tu 'dres pa'i byang chubakyisems/dom dam gnas lugs bla na med pa de ni/skabs 'dir lha sku dang /sngags dang/stonganyid gsum gyi sgo nas/rnam pa 'dra ba lam du byas te rtogs par 'gyur ba yin no//rnal 'byor 'di la cung zad brtan pa thob nas/rigs drug gi dngos grub sgrub pa ni 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi skabs nas 'di skad ces/bde bas bde ba bskyed nas ni//dkyil 'khor bzhe po'i dbus su ni//kun tu bzang ngam bde ba cher//bdag nyid kyis kyang sgoms nas kyag snying gar huX zhes bya bsams na//rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam par 'gyur//dpal ldan las rnams kun byed cing //kun tu bzang por bdag nyid 'gyur//de ltar 'gyur bar the tshom med/1huX las sangs rgyas gzugs gyur pas//phyag na rdo rje bdaganyid gyur//snying gar 'khor lo rab bsgom la//phyag na rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/2rdo rje khro bor rnams sgoms te/snying ga'i dbus su phaṭa ces bya/huX zhes bya bsaskor bsam nas/khro bo stobs chen nyid du 'gyur/3rdo rje brtan par bdagabasgyur la//snying gar oṃ zhes bya ba yis//skor sa'i hūX dang traX ldan par//bsams na rin chen 'dra bar 'gyur/4/rin chen sgoms pa snying gan ni/dbus su traX zhes bya ba bsam//oṃ zhes bya bas skor bsams na//phyag na pad mo mnyam par 'gyur/5/'khor lo rgya graX hūX ldan pas//a zhes bya ba bskyed nas kyang //oṃ zhes bya bas skor bsams na//rdo rje las dang mnyam para'agyu/ra/6zhes gsungs te/'di la snga ma 'ga' zhig gi/bde bas bde ba bskyed pa'i don/nor gyi longs spyod la 'chad pa dang /mngon rdoX lnga las lha bskyed pa la 'chad pa da bdakyil

'khor bzhi po zhes pa 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi la 'chad pa'ang yod mod kyi/ bshad pa de 'dra mi legasaso/ /yang kha cig 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams bor te/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga dang / sems dpa' bcudrug dang / skal bzang bcu drug dang / nyan rang gi sa cha ste/ dkyil 'bor rim bzhi'i dbus sulhaso so'i sgom pa la 'chad de/ spyir de ltar sgom pa mi 'gal yang / gzhung don la 'byor ba ni minapar mngon no/ /de lta na rdo rje rin po che dang / rdo rje chos dang / rdo rje las gsum po las reredakyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag pa'i dkyil lubor re re ste dkyil 'khore gsum dang / rdor sems dang phyag rdor dang khro bo gsum la dkyil 'kho ra dbus su rdor sems gnyis 'god pa yin la/ phyag rdor ram khro bo ngo bo gcig cing / zhi drag rnam 'gyur ma gtogs khyad med la/ de yang rdor sems labarten nas sgrub na/ sgrub pa po'i nga rgyal dbus kyi rdor sems 'jug cing / phyag rdor dang khrobo'akhor gyi tshul dang / yang phyag rdor dang khro bo'i dngos grub sgrub na/ sgrub pa po'i nga rgyal shar gyi phyag rdor ram khro bo la 'jug cing / dbus kyi gtso bo rdo rje sems dpa' mdun bskyed kyi tshul du byed payin no/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dang / kun tu bzang po dang / bde ba chen po ste rdo rje 'chang rnamasaskabs 'dir dgos don gcig pa3sna 'dam kha'o/ /de gsum 'dam kha yin pa'i phyir/ dkyila'akhor tha dad du mi bgrong bas gcig tu bya la/ phyag rdor ni zhi khro gnyis kyang rnam pa tha dad byungamod/ ngo bo gcig pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor so sor mi 'dren no/ /rdor sems sogs kyi dkyil ske bor dang phyag rdor zhi khro'i dngos grub sgrub par gnyis/ nga rgyal 'jog tshul so sor byung yang/ dkyila'akhor gyi rnam pa mi 'dra ba med pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor logs par 'jog mi thub bo/ /des na de la nang sel mi 'dra ba du ma byung yang / rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor zhes gcig tu bsdu bgasngar bshad pa sems dpa' gsum gyi dkyil 'khor dang / rdor sems kyi dkyil 'bor te dkyila'akhor bzhi'o/ /des na dkyil 'khor bzhi'i/ des na dkyil 'khor bzhi po las gang skabs su —41—

bab ste sgom zhes pa yin la/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dngos grub mi 'dra ba drug yod kyag dbus kyi gtso bo gang gis mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor mi 'dra ba bzhi po des chog gi drug mi dgos pa'i don no/ /yang bde bas bde ba bskyed pa zhes pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i phyag rgya'i ye shes bde bde lamanyam par bzhag pas/ shin tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba bskyed pa'am/ yang na 'dod yon gyi rol pa sna tshogs pas bde ba'i bogs 'byin byas pa'i don yin no/ /des na 'di ltar bya ste/ phyag rgye'i ye shes la brtan pa thob pa'i gang zag gis/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom na/ dkyila'akhor yongs rdzogs sam/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor ram/ snying po'i dkyil 'khor lha lngapa gang rung zhig sgom nas/ thugs kar zla ba la sa bon me lce 'bar ba'i rnam pa can bsgoms te/de'i 'od kyi rdul phra rab kyis ma dag pa'i gnas lus longs spyod yang yang sbyangs/ srog rtsol sdams te rtse gcig par mnyam par bzhag go /sgra gnas dang sgra mtha'i ting nge 'jin yang sgom dgos te/sbyong rgyud spyi dang 'dra'o/ de dag las lus sems shin tu yangs pa dang / gsal snang cher mkhyed padang / gnyid dang bshang gci dang bkres skom dang ngal dub sogs spangs par gyur pa de'i lkodabugs phyir 'gro ba na snying ga'i sa bon hu lta bu las spros pa'i 'od kyis/ dag ma dag gi snod bcud thams cad sbyangs te/ sa bon gyi yig 'bru 'ba' thig tu gyur par bsam/ nang du 'ong ba na de thams cad ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs te/ snying ga'i yi ge la thim/ gnas pa na sngags kyi 'od dngasgras rang lus dang phyi rol yid yul du 'char tshad khyab par dmigs te mnyam par bzhag go khrikho'adi bar ma chad du sgoms pas/ zhag bdun zla phyed sogs nas zla ba drug gi bar gyis rnam smin gyi lus dag nas/ ye shes kyi lha dang rnam pa mtshungs pa'i rig 'dzin du 'gyur bas/ 'di ni rgyud sde'adi rnams kyi lugs la dngos grub mchog tu bzhed do/ /man ngag 'di ni skabs 'dir kun 'a sbyar bar bya ste/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad dang / dpal shākya thub pa dang / tshe dpag med la sogasapa—42—

la'ang sbyar bar bya rgyu yin la/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'bor gyi skabs su bshad pa ni rdorasems/ kun bzang / bde ba chen po gsum gang du sgoms kyang rung dmigs rten thugs kar zlobal hūṃ kho na yin la/ phyag na rdo rje la ni/ rang nyid : las byung ba'i rnam snang yongs su gyur pa las/hu dang de las byung ba'i phyag rdor thugs kar dmigs rten 'khor lo'i steng du hūṃ ngo / khro bo sgom na thog ma phyag rdor zhi ba yin pa las/ phyis khro bo me ltar 'bar ba sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par 'gyur nas/ dmigs rten snying gar zla ba la phaṭa yig dang mtha' bskor hūṃ gi phreng bas bske(ra bsgom mo/ /rdo rje brtan pa ste nam mkha'i snying po'am/ rdo rje rin chen du sgoms nas snying gar zla bo'i dbus su hūṃ/ hu gi klad skor gyi nang du tra bsam pa'am/ hū gi mtha' skor du trī gi phreng bdang/de'i phyi rol du oṃ yig gi 'phreng bas blto(ra ba'o/ /yang rdo rje chos su sgoms nas/ thugs kar glabalaha yig gam/ khyi:yig oṃ gyi phreng bas bskor ba bsgom/ yang rang nyid rdo rje las su sgom nas/ snyingagar 'khor lo'i steng du rdo rje rgya gram/ de'i lte bar hū/ hūṃ gi klad skor gyi nang du a/ hi gi mtha' bskor du oṃ gyi 'phreng bas bskor ba bsgom mo/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag rdor zhi ba/ phyag rdor khro bo/rdo rje rin chen/ rdo rje chos/ rdo rje las te/ de ltar na 'khor los bsgyur ba drug go/'ar rgyud sdegong ma dang bstun nas rig lnga'i dbang du byas na/ rdor sems sogs gsum rdo rje'i rigs dgaphyag rdor dang khro bo 'khor lo'i rigs su bsdu/ rigs bzhi'i dbang du byas na/ las dang rin chen gcig tu bsdom pa sogs yin mod kyi/ 'di spyod rgyud yin pa'i phyir/ skabs 'dir rigs bozhirigs lnga'i dbye ba rtsal 'don du bshad mi dgos shing / 'gog par yang mi byed de don sgrub pe'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa bya ba'i rim pa la/ rgyud 'dir las sgor bu ba mang po ma gsungs shing/ zha boralos bsgyur ba dang / me ltar 'bar ba'i nang nas/ sbyin sreg la sogs pa'i las bzhi sgrub tshul gsal bar gsungs te/ rgyud nyid dang sgyin sreg gi cho ga rnams su rnyed par sla'o/ /gshin po'i don—43—

gtso bor gyur pa sdig sbyong gi las ni/ skabs 'dir sdig sbyong gi sgo la/ shāka thub sku'i dkyila'akhor gyi skabs nas/ skyes pa bud med dam/ lha klu gnod sbyin srin po sogs mi dang mim yin gang yin kyang rung / ro dang gzugs brnyan dpa/ ming byang gsum gang yang rung ba la/ sngags bzlas pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / sbyin sreg byed pa gsum gsum gyis dbye bas sdig spyong mi 'dra bdagugasungs la/ tshe dpag med dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba'i mtshams kyi bar khog las/ ge son po ladakyil 'khor du 'jug pas dbang bskur ba dang / sgom bzlas byed pa gnyis gsungs shig desasdig spyongs su ma zad tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar yang bshad la/ gshin po la ming byang dbāgazugs brnyan dang / mchod rten dang / lha sku dang/ de'i bu dang / rus pa sogs lus kyi ma shasadang / mi rigs rus gcig pa dang / bran g.yog dang / ming gcig pa ste/ dbang bskur bo'i sdos dgu la dbang bskur bar bshad do/ /'di skabs kyi lha sku ni bsgrub bya des bstan pa'i 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i sku gzugs yin la/ de'i gsal kha med na/ sgrub pa po rang nyid kyi 'dod pas/ ye shes lha'i sku 'dra byas nas/ bsgrub bya de'i ming nas brjod cing de'i robor bsam nas dbang bskur ba yin no/ /rigs rus mthun pa smos pas nye du thams cad bsdulkabran smos pas grogs po yang bstan pa yin no/ /de yang dang por yi dam la gnang ba zhu ba'i bsnyen pa skyar ma kha gso'i tshul du byas nas/rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ thun re bzhin mchod pa dang bzlas ba mang du bya zhig zhakabadun gyi bar du thun gsum mam/ thun bzhir bsten de dang de la dbang bskur ba yin lka dbang ji tsam bskur ba'i tshad ni/ 'jug pa rgyas pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dngos gzhi yongs rdzogs 'grub nalegs la/ bsdun sngags dbang dang / bum pa dang / phyag rgya'i dbang tsam gyis kyang chog go/'ogatu 'chad par 'gyur ba kun rig gis skabs kyi dbang rnams kyang 'dis rigs 'gre'o/ /yang—44—

sngags bzlas pas sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i sgo yang gsungs te/ dkyil 'khor bris kyang rung ma bris kyang rung / bsdu na bdag bskyed dpa' bo gcig pas kyang chog /sngags re re'i mthar/ bsgrub bya'i de zhes/ bya ba'i sdig pa thams cad sharnyi ku ru swāhā/ zhen/ btags pa 'bum phrag gnyis nas/ bye ba dang / dung phyur gyi bar du bzla bar yang gsungs te/ grangs mang nyung sdig pa che chung gi khyad kyisayin no/ /'di ni bzlas sgom tsam la brten nas tshe 'das kyi sdig pa sbyong tshul yin te/ gra pas mi 'dra ba rnams ni/ ngan song du skyes zin pa sdig pa chung 'bring che gsum dang / mtshams med gcag byas pa nas/ mtshams med mang du byas pa'i bar gyi sdig sbyong la dgongs pa'o/ /de ltar na gso na po kho na'i sdig sbyong gnyis dang / dbang bskur ba'i yul dgu dang / sgom bzlas kho na'i sdig sbyongs te/gshin po'i sdig sbyong bcu yod la/ gson gshin gnyis kar la zhi ba'i spyin sreg gsungs zhag de dag la'ang lus dang 'brel ba dang / ming dang 'brel ba gnyis gnyis te bzhi yod do/ /de ltar na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i skabs nas/ sdig sbyong gi sgo bcu drug gsungs so/ /yang gtso che ba'i sdig spyong gi sgo rnams kun rig gi skabs nas gsungs te/ de yang/ de bzhin dkyil 'khor bris nas kyang / zhes sogs kyi dang po shi ba'i ro la dbang bskur bste/ chu dbang bskur ba'i bum pa la sngags brgyad brgya bzla bar gsungs so/ /de yang mchod rten gyi cho gas mchod rten bzhengs nas/ mchod rten gyi nang ngam phyi ngos su bris ma'am 'bur las sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs bya/ de'i thugs kar lha de nyid dam/ rtsa rig sogs rgyud 'di'i lha'i na sngags bras/ de lta bu la rab gnas kyi dus su kun rig gi dkyil 'khor bris shing dbang bskur ba rgyas par byas nas/lha khang ngam/ phyur bu'am/ skyed mos tshal la sogs pa dben par ba theg la nyin re bzhin chad padang / bzlas pa bya ste bzlas pa 'bum la sogs pas 'grub bo/ /de yis ming nas smos nasasāzhes sogs kyis bzhi pa tsha tsha gdab pa'i sgo nas sdig pa spyong ba ste/ gur gum gyi rtsa rig sogs kyi —45—

mthar sgrub bya'i ming spel ba dang bcas pa bris/ gzungs ril de tsha tshe'i nang du 'jug cing/ tshatsho'i cho ga ni spyi dang 'dra/ de lta bu'i mchod rten 'bum 'debs te/ re re bzhin yi ge bri bam grubana'ang / ji ltar 'os pas mgo drangs nas sngags ngag nas bzla ba dang / yid kyi dmigs pas kyangarung ngo / /tsha tsha zin pa na/ snying po bye ba bzlas pas the tshom med par ngan song las thar rdo /de yi ming nas brjod nas ni/ ji skad gsang pa'i sngags bzlas shing / zhes sogs kyis lnga pa sgom bzlas kho nas sdig pa sbyong ba bstan/ 'dir yang grangs mang mtha' dung phyur dang / nyung mtha' 'bus du gsungs par/ kha cig rtsa rig dang snying po gang yin gyis/ rung bar 'chad kyang rtsa riganyuri mtha' 'bum gcig dang / snying po mang mtha' dung phyur yin par gsal lo/ /de yi ming nas brjod nasakyang / /mkhas pas 'bum phrag brgya'am ni/ /zhes sogs ni drug pa sbyin sreg gi sdig pa sbyong bskede yang bsreg rdzas nyung mtha' 'bum nas/ mang mtha' bye ba dang dung phyur gyi bar 'bul bar bshad la/ bsreg rdzas kyang til/ yungs kar/ 'bras/ ra'i 'o ma/ dri bzang gi byugs pa'i yam shingasogs 'bul ba yin zhing / me lha nyid kyi zhal ston pa'am/ me dkar po g.yas su 'khyil bsog༅rdesdig pa 'dag pa'i rtags kyang 'byung bar bshad do/ /sku bzhi pa yi tshad kyi ni/ zhes sogs kyi bdun pa/ /ro bsreg gi sgo nas sdig pa sbyong bar gsungs so/ /phyag na rdo rje pad+ma zhags pa bsnams/ zhesasogs kyis brgyad pa khro bo'i las kyi sdig spyong ste/ gshed 'brel dgos pa'i rigs la 'di bzangabar 'dod do/ /de yang phyag rdor dang 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyis bris sku'i mdun du/ sgrub bya de'i lus kyi rdzas dang 'brel ba'i sbyin sreg 'bum nas bye ba'i bar du phul nas/ thal ba las skugazugs bzhengs pa'am/ tsha tsha btab/ de la sngags 'bum phrag gnyis bzlas pas 'bar bar 'gyur ba sogs bshad do/ /'phros don gong 'og kun du sbyor rgyu la/ yang na gzugs kyi 'tshi pa'am/ zhes sogs ni/ sgrub bya de lhar skyes shing phyir mi ldog pa thob pa'i rtags go /yang na med —46—

par 'gyur na yang / zhes sogs kyi lus dang 'brel ba'i rdzas med kyang ming byang ngam/ tsharma pha//gzugs byang la dbang bskur ba dang / ming gzugs kyi byang bu sbyin sreg tu bsregs pas kyang/sdig pa shas chung ba rnams ngan 'gro las grol nas bde 'gror skye'o zhes pa'o/ /deng sang ming byangabasreg pa'ang 'di la bsams par snang la/ thal ba yungs kar bye ma sogs/ zhes/ pas dgupabrabs rdzas kyi sgo nas sdig pa sbyang ba ste/ ming ngam gzugs sam tsha tsha'i ma mchod rten nam/ lhe'i sku gzugs yin yang rung ste/ skyed mos tshal lam gtsang khang ngam/ yang dog sogs su bzhan nas/sgom bzlas sngon du 'gro ba'i/ brabs rdzas la gzungs thag bzhag /sngags bzla ste/ bus bzlas kyi rigs bsgres na sngags thams cad brgya rtsa re bzla ba'am/ spyir ni rtsa rig dang snying po mang du buglozhing / brabs sngags gzhan rnams kyang ji ltar 'os pa bzla ste/ sngags brgya rtsa brgyad la thegs pe'i bar du brabs par bya'o/ /rdzas dman pa de rnams phyag te/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du doralkarten de nyid lhar bskyed cing bzlas pa dang / mchod pa cung zad re bya'o/ /de ltar nyin re phu3 sa bzhi'am gsum mam/ ma mtha' yang thun re bya la/ de 'dra zla ba drug la sogs pas nges par sbran 'gro las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar mang du gsungs pa de thams cad kyi don bsdus na/ sdig sbyong bdun du 'du ste/ dbang bskur ba dang / bzlas pa dang / phyir bzlog dang / sbyin sreg dang/ mchod rten 'debs pa dang / tsha tsha dang / rten med na ji ltar bya ba ste bdun no/ /zhes gong ma rnamasagasungs yang / mtha' cig tu nges pa med pa 'dra'o/ /kun rig gi skabs 'di ni nas/shi ba'i lus dang / gzungs byang dang / ming byang dang / mchod rten/ lha can/ tsha tsha 'debs pa dang / sgom bzlas rkyang pa dang / sbyin sregs dang / ro bsregs dang / khro bo'i las dang / brabs rdzas kyis sbyangs ba ste/rkang tshugs pa'i sdig sbyong gi sgo bcu'am/ gzugs byang ming byang gcig tu sdoms na dgur 'gyural/ gzugs ming tsha tsha gsum la dbang bskur ba dang / gzugs ming gnyis sbyin sreg tu byed pasge—47—

——zhor byung phra mo lnga bsnan pas bcu bzhi'am bco lnga'o/ /'di dag thams cad la yang dkyil 'a 'angadang 'brel ba rnams dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bzhin dang / ma 'brel ba rnams la'ang sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / mchod pa byin rlabs dang / bsrung 'khor nas brtsams te bdag bskyed dag ge tor ma dang / bgegs bskrad pa/ byur bsal ba rnams so so'i las kyi sngon la 'jug cing/ so rbe'i 'jag tu yang skabs dang 'tsham pa'i rjes chog rgyas pa'am/ mchod bstod smon lam gdab pa sogs ji ltar 'od pa bya'o/ /rgyud kyi dgongs pa dngos ni/ ji skad bshad pa de das las gang yang rung ba re res chog la/ gal te mi 'dra ba mang du byed na'ang byed pa po so sos sgrubs te/ las re re rkang tshugs par byed pa nyid yin la/ bye ba dung phyur sogs dang tsha tsha mang po sogs ni las gcig la'ang byed pa po du mas rung ngo / /da lta'i lho sgo'i cho ga ni sbyin sreg dang mchod rten sogs skabs der mi 'grub pa 'ga' zhig ma gtogs/ thams cad nas sna tshang tsam 'dus pa sdig spyong gi sgo kun gyi 'dra 'bag lam byed/bod yul gyi skye bo rnams kyi mig sngar mdzes chos tsam du sgrigs par ni snang la/ 'on kyang sngagasadang tshig gi byin rlabs 'jug pas phan yon yod cing / khrigs bkod byed pa po rnams kyang/ skyesabu mchog tu gyur pa yin pa'i phyir/ mi smad cing lag len du gdab par bya ba ni kho na'o/ /de ltar na da lta thams cad byed pa'i lto sgo'i cho ga ni rgyud las gsungs pa de'i 'dra 'bag tsam yin pa bzhin du/ deng sang gi chog sgrigs bdag bskyed mdun bskyed rnams kyang / sgrub pa'ang sgrub chen gyi 'dra'abag yin la/ dbang len pa yang las la spyor ba'i 'dra 'bag gam/ gshin po'am slob ma'i don du yin par yang 'dod do/ /des na dkyil 'khor chen po'i las rim bsnyen sgrub bzhi po ma brdzod pa'i rgyud kyang re re tsam hal hol re thos pas sngags la mkhas so snyam mngon pa'i nga rgyal can kha cig bdag cag gi bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i sgrub mchod byed do zhes smra mod/ sgrub mchod skabs kyi bdag—48—

bskyed rgyas pa de bsnyen pa dngos kyang ma yin/ rjes mthun pa yang ma yin/ 'dra 'bag kyang ma yin pas de las bsnyen rgyas kyi tha snyad sbyor ba shin tu 'khrul la/ gal te bsnyen pa yin na sgrub pa'i thasnyad mi rung ba la sgrub mchod ces sgrub pa'i ming yang btags nas/ bsnyen rgyas kyi sgrub mchod zer ba 'di/ bsnyen pa'i sgrub pa zhes par song ba'i phyir/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'i dbye ba tsas yang mabyed pa/ gsang sngags kyi brda chad rags pa tsam la yang phyogs mgo ma thing pa'i blun rtags dbyangs su gyer ba yin no/ /da ni slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i bya ba'i rim pa ni 'di tsam zhig snyekhyad par ni lha sta gon gyi skabs bris sku dang bsre ba mi dgos la/ lha dang bum pa sta gon la sogs pa'i nyin mo de nyid dam/ dus skabs gzhan la yang rung ste/ slob ma rnams khrus byas te 'khod pa lgakha cig gsang sngags grub don gnyer/ zhes sogs mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan pobaskyed/ sngar skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ma blangs na lta ci smos/ sngar blangs kyang gso ba dngagasala'adebs pa'i don du/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi cho ga rgyas pa phog /mi nus pa'am long med na gong rgyun bshags kyi skabs su 'byung bar tsam bya/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ sogs sngagasal spro ba bskyed badz+ra satwa kro dha'i sngags bzlas pa'i spos chu slob ma la bsangs gtor o cing / bsangs chus sbags pa'i lag pa slom ma'i mgo la ba 'ag nas sngags de lan bdun bzlas/de bzhin du bdud rtsi 'byil ba'i sngags kyang/ kyang bya/ de nas slob ma la dri chab dang / spos dadamar me rnams 'bul/ /mchod pa'i sprin gyis gzungs kyis byin gyis rlabs/ las thams cad pe'i sngags gyis so shing spyin/ hu bzhi pa'i sngags kyi maṇ+ḍal byas/ dzi na dzi ka zhes mang du bzlas pas so shing dor/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyi khyor chu spyin/ satwa krem dha'i sngags kyis bsngags pa'i dpung skud kyang spyi dang mthun par bcings nas/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /ces sogs zab mo'i chos bshad/ las thams cad pas bsngags pa'i ku sha sngas dang gdan gyi don —49—

du sbyin/de nas slob ma lha la phyag 'tshal du gzhug ste/de dag ni slob ma sta gon no//de nas spyobamo slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i dngos gzhi'i lngin mo gtor ma gtong ba yan chad zin nas/slobama'i sgrib pa sbyangs shing bsod nams bskyed pa'i don du/dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams sgyin sreg gis mnyes par bya la/de nas mtshan mo slob ma dkyil 'khor khang pa'i sgo drung du 'dug pas/maṇ+ḍala'abul zhing /dga' chen/ khyod bdag sogs kyi gsol ba btab/slar yang rgyun bshags bzhin skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub tu smon lam 'debs su bcug/zla ba rdo rje'i sems bskyed spyi dang mthun par bya/theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/sogs dang /yod dang med lasarnam par 'das//nam mkha' bzhin du dri ma med//zab mo rnam rtog thams/cad kyis//rab tu mi rtog gnas med pa//spros pa kun dang bral bsto/sprosapa rnams kyi rnam par spros//las dang bya ba la sogs bral//bden pa gnyis/la gnas pa yi//theg pa rab kyi mchog 'di ni//tshul la gnas na thob para'agyur//zhes zab mo'i chos bshad/badz+ra satwa krodha'i sngags kyi bsrung ba bya go/de rjes sgre las brtul zhugs sdom pa sbyin zhes 'byung bas/bslab pa'i gnas lnga dang /mi dge ba bcu spongapal sogs pa/sngar ma blangs ba'i sdom pa'i khyad par yod na sbyin zhing /spyir gnyis ka'i rgyud sde'i lugs tsam la dgos pa min yang /rgyud 'dir dbang dngos gzhi rnams phal cher rigs lnga labarten te bskur bar snang bas/rigs lnga'i sdom bzung byas na yang mi legs pa med par mngon/de nas slob dpon gyi rtsa rig bzlos bzhin du/slob ma la mig dar btang /rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyagargya'achar bcug nas/oX badz+ra a dhi 'a taṣ+ṭha snyuX me tog gtad/lkoX badz+ra sam ya guXzhes khrid nas/o badz+ra pra be sha ya huX/zhes yal ba'i nang du bcu ga.oX aX sa mi tri sa me mahāsam ye swahā/zhes las ngag yang gsam ngang 5/ska gsang thugs mnyam pa nyid du mos pa byed du

ṣ+ka༅//snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni//bdag gi slob ma bzhugs par bgyi/sogs bden stobs brjod du gas de nas/sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir//bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni//'gro la phan phyir gtso chen gyig/sman par dgongs te bzhes/ su gsol/oX badz+ra pra ti grihā huX/zhes tshe tog gtor/oṃ pra hi: badz+ra sa ma ya stuX/zhes me tog mgo la bcing /mig dar bas g.yo badz+ra rā/tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hruXtraX/dkyil 'khor ra bzang po 'di la ltos sogs kyis ltasapa / o/lha ngo rgyas par bstan no//slob ma'i snying gar/hūX las rdo rje skyoXgis mtsho no/ pa/ badz+ra sa ma ya huX phaṭa/lan mang du bzlas glob dpon gyi rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcas pa slobama'i snying gar ga a la/oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya rnyi da ya mi/pra be sha dri lha tiṣ+ṭha huXphaṭa/ni gsum/'di ye shes 'bebs pa'i /༷ rin hwa mod mu ge /ye shes ༷ba pa dngos spyod rgyud lamidagos so//mna' chu blud do//'a na khyod kyas dmyal ba 'a chu/sogag sho lo kagasuyugyis dam la bzhag/khyod kyi srog chag/sa bsad mi bya nas/sngags so gos de bzhin no/yis bar gyis dam tshig sgrags so//de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi gsarba bid kyis ji bzhin dbang bskur te/wo gsungs pa'i don/'og nas wang ba'i da bsgyu/masakun rig nyid kyis dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa byed par 'chad pa'ang yod mod kyi/bla ma gongamarnams sngags ༵bang gi don du mdzad la/rgyud bsgyur ba pos kyang sngags dbang yin par bsasanas/sarba da ces pa bod skad du ma bsgyur bar/rgya skad rang sor bldan pa yin no//des na gro ga la sogs pa'i shog shog la gur gum mam ghi nya gis/rtsa rig brgyad pa'am sngags bcugasum bris/dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs/dkyil 'bor gyi sgo nang du bzhag cig bzlas pa rnams kyang de la zur gyi dmigs nas bya ba//bas 'dir de blangs te bla mas tshar gsum klog/

slob mas kyang tshang gsum klog du ༅ga/de nas dri bzang gi chus dkrus la bum par blug/rtsa rig/gam snying po brgya rtsa bzlas/sngags ga༈ rnams kyang cung zad bzlas nas/slob ma'i spyi bonasablug 'thung du gas cing /slob dpon gyis sngags rnams bzlos//de nas bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin pa ni sngags kyi dbang bskur ba ste/byin rlabs gnad shin tu che ba'i zab mo yinano//de nas dbang bum lnga pos rim bzhi dbang bskur te/oṃ budha ka la sha a nyi khris tsho(/rdezhes pa la sogs pa ste bum pa'i dbang ngo //rigs lnga'i phyag rgya spyi 'gro de//spyi bo dang dpral ba lasogs pa'i gnas lngar ga a sa te/oṃ bud+dhā a hi khri zhwa ni oṃ/gos cod pan gyi dbang tshe' la dbu o mi dgos/rin po che dang /me tog gi phreng ba mgo la ཿngas/oṃ rat+na myal ya lobhi khri ྅ mi traX traX traX traX traX/phreng ba'i dbang ngo /dar ram ras skra mtshams su bo tshe rtsa//oṃ badz+rapas ho a ba laXbhi ni a bhi khri zhwa ni traX/rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan lag tu gtad ga tshe budhamudra a bhi khri phu mi o/gos phyag tsho dbang ngo /oṃ bcag nā ma a bhi khri ྅ spu'i/thogs dbāme tog gang la phog pa'i lha'am rdo rje sems dpa' zhes brtags/ming gi dbang ngo /khri tshogs rdo rje gtad la/oṃ badz+ra karma a bhi khi ྅ mi maX/las bsnyo dbang ngo //'dzir logata lka.oṃbadz+ra tsakra a bhi sa ṣañca huX sgruX/i 'khor bskor ba'i dbang ngo //de nas rnam glo sa chunas bcus te/bum pa gas nam dung chos la sogs pas dbang bskur/oṃ jakhri sde tsakra/adhi pa ti stuX a bhi 'i ṣañca rma oṃ oṃ/sogs bdag po'i dbang ngo //lha mo lnga'i sku gzugs los phyanamawo mgo bor ga a sa pa'am lag tu gtad la/oṃ ba khyu du dha ra ṇi a bhi khri stsa3(/'kho(gsapa/gzungs kyi dbang ste/sngags kyi stobs las 'dod pa'i yon to la longs spyod cig sta yab yum gyi sngags phan tshun gcig gis gcig la bogs 'byin par byed pa'i don no/oṃ jakhri/ gu phya a bhi khri thu nga yo sogs/'di la dbang rdzas ༷ dgos/gal te byed na rigs lnga'i sku gzugs/

bstan no//'di ni gsang ba'i dbang bskur ba ste/lha dang snang ba thams cad ye shes kyi rnam rol du shes dgos pa'i phyir ro//de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyis/sogs dang/tshe pratswa u pa yos ma yo ga a bhi ti ྅ ji spyoX/zhes rdo rje dang rdo rjes mas pa'i dril bu gtad do//de ni sngagaso kyi spyod pa thams cad stong pa nyid dang snying rje r+sā po zung du 'brel bar sgom dgos pa'i don te/rdo rje dril bu'i dbang bskur ro//de nas rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugs bsnya ster te shis pa brjod/slob ma'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a dz+nyā du dā phya mi gro hā badz+ra su sirnyi ye/oṃ badz+ra zhin huX/sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur pa'i//slobe ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/zhes slob ma lha la gtad/de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon 'khyu/ra/sogs bka' bsgo/bka'i dbang ngo //de nas slob mas slob dpon la yon gyo cher 'bugadakyil 'khore la'ang mchode pa bya'o//skabs der mi nus na dmigs pas 'bul zhigam sto stod bya'o/de nas tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang /zhes sogs slob ṭa go gyi lobam la gdams ngag bya'o//de tsam gyis ni slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ma tshang ba med cingaslalhag la cung zad kyang ma nor ba'o//rgyud rgyal gzi brjed rtag pa 'o ma'i chu gter sna tshogs bcud ldan de//rnam dpyod nor rgyas srub thag dag gis rgyal ba'i smon lam ri dbang gang /brtsona'agrus stobs kyi sgril zhing srubs las legs bshad stobs 'bar nyin byed 'khrungs//de las/srid 'dir mun tshogs drung nas phyungs shing rab dga'i snang bar gyur//zhes pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i rtog pa'i rgyud don mngon rtogs don 'grel khyad 'phags 'di yang /tā ra nā thas bar skabs su cung zad brjod rgya 5 3 pa'o// // zhu dag ma ṅga le//

rgyud mtha' dag la 'ju / ga pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ snya sti/dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bya ba'i rgyud mtha' dag la'arja rgyag pa zhes bya ba/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal go/yangadag rig pa bla med 'gro rnams la//mchog stsol/bde gshegs kun gyi snying po de//mkha' mnyatsha'agro bas myur du grub slad du//dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal la phyag bgyi'o//'dir sdom ni/dmargya bcing dang phyag 'tshal bdag nyid 'bul//sems bskyed bgegs srung byin rlabs rnam dgabasgom//bdun po de rnams rang rgyud sbyang ba yin//phyi yi 'khrus dang bsrung ba khrus chu sgrug/bsangs gtor khrus sa byin rlabs byug pa bya//lus sogs bkru dang gnas su 'jug pa sto/brgyad po khrus kyi cho ga yin par shes//bdag srung mchod pa'i bgegs bsal gzi byin bskyed//mchod pa byin rlabs phur bu gdab pa dang //phyogs bcing bal rim pa gsum yod cing/khru guramatshams gcod don wo bcu po ni//bgogs rnams bsal ba'i sde tshan nyid du gtogs/je sbyang ba dang khrus bya bgegs bsal ba//sde tshan gsum po 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro yin//rnal 'byora'ajug pa'i bya ba drug yin te//'bags pa bsal dang gtan la 'dug pa dang //rdo rje len dngagadu bu gdags pa dang //bsad byed bzung dang ze rtsa ba brtsing ba'o//dngos gzhi'i cho ga'ang rnam pa drug yod de//bdag gi de nyid rten bskyed spyan drangs dang //bzhugs gsol dam bzhag tshogos bsags de la brgyan//mchod pa bstod pa bshags pa skyabs 'gro dang //gsol gdab semasardebaskyed tshad med bzlas pa'o//slar btang ba sde 5 rdon mtshams rnal 'byor gnyis//'jug chog yin

te thun mtshams rwa ba bkrol/ /glegs bam bklag dang rjes dran drug sgom dang / /maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing sā tsā gdab pa sogs/ /snod gos bkru ba'am sngags pa'am bsangs gtor bya/ /bsrung skud bya zhingabaza' min zos pa sbyangs/ /slar btang man chad rjes kyi bya bar bsdu/ /bya ba'i rgyud kyi chog rgyas pa la/ /bsnyen pa'i rim pa de ltar yin par shes/ /de ltar sdoms su bsgrigs pa'i don cung ra phye ste bshad na/ bya ba'i rgyud las byung ba bsnyen pa'i cho ga rgyas pa'i rim pa la/ rnal 'byor gyi yan lagabazhi ste/ rnal 'byor gyi sngon du bya ba'i rim pa/ rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i bya ba/ rna pa 'byor ge so/gzhi'i nyams len/ rnal 'byor rjes kyi rim pa'o/ /dang po la rgyud sbyang ba/ khrus bya ga bgegs/ gsal ba gsum mo/ /de'i dang po la/ dam tshig gi sngags rgya bcing ba/ phyag 'tshal ga bdaganyid 'bul ba/ sems bskyed pa/ bgegs srung ba/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ rnam dag stong nyid sgom pa ste bdun no/ /gnyis pa khrus kyi bya ba la/ phyi'i khrus dngos dang / khrus kyi srung bdad khrus chu sgrub pa dang / bsangs gtor dang / sa khrus kyi sa byin gyis brlabs pa dang / byug pa so'i khrus dag lus dang gdong dang lag pa bkru ba dang / lha'i gnas su 'jug pa ste brgyad do/ /gsum pa bgogs bsal ba la/ bdag srung ba/ mchod pa srung ba/ gnas srung ba gsum/ de'i gnyis pa mchod pa srung ba la/ mchod pa'i bgegs bsal/ mchod pa gzi byin bskyed/ mchod pa byin gyis rlabs pagasum/ gsum pa gnas srung ba la/ phur bu gdab pa dang / steng phyogs bcing ba dang / 'khore yig bcing ba dang / rwa ba bcing ba dang / rā gur phub pa dang / mtshams gcod pa ste rim pa drug go/gnyis pa rnal 'byo tshor la 'jug pa'i bya ba drug ste/ 'bags pa bsal ba/ gdan la 'dug pa/ dmotshig rdo rje len zhing bcing ba/ gdu bu gdags pa/ bsangs byed bzung ba/ ze'u kha bo ceng bogogasum pa rnal 'byor dngos gzhi'i nyams len la/ bdag gi de kho na nyid sgom pa dang / rten gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa dang / ye shes kyi lha spyan drangs pa dang / bzhugs su gsol bdag dam —55—

la ga theg pa dang / tshogs bsags pa'o/ drug pa tshogs bsags de la dbye na/ mchod pa/bstod pa/ bshags pa/ skyabs 'gro/ gsol gdab/ sems bskyed/ tshad med bzhi/ sngags bzlas pa ste brgyad do/ /rnal 'byor rjes kyi rim pa la/ slar btang ba dang / thun mtshams kyi bya ba gnyisaso/ /de ltar na sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi sde wo rnams nges par bya'o/ /de la dang po khon nasagatsang sbra dang bcas te bod rnams lag len mdzad pa ltar na/ sdoms su ma 'dus kyang thog mnyid du spyi dang mtshungs par skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sems bskyed pa bya/ khyim pa yin na bsnyen gnas kyi gso sbyong don zhags kyi cho ga ltar blang / de nas cho ga'i rim pa rnams phreng chags su bgrangs na 'di lta ste/ 1 dam tshig gi sngags rgya bcing ba/ 2 phyag 'tshal ba/ 3 bdaganyid 'bul ga 4sems bskyed pa/ 5 bgegs srung ba/ 6 byin gyis rlabs pa/ 7 rnam dag sgom pa/ 8phyi khrus byab/ 9 khrus kyi srung ba/ 10 bsangs chu sgrub pa/ 11 bsangs gtor byag 12 sa byin rlabs//13 sas byug pa/ 14 lus sogs bkru ba/ 15 gnas su 'jug pa/ 16 bdag srung ga 17mchod pa'i bgegs bsal ba/ 18 gzi byin bskyed pa/ 19 mchod pa byin rlabs/ 20 phur bus gdab pa/ 21 steng phyogs bcing ba/ 22 khor yug bcing ba/ 23 rwa bsku cong ga ci gur 'bugs pa/ 25 mtshams gcod pa/ 26 'bags pa bsal ba/ 27 gdan la 'dug pa/ 28 rdo rje bcing ba/ 29 gdu bu gdags pa/ 30 bsang byed bzung ba/ 31 ze'u kha bcing pa/ 32bdag gi de nyid/ 33 rten bskyed pa/ 34 lha spyan drangs pa/ 35 bzhugs/ su gsol ga 36dam la bzhag pa/ 37 mchod pa/ 38 bstod pa/ 39 bshags pa/ 40 skyangs 'gro 41 /gsol gdab/ 42 sems bskyed/ khu3 tshad med bzhi/ 44 bzlas brjod byed pa/ 45 slarabatang ba/ 46 thun mtshams kyi bya ba ste/ don tshan bzhi bcu zhe drug yod pa las/ dang po dam tshinagi sngags dang phyag rgya bcing ba ni/ o tā thā ga ta ud bha we swāhā/ zhes brjod cing / thal mo —56—

bkan pa las mdzub mo gnyis cung zad bkug pa mgo la bldan pa ni de bzhin gshegs rigs spyi'i dam rgya'o/ /gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ mgon po thugs rjes che ldan pa/ /thams/cad mkhyen pa ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing / /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge ba'i phan song las grol zhing / /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i/ /zhi gyur chosalaphyag 'tshal lo/ /grol bas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa dgal rab tugus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing / /dgo'adun la yang phyag 'tshal lko /gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ /ye shes sgron me rab rgyas shing / /rme rdzen rten gsum gyi mun sel pa/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drangs rgyasakun gyis rab tu bsngags/ /yon tan dam pa kun gyis brgyan/ /spyan rasagazigs zhes mtshan gsol pa/ /rtag par rtsel phyag 'tshal lo/ /stobs po tshel drag shul che/ /rigs sngags rgyal po dge ba can/ /gdul dka' mtha' dag 'dul ba po/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin dam pa 'grub pa ste/ /rigs sngags 'chang kun dbang phyug rje/ /dpa' bo gcig pu dgra thu wab/ rdorje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu/ /lha dang lha min drizar bcas/ /klu dang gnod sbyin tshogs kyis mchod/ /thub pa sangs rgyasaganyis par 'dud/ /ces so/ gzhan yang ji ltar 'os pa'i phyag 'tshal ba dag bsnan kyang mi 'gal lo/ kha cig o sarba ta thā ga tā kā ya lha ka tsit+ta badz+ra praṇa tshen/ sarba ta thāgata badz+ra ban da nā ka ro mi/ zhes pas phyag byed de/ bya rgyud rang lugs yin min ges dgosapas re zhig mi bya'o/ gsum pa bdag nyid 'bul ba ni/ snying gar thal mo sbyar/ bdag mingatshe—57—

ge mo zhes bgyi ba/ chos kyi dbyings su gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khore dang bcas pa thams cad la bdag 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa des kyang bdag la rnam pa thams cad dang dusathams cad du byin gyis rlabs pa dang / yongs su bsrung bar gyur ga /bdagal grub pa dang mchog stsol cig /ces rgyud 'di nyid las 'byung ba'am/ spyi 'gro'i tshig gis kyang rung ngo / /bzhi pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mo chog la/ byangachub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /bdag dang gzhan don sgrub slad du/ /bdagagis byang chub sems bskyed do/ /phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' gson/ /bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir/ /deng nas byang chub sems bskyed do/ /de yan chad kyi sngags dang tshigs cha rnams ༅ gsum gsum bya'o/ /lnga pa bgegs srung ba ni/ lag pa gnyis sor mo phan tshun bsnol te bsdams pa'i khu tshu 'a / rje phyir bsdams su grags pa de byas la/ /mthe chung gnyis gshibs te sgrong / mdzub mog stis rtsesbyar te brkyang ba'i g.yas g.yon du mthe bong gnyis sbyar ba khro bo ba nol ba med pa'i phyag rgya de/snying ga dang / lkog ma dang / smin mtshams dang / spyi bo rnams su sngags lan re res gtugs/ oṃbadz+ra kro dha mahā ba la/ ha na da ha pa tsa biṅgā na sa ya/ u tsu'i kro dha hūX phaṭa/ na morat+na tra yā ya/ na maXtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo badz+ra kro dh+wa ya/ mahā daX sno da ka ṭa bhe ra pā ya/ ta du thā/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali kha kha' hi khyahi/tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+ta ban+ta/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gas gardza/bi spos ya/ pi spoṭaya/ sarba bisna bi nā ya kaX /mahā ga na pa ti/ /dzi bi ta an+ta karwa ya swāhā shegapa—58—

bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgyas pas kyang ngo /drug pa byin gyis rlabs pa ni/rang gi snyingagar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/rnam par snang mdzad kyi gsung rigasasngags kyi ngo bo ma yig gser gyi mdog can dang /'tshogs mar khro bo mig tho ba'i gsung rigs sngags kyi ngo bo ha yig sngon po 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugasapar gyur/bdun pa rnam dag stong nyid sgom pa ni/oṃ snya bhā wa shudhaXsarba dhatshwa swā bhā walo rdo3haX/chos thams cad bdag nyid kyi sems su 'dus shing /sems rang bzhin gyi rna5paradag pa'o//ces brjod cing don bsam/bsnyen pa'i cho ga bsdus pa la dga' bas de yan chad borakyang chog go/brgyad pa phyi'i khrus dngos ni/dpung bzang gi rgyud las gsal mod/bod ye chonakhrigs kyi dkyus 'jug stabs mi bde bas/khrus dang gtor ma'i bya ba sngon rol nas grub par byaste/'dir yid kyis mos pa tsam bya'o//rdor bsdams las mdzub mo gnyis gshibs te bsgrengs//mthe bong gnyis de'i g.yasagayon du sbyar la/oṃ ni kha na ba su dhi swāhā/lan 'dun la sogs pa mang du bzlas te/sadang chus bkrus par bsam/dgu pa khrus kyi srung ba ni//mthe bos mthe chung gi sen mo mnan/sor mo lhag ma gsum rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i tshul du byas/lag gnyis bsnol nas phyag rgya de dpung pa g.yas g.yon du bzhag/yid tsam e gtsigs bsdams/khro bo'i lta ba dang bcas pa gan ceṅkarat+na tra yā ya/mahā yak+ṣa sen pa ta ye/na mo badz+ra kro dh+wa ya/ta du shā/oṃ hu lu hulu/sta tiṣ+ṭha/ban+ta ban+ta/ha na ha na/an+t+ra te hūX phaṭa/tses twad rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgyas bdag nyid srung ngo //'di 'dud rtsi'i sngags 'bring po yin no//bcu pa bsang chu sgrub pa ni/snod bzang por chu gtsang ma dri zhim pos sbags pa la dmigs te/na mo rat+na tru yā ya/na maXtsam badz+ra pā ṇa ye/oṃ hūX ha na ha na badz+re badz+re ṇa haXlan nyer gcig nas brgya'i ḍa sna 59

bar du bzlas/bcu gcig pa bsang gtor ni/oṃ gī liki li badz+ra hūXphaṭa/ces ni 'dunal sogs pa bzla zhing /g.yon pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas bsang chu blangs te bdag dang/gnas dang /yo byad dang /sa'i gong bu la bsangs gtor bya/bcu gnyis pa sa byin gyis/rlabs pa ni/oṃ badz+ra ha ra huX/zha bdun no//bcu gsum pa sa khrus ni/oṃ snurang la hāXphaṭa/lan bdun las mi nyung ba bzlas te/lag pa las sa byug cing 'phyis par bya'o//bcu bzhi pa lusardesogs bkru ba ni/oṃ a mṛ te huX phaṭa/lan nyer gcig tsam yid kyis bzla zhib/lus dngagadong dang lag pa rnams 'khrus chus bkru'o//'on kyang chog khrigs la yid bzlas kho na mi sre3 rdepas ngag bzlas byed dgos so//nyams len bsdud pa'i skabs gong gi phyi khrus dang /lus so gos bkru ba 'di kho nas 'grub pas bar gyi rnams bor bas chog go/'dir khrus kyi cho ga 'bring po dkyus su shad pa 'di nyid de rgyas pa ni gas las rtogs par bya'o//thob thang la de yan khosgrub khang gi phyi rol tu byeng pa yin/deng sang gi chog khrigs ltar na de ltar sgrub dka' bas lto du byed pa las 'os med do//bco lnga pa gnas su 'jug pa ni/gos gsar pa gyon/sgrub khang dang nye bar rkang pa bkrus/nye reg byas khang par zhugs/lha rnams mngon sum du dmigs pa la phyag byas nas/sgo nang du lhal phyogs de 'dug dgos pa yin pa las/chog khrigs kyis skabs su gzhan de dag dmigs parabya zhing /a mṛ ta bzla bzhi du nye reg dngos su byas na legs/mthar oṃ bi ra dza bi ra dza mahā badz+re sa ta sa ta spyo ra te spyo ra te tra ye tra ye/bidha ma ni sam bhañja ni ta ramati sirnyi a gre snya swāhā/gnas su zhugs shing dam tshig la 'jug pa'i sngags 'di lan gsum gardebacu drug pa bdag srung ba ni/8rnya du ban+ta swāhā/zhes pa de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi 'as/thamasardecad pa ni nyer gcig dang /na mo rat+na tra sdu ya/mahā yak+ṣa senā zhes pa na g.yon+t+ra

te hū phaṭa/gong bzhin ga kyid rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags 'bring po lan gsum gyis dung chos lasogs pa bsang chu'i snod lag pa g.yon tu bzhag/g.yas pas rang gi lus la gtor ro//bcubadun pa mchod pa'i bgegs bsal ba ni/bdud rtsi thabs spyor gyi sngags de nyid lan gsumadubazla bzhin du/mchod pa la mthor yab kyis bsang chu gtor/yang dzi na dzika zhes pa de bzhinagashegs rigs kyi snying po lan bdun las mi nyung bas kyang mchod pa la bsangs gtor bya'o//bco brgyad pa gzi byin bskyed pa ni/g.yon pa'i gung srin gnyis mthe bos mnan/mdzub modang mthe'uchung gnyis gdub bu'i tshul du gung srin gnyis kyi rgyab tu sbyar/g.yas rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyakha gyen du bstan nas g.yon gyi mtheb mdzub gi 'og nas bton te/gung mo bzung ba ltar byed pa ni/gzi byin bskyed pa'i phyag rgya ste/de nyid mchod pa rnams kyi steng nas/lding skor dang bus pa'i tshulabyed de de la bram pa zhes bya ba ni cab se cab se reg pa'i tshul dang thig gtor gyi tshul byed pa'o//oṃ te dza te dza sa sdo rje / su dha swāhā/lan mang du bzla ste/'di de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi gzi byin bskyed pa'o//bcu dgu pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni/yang gong du bshad par ltar gyi/na morat+na tra yā ya nas/ha na ha na a mṛ te hū phaṭa/kyi bar dang/phyag rgya gong bzhin te thabs sbyor gyi sngags rgya lan bdun la sogs pas mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/dzi na dzika la na gsum la sogs pas brtan par bya'o//bsdu na mchod pa'i bgegs bsal/gzi byin bskyed byin rlabs te/gsum po dedagaskabs 'dir ma byas kyang chog go/nyi shu pa phur bus gdab pa ni/lag pa gnyis ka'i gung srinaganyis gdu bu ltar byas te/rang rang phyogs kyi spe sha la btsugs/mthe'u chung mdzub mo gon bas te bsgrengs/mthe bong rtse sbyar te bsgrong ba las lag mgo'i rgyab nang du phyogs pas rtse mo thur la bstan pa ni phur bu'i phyag rgya ste/oṃ ki li gī la badz+re badz+re bhu ra bhan+dha hū phaṭa/lan gsum bzlas 6

pas bgegs thams cad la phur bus btab par bsam/tsho( gī li gī la badz+ra kli phaṭa/kyis/kyang bsangs gtor bya'o//'di phyogs bcing ba'i nang ni 'og phyogs 'ching ba yin kyag bgegasal phur bus 'debs pa la sogs pa'i dgos pa khyad par can g.yin yod pa'i phyir/phyogs bcingapo'i nang du ma bsdus par phur bus gdab pa zhes don tshan la sogs par byas so//nyer gcig pa steng phyogs bcing ba ni/oṃ su sirnyi ka ra dzā li ta a nan ta mu kha ta ye dz+wa la dz+wa la/rdo ban+ta/ha na ha na jiXphaṭa/ces spyi dang/tshe dzol zhuXzhes khyad par gyi sngags lan gsum gyis steng phyogs bcing par 'gyur/'di skabs bdug spos spor/nyeraganyis pa 'khor yug ཿnga ba ni/spos chus phyogs mtshams thams cad dugator la/dzi na dzikamang du bzlas pa'i mthar/bhūX/zhes lan brgya rtsa bam brjod/shar la sogs ye phyogs rnarmas dang /me la sogs pa'i phyogs mtshams thams cad bcings par gyur/nyer gsum pa rwa ba bcing ba ni/sngar gyi phur bu'i phyag rgya de nyid las mthe bong gyen du bstan zhing kha phye ba ni/rwa pe re phyag rgya ste de nyid phyogs mtshams kun tu bstan la/na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na ma ga badz+ra paṇa ye/mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ta bya thā/oṃ sa ra sa ra badz+ra/bhā ka ra huX phaṭa/rdo rje'i rwa ba bar 'tshams med pas phyogs thams cad bskor bar gyur/wo bzhi pa gura'abugs pa ni/rwa ba'i phyag rgya de nyid kha thur du bska la steng du bskor ba dra ba'i phyag rgya ste/na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na ma stso lha1badz+ra pā na ye/mahā yak+ṣa sen pa ta ye/tar+ya thā/khro skra sgru ra rak+ṣa badz+ra pā ṇi huX phaṭa/steng du rdo rje'i gur sra zhing lkog la rtse mo mthon po grub tso gyur/'di dag gi skabs su gur dang dra ba don gcig par byed do//nyer lnga pa mtshams gcod pa ni/oṃgī li gī la badz+re badzi bhu ra rwa nyuphaṭa/kyi sngags dang phyag rgya lan gsum gyis zung 'bor rnams byin gyis rlabs par mos shing /bru 2 bos sor mo rnams mnan pa'i khu tshur changalo

la/ sdigs 'dzub brkyang ste/ dbus na rgya rje che je cher lan gsum du bskor zhig na mtsho༅man+ta /badz+ra ṇa/ oṃ ta ra ta ra/ tu ru tu sa ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ban+ta ban+ta/ sa bo tra a prati ha ras si me sa sa sban+ta ku ru ku sa ta ra ta ra/ sa man+ta badz+re sa man+ta badz+re/ ku ru a ma le ka ru ṇa ma ye/ tu ta ye tu ta ye/ ba ra ba ra/ ka ra kar/ su mims man+ta/bi dh+wa na sa ya/ dz+wa la ya swāhā/ lan gsum/ rdo rje'i rwa ba'i phyi rol du medapung 'bar bsabaskor bar gyur/ rgyun gyi nyams len sngon 'gro bsdus pa'i skabs/ phur gdab dang bsang༅gtoradang mtshams gcod pa'i sngags rgya gnyis pa tsam gyis kyang chog pa'i skabs yod do/ /nyer drug pa 'bags pa bsal ba ni/ /spos chu lag mthil du blug la/ dzi na dzikarang dubazlas te/ rang gi spyi bo nas bsangs gtor bya/ /nyer 'dun pa gtan la 'dug pa ni/ rtsa ku ge re gdan sogs la 'dug par mos te/ na mo rat+na: nas/ a mṛ te hū phaṭa/ gyis twad rtsithabs spyor bzla bzhin du/ gtan la bsangs gtor byas te/ skyil mo krung gis 'dug go de yanachad gtan g.yin la gnas pa'am 'greng ste bya ba yin la/ /phyis sgom bzlas byed sa'i gtan la'adug pa'i mtshams ni 'di'o/ /nyer brgyad pa rdo rje rmenang ba ni/ spyi rgyud legs grub las jo mi tha pa'i shing ngam/ dur khrod gyi 'gal dum las bcos pa'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa tsas dmar pos bskus pa dgos par bshad pa las rtse gsum pa yang phyogs gcig gam phyogs gnyis yin gyi gsal kha med pas/ gnyis ka rung bar mngon la/ 'di kho nar ni ma nges te/ dpung bzang las rdo lja'i rnamagrangs du ma gsungs pa bzhin/ gang skabs su bab pa zhig/ blangs te/ bkrus shid sbyangs/ gu gulagyis bdugs/ yungs kar gyi brabs/ lag tu blangs te snying gar gtad la/ tsho rna dhu na badz+ra ha/zhes bdun la sogs pa mang du bzlas te/ bdag gi las thams cad mdzad du ge sol/kho brjod/ dkyus su de tsam gyis chog la/ thog ma'i rdo rje rab tu gas pa la/ /dad —63—

pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ zhes sogs kyis khro bo legs grub sbyan drangs te/ bde b.ragashegs so bcom ldan 'das: sogs dang / mchod pa lnga 'bul/ legs grub kyi sngagasasam/ o dhu na badz+ra ha/ lan stong la sogs pa bzla/ bcom ldan 'das bdagalathugs brtse ba'i slad du/ 'di dag tu bzhugs te bdag gi las thams cad mdzad du gsol/ zhes byin gyis rlabs pa'i dgongs pa zhu'o/ /'di la sngags bzla pho tshe rdorjede khro bo legs grub kyi phyag tu bzung pa'am/ sku'i mdun du bzhag nas byin gyis rlabs par mos pa yin la/ mthar rdo rje khro bos rang la stsal bar bsam/ de nas mchod yon phul te khro bo gshegs su gsol/ kha cig khro bo rdo rje la thim par bsam nas/ gshegs gsol mi byed pa ni/ zu ) bya ba rgyud kyitshul las 'das pa'o/ /nyer dgu pa gdub bu gdags pa ni/ snga rol nas ras skud gtsang ma sum sgril mdud pagasum bor ba la/ bu to ci'i 'bru gcig brgyus pa'i lag gdub spyan ma'i sngags lan brgya bzlas pas byin gyis rlabs pa de skabs 'dir g.yas kyi 'khrigs ma la skon te/ o ru ru slu ru dz+walatiṣ+ṭha sirnyi lo tsa ni sarba ar+sha sā dha ne swāhā/ lan bdun/ o ku lan+ta rdiban+ta gan+ta hūphaṭa/ lan bdun la sogs pas bsngags te/ 'dis ni bgegs kyis mi rdzi ba dab da thos grub myur ba dang / gtsang byed du bshad do/ /sum bcu pa bsang byed bzung ba ni/ ku sha'am ma rnyed na/dge zhing bkra shis pa'i rtswa sngon po srin lag la bcings te/ dzi na dzi ka nyer gcig sogs mang du bzla'o/ /so gcig pa ze'u kha bcing ba ni/ o rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ma/ sarba budha a dhiṣ+ṭha na at+pa tsib ra swāhā/ lan gsum la sogs pa bzlas te ze'u kha bcing pa'o/ /de la ze'u kha ni 'grub na zin po che'am dar ras la sogs pa las bcos pa'i dprog zhu yin la/ gzhan du na thod bcing pa'am dar —64—

————— ras dmar po'am ser po'am dkar po'i gtsug tor gyi gzugs brnyan bcings kyang rung / skra ringapo can yin na skra nyid thor tshugs su bcing ba'am/ gtsug phud can gyi gtsug phud 'ching bo'i/ skra bregs pas ni tha na dar ras dmar ser dkar po phra mo rna ltag tu bcings pas kyang 'grub bo/ /so gnyis pa bdag gi de kho na nyid sgom pa ni/ mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad sdug bsngal rgyudangabacas pa las bdag gis bsgral te/ chos kyi dbyings byang chub mchog la bdag gis dgod parabya'o/ /phyi rol du snang ba 'di thams cad bag chags kyi stobs las/ nang gi shes pa nyid de ltarasnang bar zad kyi/ phyi rol du snang ba ni rdul phra rab tsam yang med do/ /de ltar na khams gsu༅po 'di dag ni sems tsam ste/ sems de yang dmigs pa med pa nam mkha' lta bu'o/ /thams cad kyi rang bzhin spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes gtsang ba dang / bde ba dang rtag pa dang bdag dam pe'i pha rol du phyin pa sangs rgyas kyi chos mtha' yas pas nye bar bgyon pa'o/ /zhes brjod cing de'i donaring du bsam par bya'o/ /skabs 'di dag tu ches che ba mang po dag kyang rnam 'joms kyi 'grel par lung drangs pa'i lha drug ston byed kyi tshog dang / bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud dang / sangs rgyas gsang bsogs kyis bshad pa la brten nas/ bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed dgos tshul byed cing tshad ldan yin min la mi lta bar lung rnyed tshad 'dren la/ rigs pa yang dag gis ma lang bar ltar snang gi dmag dpung mang po spron par byed mod kyi/ khas slangs skyo ma snga btsan thal tshes pa kho na las don dang ldan pa ma yin te/ bsam gtan phyi ma rdo rje gtsug gtor gyi rgyud phyi ma yin par yind kyang / rdo rje gtsun toragyirgyud de bya rgyud yin pa'i rgyu mtshan med cing / bod na de'i rtsa rgyud dngos su yang med pas gtsugatoragyi rgyud phyi ma yin pa ci gzhan ngor rtsod pa'i skabs su rgyu mtshan du mi 'gyur ba dang / nges par nabasam gtan phyi ma ni spyod rgyud yin te/ don 'di la rnam snang mngon byang dang 'chad tshul gcigakho—65—

nar yod pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam 'joms kyi 'grel par drangs pa'i lung de yang da gdod brtag dgosapa yin gyi da lta ngom du rung ba'i lung ma yin la/ sangs rgyas gsang ba rgyud sde bzhi'i grangs ngesadabye ba mi mdzad cing / rgyud chig dngos bstan la bdag bskyed ston mi ston gnyis yod kyagagadul bya'i blo tshod dang bstun nas gcig gis gcig shos la kha 'gengs rgyu yin zhes bya spyod gnyis rgyud sde gcig tu 'dod pa'i lugs de dang / rgyud sde bzhir phye nas bya spyod so sor 'dod pe'i lugs de nam yang mi 'grig pas/ sangs rgyas gsang bas bshad pa rnams skabs 'dir lungakhungs su mi 'gyur ro/ /mdor na bya rgyud yin nges rnams nas/ bdag bskyed zur tsam yang mgasungs la/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa la ye shes pa bsre ba'i cho ga sogs kyang ye ma bstan zhib/ der ma zad lung khungs kyi gtso bo 'da' bar mi rung ba'i nges pa can ni/ ye shes rdo rje kun las gsargapa'i rgyud las/ bya rgyud la bdag bskyed ye med par gsungs pa 'di bya rgyud rang skad du bdag bskyed med par 'dod pa la bsgrub byed bla na med pa dang / yod par 'dod pa rnams la bzlog tumed pa'i gnod byed stobs chen po ste re zhig 'di ni lung gi sgo nas so/ /rig pa'i sgo nas kyang bya rgyud rang skad la bdag bskyed yod cing / bdag bskyed kyi lha druskadang / bsam gtan phyi ma nas bshad pa'i bzlas brjod dang bsam gtan gyi rnal 'byor de dgayod na ni/ bya spyod gnyis kyi ma po dma'i dbye bu la kha bshad kyi spros pa ji tsam mkhas kyang nyamasalen gyi skabs su mchog dman dang bzang ngan gyi dbye ba cung zad kyang med par thal bar 'gyur zhing / de yang 'dod na rgyud sde bzhi dang lnga dang drug la sogs pa'i dbye ba byed pa ba6da gad kyisaganas su 'gyur ro/ /'phros pas chog go /so gsum pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ maṇ+ḍawalam 'bras bris sku bzhugs pa'i gnas la nye bar dmigs nas 'di skad ces brjod de/ yangadag pa'i smon lam stobs las sa phyogs 'dir rin po che du ma las grub pa'i —66—

zhing khams sa gzhi yangs shing rgya che ba gser gyi bye mas brdal bar gyur/ oṃ.a tsa la bī ra huX swāhā/ de'i dbus su 'o ma'i rgya mtsho chen po nya lcibs la sogasardepa'i skyon dang bral ba/ pad+ma dang ut+pal la sogs pa'i me tog gis brgyan pa/yid du 'ong ba'i nya dang 'dabs chags la sogs pa sna tshogs pas gang bar gyur/ oṃ bi ma la dha hā khyuX de'i dbus su rab ri'i rgyal po grubazhi pa/ tho/ sabazhin nas gser dang dngul dang / in+d+ra nī la dang / pad+ma rā gdang bcas/pa'i bang rim gyis brgyan pa/ /tha ma mtha' dag tu dpag bsam gyi shing legs parabaskrun pa/ ri rab de'i steng du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyisakhrasas pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang rdo rje 'dzin thams cad nye bar 'dub/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa thams cad lhag par dgyes pas rnam par rol pa/ zin po che'i rgyal po rnam pa sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung ba/ gzhal med khang rdo rje zin po che'i rtse mo mthon po can/ gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis brgyas pa/bkra ba blta na sdug pa shin tu rnam par phye ba rin po che'i them skas bzhi dang bcas pa'i nang gi dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po rin po che du mas brgyan pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i 'dab ma can/ gser gyi ze ba dang pu sha ra ga'i ze'u 'khrusabargyan pa/ snying po'i thog la dngul gyi ri mos bskor ba/ dpag tshad du ma'i khyon can/ ri rab kyi dbus brdol nas byung ba'i ze'u 'bru'i snying por rdo rje 'brongabus gdong nas spras pa'i seng ge'i khri dang de'i steng du pad+ma'i gdan lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khom ra gyi mdzes pa/ gzhan yang lha rnams kyi gdan dang bcas pa dang / steng du rin po che'i bla bre dag kyang skad cig gis byung bar gyur/ lkodag—67—

rdo rje thal mo sor mo g.yas pa steng du yod pa byas la/na maXsarba ta thā ga tā nāX sarba blo gi yi|te/spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX swāhā/lan gsum mo//so bzhi pa lha spyan drangs pa ni/snod gtsang mar spos chu gtsang ma me tog dkar po dang cas pa ni rtsa ba'i mchod yon te/'di ni ngesapar bsham dgos la/g.yin yang 'grub na/zhi ba dang dngos grub rab la dza ba'i 'bru dnga'o ma/rgyas pa dang dngos grub 'bring la til dang zho/thun mong du 'bras yos so//de dag sbyar si mchod yon rtsa ku sha dang cas pa'ang dgos na de ni logs su bsham pa yin gyi/spos chu gtsang ma'i ca du de dag ldugs pa ni ma yin no//ma rdzo yon de dag spos kyi bdugs/rigs pa'i rgyal po bhūX bdun dang /rigs kyi snying po dzi na dzika bdun gyis byin gyis rlabs cing /tsol ༷ni ban+ta snyasmazhes/ pa de gzhin gshe/gas rigs kyi las thams cad pa mang nyung ji ltar 'os pas kyang bsngags la/mchod yon gtsang ma de mdun gyi dbus su bzhag/g.yon du khyad par gyi mchod yon 'bras yosacan dang /g.yas su bdug spos rnams bshams te/na mo rat+na tra yā ya/zhes lan gsum gyi dzosaphyag btsal/rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/mdzub mo gnyis rtse mo sbyar te bsgrengs/mtho bong g.yab cigadad pa dang ni dam tshig/sa gis//tshur gshe/gas tshur gde/gas bcom ldan 'dir//bdag gi mchod yon 'di bzhes la//mchod pas bdag la dges/par mdzod/bhūX dzi na dzika shwakya mu ne e hai hi/zhes sh+ka gsum la sogs par gsol ba 'debs pas nan tan gyis spyan drangs/de yang phyag rgya spyi bo'i thad du byas te/lan dang po phyagargya kho na bya/gnyis pa la phyag rgya des mchod yon gtsang ma thogs te spyi bo'i thad nas bzed zhal du 'bul/gsum pa la dzos sbyar ba'i mchod yon thog te 'bul/rdzas rnams dngos su med na/chugatsang ngam me tog tsam dang bcas pa 'bul zhing /lhag ma dmigs pa kho nas 'gru/ba blo/de yang lha bzhengs pa la rang yang 'greng ba dang /spre'uX/ pa la 'dug pa dang /gzur ba lagazur bas

'bul bar bshad kyang dngos su ma 'grub na dmigs pas chog go /so lnga pa bzhugs su gsol bani/ de nas pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya kha phye ba'i tshul can gyi/ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan/ /bdagagimachod yon bzhes nas kyang / /mchod pas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ o kam la ya swāhā/ yang phyag rgya de dang 'dra ba las/ gung mdzub srin gsum rdo rje rtse lnga lta bur byasal/ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs rjes thugs dpagamadzad du gsol/ /sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ā sa ni hu phaṭa/ pas ba phye las/so ros dbus ma gnyis gshibs te bsgreng ba dang / bdag dang 'gro la thugs rtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcowaldan bzhugs su gsol/ /o badz+ra ka hu phaṭa/ phyag rgya gsum po de lon/ pu du'i bdan dang / rdo rje'i gdan dang / dpa' bo'i gdan zhes grags so/ /de nas/ye shes dkyil 'khoragyi lha tshogs thams cad so so'i rdzu 'phrul gyi 'byor pa dpag tu med pa dang bcas te nam mkha'i lam las gshegs nas thar pa chen po'i khang bzang gzhal med khang gi chab sgo nas yongs su byon te/ rang rang so so'i gdan labazhugs par gyur pa ni dbus kyi pad+ma wo po'i steng gi rdo rje rin po che'i bzhugs khri la pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po sku mdog ser po btso ma'i gser gyi lhun po la nyi ma 'bum dus gcig tu shar ba ltar gzi brjid kyi phung po mtha' yas pa —69—

rab tu 'bar ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing / phyag gsathugs kar chos kyi 'khor lo'i phyag rgya mdzad pas 'gro ba thams cad la thar pa'i lam yang dag par ston pa/ dbu'i gtsug tor lta bar mi mngon pa dang sman mtshams mdzod sbu dung ltar 'khyil ba la sogs pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu yongs su rdzogs pa 'o dod chagasadang bral ba chen po'i cha byad can sku la na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spro bas phyogs bcu'i zhing khams ma lus pa rgyas par 'gengs pa/ ma lus shing lus pa med pa'i sprul pa'i tshogs mtha' yas pa 'char ba/ bsam gyis mi khyab cing lhun gyis grub pa'i sku dang gsungardedang thugs dang yon tan dang 'phrin las la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyi khri'i g.yas logs su 'phags pa rdorje 'dzin chen po gser mdog ral pa'i cod pan can na bza' ser po gyon pa/phyag g.yas pas rdo rje ser po 'dzin zhing / g.yon pa gdan la brten pa/ 'di yang na g.yas rin po che dang / g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa yang rung / lcags kyu cig phyag gnyes kar gyis 'dzin par byas kyang chog go /g.yon logs su 'phags ma rdo rje 'dzin ljangakhu'am ser mo dong ka'i me tog dang kha dog mtshungs pa'i bla gos can pus mo phyogs gcig gdan la btsugs pa'i tshul gyi bzhugs shing / phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar bas rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /da lta'i rgyud las/ 'di lha pho yin pa ltar bshad pa ni/ rgya skad du badz+ra dha rā zhes pe'i ra yigagi ring cha mo rtags yin yang yig ge nor te ring cha chad pa las bsgyur ba'i skyon yin te/ 'diralha—70—

lnga la de bzhin gshegs pa dang / rigs kyi yum dang / byang chub sems dpa' dag pho nya dang phyag snyan rnams tshang dgos pa'i phyir/ 'di lha mor ma byas na/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rigs kyi yumamatshang bar tsor bas so/ /rdo rje 'dzin chen po'i mdun ngos 'og gi phyogs su khyi'umatha' med pa/ khor kho yug tu me lce 'bar ba a sho ka dmar ba'i me tog rgyasapa lta bu'i mdog can khro zhing 'khrugs la nor bu'i zur phud kyis brgyan pa/sprul dkar po'i tshangs skud 'chang ba/ phyag g.yas na gri gug dang / g.yon na zhags pa 'dzin zhing / spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa la sogs pa khro bo'i mtshan nyid rdzogs shing dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /'di yang na stag lpags kyi smad dkris dang / rgyan gzhan rnams kyang sbrul rgyan can du bya'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma'i mdun gyi 'og phyogs su bu mo mtha' yas ma zhes bya ba'i pho nya mo gzhon zhu lang tsho can sku mdog /nag mo'am/ ljang khu'am/ sngo sangs pri yaX ku'i me tog lta bu dbu skra nag po zur phud gcig pa/ dar sngon po'i gos can phyag na me tog gi 'phreng brgyud thogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sgeg pa dang bcas pas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la lta ba/ de thams cad kyang zin po che'i dang pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /phyi rol phyogs thams cad du sangs rgyasadang byang chub sems dpa' dang nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang lha'i mchog rnams kyis yongs su bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ /so drug pa dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi'i chog lag yas pa'i mthe bos mthe chung mnan pa/ rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'dra ba/ ki li gī le'i dam tshig rdo rje bstan te/ shaX ka re sa ma ya swāhā/ zhes pa dang / 'di nyid kyi dgos chos la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dam tshig gi thal mo ni rtsa ba'i phyag rgya ste/ na maXsarba ba dha bo dhī sa tā nāX/ stu rwa ga dha —71—
