ni a gra kā ru ṇa ba ra re tru yi bhā yi ā ti ba le na mo stu ba ra rā yi ghi smyo ma hā kre be smyas hā/zhes pa rtsa ba'i phyag rgya'i sngags kyi gtso bo dang /yang spyi 'gro'i cho ga ni/khu tshuraḥngs pa gshibs te mthe bong gnyis sbyar te bskyang ba dang /dzi na dzika zhes pas 'khor gyi lha pho rnams dang / phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo las mthe bong gnyis nang du bcug/mdzub mo gas gungamo'i tshigs steng mar sbyar/oṃ ru ru slu ru sogs kyis 'khor lha mo rnams dam la pag/pastosngags de dag kyang lan gsum nas bdun gyi bar ji ltar 'os pa'o//de nas dam tshig chen wa'i phyag rgya zhes bya ba/rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha sprad pa las/gung mo dang mdzub mo rdo rje rtsegasus pa ltarabyas/mthe bong gnyis gung mo'i glo la sbyar ba steng 'og dang phyogs kun tu sa sgor zhing /istsor ban+ta swāhā/zhes lan gsum brjod pas/snga na gnas pa dang /phyi nas 'brangs pa'i bgegs thams/cad bskrad cing srung ba r+ṣa po byas par gyur//so ga kyin pa ma rdzo pa ni/gong du bshad pa ltar dzi na dzi ka bsang ba dbu o te dzatedza sa sirnyi swa dha ya swāhā/gzi byin bskyed pa dang /na mo rat+na nas/a rmi te hū phaṭa/byin gyis rlabs pa dang /dzi na dzika rnams kyis brtan par bya ste/mchod pa gsar pa rnams byin gyis rlabs/snying pa rnams kha gso ba'o//dang po ki li ki li'i phyag rgya las rdo rje thal mor bya/de nas mnyam pa'i thal mor byed pa ni/mchod pa thams cad kyi spyi'i sngon 'gro'o//bde b.ragashegs so bcom ldan 'das sogs dang /spyi 'gro re mthar rdo rje nang bsdams las/gungamadzub rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'dra rung /mthe bong gnyis 'dzub mo'i ngos la sbyar/ar+gha pra|rta ni swāmāsh+ka gsum sogs mang du brjod/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni//de bzhin gshe/gas kun bkrus gyur pa//de bzhin bdag gis lha rnams la//ga khong ma'i ri chab kyis khrus gsol lo//oṃ sarba de ba ta ar tsi ta a mṛ ta snyam 'ar tshe long72

la gzugs bar+sā shar ba la dngos su da/sa gsol na phyag rgya mi sa~X/gzhan dun mnyam ye thal mo kha phye/mtheXmadzubartse ༵sa pa'aphyag o//dngos sam yad na bza' dang rdzu gsogardedud dang rdza rnga 'a lding ༷ dang waX la sogs pa 'bud dri ༵ /dkrol ba dang /sgrib ba rornyibya ste/mchod pa' spran gya gzungs ༷da par bya'o// da 'a la rdo rdo/sa 'a / snom grordemanga' yang/'i/sems ca ngur smrag rgyal mtshan/ phul ba ya//nam she maXman sto rdeklas sbyir pa' phis can rnaXtha///'a 'a rgyas brtul bzhugs mchag ༵spyad par 'a/sna sa 'a ༷'a bzang rin bang spre yaXrde ///༵rde lar gan baX ba 'a rgyur tsor she 'a//gas bzang shen r+ṣa bdag bla sbyang she//bzad da dam ring ri 'a che je/rgyun par shag/bde gshegs sdi //chen / da rnamatshan / byang chub dang dpa byad dang //na 'ad chags 'bar bas dbu rgyan //byang chub/ ma sngo gi rgyan gyis mdzes mod kyi//'jig rten bkur bsti rim sgo oṃyam̐sbyonge snub byen me/ge shun phyo/rderde ra tsho tres/ge 7ge 7rde sa geng rnardedu//she nga ba de rdzo gi da//rgyan gya dam pa~X //da par ma chag phu shelabs//'gra ye sdod ra ge geX5rde0bu bremaX/ dang ldan//bla da thar pa mchag lashe par shag/thag 'a bla dzi mgan skyabs gduga~X twa bcas she//slod dbyangs kyi mawo ba kau kau she pa mdze//lha dang ya mgo pa' sdidabyangs sa//rgyal ba 'a dal zhaXtri rdems par sa dri zhima~X pag/rnyi'aphan ༷dung cu/gas rgyal mawo rol mo 'ar//rung 0 spre //sa rnyi ye r+sās 'a/༷ga dngaXgro baX 'a phul /me/gshe7/rdedam pa dus she ka gi sa ce/rde ta//ye pa' she 'jams bla da ga wongal//theg pa mchag/ sa sa par bsgrad par shag/ces pa'ang spro na brjod tso

bya'o/ /de nas nyer spyod nges par 'bul te/ gtsang zhing gtsang ma las byung bzhi lha rdzas bzang po'i dri 'di dag /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags khyi /bzhes nas bdag la dgyed par mdzod/ /ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bi du dha ra pū dzi te snyamāphyag rgya spyi 'gro sngon du 'gro bas/ lag pa g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi 'khrig ma nas g.yon pas gzungaba'o/ /gtsang zhing gtsang mar skyes pa yi/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i tshe tog 'di/ /bdag ni dad pas: sogs/ ā ha ra sogs/ spyi 'gro sngon du song t+yā lag gnyes soramo gzhan rnams phan tshun spros la/ mdzub mo gnyis gdub bu'i tshul du rtse sprad/ mthe bong mdzub mo'i glor bag pa'o/ /dri yi sbyar ba lha yi rdzas/ /nags tshal bcud ni yid 'onga'i de/bdag ni: ā ha ra: spyi 'gro sngon du song bas mthe chung srin lag gus mo rnams snga ma snga rme'i rgyab tu phyi ma phyi ma sbyar/ de rnams g.yas g.yon phan tshun rtse sprad/ mdzub mo brkyang zhing mthe bongade'i glor bas pa'o/ /sman rnams bcud ni yi gar 'ong / /sngags kyi zhal zasabasgo dos 'di dag /bdag ni: ā ha ra: spyi 'gro sngon du song nas/ snyim pa kha spyor bzed pa las/ mdzub mo ca zad bkugs pa'o/ /gnod rnams 'joms shing bkra shis la/ dge zhing mun pa rnams sel 'di/ bdag ni: ā lo ka ā lo ka sarba du dha ra pā dzite swāhā/ spyi 'gro sngon du btang / khu tshur gnyis gshibs pa las mtheb mdzub gnyis rtse sbyar te bsgreng ba'o/ /oṃ sems can gyi khams na gang nga yi ba med cing yongs su gzung ba med pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs chu dang thang las skyes pa/ rin po che'i ri dang/ gyomatsho'i rin po che la sogs pa de dag thams cad sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mchod pa'i 'phrin las kyis dbul bar bgyi'o/ /sangasargyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs kyi stobs dang /—74—

bdag gi bsod nams kyi stobs dang / rig pa'i gsang sngags kyi stobs kyisasangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du mchog tu rgya che ba'i byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa mchog rgya chen po'i gong ma las bla mar mngon par bsgrubs pa'i mchod pa'i sprin rab tu 'bab par gyur cig /na maXsarba budha bo dhi sa tā nāX/ sarba thā ud gte sngar ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX snya hā/ sngags 'di lan bgyod brjod/so bam pa bstod pa ni/ oṃ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can/ zhes pa la sogs pa dam tshig gsum gyi bstod pas bstod do/ /bod du 'gyur bltar na/ byaspyod kyi rgyud las bstod pa 'di ma bshad pa 'dra ba zhig yod kyang / spyir bstod pa tsam la yi ge'i don la bltas te/ thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos gsal po med na/ gong ma'ang 'og tu bla ca/ pasachog pa yin mod kyi/ 'di ni dam tshig gsum bkod nyid kyi bstod pa yin par slob dpon rin mu 'byung ldan sbas pas bshad de/ bod du ma 'gyur ba'i bya spyod kyi rgyud las kyang bshad par mngon no//mgon po thugs rjes che ldan pa sogs/ gzhan yang ji ltar 'os pas bstod pe khro mthar/na maXsarba brnya bo dhi satwa nāX/ sarba bhā sa ma ku su mi ta a bhi dz+nyā/ rnga shi ni na ma stu te swāhā/ zhes bstod pa 'byung ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po yang lan bas brjod do/ /so dgu pa bshags pa ni/ 'jig rten dag gi phyogs kun na/ /zhes ponas/ slan chad de ltar yongs mi bgyi/ /zhes pa'i bar spyi rgyud legs grub las 'byung ba ltar ram/'di nyid kyi rgyud las 'gyung ba ltar na/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thamasacad/ bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes pa'i 'o dod chags dang zhe sdang dang / gti mug las skyes pa'i sdig pa thams cad so sor bsha/gas par—75—

gis rnga//sangs rgyas dang 'a pa'i chub ( 1 se sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs bskyed pa rjos bshags par mdzad pa char ge ge zhes ge ge ni pa des bshags par ci ste/ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kya mkhyen pa s+t+riXrde/des kyang tsam mi ge ge mu ge ge gyur dod par nus pa de tsam du bshags par bgya'/slan ho/de lta bu rnga spro sdomathagaX /sno//mu4tshe 'a 4tshe sa'i4sto mi4tshespya rgyud kya cha ga la ya rang lags su med pas 'ad dan tshan zhe drug la bgrad yang rgyud 'dir gsungs 'a phags pa 'di'i 'phros las rjes su yi rang ba yang bya ste/gang drwa zherdedug degs pa'i sa~Xrgyas dang /genaXtshe mu tsho//nasa~X/dngarang 'a rgyas dang maX/ can thams cad kya bsad ba mun ge kya shes mas can gya khams 'ji ga sterang nga 'o : //dpa/sems can gya khams yangs swa ༄ /ngabar rges pa/'ag rten dang 'ag rten skyo skung 'das pa de dag /mas go larjes su ya rang ba ser mang rngamar sbar rnga la ra brangs shā/sa kang/ji lhar sangs/rgyus dang byang chub sems dpas mkhyen ༵ ltar bdag kyang ltar rjes su kyid rang bar nus pa de ༈ge mus su rang ni sna~X//༵ bcu pa skyas 'a yo/srag chags she sdug ge bdu zha bya' phyar//bdag na da sdos 'chi du//sangs/rgyas lo ༷nga )she tsho she she//kau/'a rnyi dag shes su ye/she/sa sto gsol gdab na/ma rtag bla gras bad pa' ra//chas/ kya 'kha/ra la brnya/rab dang //gdul bya ji srid si bar du//mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba legazas//zhes ni tre se/ :/ yiriganyas zhi sems bskyed pa /4lkas can khams mtha' yas paX//sdug bsnga/la nye bar ba dang //ngan 'gra rnams ga 6 ba dang //nyon mangs rnams las/

dgrol ba'i phyir/ /srid pa'i mi dge dog pa na/ /sdug bsngal sna tshogasatsimachis pa/ /de ltar yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir/ /bdag gis byang chub semasabaskyed do/ /zhes pa tsam mam/ spro na/ sems ta can 'phongs pa thams cad kyi/ /skyabasasubadag nyid rtag tu shog /bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon/ /rten med rnams kyi rten du bdag /skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs 'gyur zhing/ sdug bsngalabade bar byed pa dang / /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mongs zhi bar byed par shog /dge ba'i las rnams gang dang gang / /'di dang gzhan du bsags pa rnams/ /bsod nams ye shes zhes bya ba'i/ /tsho gis ni rnam pa gnyis su shog /pha rol phyin pa drug bsgoms nas/ /bdag gis brtson 'gru༅gang brtsams pa/ /de yang sems can ma lus pa/ /thams cad la ni phan parashog /sngon gyi rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis/ /smon lam ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin/ /bdag kyang dge ba'i sems kyis su/ /de bzhin du ni smon lam 'deb ga /sems can thams cad bde ba dang / /thams cad nad kyang med par shog /bdag ni bya ba kun nus shing / /yon tan dang yang ldan par shog /nor ldan gtong phod shes rab can/ /bzod ldan dge la dad pa dang / /sems can tshorabs thams cad du/ /skye ba dran zhing brtse ldan shog /ces pa'ang bya zhing/lto ltarayang mthar/ tshe yi mtha' klas gang byed dang / /gang yang cung zad byed 'gyur pa/ /mdor na sems can thams cad kyi/ /nyon mong thams cad zhi ba dang / /grolabar bya ba'i phyir 'bad cing / /byang chub ra btu dga' brtson no/ /zhes pa go /—77—

zhe gsum pa 3 med bzhi ni//don yid la dran bzhin pas rdo/ lhan ma 1 brjod tshul spyi dang mthun spobarjod do//zhe bzhi pa bzlas bsngi kyi rim dro la sngon mu rnyi/ sangs rgyas dang byang chugase~Xs dpa' thams cad kya lus kya lha sna na / ༵/'a na sems can mu zhe kya dgas pa sa ge hwa ba/sems can khams thams cad med pa'i dbebarderge ge / mu zha ba/bdeb thams cad myur du ba / rgo rdo//zag pa med pa kyi graba'abyung pa'i zu ba 'a sbyor ba yang dag par 'byu/nga dro/de ba gshe/rnyis pa rnams grugardedī mchog de sems can rge ge ge ge ge ge 9 5 ) sde da par sdo~X /gan maXsarba bublub ge ge mu nāX/na ma stu te mahā badz+ra sarba satwa ha taX ka ra sarba tra sa rbe khaX/dha cig//rdeṇaX a dhasmyu ya swāhā/smon lam dang sngagaX je / sto sbyar ba ni bas dam spege ge dra ༵gamathar sngags sh+ka brgyad brjod/de ltar mngan par 'dus byas pa' dge ba rtsab blan med pa'i bsod nams dang /ye shes kyi tshogs kyi bsdus pa 'di thams/go sirtu pa/ de tsho phon ri ra 7rde ge pho rdo skye sne'u sgordebla na da pa yang dag par rdzab/sa pa byang chub tu yangs su bsnga bar ba /se zu sngo ba dang /bdag sduX bsngal par gyur pa la/byin gyis rlabs pa dpabams dpa' pa'i mcho rge shege sde mu pa thams cad du na gyas rlab/zhes dang /bdag la grub pa mchag/ stsal/ cag/ces gsol ba gdab bo//bzlas pa' tso 'gro rdegasum po de dag ni dam rdzo gsum bkod kho na'i dgos i te/sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i sprin pa'i pa dang /'i chos can rngo khams /mas cad sbyong ba dang /sdug ༷la zhi bar byed t+yā rigasarded ( 7 2 skong na ya dpa //spya' cho ga 'a lugs la yongs nas bsngo rka ba na dgos mod kyang/semasardeswed naX yod pas logs su med kyang de'i rdzo go/na ma gu ru khyoXspyo sh+ka mang du gti pas bla ma la phyag bya'o//de nas pu to mo

'bru'am dge ba'i shing la ril bus byas pa'i ril bu stong rtsa bgyod dam/ brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ lngabacu rtsa bzhi'am/ nyi shu rtsa gcig blangs la/ mdun du khro bo legs grub bam/ bco༅ldan 'dasaphyag na rdo rje skad gcig gis bsam te/ na mo rat+na tru yā ya/ oṃ a ta bhu ti bi dza ya sidz+nyasiṅgā sgre swāhā/ zhes pa de bzhin gshegs rigs spyi khyab kyi rigs kyi bdag po'i sngags lan bdun bzlas/ de nas mig phug lte ba'i rnam pa lngas bkrus la/ gzhon nu mas bkal bo'i skud pa sum sgril gyis brgyus/ mdud pa btab ste lha la mchod par byas nas bsnyim par bcu gnye de bzhin gshegs rigs kyis 'phreng ba'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzla'o/ /de yang 'di lta ste/ chan mo bha ga wa te/ sirnyi su dha ya swadha ya/ sidha rnye swāhā/ zhes pa ro/ /waṃ ni bgrang 'aḍārab gnas yin pas dang por nges par bya la/ gzhan gyi mthong ba'am reg pa'ang 'bags pa lasos/sa pa/ rab gnas nyams pa'am nyams par dogs na/ spos chus bkrus shing bdug spos kyi bdugs la slar rab gnas de nyid bskyar te bya/ dkyus kyi nyams len la ni/ bgrang 'phreng rabaganas mi dgos kyang / byin rlabs gso ba'i phyir dang blo byang ba'i phyir/ sngags gnyis po de tsharare'am gsum te brjod do/ /de nas lag pa g.yas kyis bgrang 'phreng bzung ba'am/ dal bar gyur na ngal gso ba'i don du g.yon pas kyang bzung / gang ltar yang bgrang 'phreng snying gar bzung ste/ gung mo dang mthe chungabaskyang / mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab tu bkug cing sbyar/ srin lag gi steng nas mthe bong bgrong ba yinal/ dmigs pa ni/ mdun du bzhugs pa'i gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba la sngags 'phreng bkod pa ladamigs pa ste de nas bzlas pa bya'o/ /'dir bzlas bya'i sngags kyi gtso bo ni de bzhin gshegasapa'i yi ge brgya pa ste/ na maXste ya rnyi kā naX/ ta thā ga tā nāX/ sarba tra yi / pra ti ha twa bāzhidharma tā ba lī nāX/ aX a sa ma sa man+ta to a nan+ta bā sti/ ltos ni/ ha ra ha ra/ sngar—79—

sma ra ṇa/ bi ga ta rā ga bzhi dharma te/ sar sa ra/ sam ba la/ has ha sa/ tra yotra ya/ ga ga na mahā ba ra lak+ṣa ṇa/ dz+wa la dz+wa la na sā ga re swāhā shes pa nyid ci nusasu bzla bar bya'o/ /sngags bsdus pa ni/ slob dpon ku mu ta 'byung gnas kyi sgrub thabs las/ na maXtshos man+ta/ badzā ṇaX/ ā bī ra huX khaX/ zhes 'byung / rgyud nyid las/ na maXs khyu ba dha bo dhis tā nāX/ā bī ra huX khaX/ zhes 'byung ngo / /bzlas brjod kyi rjes kyi bya ba ni/ bzlas pe pho mthar bum pe) phyag brgya cas la/ bdag gi bzlas brjod kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di/ dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub kyi don du bcom ldan 'das la 'bul lo/ /'phags pa khyed kyis bdag la dam tshig chen po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes stsod/'a ni mtshon byed de rang gang 'dod pa'i dngos grub de zhe'o/ /bum pa'i phyag rgya ni/ lag gnyis srin lagagi rgyab tu gung mo sbyar/ de gnyis g.yon pa'i mdun du g.yas pa'i rgyab sbyar te bsnog g.yas kyi mdzub mo g.yon gyi gung srin dang / g.yon gyi mdzub mo g.yas kyi gung srin la 'a spyid/ mthe bongaganyis mdzub mo'i tshigs dbus ma la bldag /mthe chung gnyis gshibs te bsgreng ba'o/ /de nas/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa thams cad kyis sdug bsngal bar gyur pa bdag yongs su bzung du gsol/ bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba'i phyag rgya rang gi spyi borabazhag la/ na maXsarba ta thā ga tā nī ga ga ne ga ga ne/ zhes pa lan gsum/ thun mong gi cho gas dzi na dzika ni gsum brjod/ mgo bo'am/ snying gar zla ba riX yig byungabar bsam/ de nas sems can don gyi spyod pa la 'jug pa'i slad du dngos gzhi'i bzlas spu(da dang ting nge 'dzin grol bar bya'o/ /zhe lnga pa slar btang ba ni/ ar+ghaX pra ti ru dbra u ha —80—

ra: sogs nyer spyod lnga'i sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis mchod/ spro na/ sems can gyi khamasan: spyo pa nas/ kha grwahwa re bar brjod na'ang legs/ mgon po thugs rje tshe ldan:sogs sho lo ka gsum gyis bstod/ bzod gsol gyi tshig spyi 'gro rnams brjod/ oṃ mu ni mu ni mahā mu na ye swāhā/ o ar+ya mahā badz+ra dha rā ya swāhā/ o.ar+ya badz+ra dha rā swāhā/ o du ta a nan+ta ya swāhā/ o du ti a nan s+t+ya swāhā/ ar+gha pra tismo swahā de ltar mchod yon phul rjes spyan 'dren pa'i phyag brgya mthe bong gnyis phyir bskyed/ gshegs gsol gyi tshig spyi 'gro'i mthar/ gdon mi za bar bdag la yang / /rjes su brtse bar dgos/nas ni/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams/ /ci bde bar ni gshe/gas su gsol/ da pho bcings pa'i de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi dam dzig gi phyag rgya de mgo bo'i steng du bcas/ rtsemogyen du bstan/ sor mo bskyod cing dkrol te/ se gol gtogs pa lan gsum dag a ta thāg|sne she da bha wā ya swāhā/ zhes/ lan gsum kyis/ lha rnams gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ de'i rjes su mi nyams pa'i yan lag gi phyag rgya zhes bya ba/ g.yon pa'i thal mo gan kyal gyi steng du g.yas pa'i rgyab sbyar/ sor mo rnams bsnol ba'i rtse mo bkug ste/ rtsa bo'i phyogs su bstan pa g.yon du bskor te/ oṃ hu lu hu lu tsaṇ+ḍali ma ta gi swāhā/ zhes gzhan gyis mi thu7ma'i rigs pas rwa ba la sogs pa dgrol bar bya'o/ /zhe drug pa thun mtshams kyi bya ba ni/ bdagagi bzlas brjod bgyis pa dang / mchod pa byas pa dang / lha'i rnal 'byorabasgoms pa dang / smon lam rgya chen po byas pa dang / sdig pa rnams so sorabashags pa dang / dus gsum du byung ba'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshog༅rde'ajig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa la rjes su yi rang ba dag rjesasuyi rang ba yang sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi rgyu nyid du rab —81—

tu sbyor bar gyur cig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ladamigs shing / sems can gyi don 'byung bar gyur cig /bdag gi bsod nams kyi stobs dang / smon lam gyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bdag la byin gyis rlabs zhing / sems can thams/cad kyi don mi zad pa ni 'byung bar gyur cig /bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /stobs bcu mkhyen pa'i sal sems can thams cad so sor gnas par gyur cig /ces smon lam gdag gyogapar rgyud nyid las 'byung ba ltar smon lam gzhan yang gdab par bya'o/ /de nas gtan de las langs te/ khri'u gtsang ma la bkur sti dang bcas pa'i sgo nas/ sdong po bkod pa la sogs pa theg pa chen po'i mdo sde'i glegs bam dag bzhugs su gsol nas bklag par bya zhing / tha na phyag 'tshalab tsam yang nges par dgos so/ kha zas la 'jug pa na/ oṃ tse( ka dz+wa la badz+ra puṇi huX satshaya ma nu sma ra huX phaṭa/ bsrung ba bya/ na maXs man+ta bzhi bo dhi sa tā nāX/ thob len da de te dzo mā li ni swāhā/ zhes lan brgyad kyi mngags te/ kham dang po lhag pe'i lhal 'bug de nas zos te khrus bya'o/ khrus byed pa na bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags bzlas so/ /nyal ba na stobs poche'i sngags kyis bsrungs la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang /phyag na rdo rje dang / shwa ri'i bu rnams la phyag byas te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis rlobs pa dang / bla na med pa'i dngos grub kyi mchog stsol zhig /rnam par 'tshe ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ chos kyi 'du shes kyis nyal lo/ /de bzhin du rjes dran drug dang / maṇ+ḍal dang / sā tsha 'debs pa dang / snod dag par byed pa da dgos bo go —82—

ba'i sngags dang /dngos dang rmi lam du 'dzag pa zung ba sogs kyang bya la/ba ser skya'i rnam lnga lka.oṃ na mo bha ga wa te urdzi ṣa ya/oṃ bi shudhe bi ra dze shī ba shun ti ka re grwa smazhesabargya rtsa bzlas te btungs pas ni/zla ba phyed kyi bza' min gyi nyes pa thams cad byang bar gsubs so//de yan dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po'i rgyud las/de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying wa'i le'u las 'gyung bar bsnyen pa'i cho ga gang yin pa de/bya ba spyi rgyud rnams kyi cho gas kha bskang ste bshad zin to//yang rnam pa gcig tu na bshags pa/skyabs 'gro/gsol btab/sems bskyed/tshad med bzhi rnams bdag phul ba'i rjes bgegs srung ba'i sngon du byas na/de skabs gyi sems bskyed de mi dgos pa dang /'og tu bstod pa'i de ma thag par bzlas pa byas na//mi rung pa med cing snagagagacig tu na legs pa'ang yin no//'di ni bsnyen pa'i cho ga yin la/'di yis nye ba'i mtshan mamathong ba na sgrub pa la 'jug cing /lha'i rnal 'byor la sems brtan pa thob la/stong pa nyid dang snying rje sngags kyi nus pa shar ba'i sgrub pa po'i dbang du mdzad nas/rgyud las 'di skad cesagasungs te/ri bo'i gseb tu 'bum bzlas pa byas na/'phags pa phyag na rdo rje la sogs/pagangayang rung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' mthong bar 'gyur ro//gnyis kyis ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams so//gsum gyi ni byang chub sems pa rnams dang smra bar 'gyur ro//bzhis ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi gsungs thos par 'gyur ro//lngas ni gzungs rnams thob par 'gyur ro//drug gis nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro//sa dun gyis mngon par shes pa lnga rab tu thob para'agyur ro//brgyad kyis sangs rgyas thams cad lamangon par mchod par 'gyur ro//dgus ni myangan las 'das pa mngon par sgrub par byed do//bcus ni 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su rgyu b.ra'agyur ro//'di dag ni thams lamakhas pa'i bzlas pa'i cho ga ste/mtha' yas pa'i 'bus bu63rde 83

par shes par thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur pa'o//thabs la mi mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang /brtson 'grus(ra bdang 'bring dang tha mas ji ltar bsnyen pa de ltar ra btu sbyar na nub gcig gis rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur te snga ma bzhin no//zhes gsungs pa'i 'bras bu rim pa bcu po do ni mos pas spyod shā sa bcu yin par mngon no//skabs 'dir 'di snyam du bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed kyang med lkamadun bskyed la yang sngags sogs sa bon las/ dam tshig gis bskyed pa dang /ye shes pa spyanadrangs te bsre ba med na/lha drug gi dbye ba bshad pa dang 'gal bar gyur snyam na/'dir dang wanga'akhrus byas rnal 'byor pas zhes sogs/lha drug ston byed kyi gzhung tshig de bod du 'gyur ba'i rgyud na ni med la/rnam 'joms kyi 'grel pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad par grags pa na/lunga'adren gyi tshul du yod pa las de rnam 'joms rgyas pa'i lung yin par grags mod kyi/rnam le sdoms kyi rgyud yin du chug kyang rnam 'joms kyi rgyud yin tshad bya rgyu yin par ma nges pa'i phyir dang /'grelapa de yang mig don bzang mod tshig gi babs la dpags na snga 'gyur dus kyi zin bris bod ma zhin tu gsal ba'i phyir dang /mchod dang gsol ba lha drug bsgom//stong dang yi ge sgra gzugs dbāzhes pa lta bu rgya skad tshig ring po thung ngur bsdus pa'am//rgya skad rkang pa gsum bod skad rkang paganyis la bsdus/ pa'am/rgya skad tshig lhug pa tshigs bcad yi ge shin tu nyung ngur bsdus pa lta bu'am/tshigs bcad la rig byed kyi gsang ba'i gab tshig skad 'dod bsgrigs pa lta bu yod na ma gtogs/rjes sngags dang /kha sgo la sogs pa tshigs bcad yig 'grubargyan pa'i sdeb sbyor gyi tshig rkangaganyis la 'grig dka' bar snang zhing /tshig lam yang bod ma'i sdoms 'dra rung bsnang ga des na tshig 'di ni bod kyi sdoms tshig snying pa yin yang dag cing /tshes snga ba'i yig gyi las dpe gsaradu spel ba rnams lams bu dkyus su shor ba'i nor ba yang mang bas lung khungs stsos pa yang rtsom pa pos byas par ma nges pa'i phyir dang /bya rgyud rang rkang la ni/lha drug gi rnam gzhag go par84

'chad dgos pa mi snang bas/de 'dra'i rnam gzhag nges par dgos pa min la/ci ste byed nasangasargyas gsang bas bshad pa rnams ni spyod rgyud kyi lugs yin pas 'dir de ltar mi bya'o//'dir nilha sku la dmigs pa'am ma dmigs kyang rung ste/bdag gi de kho na nyid la dmigs pa'i skabasasogs su//chos kyi bdag med pa'i don sgom pa ni stong pa nyid kyi lha/mdun skyed gtso bo'i thragasakar sngags kyi yig 'bru bsgom pa ni yi ge'i lha/sngags kyi sgra la dmigs pa'i bsam gtan ni sgra'i rdelha//lha'i sku la dmigs pa ni gzugs kyi lha/lha so so'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bcing ba ni phyag rgya zhi lha/thun mtshams su bar chad mi 'jug cing byin rlabs brtan pa'i don du/thun gtor khang phyag rgyaspyi bor bzhan pas/rtags kyi tshul du yig 'bru bsam pa ni mtshan ma'i lha'o//'dir bsam gtan gyi de kho na nyid kyang /lha dang yi ger dang sgra dang phyag mtshan dang thig lo dang 'od zer la sogs pa la dmigs nas/stong nyid snying rje sgom pa rnams mdun skyed kho na la dmigs nas bya ba yin glisgra dang sems dang gzhi lagazhol zhes sogs kyis bzlas brjod dang /gsang sngags mer gnas dngos grub ster/zhes pa la sogs pa'i bsam gtan ni bya rgyud rang rkang gi lugs la mi sbyor ro//sangs rgyas gsang bas/bya rgyud rnams rang lugs mi mdzad par spyong rgyud du 'grel bar mdzad pade bod pa'i chen po mang pos ma dgongs pa dang /phyis kyi sgrin po mang pos rgyud 'bum btu mkhanarnams kyis bya rgyud kyi po ti'i sde tshan gyi gseb la rgyud sde gong mar gtogs pa mang po ngo ma shes par shor ba rnams bya rgyud du bdag bskyed yod pa'i rgyab rten du 'dren pa sogs cal col du ma yod pa rnams 'dzug tshugs bstan pa tsam gyi 'khrul pa sangs par 'gyur ro//de ltar na dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal po de bzhin gnags pa'i snying po'i le'u las 'gyung ba lha lnga'i sgo nas/bsnyen pa'i chog spyi rgyud nas 'byung ba'i kha skongs dang bcas pa legs par bshad pa yin no//da ni dbang bskur ba dang 'brel ba'i da/du gyi cho ga mdo tsam bshad par bya'o//de

la slob dpon dang / slob ma'i maphywa nyid dang / yul phyogs dang dus dang / dkyil ge bor kyisagazhi'i mtshan nyid la sogs pa ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud las 'byung ba ltar shes par bya'o/ /'ar cho ga dngos la sa'i cho ga dang / sta gon du gnas pa dang / dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga dag dkyila'akhor sgrub pa dang / slob ma dbang bskur ba dang / rjes kyi cho ga ga drug go /dang po las sbyangabadang / bzung ba gnyis so/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te/stob༅rdebartsamakhyen pa'i sa la sems can thams cad so sor gnas par gyur cig gi bar gong du bsnyen pa'i cho gar bshad pa ltar gyi bsgrub thabs rdzogs par bsgo me/ /sa phyogs gtsang zhing byi dor byas pa la tshetog sil ma cung zad gtor/ dkar gtor gcig la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa kyis khas/ngag ralagri 'debs pa'i tshul zhes bya ba rdor bsdams kyi phyag rgya btab te/ oṃ a kā ro mu khosarba dharmā ṇaX a byi nu yin twata/ ni gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ na maXsarba ta thugata skyo bi shwa mu ka khyoX zhes sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis rgya cher spel/ na maXsarba ta thā ga ta a ba lo gi te oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra huX/ lan 'dun sogs kyis phugagator ma gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon to lnga dang ldan pa 'di ṣ+ka yul bdag gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug/ mar gnas pa yul phyogs kyi gtso bo dang sa'i bdag po thams cad la 'bul lo/ /mchod yon dngadri dang me tog dang bdug pa dang snang gsal dang na bza' la sogs pa yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ gnod sems zhi zhing/ phan pa dang bde ba'i sems dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor gyi don du sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la stsol ba dang zhi ba dang bde ba dang bkra shis par mdzad du gsol/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin mo'am gzhan dgal/ /sa 'di —86—

bdag gis slang bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ sh+ka gtso/rol mo'i sgra dang cas te gtor ma phyir dor ro/ /'di don gyis slang ba yin/ 'ga' zhin 'a ltabubya rgyud las ma bshad ces mi byed pa ni/ snga ma rnams kyi lag len ma nor ba'i rgyun la brnyas pa byed cing / mthong rgya phra ma'i khengs pas yul dus gang du gang dgos ma shes par bgegs kyi bar chagached kyis nyo bar zad la/ 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi mtha' rgya bskyed dgos pa'i phra mo mang po zhig lkayul dus dang bstun pa'i lag len dgos kyi/ ga ge mo'i lugs la de dang de yod do med do zhesatshig rtseg than thun la mgul ba chad chad du rtsod pa dang / bshad khungs phran tshags re gdong thad der yod med kyi dbu tshugs mi 'gro ste/ sngon rgya gar du paṇ+ḍi ta gsum gyis gzhung lugs dang bstun nas lto g.yos pa'i dper 'gro nyen yod do/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la lag pas byugs shing / cab be cang be byas te/ o gi li gī la badz+ra bhi ma ro tri ba bi tra mahā kro dha bi dzu ya/ ni krin ta hūX phaṭa/ ban+ta ban+ta swāhā/ zhes mang du bzla'o/ /de nas oX gī li gī la badzi badzi bh+ya raban+ta huX phaṭa/ ces seng lding gi phur bu sor brgyad pa btab/ ki li gī las bsangs/gtor byed pa nas brtsams te/ rdo rje'i rwa ba'i phyi rol du me dpung 'bar bsabaske/ra bar gyur/ zhes pa'i bar mtshams bcings shing slar yang seng lding gi phur bug skyekhe.a mṛ te huX phaṭa/ ces bdud rtsi thal sbyor gyi sngags bsdus pa dang / tseXtshu to ban+ta grwa sma zhesalas thams cad pa mang du bzlas/ na maXsarba brnya/ bo dhi sa tā nāX/ nā maXtsho༅man+ta badz+ra rnyaX/ā ko ṭa ya/ sa he mahā tsaṇ+ḍal phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba tra rak+ṣaX tra ṭa mas mas phaṭa/ces phur bu tho bas brdung bar bya'o/ /sngags 'di dam tshig gsum bkod nyid las gsungs so/ /phur bu ni phyogs mtshams brgyad dam/ mtshams bzhi'am ma 'byor na dbus su gcig bdab bo/ /—87—

gnyis pa sa bzung ba ni/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te/sems can thams/cad so sor gnas par gyur cig/gi bar sgrub thabs rdzogs par bsgom nas las rjes mimangon par bya'o//de nas/oṃ dza ya usti ṣa dz+wa la dz+wa la/ban+ta ban+ta/da mad ma/glo huXspyiXhūX ho ha na huX/zhes gtsug tor rgyal ba'i sngags kyis bsangs gtor bya/bhūX dbu dzin dzikadang /rtsa sngags de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa bzla bzhin du/sa la lag pas byugs / shing 4bas nas/sa'i phyogs 'di bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khotshor chen po bri bar bya'o//zhes brjod/ga lko nu mas bkal ba'i sras bu lkalas thams cad pa'am/bdud rtsi thal sbyor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ga4ngung 'ig la lan bzhi bstortsa dgu bzlas/mdud pa gsum mam bdun btab lte slob mar 'gyur ba'i ma gul lam dpung parabatags pas slob ma rnams kyi bgegs thams cad zhi zhing srung ba byas par 'gyur/'di spyi la grags pa'i slob ma rjes bzung dang dgos don gcig mod/spyir rgyud kyi dpe kha cig lag de nasaslob ma yongs bzung nas/zhes 'byung ba ni yig nor brgyud pa ste/dpe 'ga' lag des ni slob ma yongs bzung ba'i//las la bgegs ni med par 'gyur//zhes 'byung ba ltar dag ste yongasasu bzung zin pa'i slob ma la srung ba byed pa'o//'di la rjes bzung gi tha snyad byed pa rnams ni sgrub byed de gdod tshol dgos so//skabasa'adir gsang ba spyi rgyud las spyir btang du/sa sbyang ba ni dkyil 'khor bri ba'i snga rol gyi zhag bdun gyi nang logs dang /sa bzung ba ni bri ba'i zhug gsum gyi sngon nas byed par gsungs lka dmigasagasal la gcig tu ma nges pas da lta'i lag len ltar na/nyi ma dang po la sa sbyangs bdang/gnyisapa la bzung ba lta bu byas na'ang rung /yang spyi rgyud las/nub gsum gyi cho ga rdzogs pa'i dbang du byas nas/rnam dpyad dang po sa gzhi bzung /zheX rdo chog gi sde gnyis kar nyi ma gcig la tshang bar

byas na'ang legs par 'gyur ro/ /de la rgyud rnams kyi dgongs pas ni/ slob dpon gyis tshad dngaldan pa'i bsnyen pa song zhing ma nyams pa yin na/ skabs 'dir sa chog gnyis kyi cho ga'i yan lagatu bsnyen pa'i cho ga dang 'dra ba'i sgrub thabs tshar re sgom pa de nges par sngon du 'gro dgos pa min pas/ skabs 'dir bzlas brjod dang lha'i rnal 'byor sgom tshul lagasungs pa ni/ don la dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga tshang bar 'gyur ba tsam la/ skabs 'dir sgrub thabs bsgom mi dgos kyang dang por ni rang gzhan gyi bsod nams spel ba'i slad dang / gnyis par na byin rlabs nye ba'i phyir dang/gsum par na cho ga mdzes pa'i ched dang / bzhi par na da lta'i gang zag dman pa cho ga tsam don gnyer gyis kyang bsnyen pa'i cho ga mi spong zhi blo byang bar 'gyur ba'i dgos pa khyad par can yod pas/ sa sbyangs bzung nyin zhag so sor byed na/ nyin re bzhin skyabs 'gro nas bsams te/ tha ma'i smon lam gyi bar gyi sgrub thabs tshar re sngon du btang nas/ de dang de la 'jug pa yin lka sbyangasabazung nyi ma gcig la byed na ni/ sbyang ba'i sngon du sgrub thabs tshar gcig bsgoms pa de kas chogago /gnyis pa sta gon du gnas pa la/ lha sta gon dang / slob ma sta gon dang / bum pa sta gon gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ slob dpon khyim pa yin na nang par thog ma la bsnyen gnas bla pag nyi ma 'char ba'i skabs thur ma'am dbyug gu bslang bas/ phyogs brtags de ma nor bar skam thig thig chen brgyad tsam 'debs shing sgo sprag gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor 'bri na rtsa thig rim pa gsum ka'i thad du thig re gdab dgos la/ lha rnams gang du 'god pa'i gnas sogs nges par byas nas de dag turtags btab bo/ /snga dro'am nyin gung sogs ji ltar 'os pa sgrub thabs tshar cig bsgoms nas bzlas brjod kyang mang du bya/ ci ste snga dro sa chog dang dgong mo sta gon byed pa yin na/ sa chog gi mgor sgrub thabs thog mar bsgoms pa de kho nas chog gi slang yang skabs 'dir mi dgos mod/ spyir sa chog—89—

dang stagon nyin zhag gcig la bsgrubs pas go mi chod pa rang yang min mod/ tshul dang mthun pamayin pas mi legs so/ /dgongs ka'i dus na gong du bshad pa ltar bsnyen pa'i skabs kyi lha spyan 'dren pa yid la bzhag nas/ bhāX/ bdun dang / dzi na dzika bdun dad glu yīXrme ban+ta zwa 4 na mo rat+na tra yā ya gsum dang / dad pa dang ni dam tshig gi: zhes shis/ dgyes paramadzad/ zlaX bdun dang / dzi na dzika bdun dang / oṃ bha ga wan ma nākā ruṇi ka shwakya 'a/ni tri sa rme ya rā dza maṇ+ḍal de ba tā sa pā ri wa ra e hai hi/ ni gtso/dkyi4khor gyi sa gzhin dbus su sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad tsam du dri bzang gi gru bzhir byug cing / dzi na dzikazhes pa rigs kyi snying po lan bdun dang / oṃ mu ni mu ni mahā mu na ye swāhā ga chuḥ/mtshan sngags lan gsum/ dbus kyi gdan gyi stengs su bcom ldan 'das sogs nas/lha gzhan rnams kyi gnas su dri'i thig le byed bzhin pas/ oṃ ār+ya badz+ra dha ra swātwagayas su 'phags pa rdo rje 'dzin chen po/ sogs nas/ gdan la brten pa/ oṃ.ār+ya badz+ra dha rā swāhā/ gtso bo'i g.yon du 'phags ma rdo rje 'dzin sogs nas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'o/ /oṃ du ta a na nā ya swāhā/ g.yas kyi 'og ca sogs nas/rin po tshes brgyan pa'o/ /oṃ du ti a na sbyi: sogs nas/ g.yon gyi 'og tā sog༅nagabazhugs par gyur/ lha lnga nyid la de tsam gyis chog cing / lha lnga'i dbang gis go mi chod pa ta men mod/ cung zad rgyud smin stobs chung la/ spyi rgyud ltar sbyar na slob ma smin tshabs tshes 'ongaba'i phyir/ spyi rgyud nas kha 'gengs byed dgos pas na 'di ltar bya ste/ gtso bo'i mdun ngos kyi 'og tu/ oX mahā kro dha a pa ra rdzita swāhā/ khro bo chen po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang / oX bha ga wa kyai a pa ra rdzi tā swāhā/ bcom ldan khro mo gzhan gyis mi thub mdang / oṃ bud+dhā lo tsa ne swāhā/ rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo sangs rgyas spyan ma —90—

dang / oṃ urnyi swāhā/ byang chub sems dpa' mdzod sbu can dang / oṃshā snyi swātwabyang chub sems dpa' mdung thung can dang / oṃ tsakra brti mahā udha we zwa sna byangachub sems dpa' 'khor los bsgyur ba cher 'byung dang / oṃ tsin+ta ma ṇi dh+wa dzāyoswāhā/ byang chub sems dpa' yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan dang/ oṃ mañjushrī ku mā ra bhā tā ya swāhā/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu gyur pa dang / o mahwa snyam/ prastu ya swāhā/ rgyel sras mthu chen thob pa dang / oṃ ā ka sha ga nā yos sma byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po dang / oṃ sarba ar+sha sirnyi ya swāhā/ byang chusasems dpa' don thams cad grub pa dang / oṃ bi ma la ma ti grwa sma byang chusasems dpa' dri ma med pa'i blo gros dang / oṃ ār+ya mai tri swāhā/ byang chub semasadapa' 'phags pa byams pa dang / oṃ mā ma gī swāhā/ rigs sngags kyi rgyal mochen mo mā ma gī dang / oṃ mahā bir+ya swāhā/ mngags gzhug pa brtson 'grus chen po dang / oṃ in+d+ra ya swāhā/ lha'i rgyal po mchod sbyin brgya pa dang/ oṃ a di t+yaswāhā/ lha'i bu nyi ma dang / oṃ shī ta aX shu swāhā/ lha'i bu zla ba dang/ cha a sna ye swāhā/ drang srong chen po me lha dang / oṃ ya ma ye swāhā/ gshin rje'i rgyal po dang/oṃ rak+ta sa ti pa ya swāhā/ phrin po'i rgyal po dang / oṃ ba ru ṇa ya zwa snya chuyibadag po dang / oṃ bā ya be swāhā/ rlung lha'i rgyal po dang / oṃ ku be ra swātāganod sbyin gyi ded dpon lus ngan po dang / oṃ i shā na ya swāhā/ 'byung yi bdag po dbang ldan dang / oṃ pri shrī de lī swāhā/ sa'i lha mo r+pā modang / tshe nan+ta nā gā ya swāhā/ oṃ u pa nan+da nā gā ya swāhā/ klu zhi rgyal po dga' bodang/ gnyen dga' bo dang / oṃ ha ri s+t+ya swāhā/ gnod sgyin mo 'phrog ma dang/ sgos 'jig—91—

rten skyong ba bzhi byed na/oṃ lha ta ra 〉 ya swāhā/kho sogs yo ga gzhal yas/khang 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i phyi'i sa gzhi la/oṃ badz+ra se na swāhā/rdo rje sde dang/nyu mi rna snye sne pa rwaskre rdo sto/ su ba hu swāhā/lag bzang dang / mu rta na ta kā ya snyam bgegs ded dpon wo po rdzos kyi bdag po dang /oṃ ru ṭa ma he shwa rā ya grwa smad bang phyukar+ṣa po dang /oṃ pradz+nyā ya swāhā/tshas pa r+ṣa po dang /rigs lnga 'cha go rgyalapo yang //glang po che zhes bya ba dang //yan lag bkras 'byen rtse bran ngo//g.yon phyogs cod pan mig bzang dang //sna tshogs 'od dang legs par grub//bdun po lho yi phyogs su bzhugs//'dir lha'i ma' brjod pas gsal 'debs palkakha gcig shākya thub pa zhes pa lta bu kho na byed zer ba ni lag len dang man ngag med par spyi rgyud bklags pa tsam gyis tshim pa'i skyon te rang lugs la thog mthar oṃ dang swāhā sbyor/de dag la sgrubathabs su bshad pa'i chogs/dzi na dzika oṃ te dza te dza nas/mnyam smi migayos bar du mchod pa byin rlas dang /ma rdzo yon nas tsoms te bstod pa rdzogs kyi bar ma rdzo bstod 'bul/'grub na lha mnyes pa'i phyir sreg blugs kyi mchod pa bya la/de nas dkyil 'khor ra gyi lha dang sangs rgyas kun la dmigs nas/ā ha ra la sogs pa'i sngags kyis nyer spyod 'u sdo / zi spu///snyug spos tso la bzhi du/dam tshig/ gsum rgyal bcom ldan 'das// sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo//slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang /khyed rnams/layang ma rdzo pa'i phyir//mgon po thugs rje'i bdag ṣ+ka can//4ni dkyila'akhor bri bar bya//de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la//bka' drin yang b.ramadzad pa'i rigs//sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang //byang chug sems/dpa' 'bras gnas dang //gzhan yaX skyi dag gsang sngags lha/lta'i / ga rten

skyong ba'i lha rnams dang //gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang //sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba//gang su lha yi spyan mnga' rnams//bdag la dgongs paramadzad du gsol//bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis//dam tshig gsus bkod dkyil 'khor ni//ji ltar nus par nyer sbyor bas//'gro ba sbyang phyir dri b.rabya//de phyir bdag dang slob ma la//rjes su brtse bas nyer dgos/te//dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ /nye bar gnas por mdzad pa'irigs//zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/kha cig bdag ming zhes pa'i thad dugasang mtshanardekhug pa sogs ni oṃ ga gong ma la yo yang /'dir rang ming nyid khug pa'o//mgo sgyun po thugs rje che ldan pa sogs sho lo ka gsum gyis phyag klel/rol mo'i sgra dang sal/te/mnyam nyid mi g.yos bstod/rtsa ba'i sngags de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa'i mthar dzi na dzika gis mngags pa'i mchod yon/ar+gha pra ca grwahwas phul/oṃ mu zhes gshegs/sugasol/kha gcig stagon gyi lha dran rdzogs su bskyed pa yin pas/skabs 'dir mi snang bar bsam pa kho nas chog ces 'dod la/gzha dag stagon gyi lha spyan 'dren dgos pas/'dir yang gshegs gsol gyi chogs spyan drangs dgos so zhes 'dod do//de gnyis kar rung ba las spyan drangs te gshegs su gsol ba nyid/mchog tu bzang b.ram rga no//go du phyis byung ba bya rgyud shes par rlom pa dag cig/snyan gsan 'bebs pa dang gshegs su gsol ba 'di/'a stsor chu dang ku sha sbyin pa'i bar du byed pa rma kyi khyad chos su sgomapar 'dug na'ang man ngag dang lag len med pas nyes te/rgyud phal cher du cho ga'i go rimakhazhakhrugs can du ཿnga bltar 'dir yang ste/stagon gyi slob ma byin stsas dang so shing 'dor chagazhung tshig gi bar skabs der/dbang bskur ba yi bum pa ni/zhes sogs bum pa stagon gsus7rde93

pa dang 'dra bas cho ga rigs mthun gyi gzhung rnams sgrig lugs shes dgos la/lha la snyan gsanarde'abebs pa la slob ma dbab por dgos pa ga la zhig ste/cho ga'i go rim gyi tshoms de lta bu mi bya'o//de dag ni lha sta gon gyi rim pa ste/spyi dang mthun shas che la/kha cig skabs 'dir slobamal so shing sbyin te/sgyin sreg byed dgos shing /de yang slob ma rjes bzung ngo zhes zer ba ni spyi rgyud las/rtse mo nas ni btsal bar bya/zhes sogs 'phros don la 'khrul gzhi byung bar snang tshe skabs 'dir so shing la sogs pa grabs su chud par byed pa tsam rgyud kyi dgongs pa yin gyi slob ma la ster ba min no// gnyis pa slob ma sta gon ni thog mar slob ma'i bar chad zhi ba'i don du zhi ba'i sgyin sreg bya/slob ma de sngar khyim pa phal pa yin na dge bsnyen sogs so thar rigs 'dun po gang rung gcig gi sdom pa thob dgos te/dkyil 'khor khang par ma zhugs pa'i sngon rol du grub pa zhig dgos lkasngar so thar sdom pa gang rung zhig thob lam nyams pa yin na/skabs 'dir so thar gyi cho gamidagos so//slob ma rnams dkyil 'khore gyi khang pa lhag gnas byed pa'am gnas khang gzhan du yang rung la/gang ltar na'ang khrus byas gral du 'khod/maṇ+ḍal 'bul/dga' chen khyod bdagaston pa ste/zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/bar 'dir skyabs 'gro dang/sems/bskyed kyi cho ga rgyas pas smon 'jug gi sdom pa phog na tshes bzang la/gal te ma 'grub na yan lag bdun pa sogs kyi spros pa spangs te/skyabs 'gro dang smon pa sems bskyed kyi dngos gzhi'i cho bzhi sems bskyed 'bogs so//skyabs sems kyi dngos gzhi tsam du 'bogs pa 'di ni/sngar ga rtagadubyang sdom thob la ma nyams pa yin kyang /skabs 'dir 'bogs dgos te cho ga'i yan lag yin pa'i phyir/dper na dkyil chog ga༈ gyi rgyun bshags bzhin no//yang cho ga shin tu bsdus pa lamangon par dga' ba'i tshe/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdagal94

dgongs su gsol/slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/srog chags sdugabasngal zhi bya'i phyir/sogs dang /sems can khams ni mtha' yas pa'i/jogasatshig rkang brgyad dang /tshe yi mtha' klas byed pa dang /lko pa nas/byang chub ra ba / tudaga' brtson no//zhes pa'i bar gyis kyang 'i bo//de ltar rgyud sbyangs nas/mya3 lasa'adas pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed pa ni/sngags kya dngos grub don gnyer gang/zhelopa nas/'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'gru / ba/i pa'i bar brjod cing don bzhan/de'i rjes su byin gyis rlabs pa ni/na mo rat+na nas/a rlu te huX phaṭa/gyis sa twa da rtsithabs sbyor bzla bzhin du/dri bzang gi chus slob ma'i mgo la bsangs gtor bya zhing /yang mgolalag pas tham ste/tseX( a mṛ te huX phaṭa/lan bdun bzla'o//yang byugs spos kyis/bkus(pa'i lag pa mgo la bzhag ste/thabs sbyor lan bdun zla bar yang bshad/yang de bzhin du rigs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba yi ge gcig pa/bhūX brgya tsam bzlas shing /bdud rdo thoX/sa sbyor ni gsusabazlas pas kyang byin gyis rlabs/de nyid brtan zhing srung ba'i don du/ gi ban+ta zwa twa zhesapas bsangs gtor dang bram par byed cing spos kyis bdug go/so shing gi dmigs pa spyi dang 'dra/dzi na dzi ka gis gtad la/bhūX/zhes dor bar bya'o//de nas slob ma'i ༵ga tu dri rjong gi chu blugs la/nye reg byed du bcug spyoX bhan+ta dga.oX hu lu hu lu tsaṇ+ḍa ma taX swāhā/mang du bzlas pa'i khyor chu lan gsum sngags de nyid kyis spyin pa'am/yang na/oṃ khyiXbi shudha sogs spyi dang mthun par byin kyang rung bar mo ngonano//sngags de rgyud sde gong ma'i khyad chos yin pa'i rgyu mtshan med cing /bya rgyud la mi rung pho rgyu mtshan yang ci yang med pa'i phyir ro/kha cig de nas chu gzhan zhig gis kha bkru bar 'dod kyang lag len la mi mdzad la/de nas las thams cad pa gi du pa'i rtsa ku sha sngas dang gtan gyi don du sbyin/

spyi rgyud las skabs 'dir srung skud sbyin pa'i gsal kha med kyang /sngar sa sbyangs ba'i ska bas sung/nga skud byed par gsungs pa de yang glob ma la 'dogs rgyu yin pa'i skabs der btags pa'i dbang du mdzad pa yin la/der ma btags na 'dir 'dogs dgos so//de nas/chos/rnams/gangadag rgyu las byung /zhes sogs dang /skar ma rab rib mar me dang /khyu/ma zil/ba chu bur dang //rmi lam glog dang sprin lta bu//'dus byas chos rnams/de ltarabalta//sdig pa yang mi bya chikho ri //zhes pa nas/'on kyang skyo gos pa'i sras/su skye//lko pa'i bar brjod de/chags bral dang ldan pa'i chos bshad pa zho/denas/bu skyesang ni dkyil 'khor mchog/mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol zhig dang //rmi la5mthong ba gang yin pa//de kun nga la legs par smros//kye bzhin bzang dgalongs la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la phyag byos shig ces brjod/phyag 'tshal du bcug la rang gnas su btang ngo //gsum pa bum pa stagon ni/bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/rnam rgyal bum pa'am gtso bo'i bum par 'os pa gcig dang /khrus bum mam bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad dam ma 'khru/ba na bzhi/las bum gcig ste/bum pa nyung ba'i phyogs 'dzin na bum pa drug bya'o//las bzhi'i dbang skurabyed na bum pa rnams kyi phyi rol phyogs bzhir/shar du rgyas pa/lhor mngon spyod/nub du dbagabyang du zhi ba'i bum pa rnams ca'/de dag so so'i kha dog sogs kyi byed las bzhi so so'i lugs su grub na'ang legs/dbang bskur tsam la spyi dang mthun pas kyang chog la/las bzhi'i dbangabaskur byed kyang /bum pa so so ma 'byor na las bum la bsdus pas chog go/de dag legs tso bkrus shing gu gul gyis 'dugs/'bru dang rin po che la sogs pa nang rdzas rnams thog marablugs/phyi nas 'bab chu gtsang ma nas blang ba'i chus sum gnyis tsam bkang /gtan nam stegs/ 96

bu gtsang ma la gtso bo'i bum par dbus sam stegs mtho sar ba theg khrus bum rnams stegs b.rama'am zur bzhin bzhag las bum ni stegs dma' ba'i phyogs sam de'i mdun du bzhagadung chos la sogs pa'i snod du dri bzang gi chu la bhāX brgya rtsa bzlas lamachod yon gyi tshul du dbus kyi bum pa'i steng du bzhag /me tog 'phreng ba'am gzungs thag kyang btags/ na morat+na: nas/a mṛ te huX phaṭa kyi bar bdud rtsi 'byil ba'i sngags kyis bsangs de nas 'di skad ces/ buwapa nang rdzas rgyan dang bcas pa thams cad rang bzhin gdod nas gnyis chos dang bral ba rang gi rig pa'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid do/ /de yang rin po tshe'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir zhing mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi gos zung can/ lha'i chu bodanganang rdzas kyi gang zhing / pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa rnams su gyur/ rungs rgyasadang byang sems sngags kyi lha rnams nye bar bzhugs pa la gsol ba btab par mos te/ dbus kyi bum pa la rig pa'i rgyal po zlaX brgya stong dang / de bzhin gshegs pe'i yigabargya dang / snying po yi ge lnga pa yang nyer gcig sogazu ci rigs pa bzla/ khrus bum bzhi las ma dunaphyogs kyi g.yas g.yon na gnas pa gnyis la/ rigs kyi snying po/ dzi na dzi ka dang / rgyab phyogs kyi gnyis la las thams cad pa/ skye de rto ban+ta swāhā dang / las bum la/ na morat+na: sogasathabs spyor gyi sngags ring ba dang / 'bring po dang / oṃ a khru te huX phaṭa/ a bsto ga kyid rtsithabs spyor ji ltar 'os pa bzla'o/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs gzhan rnams kyi mtshan sngags kyangabazla bar rigs mod kyi/ nges par dgos pa ma yin pas 'dir bzhag go /de nas zhi ba'i busapal/ tseX( ru na bye sogs sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags dang / rgyas pa'i bum pa la/ ta du thā/ tso rna stoX/zhes pa sangs rgyas rin chen tog gi sngags dang / dbang gi bum pa la/ tseX( dzi dzidzi naX gtaX dre/—97—

ya te di na swāhā/zhes pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sngags dang /mngon spyod kyi bum pa gan morat+na tra yā ya/na maXtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/mahā yak+ṣa sen pa ta ye/cha sum+bha ni sum+bha/ ni hūX/gro hā gro hā huX/gro hā pā ya gro sna pā ya huX/ā na ya ho bha ga ldan bi sdi rwadza / ༷ phaṭa/ces pa huX mdzad kyi sngags bzla'o//thun mong du/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ardzi te ka ta sa ma ya shrī huX/zhes pa'ang mang du bzla/mthar/dzi na dzika lan bdun gyis me rta ge dkaropodang /bhūX bzlas te mchod yon blugs/bdud rtsi thabs spyor gyi sngags bzla zhing /gu gulalasogs pa bdug pas bdug ste/stagon gyi nyin par bum pa'i bya bde kho nas chog go kha cigabyargyud kyi bum pa stagon la/bum pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed cing /rten la spyan 'dren pa dgos pa'i sgrub byed du/lja ta ri'i tshe dpag med dang /jo bo'i mi 'khrugs pa'i lung 'dren mod kyang de dag byargyud la gong ma'i cho ga sbyar ba'i lugs yin pas de'i rgya brten du mi 'gro zhing bya rgyud rang skad la/bum pa gzhal yas khang du bskyed pa ni nam yang mi dgos la/bum sgrub 'ga' zhig la bum par lha sbyan drangs pa yod pa ni/dkyil 'khor rgyas pa med par bum pa tsam la brten nas gzungs sgrubabyed pa'i tshe/bum pa nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dod yin pas/de'i nang du lha rnams spyan drangs te bzhugs gsol mchod bstod sogs byed pa yin zhing /dkyil 'khor med par bum pa rkyang pa ladabang bskur ba ni mi rung zhing /dbang bskur byed na bum pa las bzang ba'i dkyil 'khor legasasu yon phyin/bum pa ni dbang rdzas la dgos pa 'ba' zhin yin pas/bya rgyud rang skad gi dbangabum la lha bskyed mi dgos so//dbang gi don tsam du mi dgos kyang bum par lha bskyed du rung ba'i skabs yod phyin cho ga rgyas shing mdzes pa dang /byin rlabs che ba'i phyir byed do snyam na//o larag mod thob thang med pa'i lhag bcos byin rlabs 'gyung ba ni dka' 'o/gsum pa dkyil 'khorazhag gi cho ga la/thig gdab pa dang dkyil/༷ra bri ba'o//dang po ni/sngar phyogs legs par

brtags pa yin na des chog/min na skabs 'dir brtags sne phyogs nges por byas la/skyabasa'agro sems bskyed sngon du song nas phyi'i khrus dang /gnas su 'jug pa dang /bdag srung bdabāphur bus gdab pa dang /steng bcing bdang /khor yug bcing ba dang /gur 'bubs pa dbamatshams gcod pa rnams sngon du btang /bum pa sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bum bzlasakhon bya/bum pa bskyed pa dang /mchod yon 'bul ba sogs yan lag rnams mi dgos/de lta bu snga dro dang /nyin gung dang /dgongs ka gsum bya bar bshad kyang /ma grub na thun gcig nges par bya'o//de nas dkyil 'khore gyi lha rnams yid la dran bzhin pas dri bzang gi chus dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la bsangs gtor byed cing /na mo rat+na sogs 'dud rtsi thabs spyor dang /las thams cad pamang du bzla/thig skud tshon sna lnga pa/dkar dang dmar dang de bzhin ser//sngo dang lnga pa nag po ste/zhes 'byung ba ltar/srad bu gsar pa dang ldan pa la/tso( spyo ban+ta swāhā/lan brgya bzlas/dzi na dzika gis me tog gtor/spos kyis bdug/dri bzang byugs/sangs rgyas byang sems 'phagasastutshogs spyi lamachod dgos pas mchod pa bshams/a rdzita sa bsangs/na masarba ta sprugata spyo bi shwa mu khe khyu sogs kyis byin gyis rlabs/ar+gha pra tīts+tsha swāhā/gtso bzhingardegatsang ma las byung ba'i/zhes pa nas/ra shi ni na ma stu re snyam zhes yes ma rdzo bstod byas/byin gyis rlob par gsol ba gdab bo//de nas thig 'debs te 'dir kha cigazurathig mi 'debs par 'dod pa ni/gsang ba spyi rgyud kyi dpe sgrogs tsam byas pa las/don ma go bar zad do//de yang spyi rgyud las/gru bzhi lham par mnyam nas su//rgya gram du ni srad bu bre//rgya gram thams cad mnyam par mnyam//de ltar sras bu gtan la phab//ces pa 'di nang gi chadagu sogasardergya gram du gdang rgyu'i thig mang po yod pa rnams ston pa yin yang /khyed dag tshangs thig ston para'akhrul nas thog mar log thig dang /de nas tshangs 'ig 'debs zhes zer ba ni go rim gya tshos du 99

smra zhing tshangs zhes pa'i 'brum non pa'i phyir ro/ /des na tshangs zur gyi thig 'debs pa rgyud sosomang po dag las gsal zhing spyi dang 'dra la/ go sla bas gzhin bzhag tu mdzad la/ de rjes logasardethig nas brtsams te phyogs skor gsungs pa yin no/ /de ltar na tshangs zur gyi 'ig btag slobadapon me dang slob ma dbang du 'dug pas shar gyi logs thig dang / slob ma g.yas bskor byas te slob dpon me dang slob ma bden bral du 'dug pas lho'i thigs dang / slob ma de nyid dag slobadapon rlung du song bas nub thig dang / slob dpon de nyid dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas cha thig gdab bo/ /de nas gsang ba spyi rgyud kyi rang lugs ltar na/ rtsa thig gru bzhi de nyid cha gsum re mig dgu byas/ de re re yang / gsum gsum du btang ba'i re mig brgyad cu rtsa gcig 'byung gde'i dbusam ni sgo tshad yin zhing / sgo tshad de nyid gsum cha lhag pa dang bcas pas zur du bya rjes byas nasadang por thig gnyis gdab la/ nang ma dbus dor/ phyi ma phyed gdab phyi phyed gdab kyi rtsig pa nasemada' yab kyi bar dang / tshangs thig gi g.yas g.yo ni du thig 'debs tshul spyi dang 'dra bar byas nas/ sgo khang rta babs dang bcas pa bya'o/ /rta babs ni gsal kha med pas tshad med du byed pasogs ji ltar bde ba yin rung / snam bu bzhi ma'am/ bcu gcig yin rung sgo tshad gcig ma byas pas legs par mngon no/ /'ga' zhig phyag rdor dbang bskur gyi dgongs pa yin zer nas/ rta babs snam bu lnga par byed pa snying pos dbyen pa dang / gzhan dag logs thig gi nang du mda'/yab chud par 'dod pa sogs ni/ dkyil 'khor spyi'i lugs la yang thig chen brgyad kyi logs thig rtsa thig yin zhing / cha bcu drug gi tha ma bskor ba'i thig gru bzhi de thig chen brgyad kyi logs thigaslayin pa go bar gyis shig /blo chen 'ga' la yang 'khrul gzhi byung gda'o/ /de lta na yang thig ni rimapa spyi dang mthun par btab pas 'gal ba med la/ gang ltar yang dam tshig gsum bkod 'di 'de —100—

bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor lha lnga kho na byed na sgo rkyang yin yang / le'u bstogasukhopa dkyil 'bo ra chen po'i skabs su/ dbus kyi gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ bar ma sgo gcig nub tu lta ba dang / phyi ma sgo gcig byang du lta ba gsungs pas/ sgo gsum sbrag tu byung bdagagasang ba spyi rgyud las/ spyi 'gro'i dkyil 'khor sgo gsum sbrag la phyi ma gnyis la sgo re re dag nang ma sgo bshin gsungs pa dang mthun zhing / yang spyi rgyud las/ gzhan ni phyogs kyi cha bzhin du sgo bzhi sgo mkhyud bcas par bya/ zhes dkyil 'khor chen po'am rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rigs ga sgo rkyang yin na sgo bzhin nges pa dang / yang na thams cad dogs med par/ sgo ni re re ba'i na bya yi/snying po'i dkyil 'khor nges par ni/ rab tu bzang po sgo bzhin bya/ zhes dkyil 'khor dbus mkho na sgo bzhi dang / sgo sbrag gzhan thams cad sgo gcig tu byed pa'i lugs gcig dang / dkyil 'khoranyis rim sum rim bzhi rim sogs rim pa mang por byas pa la/ phyi rim gang yin de la ni/ sgo gcig pa dang rgya cher bya/ zhes sgo sbrag nang ma thams cad sgo bzhi pa dang / phyi ma kho na sgo gcig par byed par gcig rnams 'dam khar gsungs so/ /'dir ni de dag dang bstun nas gang ltar byas kyang rung mod kyi/ phyis kyi rdo rje slob dpon rnams kyi phyag len mgrin gcig par mthun pa ltar sgo rkyangangam sgo sum sbrag gang byed kyang sgo bzhi byed de 'gal ba yang med do/ /de yang dkyil 'khor phyi ma gnyis la rtsig pa'i nang du lha snam re 'don zhing / dkyil 'khoranang ma la ni/ dbus su spyi la grags pa dang mthun pa'i brda' sbyar te cha chen gnyis kyi tshad gru bo zhe pa gtso bo'i gnas dang / de'i phyogs bzhi'i ngos nas rtsig pa'i bar la cha chen gsum 'khor gyi gnas yin te/ lha snam rim pa gsum gyi don no/ /gsum bkod kyi rgyud 'dir dkyil ge bor chubatshad khru lnga par bshad/ de yang rtsa thig gi tshad yin la sgo gsum sbrag tu 'bri na dkyil 'khor phyi me'i rtsa thig go /sgo sbrag gsum char la rta babs byas kyang rung la/ nang ma gnyis rta babs med padag—101—

phyi ma rta babs can du byed pa spyi dang mthun pa dang / yang phyi ma dang nang ma rta babs can bar rmartababs dang bral ba'ang rung ngo / /dbus kyi gru bzhi'i gnas su slar yang de'i byed kyi tshad kyi dbusasu gru bzhi dang / de'i nang du zlum por bskor ba'i pad thig bya/ de bzhin du dkyil 'khor rdzo rme'i lha'i gnas gzhan rnams su yang pad+ma cha chung gnyis pa re bya/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol du 'byams dang rdo ra dang 'od zer 'phreng ba'i thig kyang spyi dang mthun par btab/ spyir ni bya spyod dze+edag tu phyi'i sa gzhi la mtha' gcig tu dbyibs dang mtshan nyid nges med kyang dmigs bsal med pa rnams spyi dang mthun pa bzang ngo / /gnyis pa tshon dgye ba ni/ na mo rat+na: sogs bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags sprin tubaglazhing / sa gzhi dang yo byad la bsangs gtor bya/ phyi khrus nas mtshams gcod pa'i bar thig ṣ+kaskabs su bshad pa ltar gyi khrus dang srung ba slar yang byas nas/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ sogs kyis phyag byas/ las thams cad pa bzla bzhin du dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa thog mar slobadapon gyis 'bri/ phyis ni slob ma las byed pa rnams kyis 'bri ste/ gzhul 5sa khang dang bdan dngaphyag rgya dgod pa thams cad la/ zlaX dang / dzi na dzika 'ba' zhig brjod pas kyang 'grub nye spyi'i cho ga'i lugs so/ khyud 'di nyi do las dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i skabs su gsungs shing snying wa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga de la nges par 'jug pa 'di tsam yin te/ gzhal yas khang 'bri ba na/dkyil 'khor dbus ma dang bar ma nub sgo nas brtsams te 'bri/ phyi ma byang sgo nas brtsams te 'ebre/sngags ni/ na maXsar+pā brnya bo dhi satwa nāX/ a ma la a ma la ha rak+ta a khan nā shā shwa ta sarba dzī na a shī ni/ ma ni ṣa ra da ma ma den+tu/ a di a da raX ba ra a graX sam sarba tā naX/ ta ste me badz+ra u lha a ra ra/ u sa ma sam/ sa ma nā a 'di nā dhasme te khan kha ni/ mahā bī raX/ a tsa le sa ma sam a sa ha mab le/ kaṇa kaṇa/ mahwa ragre—102—

ke ha ha ha ha/ badz+ra badz+ra aX ka me dha ra dha ra/ /hūX hūX saX da laX sa mas lo a(ga bi gra me/ ku ru ku ru ru sa /sarba thā sarba hi dz+wa la dz+wa la/ a gre a gri ṇi spyiX phaṭa phaṭaswāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di bzla ba'o/ /mi nus pas tha na bklags pas kyang ngo / /dkyil 'khoranang ma'i nyi zla sogs gdan rnams 'god pa na/ na maXsarba budha bo dhi swatwa naX/ a sarba thāsarba twa ṇa ke swāhā/ zhes pa dang / gtso bo'i mtshan ma la/ na maXs man+ta badzā ṇaX/ sa ma sa ma huX/ na maXs man+ta badzā ṇaX/ a sa ha haX maX/ zhes pa bzla zho /de rjes rgyud nas gsung༅pa'i byang chub sems pa'i phyag rgya dgod pa man chad dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i khyad chos yin pas snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di la mi 'jug pas na/ spyi rgyud kyi cho gas cho ga shes par bya'o/ /de la tshon gyi rim pa ni/ rtsig pa ni phyi nas dkar nag dmar ser sngo ba ste/ dkyil 'khor nang ma rim pa lngadagabar pa la dkar ser dmar gsum/ phyi ma la dkar po gcig pu'o/ /dbus kyi gtso bo'i gnas ni/ljang khu'am sngon po sto sngo nag gcig tu rtsis nas/ lho sngon por byed na dbus ljang khu dang/sngo nagatha dad par rtsis nas lho nag por byed na dbus sngon po'o/ /lha snam dang 'byams rnams shar dkar/ lho sngo'am nag po/ nub dmar/ byang ser ba yin/dgos pa can gyi dmigs bsal yod na ma gtogs/ 'jig rten gyi phyogs dang dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs 'grig pa nges par bya zhing / gtso bo yang dkyil 'khore gyi nub phyogs su zhal gzigs padagos la/ dbus kyi grub bzhi nang ma la bzhugs khri mtsho ni byed 'og gzhi sngon po yin na ljang khu dang / 'og gzhi ljang khu yin na sngon po la tshon sna tshogs kyis bkra ba/ de'i dbus su dkar po lte bar zla ba la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi sku gzugs dngos gzhug kyang rung / yang na gtsug ge tor rasardo rje ser po rtse lnga pa 'bri'o/ /de nas lha snam dang po lagatso bo'i gdan gyi g.yas byang dang g.yon lho mā pad+ma'i gdan la g.yas phyogs su lcags kyu ser po dang / g.yon phyogs su rdo rje ljang ser ro//—103—

lha snam gnyis pa la/ de nas g.yas g.yon tu byed pa'i zur thig dang nye ba la/ rlung du gri gug dgabaden bral du me tog 'phreng ba pad+ma la gnas pa'o/ /lha snam gsum pa la lho sgo'i thad du be con dkar po dang / byang sgo'i thad du zhags pa ser po dang / shar sgo'i thad du 'khor lo'i dkarapornams kyang pad+ma la gnas pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i lha snam la shar gyi g.yas g.yon dang / lho'i g.yas g.yon dadanub kyi g.yon dang byang gi g.yon dang / byang shar rnams su po ti'i gzugs brnyan re/ nub kyi g.yas dang byang gi g.yas su ral gri re/ shar lhor spyi blugs/ lho nub tu rdo rje/ nub byang du zhagasapa/ de rnams ji ltar 'os pa'i gdan la gnas pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i shar gyi dbus su rdo mrede'i rgyab tu nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ shar lhor me thab/ lhor be con/ lho nub tu ral gri zhu btu sprulazhugs/ de'i rgyab tu zla ba'i dkyil 'khotshor/ g.yas su bum pa/ nub byang du rlung rog byang du ga byugatho/ byang shar du rtse gsum mo/ /sgo bzhin sgo srungs byed na rgyal chen bzhi'i mashaṃ ma bo kod/ ge bor gyi lha'i gdan rnams kha dog mdzes tshon no/ /gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol du 'byams la/ lho phyogasardesu rigs sngags 'chang gi rgyal po bdun dang / shar du dbang phyug chen po dang / dka' bzlogamadang / gzhon nu gdong drug /byang du tshangs pa dang khyab 'jug chen po/ nub sgo'i g.yas dang g.yon du dga' bo dang gnyen dga'o/ /lho sgo'i thad du gnod sbyin mo 'phrog ma ste/ de rnams la lha mtshan rgyas pa ma grub na/ swa sti ka te dga' 'khyim re bri bar bya'o/ /nus na gdan zlum po reg brag po'i phyag rgya rtse gsum rno/ dka' bzlog phyag rgya rtse gsum gdengs/ khyab 'jug gi ni 'khor lo rno/ sdechen gyi ni mdung thung rno/ tshangs pa'i pad+ma yin par spund/ ces pa ltar dang / rig pe'i rgyal po rnams la/ rdo rje rtse gsum kha gcig pa re re bri bar bya'o/ /yang mdor bsdus pa'i dzinas skabs gagazhal yas khang gi phyi'i dkyil 'khor lamatshan ma rnams ma bris kyang chog /nang gi yang gtso bo —104—

las gzhan rnams gdan du 'god pa'am thig le tsam gyis kyang 'grub bo/ /skabs 'dir sgo sbragagasum kar sgo bzhir byas na/ phyi ma'i byang sgo dang / bar ma dang nang ma'i nub sgo phye ba yin pas/ lha snam dang sgo khang dkyus gcig pa dang / g.yin rnams bcad pa mtshon pa'i phyir/ rtsa 'ig gi steng du re kha dkar po mngon tsam phra mor bri'o/ /de bzhin du sgo mkhyud kyi nang du rdo rje phra mo re yang sgo gleg dang sgo srung ba'i don du 'bri bar bya zhing / 'khyams la ri dang ljon shing nags tshal dang/ mtsho dngame tog la sogs pa zhing khams kyi bkod pa mtshon byed bya'o/ /gal te dkyil 'khor sgo rkyang du byed na dbus kyi cha chen gnyis la/ gtso 'khor lnga po le god cing / lha rnams rim pa gsum du byas pa'i dang po la/ gzhan gyi mi thub pa gnyis dang spyan ma'agod/ gnyis pa la mdzod sbu can sogs dang / gsum pa la phyogs skyong rnams 'god par bye gi /bzhi pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/ nye reg byas shing gtsang sbra dang ldan pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams/ ze'u kha bcing ba'i bar bsnyen pa'i skabs su ji skad bshad pa bzhin rdzogs par byas pa'am/ mchod pa'i bgegs bsal byin bskyed byin rlabs gsum chi por/ gzhan rnams tshangabar byas pas kyang rung ngo / /mtshams der yo byad dag tshogs par byas shing / dkyil 'khor dang yo byad la dmigs nas/ bod gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar zhi bas sbyang ba/ phyed mas sbyang ga dragapo sbyangs pa ste bgegs sbyangs ba gsum dang / til sbyangs kyi sgo nas byur bsal ba yang bya/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor bzlas shing bsangs gtor byas la/ rnam par rgyal ba gtso bo'i bum pa ni/ dbus kyi gtso bo'i gnas las cung zad rgyab gyis phyogs par mañji la sogs pa'i steng du yi ge brgya pa dang bhu bzla bzhin du 'jog ste dbang gi bum pa'o/ /'di nas bzung ste rjes chog gi bar du bum pa 'i de ni mi bsgul lo/ /de bzhin du 'khrus bum rnams ni/ rigs kyi snying po kho na'am/ stagon gyi skabs su gang bzlas pa de nyid 'don bzhin du dkyil 'khor bar ma'i gnas su 'jog ste/ mdun gyi g.yas—105—

g.yon gnyis dkyil 'khor nang ma'i rlung srin gyi grwa dang / rgyab kyi g.yon g.yas gnyis me dbang gi grwa la bzhag go /oṃ a mṛ te hu phaṭa/ kyis las bum dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i shar sgor ba 'gago/gal te gnas de dag tu 'jog stabs mi bde na/ de dag tu stangs ka tsam byas nas/ dkyil 'khoraphyi ma'i nub sgo'i thad tsam du dbang bum dang / de'i g.yon du las bum dang / zur 'ig gi ha du khrus bum bzhag go /bum pa gsum las/ ma 'bye tshor na/ nub sgo'i g.yas su khrus/ bum bltag/ /spros pa la dga' na/ khrus bum brgyad sgo mtshams brgyad du bca'/ las bzhi'i bus pa ni/ gzhalayas khang gi phyi'i phyogs bzhi'am/ yang zhi ba byang shar/ rgyas pa la shar lho/ mngon spyod lho nub/dbang nub byang du bldan go /'dir 'khrul bum dang bkra shis kyi bum pa don gcig ming gi rnamagrangs so/ /phyi rol khor ra khor yug tu mchod yon gyi snod sna tshogs dang / rgyal mtshan dag rma bya'i mdongs dang / spos phor rnams brgyad brgyad dang / gzhan yang mchod pa'i khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs dang / mchod pa'i rta babs bzhi yang rtsigs par bya'o/ /spyi rgyud las/ dbang bskur phyir ni 'bring po gcig /ces 'byung ba'i 'bring po ni dbus ma'i don yin pas dbang bum yin lka grwa dngasgo ni ma lus par/ /bum pa dag kyang bzhag nas ni/ zhes pa khrus bum brgyad dam/ bar sgo tshan por gnyis gnyis shig /khyad par du ni bzhag par bya/ zhes cung zad bsdud pa la khrus bus ba'i ska chog pa dang / bum pa gcig ni phyi sgo yi/ /drung du mthon par bzhag par bya/ zhes pas las busarnams bstan pa yin no/ khren tu bsdu na/ khrus bum gyi bya ba las bum gyis byas nag bum paganyis kyis kyang dbang bskur ba rung ba tsam ni yin no/ /gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ dkyil ge bor gyi dbus sogs ji ltar rigs pa lha mtshan med pa'i sa stong du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pe'i glegs bam sogs po ti bzhugs par gsungs kyang 'di lagatso bo'i mdun phyogs ma gtogs de tsam gyi sa stong med la/ gtso bo'i mdun bkag pa'ang mi mdzes na de 'dra nges par dgos pa mo yen —106—

no//phyi rol shar du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa/byang du gser 'od dam pa/nub tu sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdo/lhor sdong po bkod pa rnams stegs bu la bzhugs nas/me tog dngadrospos sogs kyis mchod cing /dus dus su gtsang sbra dang ldan pas bklag par bshad do//'jamadapal rtsa rgyud las ni/lhor sher phyin/nub tu zla ba sgron ma/byang du sdong pos brgyan pa/shar du gser 'od dam pa/zhes gsungs te/'dir ni de dag las gang byas kyang 'dra'o//de nas 'di skad du/mtha' yas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad nas/nye bar brgyan pa lo sa gyisabadag gis de kho na nyid bsgom/dkyil 'khor chen po'i gnas su sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams gyi smon lam gyi mthu las byung ba/rin po che du ma las/grub pa'i zhing khams sa gzhi yangs shing rgya che ba/zhes pa nas/snying sher sengage'i khri dang pad+ma'i gdan/gzhan yang 'khor gyi lha'i gdan bdun dang bcas khu/ dang /steng du rin po che'i bla bre dag kyang skad cig gis byung bar gyur la/khangabazang dam pa de nyid kyi phyi rol du gzhal yas khang rim pa gnyis dang bcas pa dang /gzhal yas khang bar pa la yang phyogs bzhir gnyis gnyis dang mtshams/bzhin re re ste lha'i gdan bcu gnyis dang /gzhal med khang phyi ma'i nang ni lha rnams la lha'i gdan bcu gcig dang /de bzhin du sgo dang 'khyams rnams/la lha so so'i gdan rnams dang /khang bzang dbus ma la phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkaranag dmar ser sngo ba'i rtsegs pa rim pa lnga dang /bar pa la dkar ser dmarab ste gsum dang /phyi ma la zla ba chu shel ltar dkar ba'i rtsig pa gcig pu'o//gtso bo'i gnas kyi gzhi ljang khu/gzhan dkyil 'khol ra gsum char la mtshungasardepar/phyi nang gi sa gzhi thams cad nub dmar byang ser shar dkar lho sngo thams 07

cad rtsig pa'i steng na/ pha khu ser po dang / de'i steng du rin po che'i dra phyed kyi gzhi la rnga yab la sogs pa du ma dpyangs pa/ ba ku la'i 'phreng ba dang steng du rin po che leb kan gyis bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i 'gram na 'dod yon gyi snam bu dang bcas pas phyir rol gyi 'khyams la ri dang ljon shing dang mtsho dang pad+ma la sogs pa me tog sna tshogs dang yid du 'ong ba'i 'dab chags la sogs pas gang ba mchod pa'i khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs kyis yongs su mdzes pa/ phyi rolardo rje rin po che'i lcags ris shin tu bskor ba dang bcas pa/ rab tu gsawazhing mdzes la 'bar ba'i 'od kyi snang bas phyogs kun khyab pa'o/ /na mang tha ta thā ga tā nāX/ sarba thā ung ga te sla ra ṇa hi maX ga ga na khaX swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsusardebarjod/ de dag ni rten gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'o/ /rnam rgyal gyi dkyil chog rje byams gling pas bsgrigs pa na/ 'dir sbyan drangs nas mnyesapar byed pa ni dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dngos yin pa las/ 'di'i lugs su rlom bzhin du dam tshigabaskyed pa ni/ cho ga sra bsrer gyur pa dag go zhes bris te/ de la smras pa/ gzhan dag de ltar byed pal 'gog pa de ni khyed bden te/ bya rgyud rang skad las dam tshig pa bskyed pa med do/ de ltan yang khyed nyid la shin tu 'gal te/ /dkyil chog de dang sbyor rgyu'i sgrub thabs sogs khyed kyis brtsamasapa'i bya rgyud rang lugs yin gsung pa phal che na/ lha drug gi sgo nas bdag bskyed byed pa snang ba/ de bas lhag pa'i dam tshig pa bskyed tshul gyi cho ga ci zhig yod/ mdun skyed la dam tshig pa bskyed payang bya rgyud rang rkang gi tshul dang mi mthun pa ta nges pa yin mod/ bdag bskyed kyi dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ de bas kyang tshes cher bya rgyud kyi tshul la 'gal tshab che ba yin pa go bar gyis shig /de nas phyag rgya rnams byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ rgyud 'di nyid kyi khyad chos te/ thal mo brdab bzhi du de —108—

bzhin dzin gas pa'i yi ge brgya pa lan 'dun brjod de/ nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya thams to byin gyis rlobs pa'oX/ /yangaX thal mo brdab pa dang 4sa ༷te/ na maXsarba brnya bo dhi sa tā nāX/ba ra ba ra/ sarba sarba/ sa ma sa ma/ kā ru ṇa kā ru ṇa/ twar twar/ samasamā.usnri u sdi/ a mi taX a mi taX/ a ti a ti/ bi raX bi raX/ a tāX a tāX/ shu raX shu raX/ha ha ha ha/ mahā sa ma ya/ na ma sta a ma la/ sidha da ya ke khyuX sarba budha rngadhi sa tā nāX/ sarba a nan+ta ma rmye khyuX mahā kā ru ṇa /mya phyi ni/tri sam ye/ dzolas mā zhesabyang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po mtshungs pa med pa lan bdun bzlas pas/ dkyil 'khoraphyi ma gnyis kyi phyag rgya thams cad byin gyis rlobs/ de nas lha spyan 'dren pa ni/ dkyil zhabor gyi dbus su 'dug par mos la pus mo g.yas pa sa la gtsugs te/ lag tu me tog bzung nas/de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi lcags kyu zhes bya ba'i sngags 'di lan nyer gcig brjod par bya'o//na maXsarba bud+dhā bo dhi sa tā nāX/ sa man+ta a mo gha pra ti ha ta badzā ṇaX/ a gra a gra ā kar+ṣa ṇi huX/ be gī be gī ni mahā be gī ni/ sar+pā spa badz+ra su lā nāX/ u kar+ṣa ya guXsarba mu dra ga ṇa nāX/ ti ste ti lte/ ti ti ti ti/ ta ṭha ta ṭha/ a a nā bri te/ a prati ha ta/ a mo gha bu kra me/ sa ma sa ma a ma le mahā me/ a ti a ti/ be ge ba twa kes ma ya i daX/ kā ru ṇa sgyi ti na ya/ ta twa adhi ni/ ā na ya shī gh+raX ta thugata a d+ku shrī swāhā/ zhes pa ste/ mthar me tog nam mkha' la dor bar bya'o/ /'di dmatshig gsum bkod nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /de nas spyi khyab kyi cho gsaspyan 'dren pa ni/ gong bsnyen pa'i skabs su bshad pa rnams dran par byas te/zlaX bdun/dzi na dzika 'dun/ oX ltoX ༷ban+ta swāhā/ gsum/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya: gsum/ ma rlus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / go sogs dang / chos rnams kun gyi —109—

dbang phyug gtso/ ces sogs dang / las byed pa'i mchod yon tsong zhing / dad pa dang ni/nas/ dgyes par mjodi/ zlaX bdun la sogs pa dang / dzi na dzika bdun la sogs podaga.oṃ ru ru sogs sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags 'dun la sogs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pe'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang yi ge lnga pa lan bdun dang / oṃ mu ni mu ni: sogs ni mang du brjod cing / mthar/ oṃ bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka shākya mu ni tri sa ma ya rā dza maṇ+ḍal de ba tā sa pā ri wā ra e sgye hi/ lan gsum/ 'dir yang de bzhi gshegs pe'i lcags kyu'i sngags sh+ka gsum brjod/ bcom ldan thugs rje: nas/ 'bor gyi dkyil 'khoralabalta ba/ zhes brjod de/ snying po rtsa ba'i lha lnga gsal btab/ lha snam phyi me'i/ lho sgo'i thad du/ khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa dkar po/ stag lpags dang sbrus/gyis brgyan pa/khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ byang sgo'i thad du khro mo gzhan gyis mi thugamaser mo/ /zhags pa 'dzin zheng / dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyisabargyan pa/ rol pa'i khro mo'o/ khar sgo'i thad du rigs pa'i rgyal mos pas rgyasaspyan ma dkar mo g.yas ga bor lo 'dzin zhing / g.yon gdan la brten pa/rigs sngags kyi lha mo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'i/ dkyil 'khor gnyisapa'i lha snam la/ shar gyi g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' mdzod sbu can/g.yon du mdung thung can/ lho'i g.yas su 'khor los bsgyur ba cher 'byung/g.yon du yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyal mtshan/ nub kyi g.yon du mthu be thob pa/ byang gog yon du don thams cad grub pa/ byang shar du dri ma med pa'i blogros/ de rnams g.yas shing thog dang / g.yon po ti 'dzin pa/ nub kyi g.yas su 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa/ chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i phyag ṣ+ka—110—

mthil las g.yas g.yon du gyes pa'i ut+pal sdong bu la ral gri dang po tis mtshan pa/ byang go g.yas su nam mkha'i snying po/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang/g.yon ral gris mtshan pa'i pad+ma bsnams pa/ shar lhor 'phags pa byams pa spyi blugs dang klu shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ de thams cad gser btso ma lta ja'imadog can no/ /'dir gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' bcu gnyis 'god par bshad kyang ha cang mang par 'gyur bas na/ de rnams kyi gtso bo'i phyir byamasapa nyid kyis chog go /lho nub tu rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mo mā ma gī/ sku mdog sngon mo g.yasardo rje 'dzin zhing / g.yon gdan la brten pa/ nub byang du mngag gzhugs 'khyon 'grus cenapodakar po zhags pa 'dzin pa rol pa'i khro bo'o/ /dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i lha snam la/ shar du brgya byin dmar ser glang po che la lko pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ de'i rgyab tu nyi ma dmar po rta bdun gyis drangs༅ shing rta la zhon zhing nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me dmar po ra skyes la zhon pa tshel 'dzin pa/ lhor gon na rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po nag po ro langs la zho5 pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul thegs 'dzin pa/de'i rgyab tu zla ba dkar po ngang pa la zhon pa ku mu ta 'dzin pa/ g.yas su sa'i lha mo pad+ma'i dbus na lus phyed phyur ba'am/ phag la cings pa bum pa bsnams pa nub byang du rlud lha ljang khu ri dwags la zhon pa rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ 'dir rgyal mtshan zhes pa ni da lte'i sbubs can 'di ma yin gyi/ ba dan dang gcig gtog dang bcas pa'o/ /byang du gnod spyin ser po rta la zhon pa dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glangal zhon pa mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ phyi'i gzhal yas khang sgo bzhi pa lasgosrungs byed na/ shar sgor yul 'khor srung dkar po rgyud mang 'dzin pa/ lho sgor—111—

'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub sgo spyan mi bzang dmar po sprulazhags 'dzin pa/ byang sgor rnam thos bu ser po be con dang ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin pa'o/ /phyi'i gzhal yas khang sgo gcig pa'am/ sgo bzhi gang byed kyang sgo skyong nges par dgos pa ni min no/ /nub sgo'i g.yas g.yon du klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang gnyen dga' bo dkar po sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can/ sprul 'jug yod pa nor bu rin po tshe'adzin pa'o/ /lto sgo'i thad kyi phyi rol du gnod sbyin ma 'phrog ma ser mo 4gu busagang ba'i snod dang ne'u le'i rkyal ba 'dzin pa/ bu lnga brgya dang bcas po rdo /de bzhin du drag po dbang phyug chen po dang / gangs ri'i bu mo dbu mdang/ gzhon nu gdong drug dang / tshangs pa dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / rigs sngagasa'achang gi rgyal po glang po che dang / yan lag bkra bas byin dang / rtse bran can dang / g.yon phyogs cod pan dang / mig bzang po dang / sna tsho gos 'od dang /legs par sgrub pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khore du 'du bar 'os pa'i lha thams cad kyang bzhugs shing / phyogs thams cad du sangs rgyas dang byang chub semasadapa' dang / nyan thos dang / rang rgyal dang / lha'i mchog rnams kyis yongasasubaskor te bzhugs par gyur/ de nas/ shā ka re sa ma ya grwa sma zhes ponas brtsams me/bdag la grub pa'i mchog stso'/ cig /ces pa'i bar dam la bzhag pa dang / mchod pa dang /bstod pa dang / bshags pa dang / yi rang dang / gsol gdab dang / sems bskyed dag tshad med bzhi sgom pa dang / yongs su bsngo ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa'i bar rnams bsnyen pa'i skabs su ji skad bshad pa bzhin byas pa kho nas kyang dgos don thams cad 'grub la/ cung zad spros pal —112—

dga' na mchod yon gyi skabs su/ las kyi rdo rje bzed zhal kyi nang du mchod yon bsgreng zhig de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / rig pa'i rgyal po dang / rigs kyi snying po ma pa du bzla zhing / lha rnams kyi mtshan sngags lan gsum gsum gyis phyogs mtshams brgyad dam phyogs bzhi'am/ nub sgo'i thad nas shar du phyogs pas 'bul bar bya'o/ /khrus gsol gyi skabs ga pharaphyin drug gi tshigs bcad dang yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i shes brjod sogs kyang bya zhing /de bzhi du/ mchod yon phal cher/ sogs dang / rab 'byams rgya mtsho gosakyitshigs bcad dang / 'dod yon lnga dang / rgyal srid sna bdun dang / bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang / bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyi mchod pa sogs kyang ji ltar skabs su bab pa de ltar sbyar bar bya la/ bstod pa dkyus kyi mthar yang / skyes bu ma skyes khyod phyag 'tsha'o///skyes bu dam pa khyod phyag 'tshal/ /spyod pa'i don kun grub mdzad pa/ /skyes bu gtso bo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /phung khrol thams cad bzlog pa po/ /skyes bu seṅge khyod phyag 'tshal/ /ngan 'gro thams cad 'joms mdzad pa/ /skyes bu dpa' bo khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bsod nams dri ni mtha' yas pa/ /skyes bu pad dkar khyod phyaga'atshal/ /srid gsum 'dam rdzab rnams sbyong ba/ /skyes bu pad+ma khyod phyag 'tshal//sdug bsngal kun la rnam grol ba/ /skyes bu rnam grol khyod phyag 'tshal/ /kun tuzhi zhing legs zhi mdzad/ /zhi ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sngags kyi spyod don kun sgrub pa/ /sgrub pa khyod la phyag 'tshal 'e rna /bkra shis kun kyi bkra shis pa//bkra shis khyod la phyag 'tshal lol /chos rnams thams cad thugs chud pa/ /sangs rgyas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rnams thams cad spros pa med/ /de bzhin nyid de yi ge a'i/ /rjes zhugs rab tu ston mdzad pa/ /de bzhin —113—

gshegs khyod phyag 'tshal lo/khres dang shes bya'i dngos kun dang//'dusabyas 'du kas ma byas theg gsum//lam la rab 'jog rab gnas pa//thams/cad mkhyen pa khyod phyag 'tshal/shwakya'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das//gser gyi mdog can mtshan dpes spras//na bza' chos gos ngur smrig bsnam ga/chosa'achad phyag rgya mdzad la 'dud//'phags pa rdo rje 'dzin pa che/gser mdogaral pa'i cod pan can//gos ser gyon zhing nor bu dang //lcags kyu ledzen laphyag 'tshal lo//'phags ma rdo rje 'dzin ma yang //yid 'phrog kha dog bla gosaser//rdo rje dang bcas thal mo sbyar//pus btsugs bzhugs la phyag 'tshalardelo//pho nya mtha' yas sku gdog dmar/khro zhabrug nor bu'i zur phud dang //sprul dkar ma rdzo phyir thogs kyis brgyan/gri gug zhags pa 'dzin la bstod//mtha' yas ma ni sngo sangs mdog/zur phud gcig pa lang tshor ldan/khregadang bcas pa gos sngon gyon//me tog 'phreng ba 'dzin phyag la'i///gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che//gtum/ mo gdol ma gzhan mi thub//dngos grub kun stsol sangs rgyas spyan//grub pa'i lha mchog rnams la 'dud//rgyal sras kun gyi gtso bo ni//gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin 'jam pa'i dbyangs//'bor los bsgyurargyal byams pa ste//thabs mkhas mchog gyur la phyag 'tshal///'phags mchogo/nam mkha'i snying po sogs//rig rgyal byang sems dpa' rnams dang//myam ki dang brtson 'grus che//zhi zhing srung mdzad gtso la 'dud//dbang po zla ba nyi masogs//nges pa nyid du rnam dag kyang //thugs rjes thabs kyi sku sprul kha pa//'jig rten skyong ba rnams la 'dud//klu rgyal dga' bo nye dga' bo//'phrogam4

bu dang bcas pa rnams//rgyal ba'i bstan la mngon dga' zhing //mthu chen ldan pa rnams la'ang 'dud//stobs chen lha rnams thams cad dang/khrigasarde'adzin rgyal po thams cad dang //sa gsum gnas na dge ba can//dkyila'akhor gnas pa kun la 'dud//de ltar bstod pa'i dge ba yig/nam mkha'i mthas gtugs sems can kun//sgrib spangs yon tan kun rdzogs te//khro rje 'dzin dang mnyam par shog/de nas slar yang ma rdzo yon dang /nyer spyod sngagarnye gyisaphul la/na mo rat+na tra yā ya/oṃ a ta bhu ti zhes pa nas/dzin dzikag mgo bor bhūX yig byung bar bsams pa'i bar bzlas pa byed tshul yang phal cher bsnyen pa'i skabs dang 'dra la/'on kyang 'dir khyad par ni/dkyil 'khor gyi bzlas pa song ba'i mtshams su bu5parnams kyi bzlas pa ste/dbang bum la bhūX dang /yi ge brgya pa dang /yi ge lnga pa rnams/bzla/khrusabum mdun ma gnyis la/dzi na dzika dang rgyab zur gyi gnyis la las thams cad pa dab/lasabum la bdud rtsi thabs sbyor bzla'o//'di nas bzung ste bsangs ba dgos tshad las bum gyis byaba'o//las bzhi'i dbang bskur na yang de'i sngags bzla'o//de nas slar yang thal sbyar gyen du kha phyes lamadzub mo cung zad bkug pas//rtsa sngags lan gsum dang /dzi na dzika lan gsum gyi sa gtso bo dang /phyag rgya de dang dzi na dzika kho nas 'khor thams cad la yang lan gsum gsumadurgyas btab bo//de'i rjes su zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis lha mnyes par bya zhing /zhi ba sngon du song bsargyas pa bsgrubs na'ang legs la/zhi ba kho nas kyang nges par 'grub bo//bar 'dir log tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i gtor ma'i rim pa rnams bya ste/de ltar na rgyas btab sbyin sreg gtor ma gsum po ni/dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i yan lag yin par shes par bya'o//lnga pa dbang bskur bag/slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa dang /slob ma dbang du ba gnyis so//dang po ni/slog ma la ji tsa5

bskur ba de dag las/sbyin sreg dang dbang stegs la sogs pa bor te/gzhan lhag ma snams/ tshangabar bya'o//gnyis pa ni/bya rgyud spyi lugs la slob ma gcig kho na la cho ga gcig gis dbang bskur gyi/gnyis phan chod la yo byad gcig dang /cho ga gcig gis dbang bskur mi bya bar gsubasalkadam tshig gsum rgyal gyi rgyud las slob ma lnga man chad la zung min la dus mnyam du dbang bskur du wo bar gsungs te dgos kyi khyad chos yin par sems la/spyir ni slob ma'i snod gtso wangabartags dgos kyi snod la ci yang mi rtog par grangs tsam khon lang labs ci zhig bya/rgyud sdo' las kyang grangs dang mi mthun na mi shes par bshad kyi dbang mi thob par bshad pa ni med do//de nas slob ma dbang ༅ra ba la/khrus byas bsangs gtor thog ma'i rim//gsol/btab sems bskyed sdom pa bzung //rig dar bcings nas me tog gtad//nang du khrid nas bden stobs brjod//me tog 'dor zhing gdod g.yogasadakrol//lha ngo bstan zhing rig pa gtad//o don wo bcu bzhi h+pha sdom yid labazhag nas/dang po ni slob ma rnams 'khrus byas/dkyil 'khor khang pa'i sgo drung du 'khod/gnyisapa ni/bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi sngags bzla bzhin du bsang chu nas ku shas blangs te bsangs gtor bya/na mo rat+na nas/a rmi te huX phaṭa/zha gsum/'di ni byur bsal bdang bgogasabaskod pa yin/yang spod chus mgo la bram snye sngags de nyid sh+ka 'dun brjod pa ni srung ba yin/yang dri bzang gis byugs pa'i lag pa slob ma'i mgo la bzhag ste/oṃ dz+wa la huX/lan bdun gyis/byin rlabs/yang bhūX dang las thams cad pas bsangs gtor bya/gsum pa ni/me tog bkye bsdubya/sems bskyed gsal btab/chos bshad/'jug pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul lko/bzhi pa ni/dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/sogs kyis spyir gsol ba gob/lnga pa ni/srog chags sdug bsngal zhi bya'i phyir/zhes sogs stan/ gyi skabs ltar sems bskyed bya/drug pa ni/de
