nas sdom pa bzung ste/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams(cad la bdag 'bul gyi/thams cad kyis dus thams cad du bdag la rabatubazung du gsol/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bdagalabyin gyis rlabs tu gsol/thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa sems can gyi khamasardethams cad yongs su skyob par mdzad pa rnams kyis bdag la yongs su skyab tu gsol/las thams cad grub par bya ba'i phyir/dam tshig chen po bdagalastsal/ du gsol/zhes lan gsum rjes bzlos byed du bcug slob dpon gyis 'di skad cesabyaste/nam mkha' mtha' yas dang mnyam rgyal dbang po//sras bcas/ma lus kun kyi dam tshig stsole//'chi med bsad med sems can skyab pa med/shin tubartan pas 'di ltar bya ba nyid/ces brjod de/bdag 'bul ba'i sdom pa spyo sko/'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las ni/bdag 'bul ba'i sdom pa 'di dbang dngos gzhi song nas rjes kyi skabs na yod la/dam tshig gsum bkod kyi rgyud las skabs 'dir bshad do//gsang ba spyi rgyud la kha skong mi byed na bdag 'bul ba 'di mi dgos la/sems bskyed nyid sdom pa bzung sprin/'dun pa ni/de nas las thams cad pa dang /༈ gyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i gdong g.yogasabacings/brgyad pa ni/slob ma dam rgya 'ching du bcug pa'i lag tu dzi na dzika zhes brjod cib spro tog gtad do//yang na de'i steng du mig dar dang me tog gi sngags spyi dang 'dra bas kha bskang kyangarung ngo //dgu pa ni yang dzi na dzi ka bzla bzhi gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya ཿngas/slob ma'i ni borabazhag ste/dkyil 'khor khang pa'am/yol ba'i nang du khrid/bcu pa ni/de bzhin gshe/gas pa kun gyi gnas/ /dam tshig gsum ga dkyil 'khor mchog/snying po'i

dkyil 'bor 'di ru ni//bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi//lha yi rigasardekyi rim pa dang //bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog/de yi de gus grugaci 'drar 'khyu/ra//rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyuṇa//lha rnams rim bzhin 'bab par shog/'di la bsod nams mthu yod pa//dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog/wu gcig pa ni/oṃ pra tismo badz+ra ho zhes me tog dor/bcu gnyis pa ni/lasathams cad pa bzla bzhin du mig dar dkrol/yang na mig dar dgrol ba la/tshigs bcad dngasngags spyi dang 'dra ba las/rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa'i tshab tu/de bzhin gshegs kun wo 'don pa spos pas kyang wo bar ni mdzo no//bcu gsum pa ni/de nas lha woston to/de yang 'di na bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du bzhugs pa yin te/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams/kyismon lam gyi mthu las byung ba/lko pa nas/'bar ba'i 'od kyi snang bas phyogasakun khyab pa'o//zhes pa'i bar dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs ltar dang /dbus kyi pad+ma chen po'i steng gi spyo pa nas/tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur/lha snamakhan nga malabacom ldan 'das kyi bzhugs khri'i g.yas logs su/zhes pa nas/rdorje 'dzin pa'o//lha rnam gnyis pa la rdo rje 'dzin chen po'i mdun ngos 'og phyogasasgalko pa nas/'khore gyi dkyil 'kho ra la blta ba'o//lha snam phyi ma'i lho sgo'i thad du go pa nas/yongs su bskor te bzhugs par gyur/zhes pa'i bar du dkyila'akhor sgrub pa'i skabs bzhin no//tshe tog gang la phog pa'i lha ngos 'dzin pa ni/deng4 lag len mi byed pas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo nyid las der mos pa byas la/dkyil 'kho che bzang po 'di la ltos//da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs8

su skye//sngags dang rig pas byin gyis rlabs//'gro ba phun tsho gos de ngos grub kyang //thams cad khyod la mngon du 'gyur//dngos grub thob phyir dam tshigaskyongs//gsang sngags dag la'ang brtson par gyis/zhes bas/dzo rgyu pani/de nas slob mas/mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/lko sogs sho lo ka gas dang/na morat+na tra yā ya/zhes bzla bzhin du/dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal nas me tog gtor/oṃ pra titsā badz+ra hoXzhes lan gsum brjod/slob dpon gyis me tog blangs te/sngar dang war phul ma tshetog de dang lhan cig tu dzi na dzika dang bhāX bzla bzhi pas spyi bor bzhag go/gnyis pa dbang dngos gzhi la//sim pa bcu drug yod de//gsol dang spyin sreg3lasabum dbang //4dbang stegs 5shis brjod 6khrus bum dang //7rnam rgyal chu blangs sngags bzlasanas//9skor dang 0gsol 'debs bkra shis brjod//3ma rgyal 3bum pa las bzhirardecas//4cod pan mchod dang 6ched brjod bya//ces so//dang po ni/skabs 'dir slob mas yon dbul bar gsungs pa'i don la spya dang mthun par maṇ+ḍal 'bul/slob dpon gyisabadag la dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba ju55 du gsol zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/gnyis pa ni/skabs 'dir 'grub na cesapar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/gsum pa ni mthar/thab kyi lha rnams thab nas gshegs te dkyil 'khor la spyan drangs zin pa na/las bum blangs la bdud rtsi thabs sbyor ring ba'am 'bring po bzla bzhen du/bsangs gtor byas shing /oX a mṛ te huX phaṭa/ces bzla bzhin du/mtshan/ mo bde legs nyin bde legs sogs kyi mthar/las bum gyi chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur te sa du bcug/bzhi pa ni de nas slob ma re re bzhin dbang stegs dngos su bca' thub na legs/min na gcig la bca' ba'am/mos pa tsam gyis kyang /nga mod/de la dbang stegs ni chu tshon nam rdul

tshon dkar pos stegs bu gru bzhi'i zur la rdo rje rtse gsum phyed pas mtshan pa/ dbus su pad+ma dkarapo'am sna tshogs pad+ma 'bri/ 'dab ma brgyad pa la bkra shis rtags brgyad yod pa bya/ tshad ni rtsa bo re dkyil 'khor gyi phyed tsam zer yang / slob ma'i lus dang 'tsham pa yin pas nges pa med do/ /dza der sgo nub bam byang du gtad ces 'ga' zhig 'dod kyang nges par sgo can du 'bri dgos pa ni min la/ci ste sgo can du byed na/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub sgo dang 'jig rten nub phyogs la gtso bo zhalagazigs pa nyid kyi phyir/ gtso bo'i mdun phyogs su byed na sgo shar bstan du rigs lka debasamatshon pa'i shar nas nub tu bstan dang / lho nas byang bstan du yang rung zhing / drag po'i las kyidabang la byang nas lhor yang bstan no/ /slob ma'i phyogs la gtso bo'i mdun rgyab gang bstan yang rung mod kyi/ slob ma gtso bo la rgyab kyis phyogs pa ni mi rung la/ dbang stegs kyi sgo las rgyab ston pa yang mi mdzes so/ /lnga pa ni de nas slob ma dbang stegs la bkod/ khrus bum bzhi dbang stegasakyi grwa bzhin bzhag /steng du gdugs dkar po bzung / mtha' skor du rnga yab la sogs pa mchod pasna tshogs kyis bskor te/ ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ sogs gos 'di kyi mthar rol mo'i sgra cher bya/ drug pa khrus bum gyi dbang ni/ de nas khrum bum mdun ma gnyis/dzi na dzika dang / rgyab ma gnyis tse( rdo du gis dbang bskur te/ bum pa bzhi char gyis rim bzhin dbang bskur rgyu yin la/ /mi nus na gcig tu sdoms te dbang bskur kyang rung ngo / /'di ni khrusam ce byen dpal dang ldan/ zhes sogs kyi mthar/ sngags gnyis po lan gsum las mi nyung bar bzlas/ tso te a bhi ta ngos hū/ zhes brjod de/ chu 'khyor ba gsum tsam gyis khrus byar bzhug /slobadapon gyi dbang dngos la khrus bum gyi bya ba de kho nas chog kyang / bgegs gzhom pa'i dbang byed pa la de'i khyad chos rnams kyang thob na legs pas slob dpon gyi dbang yin yang skabs 'dir/ sdigapa dang sgrib pa thams cad shin+ta ku ru swāhā/ la sogs pa bkru byab srung gsum spyadang —120—

dam gsum bkad pa' dal 'kha/ra gya cha ga bya ba rgyud mtha' dag la 'ju : ga pa bzhug/sa/mthun par byas na shin tu legs so//bdun pa rnam rgyal las bum chu blang ba ni/de nas dung chos/sogs ar+ghaX'i snod dam bum pa gzhan du dbus kyi rnam rgyal bum pa las chu gcus te blugs/de'i tshe dzi na dzika dang/snruX ༷mang du brjod/brgyad pa bum chu la sngags bzla ba ni/bum chu de la snyingapoyi ge brgya pa lan bdun sags ji ltar 'os pa dang /yi ge lnga pa lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzla go/dgupa bskor ba dang bcu pa gsol btab ni/de nas rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/de lag sna tu thags nas dkyil 'bor la bskor ba lngo gsum byed cing /slob dpon gyis/thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pas slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud dag par mdzad du gsol/byin gyis rlab tu gsol/dbang bskur du gsol/ā+ogasol ba gdab/rol mo ba 'ag ste slob ma rnams kyis thos par yang lan gcig gsol ba gdagaspyi rgyud las 'di yid kyis gsol ba 'debs pa kho na bshad kyang /lag len la drig gis gsolab 'debs pa/slob ma dang ba bskyed pa dang /cho ga mi chad pa dang dmigs pa gsal ba'i phyirayin pas mi 'gal lo//bcu gcig pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga'i thobasabadangos la/oṃ phun sum tshogs pa sogs shis brjod kho nas chog la/slob ho du gyuranas gzhal la 'byor ba thob pa'i dbang byed na/dbang de'i khyad chos rnams kyang thob na bzang bas bkra shis rdzas brgyad bshams re re bzhin las thams cad pa'am thabs sbyor bzlas pas bsangs/bhūX dang /dzi na dzika gsum gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs nas/slob ma la me tog dkar po dnga'abras yos sogs thor bzhin du rol mo'i sgra ci rigs pa dang bcas pas/lkoX phun sumachogasardepa mnga' pa sogs dang /'gro la phan phyir de bzhin gshegs pa dga' ldan lha'i//gzhal med khang gi snying po nas ni 'dir gshegs te//dbang bcas lha yis bsko da ba'i bkra shis gang byung ba2//bkra shis des ni skyes dgu rnamasal

zhi byed shog /lo ma me tog 'od 'bar nyams dga' lusba'i tshal/ /lha slab dgagis bsten par mgon po bltams pa na/ /srid pa mthar phyin pa yi bkra shisagang byung ba/ /bkra shis: /grong khyer ser skya'i gnas nas rgyal po'i pho brang du//lhums nas bltams pa ston pa bde gshe/gas zas btsang sras/ /myur bskrun bdud rtsi'i chu gtor ba yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis: grong khyer dam pa seraskya'i gnas zhes bya bar ni/ /rmang du grags pa chen po lha yis mngone bstod pa//bsam yas dge bsgrubs bsod nams phung po'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis:dgyes shing nam phyed grong khyer nas ni mngon byung ste/ /dka' thub tshal du mo ge par gshegs shing tshangs la sogs/ /lha yi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis rab tu 'od 'bar gser dang 'dra ba'i skum phan zhing / /be rje r+ya ltar sngon po'i rtsa bting steng bzhugs te/ /skyil mo krung bcasamigayo mchog gi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis chu bo'i 'gram na tsar khri'i 'phrengagis yongs bskor ba/ /shin tu rmad du byung ba'i srid pa sel mdzad pa/ klu rgyal pos phyag byas pa yi bkra shis gang / /bkra shis: shing rgyal drung gshegs byams pa'i stobs kyis bdud kyi phyogs/ /mang po btul tshe sa steng dang ni nawamakha' la/ /bcom ldan bkra shis rnam pa sna tsho bo/sa gang byung ba/ /bkra shis:sdug bsngal mtha' dag gzhig phyir rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs te/ /nam gyi thorangs bdud bzhi po dag rnam btul ba/ /ston pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang yin pa/ /bkra shis: grong khyer wa ra na sir drang srongs ye bla/bzhugs nas/ /chos kyi 'khor ra lo mchog bstan pa yi bkra shis gang/ /lha yul—122—

dang 'dir shin tu rmad du byung gyur pa//bkra shis bkra shis gang zhin phan byed dam pa dag byed pa//bsod nams dag byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa//bco me ldan shākya thub pa'i seng ges gang gsungs pa//bkra shis:mu stegs byed pa kun kyi nga rgyal gzhom pa dang //'gro la bde ba bskyed phyiracho'aphrul dam pa dag/nye bar ston pa'i rgyal po'i bkra shis gang yin pa//bkra shis 'gro la phan phyir mtho ris gnas nas 'dir gshegs te//tshangs pa lasogs lha tsho gos lag na rnga yab gdugs//sna tshogs thogs pas yongs subaskor ba'i bkra shis gang /bkra shis de bzhin gshegs pa zhi ba'i yog/tunyer gshegs ba//man+ta ra yi me tog mang pos mngon mchod nas//lha mchonarnams kyis mngon par bstod pa'i bkra shis gang /bkra shis lha dbang kludangami yi dbang pos phyag byas pa//mkha' lding gnod sbyin dri za'i dbang lpa'i mchod gyur pa//de bzhin gshe/gas pa stobs bcu ldan pa'i bkra shis btab//bkra shis des ni skye dgu rnams la zhi byed shog/nyin mo bde legs nas/denga'adir stsole/zhes shis brjod rgyas par byed la/shin tu spros pa la dga' na/thog mar bkushis rdzas brgyad tshigs bcad tshig lhug yongs su grags pa dang rgyal srid sna bdun dang bkra shis rtags bgyod dam/bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyi tshigs bcad spyi dang mthun par brjod cing/so so'i gzugs brnyan bris sam 'bur du dod pa slob ma la gtad/de rjes thams cad mdun du pen nas/oṃ phun sum sogs shis brjod rgyas pa byed pa yin no//dbang rdzas dang bcas pa'i shis brjod kyi spros ba 'di 'byor ba'i don gyi da nyang la nges par dgos pa yin no//brtaganyis parnam rgyal bum pas dbang bskur ba ni/spyi sngags dzi na dzi ka lan bdun dang /dzi ltang 3

bltams pa tsam gyis ni/zhes sogs kyi mthar/snying po yi ge brgya pa nyid brlabazhin du dang por yal 'dab kyi bum chu blangs la slob ma'i lus lagator/de nas bum pa'am mchod yon gyi snod spyi bor bzhag/spyi bo nas bkru zhing mthar 'thung du bzhug go/chu dbang bskur pho spyi'i sngags 'di yang brjod de/san bhā ra ṇa/un dh+wa ra ṇi si pra la ta/su ta ma/supratiṣ+ṭha ta/bidza ya ba la/spyo bhā wa/pra te dz+nyā/a ro ha/snyen ba ti/ud pa da ni/dī na a ma la a bhi khri'u mi mi/a bha khyu ha ra shu bhaX ba ṭi/a ni shi ta ba pho kusba//bhi.a ba tsaXzhes pa'ang brjod de chu'i dbang bskur ba'o//spyir slob dpon gyi dbang tsam lachudabang gi skabs su de tsam gyis chog go/bcu gsum pa las bzhi'i bum pas dbang bskur ba ni/slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga dngos yin yang sngags sgrub pa'i dbang gi rigs 'ga' zhin la dgos pas/gzhan la sbyin pa'i don du slob dpon gyi 'os des kyang dang por thob na legs pas sngar las sgrub pa'i don du las bzhi'i bum pa bcas yod na/de dag gis kyang dbang bskur te/'di ni khrus mchog sogs la 'don pa spos te/ci 'dod sogs kyi tshab tu/zhi ba'i las/kun stsol1 bar mdzod/oṃ ru ru sogs dang /rgyas pa'i las/kun zhes dgatabya thā oṃ bhūX/dbang gi las kun zhes dang /oṃ dzi dzi sogs dag mngon spyod 'as/kun zhes dang /huX bzhi pa'i sngags re bum pa bzhi po de dag gis rim pa can du dbang bskur ro//spyi rma dngos bas gyi dgongs pa ni//re ṣ+ka dngos grub r+sā po don du mi gnyer bar 'phrin las bzhi re don gnyer tsam la rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu dbang mi bskur bar/las bzhi'i bum pa'adi dag las gang 'dod pa dang mthun pa re res dbang bskur ba yin kyang /'dir slob dpon gyiganas thob pas rang nyid kyis las bzhi ka sgrub dgos pa'ang yin la/gzhan la'ang bzhi'i dbangabaskur dgos pa yin pas/dngos su slob dpo/ rdo dbang yin yang /skabs 'dir las dza sto/ chu

dbang de byed pa legs so//spyir slob dgo gyi dbang du 'gyur ba tsam lagatso bum gyi chu dbangabaskur ba nyid kyis chog gi bum pa gzhan rnams kyis dbang bskur med kyang chog pa'i skabs yod do//bstobazhi pa cod pan gyi dbang ni/slong dpon gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rigs spyi'i dam rgya thos/slob ma'i spyi bor gtugs te/oṃ ta thā ga ta ud bha wa swāhā/a bhi khri zhwa / hūX/de ni spyi rgyud kyi cho ga'i lugs yin la/rgyud 'di nyid las gsungs pa ni/thal mo khong stong du spyar ba spyi bor ga khas la/na maXsarba brnya bo dhi satwa nāX/tra shi ji a grin na ma stu te/sa man+ta a da sa man tā/a gri ku na/a tsa la/a gri dhasme bi du na hi kle sha duXskos dzolan dzā ga twa na sba su khaXd dā hi tsa/shu tā tre daX tre sam ye ku ru grwa twa zhe4yos de/rgyud sde 'dir dbu ma skon pa'i dbang ma gsungs/phyag rgya spyi bor 'jog pa nyid cod pan gyi dang ngo //bco lnga pa ni/dri chab me tog bdug spos zhal zas mar me rnams slob ma'i mdun du bshams/nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum du brjod de/slob ma la dga' ston gyi tshul du bster rdo/yang na gong du shis brjod rgyas pa tshig tsam gyis byas nas/rdzas brgyad sogs dang 'brel ba'i shis brjod ni bar 'dis byas kyang yo ngo //bcu drug pa ni/sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyurardepar//blo dang ldan pas dbang bskur ro//spyo brjod cing /spyi bor me khod kha po 'jog te/mchod pa dang r+sā brjod de gnyis po de dag ni chu cod kyi yan lag gde yan chad dang gi dngos gzhi'o//dbang gi rjes su 'brang ba'i cho ga la brgyad de/gsol btab/ bka' bsgo nyes/pa sbyangs//rgyal bstan rjes gnang yon blang zhing //dam zing/ bsgrags lag dmasang ga 'bog/dang po ni/rtsa sngags yi ge brgya pas tshangs skud mchod phyir thogazhi/de yang sna ma'i me tog gi phreng pal bshad spre 1 2 rdod du mi zla cing /yang gser skud byed par

pond na'ang dkon par 'gyur bas/lag len lag/dab rgyu sras bu dkar po sum sgril sum skor sne mor mdud pa gsum dang bcas pa'o//oṃ ru ru sogs sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags kyis chun pa'i skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba'i lag gdub spyin/slob ma thal mo sbyor du bcug lka ni boragadugs bzung zhing /rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor la g.yas skor lan gsum byed du'ajug/de nas 'jug pa'i sgo phyogs nas phyag 'tshal du bcugs la/bla mas/sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur ba'i//slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/lan gsum/de ba'i na gshe/gsardepa rnams kyi gdung 'tshob pa'i don dang /sems can thams cad la thugasarjechen po'i 'phrin las 'jug pa'i don du/bdag slob dpon/'di kho chu khadakyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la slob ma 'di 'bul ba lags kyi yongs su bzung bar mdzod la/thugs brtse bas bka' trin stsal du gsol/zhes brdzo/gnyis pa ni/gdugs bzhag la slob ma dbang stegs la bkod de/de ring dkyil 'khorerdeslob dpon gyur//sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa//sangs rgyas byang chubasems dpa' dang //lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs//sems canarnams la snyid brtsebs/khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin//rog tu 'badade bri bar bya//sgrub pa po rnams rgyud las sbyor//go brjod/snyas pa cha1bdar+hadang slob ma'i nyes pa sbyang ba'i phyir/zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba ste/skabs 'dir mgrub na/rjesasubyas pas kyang rung la/'on kyang deng sang mi byed pa shas che'o//bzhi pa ni/lugs 'di'i de khon nyid stan pa ste/'di skad ces brjod do//de la phyi rol du lcags ris bskor ba ni gegs mi 'jug pa'i don yin/sgo sbrag gsum bris yod na/gzhal yas khang rim pa gsum ni/dngos grub rab 'bring tha gsum sgrub pa'i don du de dang de sterab26

la mngon par dga' ba'i lha rnams bzhugs pa'i don yin/ zhes dang/ gal te rim pa gcig las med na me gzhald khang dam pa 'di ni go 'phang mthon por bgrod cing grub pa chen po dag byung ba'i gnas kyi don yin zhes ba3/ yangagatso bo bcom ldan 'das ni phra mo las bzhi nas brtsams te mthar thug bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi bar du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun tshogs thams cad kyi gzhir gyur bas dngos grub thams cad stsol ba po yin/'phags pa rdo rje 'dzin pa ni rigs kyi bdag po byang chub sems dpa' dang /rdorje 'dzin ma ni rigs kyi yum dang / khye'u mtha' yas pa ni rigs kyi pho nya dang/bu mo mtha' yas pa ni rigs kyi pho nya mo dang / lha mo sangs rgyas spyan mni dngos grub thams cad kyi don du de bzhin gshegs rigs spyi khyab kyi rigs kyi yum dang / gzhan gyis mi thub pa pho mo ni rigs kyi khro bo khro mo ste/ 'di thamasacad dngos grub mchog gi don du/ so so'i 'phrin las kyi dngos grub stsol ba'i phyir bzhugs pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di rnams ni sangs rgyas thams/cad kyi 'phrin las sgrub pa'i don yin/ yum mā ma gī ni zhi ba dang srung bo'i don yin/ bran po pho ni gdug pa tshar gcod pa'i don te/ de dag kyang grub pa b.ram stsol ba'i tshul du bzhugs/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams ni grub pa chung ngu stsowapa dang / 'dod don sna tshogs pa sgrub pa'i don du rgyal ba sras bcas kyi bka' la stod pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa yin/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol gyi lha tshogasarnams ni/ dngos grub rab 'bring tha ma ma nges pa stsol bar bzhugs shing / las thams cad kyi gdong grogs mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes brjod/ bya rgyud kyi wa kha waṃr—127—

dgos pa bstan pa'i tshul gyis dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de nyid brjod pa yin gyi/rgyud sde gzhan gyi rgyas bkab mi bya'o//skabs 'dir spyi rgyud las phyag rgya chen po'ang ston par gsungs pas/sgrubathabs bsdus pa tsam dang /snang stong zung 'jug gi lha'i rnal 'byor sgom tshul 'chad rgyu yin na 'angadakyus kyi lag len la mi byed pa shas che'o//lnga pa ni/sngags kyi dbang bskur te/de yang me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i sngags sbyin pathob thang yin yang deng sang lag len mi byed pas/'di ltar bya ste/dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sngags kyi 'phreng ba kha dog dkar po'am/gser mdog 'od zer 'bar ba g.yas bskor du 'khod pa gsal btab//slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lhal gsol ba 'debs pa'i bsam pa'i me tog lag tu bzung nas/sgruX dang /dzi na dzika dag yi golnga pa dang /yi ge brgya pa rnams gsum gsum brjod la/bcom ldan 'di la stsal/lagasardekyi//'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol//lan gsum/gtso bo'i thug4༈sdo sngags 'phreng la dmigs su bcug ste/sngags de rnams kyi rjes bzlos lan gsum gsum bya/slob mas lha la me tog 'thor bzhi pas/bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi//bdag la 'gobar mdzad du gsol/lan gsum rjes bzlos bya/sgruX dang /dzin dzika bzla bzhi du/metog slob ma'i spyi bor gtor ro//bsdu na de tsam gyis chog/'di la rgyas pa 'grub na shog bu la gi hang gur gum sogs kyisasngags bris nas za ma tog tu bcug ste/dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bum pa sogs dang nye bar bzhag/sngar dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i don du de la'ang dmigs nas bzlas brjod byed/skabs 'dir de blangs nas slob ma klog tu bcug/bzung bar mos nas/mchog tu grub pa'i gsangardesngags 'di khyod kyis khyer cig khyer cig ces brjod/sngags dbang 'di spyi rgyud las28

skabs 'dir bshad pa bzhin mtha' bsten gyi tshul du bkod pa yin la/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las ni dang por cod pan gyi dbang dang / de rjes sngags dbang dang / 'jug tu chu dbang bskur bar yangabashad pas/ spyir go rim gcig tu ma nges pa dang / sgos su spyi 'gro'i cho ga la yang sngags dbanga'adi dbang gi dngos gzhin bsdus kyang legs pa yin la/ de lta na chu dbang gi thog mtha' gang rung du bya'o/ /de yang spyi rgyud las/ rigs sngags rgyal po klog tu gzhug ces jo gos kyisa'adi bstan pa yin la/ 'jug pa'i skabs su dkyil 'bor der ni rang sngags sam/ snying po sbyin pades kyang de mnod nas dkyil 'kho 3 gnyis par bzlas/ zhes 'byung ba/ kha cig snga ṇa sa dbang du 'dod kyang sngags dbang ston byed min/ gong du bshad pa ltar rang lha'i byin gyis rlabs dang wosabazung ba'i lha dang slob ma spros pa'i don du/ rigs kyi snying po bzla bzhin du me te go spyi bor le rdogapa'i don yin no/ /drug pa ni/ mchod pa gsar pa bshams te slob mas dkyil 'bor la phul bar mos te/slob ma'i snyim pas me tog 'thor bzhin du mchod yon dang nyer spyod kyi sngags tsam brjod/ spros pa la dga' na/ gtsang zhing gtsang ma: sogs gong gi tshigs bcad rnams brjod kyang legs so//yang skabs 'dir slob dpon la yon 'bul bar bshad kyang / deng sang lag len rka 'debs mkhan mi 'byung bas/ yon phul bar mos te nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags tsam rjes bzlos brjod do/ /bdun pa ni/ slob dpon shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po'i mdo tshar gcig ston lga/slob mas 'di skad ces brjod de/ /de ring phan chad khyed rnams kyis/ /drangs rgyasachong/ dang dge 'dun dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang ni/ ltigasaste—129—

sngags lha tsho gos ma lus la//dad pa rab tu brtan par bya//rtag par theg/pa wo po la//khyad par du ni mos par bya//dam tshig can dang mdza' bodang//bla ma la yang gus par bya//lha rnams kun la sdang mi bya//dus mtshamos/rtagatumachod pa bya//ston pa gzhan gyi gzhungs mi 'chad//rtag tu glo bur mgron mchod bya//srog chags rnams la byams pa'i sems//rab tu brtan pa nye b.rabazhag/theg chen la ni dga' rnams kyis//bsod nams dag la nan tan bskyed//bzlas brjod byed la 'bad pa yis//gsang sngags spyod la brtson par bya//gsang sngags rgyud las bstan pa yi//dam tshig rnams kyang bsrungardebar bya//dam tshig/ med pa rnams la ni//sngags dang phyag rgya mi sbrin/ no//gsang sngags rgyud ni legs bsrung zhing //de yang bdag gis rtogs/par bya//zhes spyi rgyud las 'byung ngo //dam tshig gsum bkod 'di nyid kyi rgyud las//tshigs brtsad waṃ'idod du//yang yang 'chi bar mi 'gyur zhing/zhes pa nas/sems cwa don du smo par byed/ces pa'i bar du rgyas par gsungs pa 'grub na tshes bzang mod kyang /da lta'i 'galen la spyi rgyud kyi lugs bzhin byar rung phyin 'byer bde ba dang /thams cad du spyi khya0tu 'jugapa'i cho ga shes pa'i dgos pa yod pa'i phyir dkyus su bshad pa nyid bya'o//brgyad pa ni/spyi rgyud las/de ltar dam tshig bsgos nas ni//nyid kyi phyag rgya༈blo/bstan pa//nyid kyi rigs kyi rig pa'ang spyin/zhes gsungs pa'i dbang du bya na/thal mo khong stong bstaskote/'di ni gtsug tor phyag rgya ste/dam drig gsum bkod nyid kyi phyag rgya yin/gshegs rigs spyi'i dam rgya bstan/dzi na dzika zhes pa 'di de bzhin gshegs rigs thams cad kyi snying po yin/de nas yi ge brgya pa dang /yi ge lnga pa bton te/'di ni bcom ldan 'das dam tshig/30

gsung bkod kyi sngags te/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi ye shes las byung ba yin no/ /zhes sngags dang phyagagyobastan/ deng phyin chad khyed slob dpon du gyur ba yin na/ dkyil ge r+sha dzibadang / dbang bskur ba dang / slob ma bsdu ba dang / rab tu gnas pa dang/ chosaston pa la sogs pa ni slob dpon gyi las yin no/ /spyo brjod/ ga mi bosajiltar: sogs dang gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang / deng nas brtsams te sogs spyodang mas par bya/ drug pa rjes kyi cho ga la/ mchod sbyin bya ba/ rjes bsdu ba'i tshul nyes pa zhi zhing bskang ma cho ga ste gsum las/ dang po ni/ slar yang slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la mchod yon rgyas par 'bul zhing lha re re bzhin me tog la sogs pa mchod pa'i khyad par thams cad 'bul/ dkyila'akhor khang pa'i nang du spyin sreg dang / phyi rol tu gtor ma rgya cher sbyin no/ /gong du dbang bskur ba'i rjes 'brang gi skabs su sbyin sreg ma grub kyang sla/ skabs 'deranges par 'grub par bya/ spyir bya ba'i rgyud ni/ phyi'i bya ba gtso bor ston pa nyid kyi phyir/ mchod pagator ma sbyin sreg sogs kyang bshad tshod bzhin skabs de dang der nges par bya zhing / de dag kyangating nge 'dzin tsam la snyad ma btags par rdzas dang cho ga lus ngag gi bya bar thon pa yang yang byed pa gal che ste/ kri ya'i rgyud nyid kyi rang lugs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa rjes bsdu ba'i tshul ni/yang mchod yon dang mchod pa'i sngags kyis mchod pa bsdus pa zhig phul la/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje/mdzad pa'i 'a 'pha/na las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ bdag dnganam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la rang rang gi skal ba —131—

dang 'tshams pa'i 'phrin las rnam pa gsum dang dngos grub rnam pa gsum dang byang chub rnam pa gsum gyi bka' drin stsal nas/ mthar thug thams cad kyangarnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'jog par mdzad du gsol/gnas skabs su 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang ngan 'gro'i 'gro ba dang / sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun chad pa dang / sdig pa'i las dang nyon mongasapa thams cad rab tu zhi ba dang / 'dod pa'am/ bsam gtan gyi bde ba kha na ma tho ba med pas phyogs kun tu khyab cing rgyas pa dang / rnam dkar dgob chos kyi dga' ston bla na med pa thob par mdzad du gsol/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang / nad dang 'khrugs pa dang mu ge la sogs pa 'jigs pa dang nyams nga ba thams cad zhi nas/ 'gro ba thams cad bde zhingaskyid pa dang / bdag cag dkyil 'khor chen po 'di la yongs su brten parabagyid pa rnams mkhan po dang / slob dpon dang / pha ma dang / grogs dang /'khor dang / yon bdag dang bcas pa rnams la tshe dang 'byor pa dang dbangaphyug phun sum tshogs pa dang / las kya rgyud rab 'byams 'grub pa dang/ rangarang gi skal ba dang 'tshams par 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub gyi tshogs thams cad stsal du gsol/ brtse bas bzung du gsol/byin gyis rlabs du gsol bdag cag rnams kyi don gyi mchog thams cad 'grub par gyur cig /ces lan gsum gsol ba btab/ ma 'byordo ra pa dang : sogs/lhag pa dang ni/ sogs/ bzod gsol gyi tshigs bcad spyi 'gro rnams bya/ spyan len pe khro phyagargya las mthe bong phyir bskyed/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can: sogs dang / gdon mi za bar—132—

bdag la yang je zhes pa nas/ ma tang ni grwahwa'i bar bsnyen pa'i skabs kyi slar gtong bdanga'adra'o/ /de nas spyi dang mtshungs par lha mtshan yod na dang por bsdu/ gdan tsam yin na log༅subasdu mi dgos so/ /rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ ā kā ro'i sngags las/ nu ta pa nan twa ta ta ces bzla bzhin pas/ rdul tsho ni dman ma rnams phyags/ bum chu'am dri bzang gi chus thigs rnams kyangabasub/ rdul tshon rgya mtsho chen po la 'bab pa'i chu bor dor ro/ /bya rgyud rang lugs la de tsam kho nas chog kyang klu brgyad cho ga sogs ji ltar 'os pa g.yin nas kha 'gengs sbyar na'ang 'gal ba cher med par sems/ yul phyogs bkra shis pa sogs kyi dgos pa yod na/ cho ga'i yan lag phra mo 'dres kyang cho ga 'khrugs bar mi 'gyur ro snyam mo/ /de nas smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par brjod do/ /gsum pa nyes pa zhi zhing spong ba'i cho gni/de'i phyi de'i nyin par lhag chad 'khrul pa zhi ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhin zhi ba'i sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /'di yang legs pa'i yan lag yin gyi/ ma 'grub kyang cho ga nyams parami'agyur ro/ /de ltar na 'di ni dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal po'i rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i cho ga'i skabs kyi lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la gsang ba spyi rgyud las 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba dang / dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rnams kyis legs par kha bskang ste brjod pa yin lka choga'adi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi dkyil chog yin mod/ pad+ma'i rigs dang rdo rje'i rigs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga spyi 'gro'i lugs kyang 'di kho nas bde blag tu rtogs par 'gyur te/ rigasaganyis po de dang de'i rigs pa'i rgyal po dang / rigs kyi snying po dang / las thams cad pa dbāspyi'i dam tshig gi sngags rgya sogs so so'i mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad cung zad yod pa rnams 'don pa spos shing / lha dang sngags dang dkyil 'khor gyi bkod pa rang rang gi lugs dang sbyar bas cho ga gzhan rnams 'di kho nas 'grub bo/ /de yang dper mchon na 'di lta bu ste/ 'dir rigs kyi snye133—

snying po dzi na dzika gi dod du pad rigs la a ro li ka rdo rje'i rigs la badz+ra sbyi ka /de bzhi du lag gdub la pad+mas rigs la pad+ma'i sa bon dang / rdo rje la ru drwa k+ṣa/ spyan 'dren so gosala'adir sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sngags yod sar pad regs la phyag 'tshal sngon du song nas/ ma ༄ 6 bab dang ni thos pa dang / /reg pa dang ni dran pa'ang rung / /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /nad rnams kun kyi gsos grur cig /tar+ya thā/ kas bi kaṭi ni ka ṭi ka ṭaX/ ka ṭi bha ga ba te bi dza ye swāhā/ zhes gos dkar modag rdo rjo khro rigasalkaglu rdzo ku lan/ sogs mā ma ka'i sngags so/ mā ma gī rigs kun la 'jug pa yang bshad do/ /las thams cad pa yang pad rigs la/ na mo mahā shri ya yi/ skye( sha ma ye sam ye sku/mesirnyi sirnyi spyo dha ya/ shi be shi baṅka ri a ba ha sarba a the sma dha ni sru sma zhes dgardorje'i rigs la bdud rtsi thabs sbyor nyid de 'on kyang thabs spyor ni rigs gsum ka la 'jug go/steng phyogs bcings pa yang pad rigs la/ oṃ pad+ma ni bha ga ba te/ mo ha ni dza ge smo ha ya swāhā/ zhes dang / rdo rje'i rigs la su sirnyi ka ra ring ba ste/ de ni rigs gsum char la yang ngo //bsangs byed dang byin rlabs sogs la dgos pa rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo'i sngags ni/ pad rigs la/ oX a mṛ ta bha bo ta ba huX phaṭa ces rta mgrin yi ge bsto pa dang / rdo ro regs la hāX mdzad kyi sngags hūX bzhi pa'o/ /bzlas brjod kyi thog mar dgos pa'i byin rlabs skul ba'i spyi sngagasarigs pa'i rgyal po'i sngags kyang zer/ rigs kyi bdag po'i sngags zhes kyang bya ba/ bgrang 'phreng byed pa'i sngags la/ 'dir a rgyu ti sogs kyi dod la/ pad rigs lan mo rat+na tra yā yangusogs phyag 'tshal gyi rjes su/ oX a mṛ ta ga mo shri ye shri ya ni srug zhes ga rdo rje'i rigs la phyag 'tshal sngon du songs nas/ oṃ ki ri ki ri ro tri te swāhā/ zhes pa dbasngaragyinor bu 'phreng ba byin rlabs kyi sngags ni/ pad rigs la/ tso'o ba su ma ti shri ye swāhā zhes —134—

dang / rdo rje rigs la/ tsho( badz+ra a dzi taX dza ya swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ gzhan yang bza' min zos pa dag byed sogs rnams grangs mi 'dra ba mang du yod do/ /yang don zhags chen mo dang bstogacigazhal sogs sgos kyi khyad chos mang po can tha na mchod pa'i sngags sogs kyang rgyud so sor mi 'dra ba mang po yod pa rnams la de dang de nges par dgos pa ma yin nam snyam na/ spyir rang rang gi cho gdamigs bsal yod pa rnams la de dang de byas nas mi gsal ba rnams spyi rgyud nas kha skong ba ni yin no/ /de lta mod kyi rgyud so so phan tshun gnyis kar na tha dad par gsal ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos rnams rang rang lugs su mi byed par sgos rgyud gzhan gyis kha skong ba ni shin tu legs pa rang min yang spyir na spyi rgyud ma yin pa rnams nas kyang phan tshun kha 'gengs dgos pa'i rigs ni yod la/ nges par na rang rang so so'i lugs kyi dmigs bsal yod kyang de ma 'grub na sgos rgyud ma yin par spyi rgyud kyi cho ga'i lugs su sgrub ba ni nges par rung ba yin te/ de nas gzhan yang gsang ba'i rgyud/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni thams cad kyi/ /spyi yi cho ga rgyas pa dag /mdor bsdusngarab tu bshad par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /des na byin rlabs dang rgyun yod pa ge zhor bzhag la/ tshe 'dir dngos grub thob pa don du gnyer ba yin na/ so so'i thun mong ma yin pa rnams rno khyad che ba yin no/ /de dang de bya rgyud spyi la mi 'jug pas de shes kyang bya rgyud spyi la 'jug pa'i cho ge'i bzhugs tshul bde blag tu go ba dka' la/ spyi rgyud kyi cho ga shes na/ spyi la 'jug pa'i chogashes par ma zad/ thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyang / mthong ba tsam gyis go sla bar 'gyur bas rgyud don la go ba 'tshol na spyi rgyud kyi cho ga shes pa kho na gal che'o/ /de lta na yang dam tshog gsum bkod kyi rgyud la le'u bcu gnyis pa kho na nas dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang / dbang chog gsungs pa'i phyir/ de'i lugs bzhin mi byed pa ci zhe na/ cho ga'i rim pa ni/ de nas bshad pa rnams kyang gong du bshad zin —135—

pa 'dir tshang bas de'i lugs nyid yin la/ dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa de'i lugs bzhin mi byed pe'i rgyu mtshan ni/ snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di la dbang rgyun ma chad par yod cing / rgyas pa de la lo gco nas brgyud pa'i dbang rgyun med pa'i phyir dang / rgyud 'di la 'grel pa dang dkyil 'khor rgyas pe'i sgrub thabs ma 'gyur bas dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i lha rnams kyi mtshan nyid yid ches can rnyed dka' bas byas kyang rang bzor 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi rgyud thamasacad kyi rtsa bar gyur pa/ dam tshig gsum bkod kyi snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di'i dbang bskur bathob pas/ bya rgyud rigs drug po thams cad 'chad pa dang sgom pa la dbang ba yin te/ spyi rgyud las de bzhin gshe/gas rigs kyi dkyil 'bor du/ gang zhig legs par dbang bskur ba/ /de ni rigs rnams gsum char gyi/ /dkyil 'kho ra la sogs slob dpon 'gyur/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur ba/ /de ni rigs gnyis dkyil 'khor gli /slob dpon du ni dbang bskur gyur/ /phyag na rdo rje gzi chen kyi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur ga /de ni rdo rje rigs gcig gi /dkyil 'khor du ni slob dpon 'gyur/ /ma mo gnod sbyin gsang sngags sri /dkyil 'khor gang dag ci bzhed pa/ /de dag thams cad kun gyis kyang / /dogs pa med par bri bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas so/ /yang rgyud las 'di skad du/ lha'i rigs rnams mthong ba ga /dbang bskur ba ni rnam pa bzhi/ /bla ma mnyam par bzhag pa yis/ /de dag shes nas ci rigs pa/ /slob dpon go 'phang thob bya'i phyir/ /dang po yongs su sgrags pa yin/ /rigs / sngags rnams ni sgrub pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa legs par bshad pa yin/ /bgegs rnams rab tu gzhom pa'i phyir/ /gsum pa rab tu bsgrags pa yin/ /bzhi pa 'byer ra pa thob pa'i phyir/ /cho ga rgyas pa de bshad do/ /zhes slob dpon gyi dbang dang / sngags sgrub pa'i dbang dang / bgegs gzhom pa'i dbang dga'abyor pa thob pa'i dbang ste bzhi'o/ /de dag las gong du zhib mor bstan zin pa ni slob dpon gyi—136—

dbang yin zhing / sngags sgrub pa'i dbang ni slob ma'i dbang gi ming yin la/ 'di la khyad par ni/rnam rgyal bum pa la me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i sngags bzlas te chu dbang bskur/ chu dbang ni 'de gcig pus kyang chog la/ las bzhi so so'i 'dod pa yod na/ de dang de'i bum pa'i dbang yangabaskur/ rgyas pa la mos na khrus bum dang las bum gyi dbang bskur kyang lhag pa'i skyon med do/ /sbyin sreg gi skabs kyang me tog gang la phog pa'i sngags kho nas 'bul/ sngags dang rgyud rnamasa'adzin gyur pa'i/ zhes tshig snga phyi gnyis dang / da ni dkyil 'khor sogs gsol btab dang bka' bsgo'i skor rnams mi dgos/ rgyas par bstan pa dang / gdams ngag 'bogs pa yang mi dgos go/dbang bskur gsum pa dang bzhi pa gnyis ni/ cha shas kyis na slob ma'i dbang yin mod kyang/ de'i mtshan nyid rdzogs par ma tshang ba'i phyir/ slob ma'i dbang zhes ming 'dogs mi bya'o/ /waṃ gnyis la skyabs 'gro ni med du mi rung / sems bskyed byed mi byed skabs dang sbyar/ bdag 'bul ba mi dgos shing / chu dbang gi las bum dang khrus bum gyis bskur/ bkyu byab srung gsum tshang bar bya/cod pan gyi dbang mi bskur/ spyin sreg kyang khro bo'i rgyal po kho na la 'bul gyi g.yin la mi dgos/rjes 'brang gi cho ga g.yin bdun po rnamang kyang mi byed pa'o/ /bzhi pa yang de dang 'dra ba las khrus bum kho nas dbang bskur zhing / tshig lhag por 3|na tubade ba dang legs pa dang / bkra shis pa dang rgyal bar gyur cig /rgyal b.ragyur cig /ces pa'i tshig gis dbang bskur zhing / bkru byab srung gsum mi dgos pas/ chu dbang gi mjug kho nar bkra shos rdzas brgyad nges par ster dgos la/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang/bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs nges par dgos pa ma yin kyang spros pa la dga' na ji ltar rigs pa sbyin te/ shis brjod rgyas par byed pa'o/ /de yang gong slob dpon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar bkushis rdzas brgyad re re la/ bhū dang/ dzi na dzika bzlas/ slob ma'i mdun du bstar nas/ bka' las —137—

byung bas tshig gi shis brjod cig byas pa kho nas don thams cad 'grub pa yin la/ spros pa la mos na kun la grags pa'i tshigs bcad rnams byas pas kyang legs shing / skyon du ni mi 'gyur b.lona'o/ /de ltar blo la bldan nas rgyas par ni/ spyi rgyud nyid las rtogs par bya'o/ /da ni sbyin sreg gi cho ga cung zad bshad par bya'o/ /de yang lugs 'di la rgyas pa shar dang zhi ba byang du phyogs par gsungs pa/ skabs 'dir dkyil 'bor dang / 'brel bas zhi ba'i thab khungadakyil 'khor gyi byang du thab kyi lha rnams zhal dkyil 'khor phyogs la ston/ sbyin sreg byed pa po thab khung dang dkyil 'khor gyi bar du 'dug ste/ dkyil 'khor la rgyab bstan zhing thab la mthon du phyogs pas bya/ rgyas pa'i thab khung shar du bca' ba la yang des rigs 'gre/ yang spyi dang mthun par shar du zhi ba dang / byang du rgyas pa byas kyang 'gal ba med/ rkos thab dang bris thab kyi tshur spyi dang 'dra la/ yang rgyud las/ las sgrub tsam gyi dngos bstan la mu ran tsam ma gtogs/ kha khyeragasal bar ma gsungs kyang mchu dang kha khyer gnyis kar yod pa legs/ lar rjes mthun gzhan las kha skongs dgos pa rnams sgras zin 'ba' zhig gi rjes su 'brang na dgos don stor pa mang du yong nyen yod pas/ rgyud rkyang la dpe sgrogs tsam gyi nga rgyal mi rung ngo / /des na kha khyer la pu sge 'dab ma brgyad dam bcu drug /grwa bzhir rdo rje bzhi/ de dag kyang rdul tshon dkar po la bcad dmaraser sngo ljang gang gis btab kyang rung mod zhi rgyas la nag po'i re kha mi bya'o/ /der bud shing rtsig pa sogs spyi dang 'dra/ ku sha mtshon byed rtsa'i gdan la g.yas su me lha dang dkyil 'khor lha'i sregardzas te sreg rdzas tshar gnyis bsangs chu'am/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe/ las bus de so/sam bum chu dung phor sogs su blugs pas kyang rung ste de rnams bshams/ g.yon du rigs sngagasakyi gzi byin bskyed pa'i dri chab gcig dang / mchod yon gnyis dang / nyer spyod tshar gnyis rnamasapo zhams/ bsregs blugs byed pa po'i mdun du me yol rtsigs pa'i nang du bgang blugs dag de —138—

dang nye ba len stabs bde ba'i phyogs gang yang 'os par mar khu yam shing ku sha la sogs pa bzhag go /de la sreg rdzas ni/ zhi ba la/ sbrang rtsi 'o ma mar 'o thug nas 'bras til dang dur pa lom dngabacas pa la sogs pa'o/ /rgyas pa la yang 'o ma dang 'o thug dang zho dang lag pan dang nas chan dang til dkar nag dang sgron shing gi dum bu dang na ga puṅge dang / shu ti dang / nye shing dang / bil ba dang /gro dang / sran ma la sogs pa'o/ /de lta na yang zhi rgyas gnyis po 'di sreg rdzas gcig gis gzug shos kha bskang pas chog cing / shu ti nye shing na ga puṅge gsum da lta bod du grags pa 'di rnamasamayin pas/ de rnams rnyed dka' yang mar dang yam shing 'dzom phyin/ rdzas gzhan rnams gang rnyed kyis chog pa yin no/ /dkyil 'khor dang 'brel na/ chu dang cod pan gyi dbang tsam rang nyid kyisablangs nas sbyin sreg la 'jug ma 'brel na mi dgos/ zhi ba la pad+ma'i skyil krung dang / rgyas palabakra shis kyi skyil krung ste bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis 'bod/ bsangs chu'am las bum gyi chu ladamigs te/ na mo rat+na: nas/ a rlu te hūX phaṭa kyi bar bdud rtsi thabs sbyor zha twanabarjod/ bsangs chu gsar du sgrub dgos na/ /bsnyen pa'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin bya/ gzi byin bskyed pa'i dri chab la dmigs te/ na mo lo ka khyu tā ya/ oX shang ka she shan ti ka re/sdus tsho stu ni ni ghā ta ya tsho ni swāhā/ oṃ ku lan+ta ri ban+ta ban+ta hūX phaṭa/ sgyu/maki'i rigs sngags dang snying po gnyis nyer gcig sogs mang du bzlas la/ dz+wa la dz+wa lwa yo phaṭa/sirnyi sma dha ya phaṭa/ di pe di pā ya phaṭa/ ces pa rnams kyang ci rigs par bzlas de ltabu'i dri chab kyi mchod rdzas sreg rdzas thams cad la bsangs gtor byas te/ 'dud rtsi thabs sbyoradang sngags bshad ma thag pa de rnams lan gcig gi mthar/ skye( gzi brjid ldan pas tardzasanang du/ /phyi bsgo ltel ma mdzad bzhugs nas su/ /kun gyi gzi brdzid spelabadang / /byin rlabs can du mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra huX dha/ zhes ga dzin dzika—139—

mang du brjod/ rgyud las/ zlos bu dang ni ma 'dres dang / /bsnor ba yis kyang rtsi lo snyed pa/ /mkhasapas rdzas kyis byin gyis rlobs/ zhes sngags dang tshigs bcad de rnams mgo thon rkang thon gyi tshul gyis lan mang du brjod par gsungs na yang da lta tshar gsum mam gcig tsam byed/ 'di sreg rdzas mchod rdzas byin rlabs yin/ byin rlabs kyi cho ga 'di sbyin sreg tu ma zad sgrub pa'i skabs kyi mchod rdzas kun la'ang dgos la bsnyen pa'i skabs kyi mchod pa gzi byin bskyed pa la'ang 'di dag byas na legs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas thab kyi shar lho'am/ byang dang shar gang rung du me tshang bcas palka.a mṛ te dang dzi na dzika bzla bzhin du me sbar/ mar khu blugs gzar gyis cung zad gcus te blugs la/ gdangs ring pos swāhā dang / hā yig ring po lan mang du brjod cing bsgyings padangabacas par bya'o/ /tseX( dang /zlaX mang du brjod/ rlung yab kyis g.yabs/ ku sha la sogs pa'i rtsasngon po'i bam po phyogs mtshams brgyad du spyi dang mthun par bkram/ oX tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /lha yi drang srong bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oX a sna ye ha bya ka bya ba ha na ya snyusmame lha'i sngags thung ba dang / lag gnyis khu tshur las gung mo sgreng ba'i tshig gsum par mdzub mo'i rtse mo sbyar/ g.yas snying gar phyir bstan/ g.yon dkur bldan /mthe bong nang du g.yab pe'i spyan drangs/ bsangs chus gtor te las thams cad pa bzlas/ sngags de nyid kyis sreg blugs lan gsum phul/ thabs kyi dbus su drang srong chen po me lha sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas gnyis kyi mchog sbyin dang bgrang 'phreng / g.yon gnyis kyis dbyig pa dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis gnas pa/ 'khor drang srong gi tshogs thams cad kyi bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ 8( badz+ra ke li gī la badz+ra bhi ma ro tri sogs kyis bgegs bsangs/de nas gong gi sngags dang phyag brgya las mthe bong mdzub mo'i glor bzhag pas dam la ba theg go/skyertso—140—

dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ra gyi cho ga bya ba'i rgyud mtha' dag la 'jug pa bzhugs/asna ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ā di bya ā di bya ya swāhā/ zhes me lha'i sngags ring bas mar dang yam shing dang / sngags de nyid dam 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i/ o tiṣ+ṭha ha ri sogs kyisadakar gsum dang 'bru sna la sogs pa me lnga nyid kyi sreg rdzas rnams rim gyis 'bul/ yang gongabazhin/ tse( 65sna ye sogs sngags thung bas bgang blugs lan gsum la sogs pa ji ltar 'osapa 'bul/ skabs de dag tu mi bkra ngan pa dag byung na bdud rtsi thabs spyor gyi sngags kyis bas bcu gtor bas bzlog par 'gyur la/ /da dung ma bzlog na/ bdud rtsi thabs sbyor 'am/ lhobs po che gang rung spyan drangs la/ so so'i rang sngags kyi bgang blugs phul bas byur dang bgegs rnamasazhibar 'gyur ro/ /me bkra ngan pa ma byung na de 'dra mi dgos so/ /de rjes/ bdag gi spyin sreg gi las 'di bgegs med cing 'bras bu'i mchos/ dang ldan par mdzad du garbertsol/ zhes me lha la gsol ba lan gsum btab/ de nas skabs 'di nyid du 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ba'i me lha la mchod yon nyer spyod gtor ma bgang blugs bstod pa rnams grub nas gshegs gsol byas na bya rgyud rang lugs yin pas cho ga'i rim pa 'di ltar bzang la/ yang skabs 'dir me lha thab kyi zur nang ci bde bar bzhugs/ bar 'der dkyil 'khor pa mchod/ slar yang me lha'i rjes cho ga byed pa sogs spyi 'gros kyi rigs pa bkabakyang 'gal ba med do/ /de lha na yang rgyud sde gong 'og gi sbyin sreg thams cad la dkyil 'khor pamachod pa'i tshe/ me lha gug par sdod pa ma yin te/ me nyid dang me lha gnyis su med pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor pa mchod pa'i tshe de yang mchod pa yin no/ kha cig 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ /de tshe tshe yi snying gar sngags/ /bdun bzlas pa yis rtag par ni/ /me spyan drangs pa rig pa'i bdag /me tog dri ni zhim rnams kyis/ /gnas 'bul ba ni spyan drangs nas/ /rtag tu'o sngags shes mkhas pas sgo /tshes gsungs pa'i don du bsam nas/ me'i lha'i thugs kar dkyil 'khor ba spyan drangs te bzhugs —141—

par 'dod pa ni/rang gi de nyid ston par byed pa ste/me spyan drangs ngo zhes pa yan chad hra so/ngamelha spyan 'dren dang /rig pa'i bdag ces pa man chad dkyil 'khor pa spyan 'dren gyi tshig yin payogo bar snang bdang /me spyan drangs ngo zhes pas dkyil 'khor ba spyan drangs bar go ba ni/thin tu blun po'i rnam 'gyur yin pas phyir dang /me'i snying gar sngags lan bdun bzla zhes pa ni/medapung gi dbus su sems gtad nas me lha rang gi sngags lan bdun bzlas te sbyan drangs zhes pa'i don yin pa la/me lha'i snying gar dkyil 'khor ba spyan 'dren/zhes par go 'dug gde ltar nasngags lan bdun gang yin ngos 'dzin rgyu med pa dang /me spyan drangs zhes pa dkyil la bor pa yin na/spyan drangs nas rtag shu'o zhes pa ni nges par yang dkyil 'bor pa las 'os med pas dkyila'akhor ba lan gnyis spyan 'dren dgos par thal bar 'gyur ro//de na 'bar ba'i me'i nang du gnas sam gdan bkod pa la dkyil 'khor ra ba rnams spyan 'dren pa yin no//de yang 'di ltar bya ste/na maXsarba ta thā ga tā nāX/sarba thu ud gta snyar ṇa yi(maX ga ga na khaX swāhā/lan gsum gyi lha'i gdan grub par gyur/denas : ༷ dang dzi na dzika ga kyin brjod pa nas 0mas/yongs su bskor te bzhugs par gyur/zhes ye bar bsnyen pa'i skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra ba las/ye shes dkyil 'khore lha tshogs thams cad rang rang so so'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur pa ni/zhes sbrel/'di dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshad dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs pa yin pas/dkyil 'khor gyi drung nas me tog gi snod blangs te/'bru tshom zhig thab nang du 'dor ba sogs bod rnying pa'i lag len bzhin byas kyang pungazhing /dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i tshe 'dir dam bldan mi dgos te sngar grub pa nyid kyis so//dkyil 'khor med na shang ka re nas/ban+ta grwa rta'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin dam bzhag bya/bde bar gshe/gas so bcom ldan 'das/༷/a mṛ ta swāhā/gtsang zhing gtsang gru

nas/ mnyam nyid mi g.ye6 mas bstod pa'i bar mchod bstod kyang bsnyen pa'i skab༅pe lo no/ /de nas dzi na dzika dang / yi ge lnga pa dang / yi ge brgya pa rnams ja sgo bzhin du bgang blugs lan gsum la sogs pa phul/ de nas brtsams te yi ge lnga pa'am/ mu ni'i sngags sam/ yig brgyaste gsum po gang rung gcig kho nas/ yam shing la sogs pa'i sreg rdzas gzhan rnams 'bul lgabagang blugs kyang brgya rtsa sogs ji ltar 'os pa 'bul dgos kyang grangs gcig tu nges pa med do//yang nges par dgos pa ni min yang 'khor rnams la mtshan sngags kyi sgo nas bgang blugs re tsam phul kyang legs la/ sreg rdzas gzhan rnams ni sgos su 'bul mi dgos so/ /spyir ni gtso bo dang / rang sngags kho na la phul bas lha g.yin thams cad kyang chim para'agyur ba'i phyir/ 'khor la sgos kyi 'bul ba med kyang chog go /dbang bskur dngos gzhi'i skabs kyi sbyin sreg yin na/ de'i rjes su slob dpon gyi mdun du slob ma bzhag /slob dpon gyis lagapagayon pas/ de'i g.yas kyi mthe bong bzung ba'am/ de'i gos kyi mtha' nas bzung ba lta bus kyang chog /blugs gzar mar gyi bkang la yi ge brgya pa dang / na mo 'e1 ka sogs mā mas sngagasabazlas te/ slob ma'i lus la lan gcig bskor nas/ slob ma nyid kyis 'bul du 'jug pal na bdun bya/ slob ma mang po sogs la de ltar mi nus na mos pa brtan pos dmigs pa sgom du 'gra/ nas slob dpon gyis phul bas chog la/ yang na las kyi rdo rjes bgang blugs bskor kyang rung banyid do/ /de nas slob ma la thabs sbyor bzlas pa'i dpung skud bcings/ las sngags kyis snying garabasangs gtor bya/ slar yang slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor la bgang blugs lan gsum 'bul lo//spyin sreg logs su byed pa yin na/ ar+gha pra titsā swāhā nas/ ma tang gi snyu he'i bar slarabatang ba'i cho ga bsnyen pa'i skabs dang 'dra la/ dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i skabs ni/ ar+gha nas/ nai be t+ya swāhā/ dkyil 'khor la me tog dor shing / sngar gyi me tog go snod dkyil snyen ragyi—143—

drung du bskyal/ me tog cung zad tsam dkyil 'khor la gtor/ me nang du bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis lha chogs rnams slar phyir la gshegs te/ dkyil 'khorachen po'i gnas garang rang gi gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ zhes 'di/de nasasreg rdzas kyi lhag ma rnams sreg bzhin du/ oṃ la ha ri piṅka la lo hi ta ak+ṣa de hi da dā pa ya hu phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba ra na sha ya snya hā/ zhes pas 'bul zhig mchod yon dnganyer spyod rnams kyang sngags de nyid kho nas 'bul ba'am/ swahwas gong du ar+gha nas/ ā lo ke'i bar du sbyar ba dang / gtor ma yod na ba li sbyar ba rnams kyis kyang phul/ slar yang sngags ringabs bgang blugs bdun phul/ tshangs dbang 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ zhes sogs bstod pa ji ltar 'os pas bstod te/ spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya las mthe bong phyir bskyed/ o.asnaye sogs sngags thung ba'i mthar/ ga smo ga smo zhes brjod pas gshegs su gsog bzhud cigaces ni bdag po'i bka'/ /bzlos pas rab tu bsgrags nas bzhud/ spyan yang drangs ma thag tu ni/gsang sngags dgyes nas 'byon par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa la/ 'byon par mdzod cig cesabasgyur nas/ gshegs gsol gyi tshig byed pa'ang yod de 'gal ba med par 'dra'o/ /de rjes smon lam dang shis pa brjod do/ /las rjes mi mngon par byed tshul spyi dang 'dra/ 'di ni zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ste 'di tsam gyis kyang bya/ rgyud rang lugs kyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga ji ltar yin pa go bar nus so/ /da ni gtor ma'i cho ga bshad par bya'o/ /bya rgyud rang lugs la 'jig rten 'das pe'i dkyil 'bor pa la gtor ma ma bshad ces grags pa dang / der ma zad kri yo ga sde gsum char du yang ma bshad do zhes grags la/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma ni rnam grangs du ma zhig gsungs pa yin no/ /de lta na yang spyi rgyud dpung bzangs kyi dngos bstan las/ 'byung po spyi dang phyogs skyong nigator ma gnyis gsungs te/ go rim yang de ltar gdon la mchod pa byas nas su/ de nas—144—

phyogs skyo ngo rnams la mchob pa bya/ zhes gsungs shing / da lta gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba lwa/ zhes sogs ni/ gnyis po de'i mjug sdom phan yon ston pa yin kyang / zur gyis bgegasagator yang 'phangs par mngon la/ rgyud mang por bgegs la gtor ma spyin pa yang gsungs pas/spyir bgegs gtor dgos la/ gzungs grwa lnga las rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma'ang gsungs pa ltarade yang 'grub na legs/ khyad par du yang dkyil 'khor gyi sgo srungs la bkod yod na nges par bya/spyir gtor ma cha gsum po de grub na/ rgyal chen gyi gtor ma ma grub kyang cho ga chad par mi 'gyuraro/ /de rnams chabs gcig tu bshom na rgyal chen dang phyogs skyong gral 'go ma'i stegs bu mtho bal bzhag /'byung po spyi'i de bar ma dang / bgegs gtor sa phyogs dma' ba'am/ dkyil 'khoradang 'brel na dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi'i sgo drung du bzhag go /phyi rol gtor ma'i tshul du byed na/dkyil 'khor khang pa'i lto nub phyogs thag bsrengs nas/ stegs mtho ba la 'byung po spyi gtor dang/dma' ba'i phyogs sam/ sa rjen la bgegs gtor bshams te gtor/ byang shar du thag nye bar stegs bu mtho ba la phyogs skyong gi gtor ma 'jog cing / rgyal chen gyi gtor ma'ang phyogs ge torami byed na de nyid nas gtong ba'am/ las dang rjes su mthun pa'i phyogs nas gtor/ phyogs gtor byed na phyogs bzhi so so nas bshams te gtod/ phyogs skyong bcu la phyogs gtor byed na/ gzhan rnams rang rang gi phyogs dang steng 'og gnyis shar nub thag ring bar skyel lo/ /so so'i dam rdzas kyi skabs su sna tshogs shog yod kyang / sgrub mchod sogs spyi gtor gyi skabs 'dir cha gsum la bgegs ga hor ma gtogs thams cad dkar gtor du bya/ dbyingasabakod pa deng sang gi lag len spyi dang mthun pas chog /gang ltar yang legs par bshamasalaganas gcig tu bshams pa rnams dus gcig tu byin gyis rlabs cha kyang rung / gnas so so na yod pa rnams 'bul ba'i gnas skabs so so de nyid du byin rlabs byed dgos so/ /de la byin—145—

rlabs kyi cho ga ni/yongs su grags pa'i sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis rlabs kyang rbab//yang bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyis bsangs/oṃ te dza sogs kyi gzi byin bskyed slar yang bdud rtsithal spyor gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis rlabs/dzi na dzika gis brtan par byas/nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas rgya cher spel lo//yang na spyan ras gzigs kyi cho ga zhib mo las 'byung ba bzhin/oX dz+wa la ba ti rat+na ghā ṭa swā ri ṇi tu ṭi tu ṭi swāhā/zhes gtor snodabyin gyis rlabs/oṃr sā ra sā gra ba ti sarba bir+ya a dhi spyi te/saX pū ra ya huX/zhes pas ro bro bar byas/oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la spa ra pra ra sa ra sa sī dh+wa ya huX/zhes rgya cher spel zhing gzi byin chud do//'di tsam kyis kyang chog ste/gtor chog gsal kha med pa'i bya rgyud kyi skabs mang po kha bskang du rung ngo //de ltar na byin rlabs gsum po gang rung cig bya/de nas bgegs gtor ni/cha gsu5gyichog spyi dang 'dra ba'i bden brdar byas te bgegs rnams gtor ma'i gnas su bkug nya gung kare sogs la spyi 'gro ltar nan ma mkha' mdzod kyi sngags kyi mthar/ga ga na khaX gro sto / daX ba liX ta ye swāhā/zhes 'don pa bsgyur bas sbyin pa'am/rgyud 'di nyid las gsungs pa'i sgos kyi gtor sngags ni/na maXsarba ta thā ga tā nāX/ba la ba ti ba snyi n+di snyam zhes pa btagasapas sbyin no//gang zhing mtshan mo rgyu ba yi/zhes sogs spyi dang mthun par bzhad sbyang byasal/gtor ma ring du gtong ba dang /thabs spyor gyi sngags kyis mtshams bcad nas snying po bzlobazhi du nang du 'ongs la nye reg bya'o//de nas 'byung po'i gtor ma ni/sngon bzhi byin gyis rlabs/oṃ lha dang lha rin gnod sbyin lto 'bye grul/go pa nas/'dir byon cig ces pa'i sa bca/don zhags kyi rgyud las/'byung po spyi spyan 'dren pa'i sngags ni/oṃ di bya lo tsa ni a mo lho pra wa re sarba bidu a dhi snga te sirnyi shudhe bi / 'u te swāhā/spyo pa spyan 'dren par na kung

pad+ma'i rigs kyi cho ga'i khyad chos yin par sems/des na skabs 'dir gong gi tshigs bcad nyid rgyud kyi sngags tshig yin pas de tsam gyis chog par mngon la/de nas/oṃ de bā ya sta twa de bzhin tu sbyar te/nā ga dang /yak+ṣa dang /ga dha rgyu dang /mi rna/ sur dang /ka sno ra dang /ga ru ṭā dang /ma ho rā ga dang /ma nu yi dang / a mnu tshi gris rnams lo godag bshad pa ltar rgyud 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i gtor sngags btags pa'am/nam mkha' mdzod kyisngags btags pas gtor ma 'bul/de nas mchod pa dang tor ma thams cad lhan cig tu 'bulab ni/oṃ 'byung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang /nas/ra btu dgyes shingamagu bar gyur nas su//'phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug pa dang //bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul ba//'di dag bzhes nas btung zhing bsnamasardenas su//las 'di rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis/ par mdzod swāhā/lan gsusagyimathar ma rdzo gtor rnams ring du gtor/chos rnams gang dag sogs kyis chos bco/sarba dhū /ta ru ca/zhes se gol gtogs ter de/gas su gsol lo//da nas phyogs skyong gi gtor ma sbyin par bya ste/'di ni 'jig rten pa'i gtor chog tha pasocad kyi gtso bo yin par shes par bya'o//de la thog mar phyag rgya rnams go bar bya ste/'gagasamathe chung bkug pa mthe bos mnan/sor mo dbus ma gsum brkyang ba/g.yon snying gan bzhagagayas dku la bsten pa ni/dbang po'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya ste/de lang/ mdzub mo gnyis g.yabapani spyan drangs pa dang /mdzub mo gnyis phyir bskyed pa ni/slar btang ba'i phyag tsug/de bzhin du gzhan rnams kyang shes par bya ste/me lha'i phyag rgya ni sgyin sreg gi skabs su bshad pa rgan no//rdo rje nang bsdams las srin lag gnyis phyir brkyang ba ni/gshin rje'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya ste de nyid g.yab cing drag tu bkug pa ni spyan 'dren pa ngang 4 7 /dam rgya las mthe bong phyir bskyed pa ni/

gshegs su gsol ba'o//rdo rje khu tshur las gung mdzub phyir brkyang brogazhi bas pa g.yas snying gdang /g.yon dkur bzhag pa ni srin po'i dam rgya ste/de nyid las g.yon gyi mdzub mo g.yab pa dang /phyir bskyed pa yang spyan drangs pa dang gshegs su gsol ba'o//khur tshur gnyis kyi mthebamadzub zhag mig gi tshul du sbyar nas khu tshur snying gar 'jog pa ni chu lha'i phyag rgya ste/g.yon pale'adzu ba mo g.yab pa dang /phyir bskyed pa yang ngo //lag gnyis khu tshur 'che//gung mo bsgreng bo'i tshigs gsum par mdzub mo bkug pa'i rtse mo btsugs pa/g.yon snying ga dang g.yas dkur bstenapa ni/rlung lha'i phyag rgya yin la/de las g.yas kyi mthe bong g.yab pa dang /phyir bskyed pa yang ngo //rdo rje nang bsdams las mthe chung ga6bas te brkyang pa de srin lag brkyang zhing rtse mor sbyar ba'i nang du bcug pa ni gnod sbyin gyi phyag rgya ste/de nyid las gung mo brkyang nas g.yas pa dang /phyir bskyed pa yang ngo //rdo rje nang bsdams las gung mo gnyis brkyang ba'i rgyab tu mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse ma sbyar ba zhes bya ste/gung mo'i sen mo lamadzub mo reg pa yin la/mthe bong gnyis so so'i phyogs kyi gung mo la sbyar ba ni/dbang ldan gyi phyag rgya ste/de nyid las mdzub mo g.yab pa dang phyir bskyed pa yang ngo //mig steng du phyogs shing thal mo khong stong ni/tshangs pa'i phyag rgya ste/de las mas pa mo g.yab pa dang /phyi la drag tu brkyang pa yang ngo //skabs 'dir zla bdang nyi ma ni tshangs pa'i rjes 'brangayin pa'i phyir/phyag rgya logs pa mi dgos so//lag gnyis thal mo khong stong las mthe bong gnyisanang du bcug pa thal mo'i rtse mo mthur du bstan/ pa ni sa bdag gi phyag rgya yin te/mig thuradubastan nas mdzub mo gnyis g.yab pa dang /de nyid phyir bskyed pa yang ngo //skabs 'dir klu dang lha min yang lha'i rjes 'brang yin pas phyag rgya la sogs pa mi dgos so//phyogs gtor du byed na gtor ma bcu bya la/gzhan ni ji ltar bde ba stobasdu na gcig gis kyang chog go/gtor ma byinarlabs sgos su dgos mi dgos skabs dang sbyar/mchod pa byin rlabs kyang dkyus bzhi sgan mo48

badz+ra a phya shi badz+ra phu ṇi rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/tshe bye haX/dbang po dag tshe asne ka'i la/ā ka si la dz+wa la dz+wa la/da ha da ha shi ṣe to li bi ru puk+ṣa swatwa tshe rkye thi melhadang /oṃ ya ma ya swāhā/gshin rje dang /oṃ sarba bhu ta bha yaX ka ra ku ru kuru swāhāsrin po dang /oṃ tri tri su tra/tri tri shi kho to li bi ru pak+ṣa swāhā/chu lha dang /oṃ shwa sakha kha khu kha swāhā/rlung lha dang /oṃ ku be rā ya swāhā/gnod sbyin dang /oṃ rju rju shi ba swāhā/dbang ldan dang /rma snga khuX/ bra sme swāhā/tshangs pa dang /oṃ ba yig gra ha a dhi pa ta ye swāhā/nyi ma dang /oṃ tsan+t+ra na k+ṣa tra a ti pa ta ye swāhā/zla ba dang /tshe adhe pri sbyikhyoXswāhā/sa lha dang /oṃ a su re swāhā/lha ma yin dang /oṃ nā go bh+yaXgrwa twa klu rnams rta ste de dag re re bzhi yang e hre hi zhes btags pa'i sngags dang /gong du bshad pa'i spyan blug pa'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/tsho( ka ma 'a/ya swāhā/gdan phul/spro na zhal phyag gi sna5pa gsal 'debs shing ngag tu brjod/bsdu na yid kyis bsam pas chog sngar gyi sngags la e hre hi bor ba re re bzhin lan gsum gsum sngar bshad pa'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang bcas pas dam labazhan/gong du bshad pa'i so so'i sngags sam/mtshan sngags tsam gyi mthar/oṃ ar+ghaXpra zhwa tsār+shaswāhā/oṃ ga rnye swāhā/purdze/dhu pe/ne be tu a lo ke'i bar du sbyar/spyi 'gros kyi lugs ltar na/sngags re re'i mthar/nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags sbyar ba lan gsum gsum gyis/'bul/dam tshig gsum bkod nyid ltar na/sngags re re'i mthar thun mong ma yin pa'i gtor sngags sbyarate 'bul/thams cad kyi thun mong du/oṃ dbang bdag 'byung po'i bdag por bcas/pa yis//gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol//ma dang srin po gshin rje chu bdag dang //rlung dang lus༅ 'byung po'i mgon dang bcas/lteng gi nyi zla tshas pa wo po dang //lha rnams ku/ ༷nga sa'i klu rnams dang //ri'i lha dang

gnod sbyin tshogs rnams kun//so so so sor gtor ma phul ba rnas/rosatudagyes pa'i yid kyis bzhes nas kyang //rang rang phyogs su legs parabazhugs nas su//rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen mdun dang //nangamidamag dang dpung bcas thabs gcig tu//me tog dri dang byug pa gtor mabacas//'di rnams btung zhing legs par gsol nas kyang //bdag gi'ang/'di 'bras bu mchis par mdzod swāhā/shudha ka ra'i cha gsum gtor rdzo tu drangasaparnams dang dpung bzangs snga 'gyur gnyis la 'gyur khyad kho na ma yin pa'i khyad par 'phran ༵/sa snyug pa las 'a rgyud ltar bris pa'o//spyo zhagasum/dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba lha/titsā sogs kyas bstod/yang sngags so so'am mtshan sngags sdoms pa'i mthar/ar+ghaX pra—ts+tsha swāhā/de rjes spro na/chos skad byas kyang logs la bsdu na ma byas kyang cardo kha chod pa rnams mas rim gyis bsdus nas gtor ma'i mgo la blug/rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te bskyalalo//so so'i sngags gyi mthar/ru ca khyu za naX/spyo brjod cing /gong du bzhad ye gshegs gsol gyi phyag rgyas rang gi gnas su btang ngo //'di phyogs gtor du byed na/phyogasarere bzhin gtor ma byin rlabs spyan 'dren gdan 'bul bskyed chog dam la bzhag pa mchod pa gtor ma bstod pa gshegs gsol zhes rim pa de rnams kyi dbye ba so sor phral re/phyogs tha dad du 'bul lo//de las shar gyi rjes su steng dang /nub kyi rjes su 'og byed pa ni lag ler+sā//de nas rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma ni/so so'i dam rdzas rnams kyang bshams shing byin gyis rlabs/rma lha ta rwa gi ya swāhā/tshe bye hi/yul 'khor grung dang /oṃ pi ru dha kā ya zwa twa tshe bye hi/'phags skyes po dang /oṃ bi ru bāk+ta ya swāhā/tshe rkye hi/spyan ming sgrog ba tshe pi shra bayi ri nyusne rnardeṇa ya swāhā/e hre ha/rnam thos bu rnams du 0 drangs/ ka ma la ye snya hwas gdan phug

spro na bar 'dir sku'i rnam pa spyi dang mthun par bskyed pa'i tshigs rnams ngag nas brjod/ bsdunayid kyis bsam pa kho nas chog /thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba'i phyag rgya kho na bstan te/so so'i sngags rnams re re bzhin tshar gsum gsum gyis dam la bzhag /mtshan bzhi po sbrel nas 'gora.o dang / mjug tu swāhā sbyar nas/ oṃ ar+gha pra titsā swāhā dag de bzhin du sbyar nas/ oṃg rnye swāhā/ la sogs pa nyer spyod phul/ oṃ sgri ta ra ni swāhā/ zhes sogs sngags sku ni po re re'i mthar nam mkha' mdzod btags pa'am/ 'di nyid las byung ba'i ba lab ta'i gtor sngags btags pa lan gsum gsum gyi phul/ rol mo dang thos te/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa: gos sho lo ka bgyi bstod/ de nas shis par brjod de las bcol byed pa ni 'di skad ces/phyag 'tshal skyes bu dpa' 'di la/ /phyag 'tshal skyes bu mchor+sha/ tu zhe la/ /thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos rgyal khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sings rgyasarnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rkang gnyis khyed rnams bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed rnams bde legs shog /lam du zhugs rnams bde legs shog /phyira'od dag kyang bde legs shog /mtshan mo bde legs nyin bde legag /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shog /khyed cag kun tu bde legs shog /de dag sdigapar ma gyur cig /nyi ma thams cad dge ba yin/ /rgyu skar thams cad bzang po yin/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rdzu 'phrul che/ /dgra bcom thams cad zag pa med/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di rnams kyis/ /kun tu bde legs 'byung 'gyuracig /tar+ya thā/ ha ri ha ri ṇi ha ri ṇi tsa li tsa li ni tsa li ni gawaṇi bh+ra ma ṇi/ moha ṇi sti bha ni/ 'a ni swa ya bhu be swāhā/ rgyal po chen po yul snyen bsrung 'khoradang bcas pa thams cad kyi bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srung pa dang /—151—

'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub par mdzad du gsol/ lo brgya 'tsho bar gyuracig /ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig ta byi thā/ su su ru su su ru su su ru su surume swāhā/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa: nas/ mthong bar gyur cig gi bar gong bzhin/ ta du thā/ be lu gi be lu gi a mṛ ta ghā ta ni bā ruṇa ba ti so ma ba ti be ṇ+ḍa mā li ni be li ni be lu ne pu tri ke tso tsu tso tsu swāhā/ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa: sogs gong bzhi/ ta du thā/ be du ri be du ri be du ri be du ri/ mni te mni te/ ko ṭi ko ṭi/ koṭi ko shi/ byu ma ti bi byu mati/ hu hu hu hu hu hu hu hu/ ru ru ru ru ru ru ru mā tsu tsu tsu tsu tsu tsu sto tsu/ tsa tsa tsatsatsa tsa tsa tsa/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa: go ye snyengaḥn/shar phyogs na ni yul 'khor srung / /lho phyogs na ni 'phags skyes po/ zhub phyogs na ni mig mi bzang / /byang phyogs na ni rnam thos bu/ /rgyal po chen po 'di bzhi dag /'jig rten skyong ba grangs dang ldan/ phyogs bzhi dag ni skyongabar byed/ /sde bo che la stobs po che/ /pha rol dgra rnams rab tu 'jom ga /gzhan gyi mi thub thub par dka'/ /rdzu 'phrul ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ kha ldog ldan zhing grags dang ldan/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po lha min dang / /lha yig yuwa yangamyong bar byed/ /khyed rnams kyis kyang bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la srungabar mdzod cig /mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ zhes sogs spyi dang mthun para'aphrin las bcol/ sngags re re'i mthar/ ar+ghaX sbyar te mchod yon phul/ dhi ta phun ya rte/ga tsā swa za naX/ de bzhin du gzhan la'ang sbyar nas/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma phyi roladu btang ngo / /'di la'ang phyogs gtor byed na so sor phral te bya/ de ltar na de dag ni/ gong ma—152—

rnams mas rim nas gtong ba'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ /yang gtor ma'i rim pa rnams yas rim nas btang kyang / spyi 'gros kyi lag len dang mthun zhing mi legs pa ma yin pas ji ltar bde bas chog cing / de dag las ji ltar bde ba re re gnyis gnyis sogs de dang de bsgrub par bya gi /'dir brjod pa dam tshig gsum bkod dpal ldan a ti sha /dbang phyug rin chen shākya rdo rje dang/ /sangs rgyas 'bum dang mang mkhar lo tsā pa/ /gzhon nu 'od dang don ri grags chen pa/ /dza de ni brgyud pa'i khyad par dang po yin/ kha che'i mkhas pa ye shes rdo rje dang / /pu rangs lo chungs 'a kun snying dang / /rje btsun grags rgyal nub pa rig 'dzin grags/ /nam mkha' bsod nams nubagog dar gzhon pa/ /ston pa don yod slob dpon rin rgyal ba/ /grags chen bla ma zhes pa 'angabargyud pa gzhan/ /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gzhon nu tshul khrims dang / /sngags 'chang tshul rgyal nam mkha' smon lam dang / /lo grags chos kyi rgyal mtshan ngag dbang grags/ /rnam rgyal grags pa tshul khrims mchog grub dang / /rnam rgyal bkra shis mkhan po rje btsun te/ /yang na rnam zin nganadabang rnam par rgyal/ /brgyud pa'i rim pa 'di las byung ba yin/ /'di la lag len byed na bya rgyun kyi/ dkyil 'khor cho ga gang la'ang dka' ba med/ /yang smras pa/ 'di na rdo rje 'chang zhes grags pa 'gas/ /spyi rnam tsam gyi kha bshad bris med kyang / /kri ya'i cho ga phyogs mthong tsam yang min/ /sgrub thabs gcig la'ang lag len khelabamed/ /bya rgyud nub pas snying rlung langs so skad/ /mkhas chen 'ga' la ra mda' byas kyang bslus//zhes sogs yul dang ngag 'khyal rtag smra yang / /sum pa'i 'phrang gi rna ro'i dpe dang 'dra/ /chen po rnams kyang phal cher 'dres mar spyod/ /gong ma'i lugs su bkral na mi 'gal yang / /'dres ma'i lugs la gtsang mar 'dzin pa 'di/ /log shes yin phyir mkhas la mi mdzes so/ /dam cit+pagasum bkod chog khrigs rab gsal ba/ /legs sbyar dge 'dis mtha' dag 'gro ba rnams/ /rab —153—

mchog dngos grub tshogs kyi dpal 'bar bas/shwakya seṅge nyid dang mtshungs par shog/lha dngasngags dang cho ga ste/'da' bar mi bya dam tshig gsum/sngags rigs kun gyi 'jug jo gos yin//'di 'dra thob pa'ang skal ba bzang /dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bya ba'i rgyud mtha' dag la 'jug pa zhes bya ba 'di yang tā ra nā thas mi mthun pa'i phyogs dang sdig pa dang sdug bsngal ma lus pa zad pa'i lo la sbyar ba'o// //zhus/ dag/bkra shis//54

ṭa/na sal bzhu/gas/oṃ snyu sti/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khore gyi cho ga bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba ston pa shākya seṅge ni/ /gzungs kyi lha mor bcas la gus btud nas/ /srung ba lnga yi gzungs mdo'i dgongs pa mchog /lag len cho ga'i snying po 'dir bshad bya/ /de la 'di ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nang rga bya ba'i rgyud la/ rigs drug yod pa las de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs so/ /de la yang nang tshan mang du yod pa las/ rigs kyi lha mo'i rgyud sder gtogs so/ /de las stong chen rab 'joms dang / rma bya chen mo dang / so sor 'brang ma dang/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin dang / bsil ba'i tshal chen mo te/lnga po 'di la srung ba lnga'am/ gzungs grwa lngar grags la/ lnga po de dag rbangs gcig par byed pa'i khungs ni/ stong chen gyi 'jug gi cha dang / sor 'brang gi dbus kyi cha na gsal lo/ /de bas na rgyud tha dad nas bshad pa yin pas so sor yang sgrub tu rung la/ chabs gcig tu bsgom zhing sgrub pa ni ches mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /de la rnal 'byor rdzogs 'phreng las gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor khyad par can yang bzhugs mod kyi/ 'dir rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa/rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i sgrub thabs la brten zhing lo pan gyi man ngag rgyun ma chad pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyis yig rigs mang po mdzad pa la brten nas bri bar bya'o/ /de la dang por sngon 'gro gtor ma/ oṃ a mṛ te huX phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ spyo bhā wa 〈khyu sde sarba dharma swa bhā wa —155—

shurnyo3haX gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 1༷ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ las byung ba'i ge tor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ na maXsarba ta thā ga ta sbyoXbi shwa mu khe khyoX sarba thā khaX ud ga te spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad gtor ma len pa'i gnas su ā kar+ṣa ya dzaX oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇaX/a du nu tu sno twa ta oṃ āXhuX phaṭa swāhā lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pukhye āXhūX/ nas/shasta'i bar gyi mchod/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun grub shog ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ tshig lhug pas 'phrin las gzhol ba spyi dang 'dra/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma sa tsa gtsang ba'i phyogs su dor ro/ /spyir bya spyod rang rkang gi lugs la gnas khang byin rlabs mi dgos kyang / rgyud sde gong ma dang sgo bstun nas sgrub pa'i lugs 'di rigs la/ de byed pa bzang bas gnas yo byin rlabs bya ste/ a mra tas bsangs/ su bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang snaX las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rta bobs bzhis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ slar yang oṃ las byung ba'i/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag rnams/ rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung / byed las rang bzhin 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad zag med kyi bde ba chen pos tshim par byed pa/ yul dang dus —156—

yongs su chad pa med par 'jug pa/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i/ mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pu rdu/ oṃ badz+ra pukhye āXhuX/ de bzhin du/ dh+wa pe ā lo ke gen+ta ni we py-i/ oṃ badz+ra shasta āXhūX/ oṃ badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ sarba skrad pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a brta ya a brta ya hoX na maXsarba ta thā ga ta smyo bi sgo / mu khe khyuX sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags ring po gong bzhin te/ sngags tshan gsum po de lan gsum gsum brjod/ rol chen dang bcas te/ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra sma ra pra ma rta na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ a rta te sa mya ka saX bzhi ya/ ta bya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ mahā badz+re mahā te dza badz+re/ mahā bornyi tsit+ta badz+re/ mahā bo dhi man u pa saX kra ma ṇi sarba karma a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ni swāhā/skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang 'dra ba dang / 'gro rnams sgral 'dod bsam pa yis sogs sam/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ sogs rang wo zhig brjod/ oṃ āXhuX rak+ṣa rak+ṣa huX phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba'o/ /rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ praX yig dkar la ser ba'i mdangs can/ de las 'od 'phros/ srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bla ma dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaX bla ma mchog dang bcom ldan so sor 'brang ma dang / /stong chen rab 'joms de bzhin rma bya chen mo dang / /gsang sngags rjes 'dzin bsil ba'i tshal te lha mo lnga/ /'khor dang bcas la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañca rak+ṣa de ba tsakra maṇ+ḍal sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra titsā pu dza me bha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ de bzhin du/ ar+ghaṃ gyis gnas ga pā byaX/ puspro skyo pe/ā —157—

lo ke/ga rje/ni wi te/ shasta zhes pa rnams bcug la mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs rgyun bshags bya/ rdzu 'phrul tshad dang ldan pa lha mo lnga rnams la/ /lha gang mngon par rab tu dang pa yod pa yi/ /lha de mgu zhing yid ni rab tu dga' gyur te/ /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis bdag la srung du gsol/sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cigasogs oṃ med bzhi spyi dang 'dra/ oṃ shā n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa ut+pa ko3haX/ stong pa'i ngang las raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa rnams shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus dkar ba'i ste ba la huX/de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og rdo rje sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje gur dang bla re/ phyi rol rdo rje'i dra ba dang / ye shes kyi med dpung 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ de'i nang du yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po dbus su gzhe'i dbyibs kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po dbus su gru gsum gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po dbus su zlum pos mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po dbus su gru bzhis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suX las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar shel/ lho biḍar+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga /byang gser las grub pa/ lcog brgyad dang ldan pa'o/ /de'i steng du paX las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar huX las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la 1 las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta sbabs bzhis brgyan pa/ sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po dang / dra ba —158—

dang dra ba phyed pa'i sa dang bya 'dabs las thur du dpyangs pa'i shar bu'i 'phreng ba dang / steng du mda' yab dang / rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa/ sgo dang sgo 'byud kyi 'tshams la zla phyed rdo rje dang / steng thog legs par phub pa'i dbus kyi rtse mo/ /rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa'o/ /nang gi lha snam shar sngo/ lho ser nub dmar byang ljang / dbus dkar ba'i steng du pa las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du pra yig dkar la ser ba'i mdangs can/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma/ sku mdog dkar la yid tsam ser ba/ dbu la mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ rtsa zhal dkar ser/ g.yas nag /rgyab ser/ g.yon dmar ba'i zhal bzhi pa/zhal re re la zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas dang pos 'khor lo/ /gnyis pas rdo rje gsum pas mda'/ bzhi pas ral gri g.yon dang pos rdo rje'i thegs pa/ gnyis pas rtse gsum/ gsum pas gzhu/ bzhi pas dgra sta 'dzin pa/ zla ba'i gdan la zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ lo ma dang / 'dab ma dang / 'bras bu rgyas pa'i byang chub kyi shing drung na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du hu las stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma/ sku mdog dang / rtsa zhal sngon mo/ /g.yas dkar/ rgyab ser/ g.yon dmar ba'i zhal bzhi/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / zhal gdangs pa/ mche ba gtsigs —159—

pa ljags 'gril ba/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang bcas nyu pre'i mchog spyin lcags kyu mda' dang ral gri/ g.yon bzhi na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ dgra sta gzhu dang rin po che zur drug pas mtshan pa'i pad+ma rnams 'dzin pa/ drag mo'i tshul can/ stag lpags kyi shams thabs dang / sbrul dang rin po che dang rus weng gis brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang / mi mgo'i do shal can/ nyi ma la g.yas brkyang gi rol pas bzhugs shing / me dpung gi rgyab yol can/ shing n+ya gro dha'i sdong po la rgyab bsten pa'o/ /lhor ma yig las rma bya chen mo gser gyi mdog can ser nag /dmar ba'i zhal gsum/spyan gsum gsum gyis mdzes pa/ phyag g.yas bzhi na mchog spyin/ rin po che'i rgyun 'bab pa'i bum pa/ 'khor lo ral gri g.yon bzhi na lhung bzed kyi nang du gnas pa'i dge slong / rma bya'i mjug sgro/ sna tshogs rdo rjes kha rgyan pa'i bum pa/rin po che'i rgyal mtshan rnams 'dzin pa/ mya ngan med pa'i shing drung na bzhugs pa'o/ /nub tu sha las gsang sngags rjes su 'brang ma sku mdog dmar skya/dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag dang po gnyis chos 'chad/ gnyis pa gnyis mnyam bzhag /lhag ma g.yas bzhi mchog sbyin/skyabs spyin rdo rje/ mda' g.yon bzhi zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/pad+mas brgyan pa'i bum pa/ rin po che'i snye ma dang gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ shing shi ri sha'i sdong po la rgyab bsten pa'o/ /byang du ga las bsil ba tshal chen mo ljang khu/ ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ spyan gnyis gnyis dang ldan pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang / rdo rje dang mda'/ g.yon —160—

gsum (zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang / rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang / gzhu rnams shing shing tsam pa ka'i sdong po la rgyab bsten pa la/ de gsum char yang sems ma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra nag po phyed bcings phyed grol ba/ gtso mo dang mtshungs par bzla gdan dang / nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ stong chen ma gtogs pa gtso 'khor bzhi char yang rab tu zhi ba/ dar sna tshogs pa'i nam bza' dang / mu tig gi do shal la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la/ rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba/ dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan dang bcas pa re re'o/ /gtso 'khor lnga char gyi/ dpral par oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ thugs kar hū nag po thugs ka'i dbus rnams su/ pra hu ma sha ga rang rang gi sku mdog dang mthun pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ /sa bon rngams las 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa' srung ba lnga'i lha tshogs la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ o badz+ra sa mā dza o badz+ra pur+sha ā hu/ nas/nai wi te'i bar gyis mchod/ dza : ba ho yang gtso mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rigs badz+ra sa gru/ dza gong bzhin mchod/ o sarba ta thā ga ta adhi khri pos tu ma/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta adhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hū/ zhes gsungs shing / bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs/ ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis sku lus gang / chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ gtso 'khor thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbu rgyan/ de —161—

nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañca rak+ṣa sogs gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung / /rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid mchog /dung dang kun da'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /so sor 'brang ma phyag 'tshal bstod/ kha dog nag mo mi bzad 'jigs/ /rngam zhing zhal 'gyur khro gnyer can/ /gdul dka'i 'byung po yang dag 'dul/ /rdo rje khro mor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha mo ye shes las byung che/ /gser gyi 'od ltar rab 'bar ba'i/ /rma bya che la rab dad pas//rig pa'i rgyal mo phyag 'tshal bstod/ /pad+ma kha phye'i zhal mnga' ba/ /zhal mdzes ma la spyan yangs shing / /pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba'i/ /'gro ba'i mar gyur phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mthing ga nam mkha'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyis sgeg ma/ /dug rnams 'joms par byed pa mo/ /sku mdzes ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ra ṇi mahā pra ti spyo re hu hu phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ so sor 'brang ma'i 'o/ /oṃ a mṛ ta wa re wa ra pra wa ra bi shudhe hu hu phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ stong r+ṣa mo'i 'o/ /oṃ a mṛ ta bu lo ki ni gar+bha sa ma rak+ṣa ṇi a kar+ṣa ṇi hū hū phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ rma bya chen mo'i 'o/ /oṃ bi ma le bi pū le dza ya wa re a mṛ ta bi ra dze hūṃ hu phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin gyi'o/ /oṃ bha ra bha ra sam+bha ra sam+bha ra isgri ya ba la bi shwa dha ni hū hu phaṭa phaṭa ru ru tsa le swāhā/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi'o/ /de nas yang ar+gha:nas sha lta'i bar phyis mchod/ spro na gong bzhin bstod pa'am/ sor sor 'brang dang stong chen rab 'joms dang / /rma bya chen mo gsang sngags rjes su 'brang / /bsil ba'i tshal te ye shes lnga yi sku/ /gzungs sngags rgyal mo lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod/ces pas bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis drangs nas/ dkyil —162—
