nub tu ye shes tshe dpag med/ nub byang du mi g.yo tshe dpag med/ thams cad kyang sku mdog nas/ spyod pa'o/ /thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ nas hi yig dmar po de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza ma lus sems can kun kyi mgon gyur zhing / nas/ yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā pa ra mi ta/ ā yur dz+nyā na/ sa pā ri wa ra e phya hi/a mṛ ta lan gsum gyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs la dgongs bzhin gnang bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra wa ra sa t+pa ra ar+gha pra tismo swāhā/ ji ltar bltams pa: nas/ shrī ye hu/bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yi ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ pad+ma ka ma la ya stu/ oṃ badz+ra puspro nas/ ni wi bye'i bar gyis mchod/ dza / ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hi las 'od 'phros nas yar lud pa las/gtso 'khor thams cad la 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ de nas gong du shad pa'i sngags gsum po ci nus su bzlas la/ mthar/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ba thams cad brtan par bzhugs nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod la/ gong ltar mchod pa byin rlabs bya ba las/ rol mo byin dbab mi dgos so/ /de nas —213—

phyag rgya spyi dang mthun par cas la/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla re dang / /mchod yon bkod pas 'od zer rab bkye te/ /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcas mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā pa ri mi ta/ ā yur dz+nyā na sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaX pra ru swāhā/ de bzhin tu sbyar te mthar rol mo la/ sil snyan zhes pa dang / shasta'i bar ro/ gos zung bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ zle las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi na bza' nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos/ /mi phyed rdo rje'i sku brnyes la/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul nas/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ sarba nas/badz+ra wasta ye āXhuX/ spro na rgyal srid sna bdun dang / 'dod yon lnga rnams spyi dang mthun par 'bul/ /lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal tshe/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ /ma ṅga la aṣ+ṭa aX ka pu aX ka pu dzi te āXhuX/ tshig gzhan rnams de dang 'dra ba la/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ ma ṅga laX aṣ+ṭa dra bya yuX dzi te bstod pa ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rgya wo bskor/ /sems can sdug bsngal sna tshogs kun/ /ma lus par ni sel mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /rdo rje sems dpa' las byung wo / /nyes pa'i dri ma kun bcom pa/ /rdo rje lus can rdo rje can/ /rdo rje tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /bsam pa'i don kun skad cig gis/ /rang 'dod bzhin du tshim mdzad pa/ /mchog gi bdag po chen po ste/ /rin chen tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /ji ltar nyon mongs dri ma yis/ /kun nas gos par mi 'gyur —214—

zhing / /thugs rjes gas tshul sto mdzad pa'i/ /pad+ma tshe dpag: 'dod pa'i las rnams ma lus pa/ /skad cig gcig gis rdzogs pa'i dpal/ /bsam kun 'phel byed dpag bsam shing / /las kyi tshe dpag: nyes pa kun las khyod grol nas/ /sna tshogs yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ /'khor ba'i skyabs mdzad dpa' bo ste/ /kun gzigs tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /stobs chen rnams kyis rab brgyan te/ /mi mthun phyogs rnams ma lus spangs/ /ston pa sred med bu yi stobs/ /yon tan tshe dpag: me long mnyam nyid la sogs pa/ /ye shes mang po'i mdzod 'dzin zhing / /rtog pa ma lus khyod kyis spangs/ /ye shes tshe dpag:rnam par rtog las khyod grol nas/ /mtha' bral ting 'dzin zhi ba nyid/ /bdud dang mu stegs 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /mi g.yo tshe dpag med phyag 'tshal/ /'khor ba'i sems can gang yang rung / /khyod kyi mtshan tsam 'dzin pa la/ /tshe dang ye shes stsol mdzad pa'i/ /tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa dang / spro na/bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bla na med/ /tshe dang ye shes dpag med rnam nges pa'i/ /gzi brjid rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dri med pad+ma ra ga'i mdangs ldan zhing / /mtshan mchog sum cu rtsa gnyis dpe byad bzang / /brgyad cus legs spras bdud rtsi'i bum bzang mchog /mnyam bzhag phyag gis bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo theg mchog ston pa yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs/ /seng ge'i sgra yis bdud dang gshin rje'i dpal/ /kun tu 'joms byed gdul bya'i tshogs skyong ba/ /tshe dpag med kyi gsung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par mi rtog mkhyen pas shes bya khyab//byams —215—

dang thugs rjes 'gro kun rjes 'dzin zhing / /dbyings dang ye shes kun du ro gcig pa/ /ye shes lnga yi thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes rgya mtsho gting mtha' rab yangs pa/ /mi 'gyur 'gag med tshe yi lhun pos brgyan/ /yon tan sna tshogs rin chen gter 'dzin pa/ /dpag yas 'byung pos bsten la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang bzhin chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /sna tshogs 'phrin las 'od zer rab bkye bas/ /ma rig mun sel tshe dang ye shes kyi/ /snang ba bskyed par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nor bu dpag bsam shing dang bum pa bzang / /drang srong gis sbyar rigs sngags mthu yis kyang / /'di ltar 'gro ba'i dpal 'byor rgyas byed cing / /skye rgu'i 'dod don gang lags sgrub bgyid na//skyabs mchog khyod ni mgon du legs bgyis nas/ /gsang sngags rgyal po rtag tu brjod bgyid cing / /rtse gcig yid kyi gus pas gsol btab na/ /'dir ltar skal bzang 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ /de ltar dgongs nas ma lus mkhyen pa'i thugs/ /thugs rje'i dbang gi bdag la dgongs nas kyang / /las dang glo bur rkyen las byung ba yi/ /gshin rje'i gnod pa ma lus bzlog tu gsol//nad gdon bar chad tshogs kun zhi ba dang / /bum pa bzang sogs dngos grub kun thob nas/ /mi 'gyur rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe 'grub ste/ /tshe dpag med mgon go 'phang thob par mdzod/ /ces bstod cing gsol ba btab/ de nas bum bskyed ni/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pa las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du bhu las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba ldir ba mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul ba bcings pa/—216—

dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba rnams las/ bum pa dgu po rnams kyi nang du pad zla la gnas pa'i hru yig re re yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus kyi bum par rnam par snang mdzad tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa/ shar gyi bum par rdo rje tshe dpag med/lho'i bum par rin chen tshe dang ga med/ nub kyi bum pa pad+ma tshe dpag med/ byang gi bum par las kyi tshe dpag med/ byang shar gyi bum par kun gzigs tshe dpag med/ shar lho'i bum par yon tan tshe dpag med/ /lho nub kyi bum par ye shes tshe dpag med/ /nub byang gi bum par mi g.yo tshe dpag med/ /thams cad kyang nas spyod pa'o/ /gal te bum pa gnyis las med na/ yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du/ sdong bu cung zad dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang / 'dab ma brgyad la nas/ spyod pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi skabs bzhi/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i nang du/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hu las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ khro bo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs shing / g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /thams cad kyi spyi bor o nas/ badz+ra sa mā dza'i bar gong bzhi/ dza : ba ho slar yang thugs ka'i hi las nas/ dbu brgyan gyi bar yang mdun bskyed bzhin/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ ar+gha nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo sogs kyis bstod/ 'jigs pa'i hū sgra nges sgrogs —217—

shing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus rtsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes las bum nang gi lha la yang bstod/rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzugs thag la brten nas song / bum nang gi lha rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te bum pa gang bar gyur/ gzungs thag nas bzung la sngags gsum po ci rigs par bzla/ las bum la dmig nas/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍali ha na ha na hū phaṭa ces pa'ang nyer gcig sogs bzla'o/ /mthar gong bzhin mchod bstod/ yig brgya'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang / sogs/ o ā hū/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis bum nang gi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa kun dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing dung chos kyi chu bum pa rnams su blug go /de nas gtor ma 'bul te/ 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma gzhung nas ma zugad kyang /phyis kyi rnams lag len la mdzad pa ltar na/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā hū gzungs ring kyi mthar/ a kā ro ba khas pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta smyo bi shwa mu khe sbo sarba thā kha ut+na ste te spa ra ṇa e ma ga ga ṇa kha swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis rgya cher spel la stabs/ ar+gha sogs kyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo sogs kyis bstod/mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ nas/kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma yang gong bzhin byin gyis rlabs nas/ rang gi snying —218—

ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi phyogs bzhi nas rgyal po chen po sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par gyur/ oṃ e rkye hi/ tsa tun mahā rā dzā sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaX zhes brjod/ oṃ stu ta ra ni ya/ oṃ bi ru sgye ka ya/ oṃ bi ru bhak+ṣa ya/ oṃ be+e shra wa ṇa ya sa pā ri wā ra khyuX na maXsarba ta thā ga ta sbyoXnas/ ga ga na khaX grihā daX bāX li ta swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ spro na re re'i mtshan sngags la nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya sbyar ba lan gsum gsum gyis phul na shin tu legs so//oṃ tsa tu mahā rā dzā sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaX nas shasta'i bar gyis ma rdzo/ rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ mar gad mdog can pi wang 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur pa'i/ /yul 'khor bsrung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin/ /grul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /'phags skyes po la: /mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/ kha dog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /klu yi tshogs la dbang bskyur ba'i/ /mig mi bzang la: ded dpon chen po gser mdog can/ /be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bsgyur pa'i/ /rnam thos sras la: dad ldan rgyal ba'i bka' thos zhal mthong zhing / /sgrub la brtson pas byang chub thugs su chud/ /thabs mkhas snying rjes tshogs gnyis rdzogs mdzad pa/ /bdag dang gzhan don 'byor pa khyod la 'dud/ /rgyal chen sde bzhi 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar bya/ de'i rjes su sgos kyi chos skyong tre/gtor ma yod na'ang rang rang gi cho gas bsngo/ 'di la nag po r+ṣa po sogs la rgyal wo gyi cho ga'i rigs 'gros sbyong ba'i lag len 'dug na'ang snying pos dben pas sgos kyi chos skyong gi gtor chog —219—

rnams yang na mi byed/ byed na rang gzhung gi 'bul dgos kyis/ blo bzo mi bya'o/ /de'i rjes su phyogs skyong dang / 'byung po spyi dang / bgegs kyi gtor ma te/ gtor ma cha gsum du grags pa'ang nges par gtong dgos la/ de'i cho ga ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas slob ma la ji ltar bya ba'i dbang gi cho ga rnams slob dpon nyid kyis bdag 'jug tu blangs/ slar yang mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas la/ slob ma la byin rlabs 'jug pas don du bzlas pa ci rigs par bya'o/ /gsum pa la dbang bskur ba ni slob ma rnams khrus byas/ gral la 'khord/ me rtab bkye bsdu bya/ sems bskyed gsal gdab/ chos bshad ci rig par bya/ spro na chos 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus dang che ba'ang brjod nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bskul/ de rnams kyis kyang maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas/dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs lan gsum nges bzlos kyi sgo nas gsol ba btab/ tsho( tsak+ṣu4ban+ta wā rā ā ma na ya hu/ gis gdong bcing / ā kha lī ra hū/ gi me tog gi 'phreng ba gtad/ slob dpon gyis thugs ka nas sprul pa'i khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i tshogs kyis bgegs bskrad par gyur/ las bum gyi chus bsangs la/ a khru ta'i sngags brjod/ rigs dang mthun pa brtag pa'i slad du/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhesadris pa la/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes rjes zlos kyis lan btab/slar yang mthar thug gi don gnyer brtag pa'i slad du/ de yi bu la ci zhig bya/ zhes dris pa la/sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes rjes bzlos kyi lan 'debs su bcug /slob ma'i snying khar kun rdzob byang sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam byang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'khod par gyur/ oṃ sarba yo ka tsit+ta u pa ta ya mi/ zhes rjes bzlos bya/rdo rje snying khar gtugs la/ su ra te sa ma ya sta/—220—

ho sirnyi badz+ra ya thā su kha/ zhes pas brtan par byas/rdo rje mgo bor bzhag la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba chen po 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes pa gsang bar gdam/ slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jusate dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi sgo drung du khrid par mos la/ dkyil 'khor la 'dud pa tsam byed du 'jug cing / hu dza : / zhes pa'i rjes bzlos dang / yol ba bsal/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thamasacad la lan gsum du phyag 'tshal bar mos la/ gnas gsum du thal mo spyor bzhin pas/ 'di'i rjes bzlos/ oṃ na ma te hū/ oṃ na mo me hū/ oṃ na mo na ma hu/ zhes brjod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs rgyun zug gsal na gsum byed du bcug /maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar skul la/ slob mas kyang 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal tu gsol/ rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa lhag par gnas pa mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slob ma skad cig gis rgyal ba tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i snying khar zla ba la gnas pa'i hi yig las 'od zer 'phros pa dang / slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i khyi yig las kyang 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad dang / gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / grub pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs —221—

bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas par bshad do/ /bdag 'jug gi tshe/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod sbyin ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang skyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rjes deng bdag stsol/ /ni gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi lha rnams dbang stegs rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/ de'i steng gi phyogs su gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can mtha' bskor du rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang / rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ gdan de nyid kyi steng du slob ma sdiXlas rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog pad+ma ra ga'i nas/thugs kar hūṃ/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX dzaXhuX baX hoX yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hriXyig las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la thun mong ma yin pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs kyis bskor ba ni/rigs sngags 'di la dgongs pa gcig gyur sangs rgyas tshogs/ /bye ba gang gā'i klung gi bye snyed dbus su te/ khar du bye ba dgu bcu rtsa dgu lho phyogs su/ /bye ba bdun cu rtsa bdun nub tu bye ba phrag /brgyad cu rtsa bzhi byang du bye ba drug cu lnga/ /byang shar sogs la bye ba phrag gi grangs sgres pa/ /lnga bcu rtsa lnga dang ni bzhi bcu rtsa lnga dang / /sum cu rtsa drug nyer lnga rnams ni sangs rgyas so/ /gzhan yang —223—

kyi byin rlabs dang / yon tan dang / nus mthu thams cad dang / lha klu gnod spyin mi dang mi ma yin thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams mthu stobs ma lus pa dang / nor bu dang / sman dang rigs sngags dang / bcud len dang / grub pa'i rdzas rnams gtso bor gyur pa 'byung ba'i khams thams cad kyi bkrag mdangs bcud de mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i snod bcud brtan g.yo thams cad kyi dwangs ma mi shigs pa'i ngo bo rnams 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyis sku'i rnam par bsdus/ nam mkha'i dbyings las kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar phyogs thams cad nas byon te/ slob ma'i ba sbu'i bu ga thams cad nas bzhugs shing 'dres/ lus kyi nang thams cad 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang 'od zer dmar po'i rnam pas gang / sdig sgrib thams cad byang / lus sems thams cad bde bas khyab par gyur/ snying po'i mthar/ tsho( badz+ra ā be sha ya a a a a zhes bzlas shing spos dang /rol mo bya/ de nas spyi bor rdo rje bsnol mar bzhag nas/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes lan gnyis kyis brtan par bya/ oṃ pra tismo badz+ra ho/ zhes rjes bzlos byed bzhin du/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'am/rigs kyi lha la me tog 'dor du gzhug /me tog slob dpon gyis blangs la slob ma'i mgo bor ཿngas te/ pra ti gro hā twa/ i ma satwa mahā bā la/ zhes brjod de me rta ge phul ba'i lhas dngos grub stsal bar mos su bcug /oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ṣa hū ā/ zhes brjod de gdong g.yogasabakrol/ he badz+ra pa lja zhes lta bar bskul te/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar rten dang brten par —222—

mtha' skor du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshad med pa rnams dang /'chi med tshe'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i lha dang drang srong rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba lko badz+ra sa ma dza ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ zhes rjes zlos kyis gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon dang rnam snang tshe dpag med dbyer ma mchis pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ rin po che'i bum pa 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur bar gyur/ bum pa slob ma'i spyi bor gtso/sa shing bum chu 'thung du bcu gal/ o be+e ro tsā na ā yur dz+nyā na sirnyi sa ma ya a bhi khiñca hu/ lus la rnam snang tshe dbang bskur/ /bu khyod 'chi bdag las grol te/ /bskal pa stong du tshe 'phel nas/ /srog gcod sdig pa dag gyur cig /de nas rol chen dril bsil tsam dang bcas pas kyang rung ste/ pha rol du phyin pa drug gi shis pa brjod nas dbang bskur ba ni/ spyin pa'i stobs kyi sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags/ /mi yis seng ge sbyin pa'i stobs rtogs nas/ /snying rje can gyi grong khyer 'jug pa na/ /sbyin pa'i stobs kyi sgra ni grags par 'gyur/ de bzhin du sgyin pa zhes pa thams cad du/ tshul khrims zhes sbyar ba dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab ces pa'i bar du 'don pa spo/ sho lo ka re re'i mthar/spyin pa mthar phyin tshe yang 'phel bar shog /ces pa nas/ shes rab mthar phyin tshe yang 'phel bar shog /ces pa'i bar tshig rkang re re 'jug pa'i lag len snang ba bzhin byas kyang 'gal ba med par mngon 9pre/ 'ga' zhig dkyus kyi tshig rkang mtha' ma dor nas/ de 'don pa ni bka' la dbang za bar 'gyur bas spang ngo / /de nas 'di skad —224—

ces / /zhes gsungs shing / bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ ye shes kyi chus lus kyi nang thams cad gang / 'khore ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa gti mug gis kun nas slangs te/ sems can gzhan gyi srog bcad pas/ tshe 'dir tshe thung ba'i las sgrib bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ rnam snang tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pas rgyud byin gyis rlabs par mos pa gyis/ zhes sogs/ yang gong bzhin gsol ba btab/rnam snang tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes pa'i tshab tu/ rdo rje tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa/ be+e ro tsā na zhes par/ badz+ra de bzhi du/ lus la rdo rje'i tshe dbang /zhes dang / khyad par du yang nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gis kun nas/ zhes dang / rdo rje tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa/ ces 'don pa spo/ de bzhi du/ rin chen: rat+na:rin chen tshe dbang: nga rgyal dang ser snas: rin chen tshe dang: de bzhi du/ pad+ma:pad+ma pad+ma'i tshe dbang: 'dod chags kyis: pad+ma tshe dang / de bzhi du/ las kyingukarma: phrag dog gis: las kyi tshe dang / zhes pa spo/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa yod na/ rigs lnga'i bum pa rnams kyis re re bzhin dbang bskur ba yin la/ gnyis su bsdus pa yin na/ de thams cad la rnam rgyal bum pa kho nas dbang bskur ba yin no/ /de nas cod pan gyi dbang ni/ de ltar rigs lngas bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ pad+ma'i phyag rgya spyi bor gsags la/ lkoX pad+mo bha ba a bhi ṣañca hūX/ zhes brjod/ de nas bar 'dir spro na bzlas lung sbyin pa'i lugs kyang yod mod/ lag len mi mdzad pa shas che'o/ /de nas bum pa dgu yod na mtshams kyi bum pa —225—

bzhis/ rim pa bzhin 'khrud pa'am/ gnyis las med na/ las bum gyis lan bzhir 'khrud de/kun gzigs tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa la sogs mtshams kyi tshe dpag med bzhi po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ slob ma'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad bkrus par gyur/ zhes brjod la/ sngags gsum gyi mthar/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shin+ta ku ru swāhā/ nad thams cad shin ku ru swāhā/ gdon thams cad rims thams cad nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad: 'khon dang grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad: byad dang byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad: mtshan mo nag mo dang / dus kyi zhags pa dang / skyon rje'i pho nya thams cad: dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad: bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad:gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa thams cad rgyal po dang the'u brang gi gnod pa thams cad: btsan dang dmu'i gnod thams cad: klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa la sogs pa mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shin+ta ku ru swāhā/ zhes bkru'o/ /de nas byabs pa ni/ rma bya'i mdongs kyi dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lha'i mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar dmigs la/ de'i 'od zer gyis/ slob ma'i nad gdon sdig sgrib phra zhing phra ba thams cad kyang rdo khab len gyi lcags phye blangs ba bzhin du blangs te phyir dor bar mos shig /sngags gsum gyi mthar/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sogs gong gi mthar/ shin+ta ku ru phyi dod du/a pā na ya zhes pa bzhug go/de nas bsrung ba ni/ slob ma'i gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram re re bzhag pas/ rdo rje de las de 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros/lus la rdo rje'i go bkon te/ phyin chad gnod pa gang gis kyang mi tshugs par —226—

byas pa'i mos pa gyis/ zhes brjod la sngags gsum gyi mthar/ gong dang 'dra ba las shin+ta ku ru tshab tu rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes pa bcug /de la gnas bdun ni/ spyi bo/ snying kha sog phrag /dpung pa g.yas g.yon/ pus mo g.yas g.yon rnams so/ /de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i byin rlabs ni/slob ma'i snying kha pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i lte ba la rnam snang tshe dpag med/'dab ma bzhi la/ shar du rdo rje tshe dpag med/ lho ru rin chen tshe dpag med/nub tu pad+ma tshe dpag med/ byang du las kyi tshe dpag med/ spyi bor ye shes tshe dpag med/ slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer ma mchis pa'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ spyi bo'i ye shes tshe dpag med la thim pas/ de nyid 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu ste/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ snying kha'i rigs lnga tshe dpag med la thim pas de rnams kyang 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du zhu ste lus kyi nang thams cad gang / bskul ba'i bar du rkyen gang gis kyang mi shigs pa'i 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ gzungs sogs gsum po'i mthar/ nga ni ye shes tshe dpag med/ /kun tu brnyas pa spang bar gyis/ /'chi bdag chen po ngas bcom te/ /bu khyod tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes/ /zhes brjod/ rgyal srid sna bdun gyi gzugs ba ho rnams snying po lan gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs la/ rim pa bzhin lag tu gtad la/ lha rdzas las sdo/ba nye ba shin tu zlum/ /rtsibs stong ldan shing mu khyud rab mnyam ldan/ /sdang ba'i dgra las rnam par rgyal gyur pa'i/ /'khor lo rin wo dam pa'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ tsakra rat+na a bhi khiñca ma/ rin chen ngo bo lha rdzas biḍar+ya/ /kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing / /dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan de bzhin/ /nor bu rin —227—

chen dam pas dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ ma ṇi rat+na a bhi ṣi3 ma/ gzugs mdzes lta na sdug cing tshul bzang ma/ /pags pa'i mdog legs 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan/ /yid 'ong 'dod dgu'i reg bya dang ldan pa'i/ /btsun mo rin chen: wa sti rat+na gang yang rgyal bas mu tig mdangs ldan pa'i/ /gser sogs mang po thub la dbul ba ltar/ /bzod ldan mtshungs pa'i khyim bdag nor ldan pa'i/ /blon po rin chen mahā sta rat+na yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni/ /rab gnas gangs chen ri 'dra glang po che/ /rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i//glang po rin chen hasti rat+na tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i/ /sa rnams bskor te slar yang ldog nus pa'i/ /rma bya'i mgrin pa'i skru ltar yid 'ong ba'i/ /rta mchog rin chen: a shwa rat+na: 'gro dang ldog dang kun nas 'ong 'gyur bas/ /ma lus bdud dpung 'jig par byed pa ste/ /dpa' brtan 'byor pa'i dpung dang bcas pa yi/ dmag dpon rin chen dam pu ru kha bkra shis rdzas brgyad bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ma las byung ba'i bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad slob ma rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ o ma ṅga la aṣ+ṭa dra bya swāhā/ de nas rim pas slob ma'i lag tu gto la/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas me long phyag tu phul ba na/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir yang rdo rje slob mas gtso byas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems thams cad me long gi rdzas la brten nas/ shin tu bkra shis —228—

par gyur cig /me long ye shes rgya mtsho chen po ste/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te/ /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang sgrib pa dag gyur cig /de bzhi du/ sngon bcom ldan 'das la glang po che sa bsrung gis gi ha phyag tu phul ba zhes dang / gi hang gi rdzas la zhes 'don pa spo/ gi hang dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur te/ /nyon mongs zugs rngu med par gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang dug gsum zhi gyur cig /de bzhi du/ zhing pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas zho/ zho'i rdzas la rten nas/ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ /snying po rnam dag ye shes rnam rtogs te/ /yon tan kun gyi dbyings su gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang nad kun zhi gyur cig /rtsa tshong bkra shis kyi rtsa dur ba/ dur ba'i rdzas la/ dur bas tshe ni 'phel bar byed pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab grub ste/ /nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel gyur cigalha tshangs pas shing tog bil ba: bil ba'i rdzas la/ bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i chos/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang don kun 'grub gyur cigalha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba dung dkar gyi rdzas la/ dung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrog pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho mchog tu dag gyur te/ /chos rnams ma nor yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbang thob shog /bram ze dkar rgyal gyi bus li khri: li khri'i rdzas/ li khri dmar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma nor dbang du bsdus byas —229—

nas/ /chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang khyed srid brtan gyur cig /phyag na rdo rjes grub pa'i rdzas yungs dkar yungs kar gyi rdzas yungs dkar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa ste/ /mthu stobs yon tan phun sum tshogs pa yis/ /bkra shis des kyang bgegs kun zhi byed shog /de dag gi mthar spro na/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs/ bkra shis tshigs bcad gsum bya'o/ /de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs kyis dam tshig bsrung bar khas blangs/ gtang rag gi yon 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs slob mar khas blangs/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ de nas rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mchod pa gsar du bshams pa'am kha gsos la/ bsangs sbyangs/ byin rlabs gong ba bya/ gong tshogs wo gi skabs ltar mchod/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor/ sogs sam bstod pa rgyas bsdus gang yo gis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ khyad par du yang bdag cag slob mar bcas pa la 'chi ba med par tshe'i dngos grub stsal ba dang / phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi nas/ tshe 'di nyid la rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dngos grub zhu/rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum sogasabarjod pas lhag chad kha bskangs/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ khyed kyis sems can sogs badz+ra mu mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim rasabris kyi dkyil 'khor la brtan bzhugs spyi dang mthun par bya/ smon lam dang bkra shis kyang gang —230—

'grub bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gong du bshad pa'i cho ga de dag lhag par nges par byas nas/ cho ga'i khyad par lhag po rnams brjod par bya/ thog ma nyid du/ sa chog /lhag gnas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba rnams spyor dgos shing / 'og ma so so'i skabs su'ang cung zad cung zad 'phel bar 'gyur/ de yang dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sa gzhi'i/ dbus kyi char dkar gtor gnyis/ rang gi mdun du/dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba/ rdo rje dril bu nyer spyod lnga sogs bshams/ a mra tas bsangs/swabha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las grub pa'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar zlaX las gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan ma tshang ba med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ra lha pa bzhin nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ āXhuX/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaXrgyas pa la dga' na cha gsum gtor ma bzhin phyogs skyong gi gtor ma btang / bsdu na tseX( dwa sha di ka 'e1 ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra khyuX.an+taX pra rte swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pā t+yaX ma rna dā sha di ka shwe1 ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra khyuX.a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/stso nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ badz+ra muX zhes sogs kyis gshegs su gsol/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ gnas bdag gzhi bdag gro rwang bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad tseX( badz+ra sa mā dzaX tseX( bhu mi pā la sa pā ri wā ra khyoX zhes pa thams cad kyi mgor sbyar nas ar+ghaX pu duX gis chu gnyis/ a kā ro/ lan gsum gyis/ gtor la/ pus nas sha sna'i bar gyis nyer spyod dang / rol mo phul/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi las rtsom na/ gnyen gshin du gyur pa'i sems kyis sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la ci bde bar stsol la/ dge ba'i sdong —231—

grogs rgya chen pos mdzod cig /ces pa'i mthar gtor ma btang / ga tsā ga smo swa bhā wa naX/ zhes brjod/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na huX phaṭa/ zhes pa bzla bzhin du/ sa gzhi la yungs dkar dang / thal bas gtor/ spos chus chag chag btab/ lag pa g.yas sa gnon gyi phyag rgya sa la reg ste gzungs sam snying po lan brgya rtsa brjod la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar bya'o/ /zhes blos bzung zhing ngag tu brjod/ oṃ bhu khaX/ sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur / hūX laX huX/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+ra bha wa ban+ta hūX/ phyogs thams cad yongs su bcing bar gyur/ zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ gong du pa gad pa'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun du dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su tshom bu/ mchod gtor dang bcas pa bshams la/ mchod pa gtor ma gong bzhin byin gyis mas/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa tshom bu'i steng du byon pa ni/ sku mdog ser mo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gser gyi bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sa'i lha mo dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ pra thi wi de wi khyoX zhes thams cad la sbyar te/chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod dang gtor ma gong bzhi 'bul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ shwakya seng ge skyob pa yi/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khordo ra 'bri/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slar yang ar+ghaX gyis mchod yon phul te/ sa'i lha mo/ slar yang sa de nyid la thim/ zhes brjod/ tshom bu de bsal nas slar yang dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi —232—

dbus su tsho me bu dgu bkod/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i steng du/ dri bzang gi thig le rnams pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas par gyur/ rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rgyal ba tshe dpag med lha dgu'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dza ma lus sems can sogs kyi mthar mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas la/ pad zla'i gdan rnams kyi steng du yongs su 'khod par gyur/ mchod pa rnams gong bzhi byin gyis rlabs/dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs su bshad pa ltar 'bul/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la rab tu gnyen gshin pa'i/ thugs kyis sa'i phyogs 'dir lhag par gnas pa mdzad cing / nang par dkyil 'khor chen po byin gyis rlabs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba bto/ spro na/ tshe dpag med mgon bcom ldan 'das/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur te/ spyi rgyud ltar snyan gsan dbab na'ang shin tu legs so/ /nang par 'degs pa'i lugs yod kyang skabs 'di nyid du byas na lag len bde ste/ tse( badz+ra u dro zhes rdo rje gtsug gtor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog te/ mdun bskyed kyi lha snam mkhar btegs/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig bya/ o badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hū hū hu phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gsum gyis nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang sa gzhi la bsrung ba bya'o/ /de nas gong du bshad pa ltar bum pa lhag gnas bya/ /slob ma lhag par gnas pa ni gcig tu dgos pa ma yin zhing —233—

deng sang phal cher/ lag len la mi mdzad mod/ 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang bskur sogs 'ga' zhig la mdzad pa ltar na'ang legs pa yin no/ /de ltar na/ mya dzon las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed pa dang / gsol btab dang spro ba bskyed pa dang / rgyun bshags dang / sgo gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs zhing mchod pa dang/ so shing dang / khyor chu dang / ku sha dang / bsrung skud dang / zab mo'i chos bshad pa dang / rmi lam brtag pa rnams spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ thig skud sna lnga gcig tu sgril ba zhig bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ hu tru khyo a yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i thig skud sna lnga de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i bdag nyid du gyur/rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros/ sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas/ ye shes kyi thig skud spyan drangs te/ dam tshig gi thig skud la thim/ o badz+ra sa ma ya snyu tra ma ti kra ma hū/ zhes lan mang du bsngags/ thig chen brgyad gdab tshul spyi dang mthun par gdab/dkyil 'khor gyi sgo rkyang rta babs sgo tshad gcig la snam bu bzhi par bya zhing / rtsa thig la reg tu nye bar nang gi pad+ma'i mu khyud kyi phyi thig bskor/ lhag ma spyi dang 'dra'o/ /mthar badz+ra mu zhes thig skud kyi ye shes pa gshegs te thig skud byin rlabs so/ /rdul tsho ni byin rlabs ni/ thig skud ces pa thams cad rdul mtshon zhes pa dang / mthar skye( badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ye hū/ zhes bsngags pa las gzhan rnams de nyid dang 'dra ba ni rdul tshon gyis byin gyis rlabs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri tshul yang spyi dang mthun/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs las 'byung ba bzhin 'bri zhing / lha mtshan ni bum pa ser po dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan dang bcas pa zla ba'i gdan la gnas pa bri'o/ /'di nyid kyi gzhung kho bos mthong ba phal cher na/ lha dgu nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs par byas 'dug na'ang / bod kyi yi ge snga phyi thams cad na zla gdan kho nar yod pa'i/zla gdan du 'os par yang mngon la/ lag len gyi rgyun la'ang zla gdan kho nar snang la/ zla gdan du —234—

bya la/ khyad par can gyi rgyu mtshan zhig yod na ma gtabs/ rgya gzhung gi yi ge ma dag par sem mo/ /mthar rgyan dgram pa sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i gnas skabs su/ye shes pa spyan 'dren dngos de sta gon gyi lha spyan 'dren pa yin pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas zhes pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings nas zhes 'don pa spo/ gnyis su med par thim/ zhes pa'i rjes su/ yang thugs ka'i hi las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyi lha tshogs kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzatshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin mchod/ dza hu ba ho de nas slar yang thugs ka'i sogs dbang bskur rgyas btab bya/ rjes chog gi tshe/ rdul tshon gshegs gsol spyi dang mthun no/ /ras bris sam rdul tshon gang yin kyang rung ste/ cho ga nyin zhag sbrel ma byed pa'i tshe/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa bshegs pa nyin re bzhin byed dgos la/ rdul tshon la dngos gzhi'i nyi ma gnyis pa phan chad la/ sta gon gyi lha spyan 'dren mi byed pa nyid dag pas/ ngag 'don ras bris kyi skabs su zugad pa nyid kho nas chog go /de bzhin du bum pa sgrub tshul yang ras bris gzhan no/ /gsum pa ni/ rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gang la rten kyang 'dra ste/ las bum mam las thams cad pa bzlas pa'i spos chus/ sgrub bya'i las thams cad dam/ yan lag lnga legs par bkrus te/ khrus khu phyed khams phor so mar bzhag /phyed sa nag dang / mchod rten rnying pa'i sa/ro thal/ rdza thal/ tshig snag rnams dang bsres te/ gshin rje'i gzugs nag po dbyugs pa dang zhags pa 'dzin pa zhig bcos la/ sla nga'i nang du kha cung zad sbub pas mgo lhor bstan te dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su bzhag /de la gdan gzhi nag po 'ding zhing / steng nas kyang ras nag gis cung zad bkab/ de'i mdun du kham phor 'o mas bkang ba dang / nya'i bdug spos kyi snod dang / nyer spyod lnga rnams po gams/ me tog nag po dang / 'bru nag po'i rigs dang / sha mar bu ram gser —235—

—dngul sogs rin po che dang / tshwa sogs gshin rje'i rdzongs rnams dang / de rnams 'jal pa'i bre la/oṃ asma sarba sa tsi swāhā/ zhes bris shing bzla srang dang zho cha la/ o thib ta mthong ba'i rgyal po swāhā/ zhes bris shing bzlas la snga ma dang nye bar bzhag /'brang rgyas phyed dkar phyed nag gi dkar po la mar gyi sdong bu lnga/ nag po la mar nag gi sdong bu lnga btsugs/ shar ram nub tu bzhag /dkyil 'khor gyi byang phyogs su/ ku sha'i gdan la sgrub bya'i glud gos tshon skud sna lngas rgya gram ris su bcings nas bzhag /dug sna btang pa'i chu kham phor gang 'o ma dang bsres pa yang gang 'os su bzhag cing / stan dkar po dang / me tog dkar po sogs kyang 'dzom par bya ste/ nge/ yan chad ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan dgram pa dang lhan cig bshams kyang rung / bum pa sgrub pa yan chad kyi bar gang la byas kyang 'dra'o/ /lho phyogs su stegs bu'i steng du tshe mdo bzhugs su gsol/ /byang phyogs su stegs bu'i steng du 'chi med rnga sgra bzhugs su gsol te/ dbang bskur thos pa re res gtsang sbra dang bcas te / de gnyis klog grangs ni sgrub bya'i lo grangs byed pa'i lag len kho na yod kyang bshad tshod bzhin lan brgya rtsa brgyad nyid byas na legs pa ste ma tshar gyi dogs na klog mkhan cha gsum bzhi bya'o/ /de yang slob dpon gyi rdzas de dag thams cad sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis rlabs pa'ang / bsdu na bsangs sbyangs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags brgya lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis byin gyis brlabs/ gzugs brnyan de gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa dngos su bsam/ mdo klog mkhan gnyis las lho mas gzungs mdo tshar re thon pa dang / me tog nag po sogs bre srang zho cha rnams kyis gzhal/ gzhi nag po'i steng du spungs te/ chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje 'khor dang bcas pa la rdzongs kyi dngos po 'di dang 'di lta bu zhes ming smos nas/ bre gcig bcu brgya stong grangs med pa'i bar du 'bul gyis/ sgrub bya 'di zhes bya —236—

ba'i tshe glud dang srog glud bzhes la/ gnod pa'i sems spangs nas/ phan pa dang bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ srang dang zho cha la'ang des 'gre/ byang mas mdo tshar re thon pa dang / tshon skud de la nya'i dud pas bdug/de rnams grub tu nye ba na/ slob dpon gyi 'jig rten 'das gtor dang / rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma dang / cha gsum rnams gtong / mdo klog zin pa na/ 'brang rgyas phyed mar gshags la/ nag po ngos de snod cig tu bcug /mar nag gi sdong bu lnga yang spar la/ khrus khu'i kham phor dang lhan cig gshin rje'i gzugs kyi mdun du bzhag la/ slob dpon yi dam gyi nga rgyal brtan pos 'di skad ces/'di nas lho yi phyogs rol nas/ /dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha rol na/ /rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og na/ /thod pa lcags kyi grong khyer na/ /yi dwags kun gyi sde dpon po/ /ma mo kun gyi tshogs rje bo/ /gson gshin kun kyi zam kha ba/ khre ba kun gyi gshin bu rje/ /gson po bkos la 'debs pa po/ /dge ba can gyi stangs 'dzin pa/ /sdig pa can gyi chad pa mkhan/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ /legs nyes chos bzhin spyod pa po/ /chos rgyal gzhan rje zhes bya ba/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu rlabs can/ /'di skad nyon cig 'chi bdag nyon/ /chos kyi rgyal po gshin rje'i tshogs/ /'chi bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /sgrub bya che ge zhes bya ba'i/ /tshe dang srog gi glud 'bul gyi/ /'dod yon rin chen sna lnga dang / /'bru dang mchod yon sna tshogs dang / /zhal zas me tog sogs mchod dang / /glud 'di lung la tshe srog byin/ /bzung ba thong la bcings ba khrol/ /bka' dang dam las ma 'da' cig /khyod kyi 'khor gyi yi dwags la/ /bza' ba bzang po 'di 'bul gyis/ /'di zo 'khor gyi yi dwags rnams/ /ma —237—

'tshe bar ni gzhan du dengs/ zhes pa'i mthar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags drag tu brjod cing / gzugs brnyan/ rdzongs chas/ nyer spyod/ gtor ma/ khrus khu/ gzhi stan khebs sogs thams cad lho phyogs kyi grod zad mthar skyal lo/ /de nas glud gos kyi tshon skud bkrol la/ des sgrub bya'i yan lag lnga bcings/ slob dpon bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bden pa bdar ba'i mthar/ sgrub bya 'di zhes bgyi ba'i sdig sgrib nad gdon 'khon grib mi gtsang ba/chags che nyams nga / shwe1 skeg /zla skeg /zhag skeg /byad kha/ phur kha/ mi mthun par byed pa/ mtshan mo nag mo dang / dus kyi zhags pa'i gdon la sogs pa mdor na phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs gang yin pa thams cad skad cig tha pa cig yud tsam la/ tshon skud sna lnga pa 'di nyid la thim par gyur cig /oṃ ṭak+ki hū dza zhes lan gsum gyi mthar/ a mṛ ta lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pa'i ral gris tshon skud de gcod cing / gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang / /tshangs pa dang ni 'jig rten skyong / /gnod sbyin sde dpon dbang phyug che/ /de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang / /'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa ste/ /de dag rnams kyi gzi brjid kyis/ /byad sdems las rnams chad gyur cig /oṃ sarba ban+ta ka kho rdo ts+tsha da nā ya swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de nas dum bu mang por btubs te/ kham phor so ma'i nang du/ 'o chab dang dug chu bsres pa de la tshon skud dum re dang /bum chu thig re sgrub bya'i lus la bskor/ rjes su blug /snying po'i mthar/ sgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi dug bcom par gyur cig /ces brjod/ mthar rdo rje gsor zhing 'di skad ces brjod de/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag 'jig rten dug ma sum ste/ /sangs rgyas bco sgyum ldan dug mi mnga'/ /sangs —238—

rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo/ /de bzhin du chos dang dge bdun la'ang sbyar/ sa 'di dug gi ma yin te/ /sa 'di dug gi pha yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di yis su/ /dug gsum sa yi nang du song / /de bzhin du chu dang me dang rlud rnams la'ang sbyar/ sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis dug nges par bcom mo/ /de bzhi du sbyar te/ rang sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis: dgra bcom pa'i:phyir mo 'ong ba'i: lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'i: rgyun du zhugs pa'i bden par smra ba'i gzi brjid kyis: de bzhin du tshangs pa'i be con gyis dug nges par bcom mo/ /dbang po'i rdo rjes khyab 'jug gi 'khor los: me lha'i dbal gyi:chu lha'i zhags pas: lha ma yin gyi skyu mas: klu'i rigs sngags kyis: drag po'i mdung rtse gsum pas: skems byed kyi mdung thung gi dug nges par bcom mo/ /dug sa'i nang du song zhig /chu'i nang : me'i: rlung gi nang du song zhig /cesabarjod la de dang glud gos lhan cig byang phyogs kyi grong khyer zad sar skyal lo/ gtor ma dang glud skyel ba rnams phyir bzlog dus phyir mig mi lta/ sgrub bya de la dbang bskur rgyu yin na/ skabs 'dir stan bzang po la bzhag /'brang rgyas gtad/ shis pa brjod la dbang bskur/ dbang gi bkru byabasabasrung gsum gyi skabs/ cung zad 'don pa spos pas rung / 'chi bslu rkyang pa byed pa'i tshe/ las bum gyis chus/ bkru ba dang / byab pa gnyis song ba'i mtshams su/ de lta bu'i khrus khu de chu bo'am/mtsho'am/ lteng ka sogs su dor la/ stan dkar po bting ba'i steng du me tog dkar po bkram/ sgrub bya slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te/ stan rnying pa las bslangs nas/ gsar pa'i steng du 'greng bas gnas pa la/ sangs rgyas kyis ni bdud pham mdzad/ /chos ma yin ni chos kyis so/ /dge bdun gyis ni mu stegs pham/ /dbang pos lha min pham par —239—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/byas/ /lha min gyis ni zla ba pham/ /nam mkha' lding gis rgya mtsho'i tsho/ /me yis shing rnams pham par 'gyur/ /chu yis me yang pham par 'gyur/ /rlung gi sprin rnam rab tu pham/ /rdo rje yis ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden pa rab tu gnas/ /sa yang bden par gnas pa lags/ /sangs rgyas kyang bden chos kyang bden/ /bden pas rgyal 'gyur rdzun ma lags/ /dza ye dza ye su dza ye stu/zhes bden stobs brjod/ ku sha'i rtses bsangs gtor byas la sgrub bya 'dug du bcug go /de nas gong bzhin srung ba'ang byas te/ 'brang rgyas kyi phyed dkar po sgrub bya'i lag tu gtad la/ bkra shis tshe brtan dpal gyi zas/ /snying po bsdus pa'i bcud 'di ni/ /de ring bu yis bza' bar gyis/ /'di zos sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ /zhal zas gtad pas nad kun las/ /grol 'gyur the tshom mi dgos so/ /snying po lan gsum bzlas la cung zad bzar bcug /de nas me tog dkar po gtor la rol mo'i sgra dang dbyangs snyan pa dang bcas pas/ sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /ston mchod dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshig rkang pa dang po gnyis 'dra/ phyi ma gnyis la/ zhi ba chags bral: chos la zhes dang / tshogs kyi dam pa: dge bdun 'es 'don pa spo/ 'byung po gang dag sogs dang / 'di na rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gis/ /shin tu bden pa gsungs zhing rdzun min pa/ /de kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig/bden pa de yis 'dir ni dge bar shog /ces pas thog drangs pa'i bkra shis ci rigs pa bya'o/ /de ltar na chos 'di gang las brgyud pa ni/ bod kyi brgyud pa rnams la mi 'dra ba sna tshogs nas brgyud pas chog mod kyi/ 'dir nye bar mkho ba brjod/ rgyal ba tshe dpag 0 —240—

med bram ze'i rigs las byung ba'i slob dpon snying po'i zhabs te mtshan dngos snying po'i lha/ de'i sras slob dpon chen po dze tā ri/ slob dpon byang chub bzang po/ slob dpon ting 'dzin bzang po/ slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa ba ri lo tshwa ba sa skya pa gong ma lnga/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ theg chen chos rje kun dga' bkra shis/ spyang lung pa gzhon nu blo gros/ rgyal ba shākya mchog ldan/ spyang lung gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog /de la don gyi slad du mtshan na smos te/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / mkhan chen rin po che lung rigs rgya mtsho/ rje kun dga' dpal bzang gsum gyis gsan/ de rnams las dngos kyi thob te 'khums so/ /༈ de ltar mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'i gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor bshad nas/ de dang 'chi med rnga sgra'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la mi 'dra ba'i khyad par cung zad yod pa rnams brjod na/bdag bskyed kyi skabs/ gzhal yas khang bskyed mi dgos so/ /bzlas pa'i skabs 'chi med rnga sgra'i gzungs ring nyid ci nus su bzla zhing / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma u bya ā mi ta bha ya/ ta thā ga ta ya/ a rta te sa myakla bsgo/ ya/ ta kyi thā/ tse( a mṛ te/ a mṛ ta ut+ta we/ a mṛ ta sa bha we/ a mṛ ta gar+bhe/ a mṛ ta sirnyi/ a mṛ ta ta dze/ a mṛ ta bi gra rnye/a mṛ ti bi gran+ta ga mri ni/ a mṛ ( she ga ga na kirti ka re/ a rlu ta du skye bhi swa re/sarba ar+sha sa dha na/ sarba karma kle sha /k+ṣa ya ka ri swāhā/ zhes bya ba dang / lha dgu'i skabs su bshad pa'i snying po nye snying gnyis rnams bzla zhing / gzhus las tshe gzungs oṃ gnyis mar grags pa'ang bzla bar bshad do/ /mdun bskyed kyi skabs/ lha lngar byed na/ gtso bo'i sku'i —241—

g.yas kyi 'dab ma la/ sdi las spyan ras gzigs dkar po pad+ma dang rnga yab 'dzin pa/ g.yon du hu las mthu chen thob sngon po yid tsam khro ba rdo rje dang rnga yab 'dzin pa/ de gnyis rgyan dang na bza' gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'o/ /mdun du hū las gshin rje gshed nag po dgrag tho 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu hu las rta mgrin dmar po dbyug pa dkar po 'dzin pa/ de gnyis kas g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing / khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ mtshams bzhir bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba pad+mas kha brgyan pa rnams so/ /rgyas pa la mos na/ gzhin rje gshed kyis 'og tu/ bdud mchod pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / rta mgrin gyi zhabs 'og tu legs par lta ba dang / zhes bya ba mnan pa/ lha snam la/ lho ru 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po bzang po mchog /byang du yum lha mo gzi brjid can/ de gnyis sems dpa' sems ma'i cha lugs can/ nub tu btsun mo bzang skyong ma/ shar du sras zla 'od/ shar lhor rim gro ba gnyan pa dri med/ lho nub tu shes rab can gyi mchog bzang po'i tog/nub byang du rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i mchog bkod pa chen po ste/ de rnams rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can no/ /byang shar du nyan thos 'dus pa'i tshogs ci rigs pa bsgom par bya'o/ /phyi nang thams cad du byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i shar sgor yul 'khor srung dkar po pi wa 'dzin pa/ lho sgor 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub sgor mig mi bzang dmar po sprul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang sgor rnam thos sras ser po be con dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ rang —242—

rang gi 'khor tshogs du ma dang bcas rbe'o/ /yab yum man chad kyi lha 'di rnams ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi skabs sbyan drangs nas/ lha lnga'i dam ye bsres pa'i rjes la bskyed pas chog go/bstod pa'i skabs spyi bstod 'dra zhing / sgos bstod ni/ gtso bo la/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs dang / 'bor la/ bzang po spyod pas 'gro ba 'dzin mdzad cing / thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /skyon gyis ma gos sku lus gangs ri 'dra/ /thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mthu stobs mchog mnga' yon tan bsam mi khyab/ /bdud bgegs gdug pa tshar gtsod rdo rje 'dzin/ /chos nyid skye med don ldan dpa' bo ste/ /rje btsun rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bgegs chen ma lus 'dul mdzad gzhin rje gshed/ khro bo'i tshul 'chang stobs chen dpa' bo ste/ /dbyug tho 'bar bas dgra bo thal bar rlog /bcom ldan gzhin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can hu gi nga ro ldan/ /dpal chen byi dra'i 'od 'bar nyon mongs sreg /bdud dpung 'joms phyir dbyug pa'i phyag mtshan can/ /dpa' bo rta mgrin sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs kyi sras po ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /gang la gang 'dul 'gro ba 'dul ba'i sku/ /nyan thos 'dus pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dad ldan rgyal ba'i bka' thos sogs kyis bstod/ de ni dze tā ris mdzad pa yin la/ bstod pa rgyas pa la dga' na sbyar bas rung ngo / /'di la lhag gnas bzhi char nges par mdzad kyi 'dug cing / lha lhag gnas dang / bum pa bsgrub pa'i skabs kyang 'don pa spo dgos pa rigs 'gres shes shing / lha lnga kho na bya'o/ /dbang gi dngos gzhi'i skabs/ lus la rnam snang tshe dbang bskur/ sogs kyi dod du/ ji ltar —243—

bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ sogs kho na sbyar/ be+e ro tsa na ā yur dz+nyā na sogs kyi dod la/gtso bum la/ tsho'o rtswaX sogs dang / shar gyi bum pa la/ glu( āXkre/ khyo ka hūṃ/ zhes dang / lho'i la/oṃ bha ra ta ka skre swahā/ nub kyi la/ oṃ ā mṛ ta u ji wa ye swāhā/ byang gi la/ oṃ badz+ra huX phaṭa/ zhes pa rnams la/ ā sdo/ra dz+nyā na sirnyi sa ma ya hūX/ zhes pa btags/ lhag ma gzhan rnams lha sngags brjes pa kho nas chog go /de tsam gyis 'chi med rnga sgra'i cho ga yang shes par 'gyur ro/ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ ba ri ba yan chad gong dang 'dra/ mchims brtson seng / rgya zhang phug pa/'jang pa shes rab rin chen/ e pa 'khon ston/ 'jam dbyangs bzhi thog pa/ byang sems rgyal ye/bla ma grags pa dpal bzang / bla ma chos 'phags rgyal 'tshan/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge /bu ston chen po/ chos rgyal nam mkha'i mtshan can/ chos rje rin chen dpal grub/ sku zhang mkhyen rab chosarje/ sku zhung bsod nams mchog grub/ 'brog khang pa don grub rgyal mtshan/ byang gling pa bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dam pa dpal ldan chos bzang / des bdag la'o/ /de ltar mchog tu ngo mtshar rmad byung ba'i/ /tshe dang ye shes bla med sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rgyal ba'i bdag pos gsungs pa'i sngags rgyud lam/ /grub mchog stong gi shing rta'i rjes zhugs pa/ /lam 'dir 'jug pa dag kyang skal bzang ste/ /yid tshes khungs ldan blo chen yid dga'i gnas/ /gzhan du las tshogs 'ga' zhig 'grub mthong yang / /bla med gnas su 'khrid pa nus pa dkon/ /gzungs mdo las 'byung dkyil 'khor cho ga dgra las rnam rgyal gyi/ /gzhung gi rjes 'brang mchog gyur man ngag rnams kyis legs brgyan nas/ /cung zad bshad pa 'dis kyang 'gro kun bla med byang chub kyi/ /rgyal srid rdo rje'i tshe dang ye shes gnas la 'khod par shog /bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bdud rtsi'i chu gter zhes bya ba 'di yang / snga phyir don gnyer du mas bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas/ rang lo so bzhi pa/ dbo'i zla —244—

bum pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ snyu sti/ na mo gu sa tshe dbang lha gcig bum gcig gi cho ga bdud rtsi'i bum pa zhes bya ba bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'dir tshe dbang zab mo bskur bar 'dod pas/ gshom rnams legs par byas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun/ rang gi snying ka'i hruXlas 'od zer 'phros pas bla ma dang rgyal ba tshe dpag med kyi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaX 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo sogs dang / dkon mchog gsum la sogs dang / tshad med bzhi spyi mthun bya/ oṃ swā bhā ba: ma dag pa'i snang cha sbyangs/ skra zla bya'i sa gzhi lag mthil ltar ngos snyoms shing / gser gyi bye ma brdal ba'i steng na/ dpag bsam gyi sdong po rgyas pa'i bsil grib kyi rtsa bar rma bya gzhon nus btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du sna tshogs pad+ma dang chu shel zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hiXyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa/ sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar cher 'bar ba nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid can/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ zhi ba 'dzum pa sgeg pa'i nyams chags pa/ dar dang rin po che'i na bzas klubs pa/ mtshan dang dpe byed kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na/ 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis —246—

bzhugs pa/ dri med zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ de'i spyi bor ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi mdun du/ rigs bdag bla ma 'od dpag tu med pa/ sku mdog byi rle'i lhun po la nyi ma phog pa ltar dmar ba sprul pa'i sku'i cha lugs can/ chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing / dbu'i gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing / phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na bi rje ru'i lhung bzed bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa/ rang la dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal can 'dzum mul ba gcig gsal btab/ de la mos gdung drag po dang 'brel bas/ o badz+ra ā yu ṣe sa ra ha/ ka ra re/ sha ra re hū phaṭa/ dri med gzhom gzhig bral ba chos sku'i ngang nyid las/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i tshul/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan dri med 'od 'bar ba/ /skyob pa mtshungs med 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/rigs bdag gis thugs ka'i spyi'e 'od kyis/ 'byung bzhi 'khor 'das thams cad kyi bcud bsdus te lhung bzed du zhu/ yar lud pa spyi bo nas zhugs 'khor lo bzhir dbang bzhi thob/ lus kyi zungs dang / sems kyi rten du gyur par mos la/ oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzī wan ti ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla ba ni bdag bskyed do/ /tshe bum/a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ ma dag pa'i snang cha sbyangs nas/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can gyis bar gong bzhi las/ rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo zhes pa bor/ dpral bar lko/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hū dang khyo rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bde ba can nas sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dza ma lus sems can: ar+gha sogs kyi mchod/ dza / ba ho—247—

gnyis su med par thim/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dza pañca ku la sa pā ri wā ra ar+gha sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī hu zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur sku gang dri ma thams cad dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ 'od dpag med kyi dbu brgyan/ nang mchod dang / mchod pa pa bsangs sbyangs spyi dang mthun par bya/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /tshe dang ye shes stsal tu gsol/ /o a mṛ ta bha ba sa pā ri wā ra ar+gha pra tismo swāhā/ de bzhin du mchod yon zhes par zhabs bsil/ ar+gha zhes par pu du 'jug pa sogs rol mo'i bar du sbyar/bstod pa rgyas pa'ang spro na bya/ bsdu na/ dri med gzhom gzhig sogs kyis chog go /skabs 'dir mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ ya las rlung / ra las me/ a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ ye shes lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ o ā hū ha ho khyi mdun bskyed kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus drangs nas gsol bar bsam oṃ a mṛ ta bha ba sa pā ri wā ra khyu na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sbyo bi shwa sogs lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+gha sogs kyis mchod/ gong bzhin bstod/ mchod spyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la nas/ 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar bya/ skabs 'dir spro na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang / gzhi bdag gtor ma bya/ tshe chang tshe ril bsangs sbyangs/ tshe chang gi snod a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ o ā hū dra a las rigs lnga'i rang bzhin gyi tshe spel ba'i dam tshig gi rdzas su gyur pa la hi dmar pos mtshan pa/ de'i 'od —248—

zer gyis 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud thams cad bsdus te thim/ zhu zhing 'dres pa las 'chi ba med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam la/ o ā hū dra a dang / hi brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pa'i byin gyis brlabs/ tshe ril o las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma'i dngos po bhu zhu ba las tshe spel ba'i 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ma tshang ba med pa la hi yig dmar pos mtshan pa/ de'i 'od zer gyis 'khor 'das kyi 'byung bzhi dang 'dod yon gyi bcud thams cad bsdus te thim/ zhu zhing 'dres pa las 'chi med ye shes kyi bcud len chen po 'dod pa lnga'i sprin 'phro bar bsam la/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta smo zhes sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas slob pa rnams 'dus pa la me tog bkye bsdu sogs byas nas/ 'di skad ces/ 'o na gnas skabs su sku che'i 'gal rkyen zhi nas 'chi med che'i dngos grub thob pa dang / mthar thug tu sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang thob nas rang gzhan la phan bde rgya chen po sgrub par bya/ de'i phyir du rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa lha gcig bum gcig gi tshe dbang zab mo zhu snyams par mdzod/'di sngon skyes bu ras chung bas/ ye shes mkha' 'gro grub pa'i rgyal mo la lan gcig gsan pas sngar sku che'i 'phen pa zhag bdun tsam yin pa/ mi lo bzhi bcu zhe bzhir 'phel/ bod du yang slob ma gzhan la ma gnang / rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje kho na la phul/ phyis kyang skyes mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gi bar chig rgyud kho nar bzhugs shing / skyes mchog des mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan bzhin bka' rgya bkrol/ chos 'dis sa steng kun khyab/ sa —249—

dge bka' gsum gyi grub mtha'i zhal 'dzin so sor mdzad pa kun yang gzhan don 'phrin las 'di ka kho na'i sgo nas mdzad cing / bod gangs chen gyi ljongs kyis mkhas rmongs thams cad kyi phyag len rgyun gcig pa yin zhing / de lta bu'i tshe dbang nus pa kun ldan 'di nyid sgrub par bgyid pa la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ sbyor chog maṇ+ḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba gdab pa yin la/ bla ma dang mgon po tshe dpag med pa'i drung du tshe dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ snyims pa me |dzi dang bcas/ thal mo sbyar la gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba/ /de ring pond pa'i rin r+ṣa gter/ /gtso bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni/ /gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyi/ /blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri'i steng du/ rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i rigs bdag bla ma 'od dpag med pas rgyas gdab pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i mtha' bskor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / sangs rgyas byang sems kyi tshogs ma lus pa dang /dbang phyug ma tshe ring mched lnga la sogs pas bskor te bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar/bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dang / khyad par du yang srog bcad pa sogs tshe thung gi las ci dang ci bsags pa thams cad bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag —250—

skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum/ oX swā bha ba: ma dag pa'i snang cha nas/ mos gdung drag po dang 'brel bas zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar las/ rang gi sems nyid zhes pa/khyed rang rnams kyis sems nyid ces 'don pa spos/ 'di'i rjes zlos 'tshal/ oṃ badz+ra a yu khe sogs/ dri med gzhom zhig sogs/ zhes gsol ba btab pa rgyur song ste/ spyi bor rigs bdag bla ma 'od dpag tu med par gsal ba la mos blo dung byas pas/de'i thugs ka'i yi ge hiXlas 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ rang rang so rbe'i tshe yar ba/ nyams pa/ gzhan gyis ngan thabs byas pa/ 'dre srin gdug pa can gyis bla tshe khyer ba/ ban bon mthu bo ches bla tshe brkus pa la sogs pa'i cha shas thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags kyi phye ma len pa ltar 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du byas/rigs bdag bla ma 'od dpag tu med par gsal ba'i phyag gi bi zla ru'i lhung bzed kyi nang du zhugs/ gzhi gnas kyi bdud rtsi dang 'dres/ dngos grub kyi tshul du 'o bzangs kyi 'o ma lud pa bzhin bun chil chil lud pa de nyid bo ba zegs pa cung zad kyang med par rang gi dbu gtsug tshangs pa'i sgo nas zhugs 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas rnams gang / dbang bzhi bskur ba'i tshul gyis sku lus kyi khyon thams cad khyab/ lus kyi zungs dang sems kyi rten du gyur te 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang rgyud nga ridapal ldan bla ma thugs rje can rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi sku tshe mi 'gyur ba g.yung drung / mi 'jigs pa rdo rje/ mi nub pa rgyal mtshan/ mi 'chad pa chu bo'i rgyun lta bu/ sku tshe —251—

nyi zla dang mnyam pa/ 'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lo brgya thub cing sogs/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra swāhā/ yang spyi bo'i rigs bdag bla ma 'od dpag tu med par gsal ba la mos blo dung mdzad pas/ de'i thugs ka'i yi ge hi las 'od zer lcags kyu'i dbyibs can bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros te/ gling bzhi'i dbus na gnas pa'i ri rgyal lhun po rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ de'i 'og na gnas pa'i gser gyi ri bdun/khor yug lcags kyi ri bo/ gangs chen ti se la sogs pa'i gangs ri/ ri bo 'bigs byed la sogs pa'i brag ri/ ma la ya la sogs pa nags ri/ spos ngad ldang la sogs pa spang ri/ rtsi shing nags tshal la sogs pa'i gling thams cad la khyab par gnas pa/ mdor na 'byung ba sa khams kyis bsdus pa'i bcud thams cad rdo khab len kyis ltags kyi phye ma len pa ltar 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus zhes pa nas/ su pratikhyi'i bar gong bzhin/ yang spyi bo'i rigs bdag nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros te'i bar gong bzhi/ lha yul na gnas pa'i rol pa'i mtsho bdun/ klu yul na gnas pa'i ma dros pa'i mtsho/ da lta 'gro ba mi'i spyod yul du gyur pa/ chu mig lding ka chu bran/ chu klung / bye ba brag brgya la sogs pa brlan zhing gsher ba/ mdor na 'byung ba chu khams kyis bsdus pa'i bcud thams cad rdo khab len sogs nas/ su pra ti tsho bar gong ba smi/ yang spyi bo'i rigs bdag nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros te'i bar/ lto rta gdong gi me/ brdabs pa dang btsubs pa las byung ba'i me rgyu nus pa thog med/ gling bzhi kun gsal gyi rgyal po gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i nor bu 'od chags/ lha mi'i bkrag mdangs gzi —252—

'od thams cad rdo khab len sogs nas/ su pra ti glu'i bar gong bzhi/ yang spyi bo'i rigs bdag nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros te'i bar/ bde 'gro gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad dang/ rang bzhin lhun grub rlud gi dkyil 'khor chen po dang / yang zhing g.yo ba rkyang ser lhag pas mtshon pas rlung khams kyi bcud thams cad rdo khab len nas/ su pra tidzi'i bar gong bzhi/ yang spyi bo'i rigs bdag nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phro te'i bar gong bzhin/ lha/ klu/bdud/ dmu/ btsan/ rgyal po/ the rang / ma mo/ gshin rje/ 'jig rten dregs byed ma lus pa'i tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rdo khab len sogs nas/ su pra ti khri'i bar gong bzhin/ yang spyi bo'i rigs bdag nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros te'i bar gong bzhin/ rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams dang / khyad par steng phyogs 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba tshe dpag med/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhang khams na bzhugs pa'i 'dren pa 'od dpag med la sogs pa/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub brnyes pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / bcom ldan 'das ma rnam par rgyal ma/ 'phags ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la sogs pa tshe'i dngos grub stsol ba'i lha tshogs rnams dang / lho phyogs dpal gyi ri yid pham par byed pa'i gnas na bzhugs pa'i 'chi med dbang po sha wa ra/ pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas na bzhugs pa'i slob dpon pad+ma 'gyung gnas/ nags tshal dra ba can na bzhugs pa'i ma cig grub pa'i rgyal mo la sogs pa dbang bcu las/ tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin gyi gnas mngon du mdzad pa rnams kyi thugs rje'i byin rlabs ma lus pa rdo khab —253—

len nas/ su pra tikhyi'i bar gong bzhi/ slar yang bzhi pa'i don du mos pa 'di bzhin mdzad par zhu/ rang nyid rgyal ba tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i spyi bo'i rigs bdag 'od du zhu nas thim pas/ che'i srad bu la yig 'bru gsum ba la'i rgya thag la nas 'bru 'byar ba lta bu/ spyi bor zla gdan la oṃ/ mgrin par pad+ma la ā thugs kar nyi ma la hu/ rang lus sa chu me rlud bzhi/ bcud 'khor 'das kyi bsdus pa lnga'i dwangs ma gong bu gcig pa/ dwangs ma lnga ldan 'od kyi lus/ skye 'chi med pa rdo rje dngos/ mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo mngon du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bkra shis tshe brtan dpal gyi zas/ /snying po bsdus pa'i bcud 'di ni/ /de ring bu yis bza' bar bya/ /'di zos sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ /zhal mthong gyur la the tshom med/ /oṃ a ma ra ṇa dzi wan tī ye spru hā/ tshar gcig kho na byed na/ 'og nas 'gyung ba'i tshe phur gdab pa man chad bya'o/ /brgya tshar sogs mang du bya bar 'dod na/ 'di skad bya ste/ slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ tshe bum stong pa'i ngang las/ rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i ngo bo hri las 'khrungs pa'i mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med ye shes kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung bcas bzhugs pa/ dri med zla ba'i rgyab yol can dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal mul ba'i spyan sngar dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ sa gzhi spos kyi sogs bya/ yid 'phrog rma byas bkur —254—

ba'i khri steng na/ /tshe dpag med mgon rdo rje'i skyil krungs can/ /gzhon nu'i mtshan can chos rje grub dbang po/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum bzang 'dzin der 'dud/ /drin can bla ma'i ngo bo tshe bum lha'i rang bzhin du gsal ba la mos gus dung pa mdzad pas/ de'i thugs ka'i yi ge hru las 'od zer lcags kyus dbyibs can bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ rang rang so so'i nas/ cha shas rnams dang gi bar gong bzhi/ phyi rol 'byung ba bzhi'i nang na gnas pa'i 'chi ba med pa'i tshe'i bcud/ zag bcas 'khor ba pa/ zag med mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshe dang bsod rnams thams cad ma tshang ba med pa 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ bdud rtsi'i rang bzhi du gyur te/ rang rang so so'i spyi bo'i chas pa'i sgo thad na bzhugs pa'i tshe bum lha'i rang bzhin can du gsal ba'i phyag gi bum pa'i nang du zhugs/ bum nang nas dngos grub kyi tshul du chil chil lud pa de nyid bo ba zegs pa cung zad kyang med par rang gi dbu gtsug tshangs pa'i sgo nas zhugs/ 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas thams cad gang zhes pa nas/ su pra ti khye'i bar gong bzhi/ oṃ a ma ra ṇa: phyin drug stobs kyi sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags/ /mi'i seng ge phyin drug stobs rtogs nas/ /snying rje can gyi grong khyer 'jug pa na/ /phyin drug stobs kyi sgra ni grags par 'gyur/ /phyin drug mthar phyin tshe yang 'phel bar ye|ga /tshar ci tsam byed kyang / maṇ+ḍal bsdus pa phul la/ yid 'phrog rma bya nas/ 'di'i bar skyar gin byed pa yin no/ /mthar 'jug tu/ de ltar bde chen ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi lus kyi nang thams cad gang / skye ba snga ma rnams su nyon mongs pa dug gsum/ dug lngas kun nas bslangs te/ sems can gzhan gyi —255—

srog bcad pas/ tshe 'di'i tshe thung ba'i las sgrib bag chags thams cad sbyangs/dwangs ma lnga ldan zhes pa nas/ mos pa mdzod kyi bar gong bzhi/ snying gar tshe phur gdab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ spyi bor rgyal ba tshe dpag med dkar po'i phyag gi bum pa las bdud rtsi dkar po lud pa dbu ma'i lam brgyud/snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ lte ba nas rgyal ba tshe dpag med dmar po'i phyag gi bum pa rmos/ bdud rtsi dmar po dbu ma'i lam nas gyen du 'phyur ba snying gar nyi mar gyur/ nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su rang sems hṝXdamar po'i dkyil du 'chi med srog gi ngo bo a dkar po dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can/ ro rkyang gi rlung gi ngo bo ā li ka li'i phreng bas nyi zla kha sbyor rgya gram du dkris/ bskal pa'i bar du rkyen gang gis kyang mi shigs pa'i 'chi med srog gi tshe phur btab par bsam/ srin lag gnyis su hūX dmar po mgo phyir lta res phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad bsrung bar bsam/ oX badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūX/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor rtsa ba'i bla ma/ mtha' bskor du brgyud pa'i bla ma'i tshogs kyi bskor ba la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ de thams cad kyi 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum pas spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing / mthar rang la thim pas/ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i byin brlabs kyis 'gyur med tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa 'tshal/spro na brgyud 'debs rgyas pa bya/ bsdu na/ bcom ldan tshe dpag med mgon/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti phug gsang sngags sdong po/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/dbang phyug mi la ras pa/ chos rgyal zla 'od gshone nu/ bde gshegs khams pa rdor rgyal/ skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon/ spyan lnga grags pa 'byung gnas/—256—

yang dbron chos kyi spyan ldan/ thugs sras spyan snga rin ldan/ shrī zur phug pa chen po/ 'bar ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang / de nas/ g.yag phrug sangs rgyas dpal ba/ mkhas grub gzhon nu seng ge/ kun mkhyen chos rgyal dpal bzang /pan chen shākya mchog ldan/ lta lung gzhon nu chos grub/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog /'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ yang na/ skyes chen nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ skyabs lce 'jam dpal rgya mtsho spre bo chos kyi rgya mtsho/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog /thugs sras lha dbang grags pa/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ da lta nyid du/ 'dug sa 'di nyid du/ mi zad tshe'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /mi 'gyur brten pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /sra brtan g.yung drung dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /mdangs rgyas lus kyi bde stobs 'phel ba dang / /ngag snyan brjod pa'i rang sgra bde ba dang / /gsal dag sems kyi 'char sgo bskyed pa sa /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis rlobs/ /de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung snyams pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs bya/ tshe dbang legs par thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'khul/ lus longs spyod dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po thams cad lha dang bla ma la 'bul cha shas kyang longs spyod du gsol snyams pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag dran du sogs bya/rjes chog ni mdun bskyed mchod bstod sngar ltar bya/ yi ge brgya pa bzla/ su pra ti sgra pa brtan bzhugs bya zhes pa'ang stan gcig pa byams pa 'gro phan bzang po sogs don gnyer 'gas —257—

gas95 bsdo kyig ba/ tra///sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo//rin chen mthing sngon lta bur gsal ba'i sku//mtshan dpe'i gzi ldan 'od kyi dra ba can//mthong thos dran pas phagaso ngaganas spong ba'i//mi 'khrugs lha yi mchog khyod phyag gi gnas//ring du sbyangs pa'i rnam da khyod 'od dkar gyis//mtha' yas rgyud don ku mud ta yi tshal//legs par phye ba las byung cho ga'itshul//ma 'dres go bde'i ngag gis bshad kyis nyon/'dir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugasapa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas gshin po rjes su 'dzin pa'i nyin gcig pa'i cho ga la/spyor rgaco/ rjes gsum gyi/dang po ni/gzhi bzang po'i steng du/ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor dgram mtha' bskor du dbang ldan nas g.yas bskor mtshams 'dzin dang /chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lngaphyogs mtshams su mdzes par bshams/lhor gtor ma cha gsum dang rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu bum pa la sogs pa 'og tu dgos pa thams cad tshogs par byas te stan la 'dug nas/gnyisapadangos gzhi la/bdag bskyed/bum bzlas/mdun bskyed bsgrub cing mchod pa/'jumi cing dbangablang ba/tshe 'das rjes su bzung ba/dkyil 'khor chen po'i mjug gi bya ba dang drug las/dang poni/glu tshe a mṛ te hūX phaṭa/ces brjod pas bgegs bsangs/tseX( su bhā wa shu khyu sarba dharma/ swa bhā wa shurnyo rdo3haX gis stong par sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/oṃ wo/byung ba'i zin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/oX zhu ba las/'byung ba'i lhas rdza las grub pa'i rdo/da yon/me tog/bdug spog mar me/

dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo dang phan gdugs la sogs pa'i mchod rdzasabasam gyis mi khyab pa dwangs shing thog pa med pa sa dang nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar bsams la/ de'i sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ rol mo ji snyed pa'i sgra bya zhing / dharma ra ṇi la sogs pa brjod do/ /de nas bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro ci nus byas nas/ cho se/ thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la/ de ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /snyam du sems bskyed de/rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba la gnas pa'i huX gi 'od zer gyis/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang rbacomaldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub semasadapa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oX badz+ra sa mā dzaX zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas sego labyazhing / nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru khyuX na mo a khyo khyu sa pā ri wā re khyuX chos dbyings mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rjes rtag tu mya ngan mi'ada' bar/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don sgrub lhur mdzad pa'i/ /bco༅ldan mi'akhrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣi khyu sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaX/pur+sha dhu pe ā lo ke ga rnye nai wi t+ya/ sha p+ta pū dza mo gha mu dra slar ṇa sam ye phoXzhes pas mchod/ dkon mchor+sha/ gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum gyisargyun bshags bya/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom nas/ oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra ga bha wa at+pa bo ste ni haXgis dngos po thams cad stong pa nyid du yun ring du bsgom ste/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa go /de —260—

na~X sbyi pa'i ngang sdus glang po r+ṣa btegs pa'i rin po cha yi /khri pad+ma dang zla ba 'a dal 'khor gya steng du/huX las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūX sa mawo pa de las 'od 'phros/'phags pa mchod/sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/mis la sprus thaXl thim/de 'a sna gyur pa las/bdag༈pye ye bcamarde' 'das zhabrugs pa sku mdog in+t+ra nā ma bzhag gi//zhal gag phyagaganyas pa/g.yas snra gnon dang /ri zu mnyam 'a — steng na rdorje dar gyi 'dzin pa/ral pa' thor cog can/ na po tshe' spyan sna tsho gos/dang/darasheshams thabs can/mtshan 'di de po nga gis bzhags dang /dpe byad bzangapabargyad cus spras pa/rdorje skyal mo krung ༷sa bzhugs par bsam/denang rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya gnas gsum tu gtugs la/kāX ka na/lan gsum bzlas pas byin gyis/brlabs/te/dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni gzhi dang po'o//de nas snying ga'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thamasacad mi 'khrugs pa gtso bor gyur ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i rnam par rdoX/ badz+ra sa mā dzaXzhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/mdun gyi mu ge ge de ri ge ge pa la/ ar+ghaX swāhā/zhes pas mchod yon phul/sa ldan sa mi de bzhan gde/gas pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa~X rdzogs pa' sangs rgyas (ldi/kris pa 'khor dang bcas pas/bdag dang mas can rnyi//sa ji sgyu myo / nas snying ga khri brlab snrogasol/zhes gso'/ // btab pas/rang la ma nas/ nga gan pad zla steng du/sa su bskyod pa sngon ye she/sde pa ba5bzhag / phyag rgya can/shar du rnam ༵nga dkar pa byang chub mchag ga phyag rgya

can/ lhor rin chen 'gyung ldan ser po g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon mnyamabazhag gi phyag rgya can/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyagargyacan/ byang du don grub ljang khu g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon mnyam bzhag go phyagargya can/ thams cad kyang dar gyi na bza' dang / zin po che'i rgyan gyi brgyan pa/mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang / dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od dang 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ /de ni gzhi gnyis pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣi khyu sa pā ri wā ra ar+gha pra tī tsa pū dza re spugasamu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hū/ de bzhin du pā du/ pu zhe la sogs la'ang sbyar/phyag rgya bcasapas ma rdzo la/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar bzhug pa g.yas su bskor zhing / rnam dag pa rje zhi dbus kyi lte ba la/ zhes sogs brjod pas/ bstod par bas ma mo/ /de nas rang go snying ga'i mibaskyod pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i ste du/ gzungs sngags sbrul 'khyil ba lta burabakod la/ de las 'od 'phros ngan song thams cad zhi bar byas/ slar 'dusasnying ga'i chos kyi yi ge la thim par bsam zhing / na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ cha ka ka ni kā ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ tra sa ni tra sa ni/ prati ha na prati ha na/sarba karmā pa ra pa ra ṇi me swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas la/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol bag kha/yi ge brgyapalan gsum brjod pas/ bsgom bzlas kyi byin rlabs brtan par bsam la/ slar yang bdaganyid lamachod bstod bya ba'i phyir/ mchod rdzas rnams bsangs sbyangs byin gyis rlabs nas thal mo sbyar—262—

la/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnam ga /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod/ /oXsarba ta thā ga ta a khyo khyu sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra titsā pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye huX/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang / sngags rnams go brjes la/ me tog dang pulpe/ 'dugaspos dang dhu pe snang gsal dang / ā lo ke dri mchog dang ga rnye zhal zas dang nai wi du rolamo dang shasta rnams kyis ma rdzo la/ rdo rje dril bu dkrol zhing / oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi tā/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saX pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bzhi slo tra pra tsa li ni/ pra dz+nyā rī ra mi ta na da ga bha watwa/ badz+ra satwa triXd ya sa rto ṣa ṇi huX hāX hūṃ ho ho ho a khaX swāhā/ zholas ro lo bu 'byor bar 'bul lo/ /de nas dril bu 'dzin pas/ rnam dag pa' dbus kyi lteb la/ /rab brjid glang po pad+ma zla ba'i gdan/ /sa bon huX las rgyal ba'i skur bzhes/pa'i/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku mdog sngon po mtshan dpes legs brgyan zhing / /phyag g.yas sa gnon phyag rgyas 'gro ba 'dus/ /g.yon pa mnyam bzhag steng du rdo rje 'dzin/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyaga'atshal lo/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kun kyis dbang bskur zhing / /byamasadang dngos grub kun gyi rtsa ba ste/ /snying rjes sems can kun gyi sgrib pa sbyong/ /bcom ldan: shin tu tshogs bsags ye shes 'byor pa'i sku/ /nges tshig ldan pa yid 'ong dag pa'i gsung / /nam mkha'i rang bzhin gdod nas rnam grol thugs/ /bcom ldan mi: stobs bcu'i dbang phyug rigs lnga'i sangs rgyasarnams/ /ma lus 'dus pa bde gshe/gas kun gyi gtso/ /rgyal ba kun las lhagapa'i thugs rje can/ bcom ldan: thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dpal gyi be'u nas/ /—263—
