sa bon 'a las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis//rges song sdug bsngal rnga/sbyong mdzad pa'/ /bcom ldan de ltar bstod cang 'a ba she pa mthus//pa'i sdig sgri khams gsum sems can thams /da kya//thogs med bsags pa' /ga —ba bag chag/sa kun//bcom ldan ma 'khru/gas mgon posasbyang du gsol/lko pas bstod de bdag bskyed do//gnyis pa bum bzlas ni/rnam rgyal bum pa'i rka du/dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba dang /rdo 'a me tog phreng ba dang spos pa bsal/amra tas ba~Xs/kyil 'khore gyi sde shā/stongapa' ngang las/paX las dang pad+ma dang a las zla ba dal 'khore gya steng du thoXlas rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings/pa/dpag 'a gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/nang chu dang bcud thams/ngo 'isayongs su gang ba 'a dbus su/paX las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad paltebar/glang po tshes btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan/'dab 9ri rkyo sho/rta / tsho/ :gri rten/'a brgyad la zla ba 'a je mi 9 /rang ngag nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang ba gya gnas nas/rdo rje 'khrugs pa 'khore dang bcas sna spyan chigo yo ༷rabaḥtha/nas/rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags dang phyag rgya bya/ dad pa dang dam ga ges//khrinardegashe/gas tshur gshe/gas bcom ldan 'das//bdag la mchode yon bzhes nasapa ri //ma rdzo pas 'ad la dgyes par ma sgo/oX sarba ta mu 'a a nā bh+ya sapa bcasang ma pa lha smi/zhes pas spyan drangs shing/gil dbus kyi gdan gri/gas/pa 'khordo ra bcas bum ༵ nang du byon par ga tshes la//bus kya gdan steng du/bcom ldan 'das 'khrugs par / ༷cha a rgyu ri la ltar sngo ba zhol nas/

rdo dzhai la mo krung kyi bzhugs pa'o/she/dzi pa'i bar gyi cha me shi /ye she du lha ma pad+ma can dkar rma zhes pa nas/'ad zar daXkau/ tu pa 'phra/ba 'a/shaṃ//rdopas lha ༵ rnams gsal btab la/oX da ta thā ga phri ak+ṣa khyu sa pā wā ra an+taXprapū dza gha sa mu dra spa je ṇa sa ༷ rnyi huX/de ba༈ du /la mo'i bar sngags dbug ong cas pas 'a la/ba tshan dpes rab mdze/rda rje nga bzhu ltar sti nasagasal ba 'a sku//mtshan rdzo rab ma~X rda rje la krung 'a//rdorje dngadzos 'a ༷mche sa gnan mdzad// zhabrugs she~X legs ba thang se 1 5ge'i//lha yarnga ba ltar rnam kun tu//le spru paX rtag du mi 9 bsha/da nga ḍi sgra//yan sku pe sdig cus tsho yo pa kyis sgrags pa'// ༷brugs rgyalab 'a gsung la 'i shas rgya ma spri dzo ṇa gi bus ma par mi//sda thob ci/rna / rdzupar 'khra/la ba sa/sa can//da zha rlung 'brashā /she par g.ya ba /༵sdigs rgyal sa sa dus gsum rgya~X ba yan tan ba'i 'phrin 'a// shas rang bzhan shi tha 'a de ༷pe stan nas// 'khrugs kau⑪la ba 'a 'an lasardenang gi mi pa//bkra rdzu lha ma sa/sa//storngo pa/dza te/bumanang 'a zhabrugs pa ༷༷ra dang ba~Xs pa' btsoX ༷/ra zla brnyi nga dugazungs sngags kya 'phreng ba bkad pa la dmags te/ga ba la kāX ka dgazhabor rnams la rang rang gi sngags ci nus dang /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shi ye snyusma' spyo/ mu sdizhes sogs ca 'grub bzlas pas/lha so so'i sku las ye shes bdud rtsa 'dzag pas ga pa 'khrud nges kyi ye shes kyi chu nus ldan du byin gyis brlabaX nas/sngar bzhi ma rdzo mu rtse/dung chos kyi chu phul bas ye shes pa gshegs par bsams rdo/6ya ge brgya pa lan gsum gyas brtan par bya rdo/

gsum pa dkyil 'khor ra bsgra/ba pa ni/ ras bris zhal phye la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ 'a yo bo bha wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paX las pad+ma dang raX las nyi ma'i dkyil 'thor gyi steng du/ huX las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa huX gis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las/rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur dang bla re/ phyi rol ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ de'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ baX laX bhāXlas byung ba'i rin po che'i gzhal yas khang / sna tshogs rdorje'i stegs bu lo gnas pa/ gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa phyi nas rim pa bzhin du/ dkaraser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du/ /rin po tshe'i pha gu ser pos bskor ba/ de'i steng du rin po che'i bre phul gyis bteg pa'i gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su/ chu srin gyi kha nas byung ba'i dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / dril bu dang / me tog gi 'phreng ba dang /rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can 'phyang ba/ de'i steng nas thur du 'phyang ba'i slad 'a yab dang / de'i steng na rin po che'i dra mig gseng ma'i pu shus bsgor ba/ rtsigapa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la gnas pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas mchod byed pa/ sgo dang sgo khyud kyi mtshams dang grwa bzhir zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje nor bus spras pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rdo rje'i gdung zlum de'i steng du rdo rje'i spu5gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur buragyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che'i tog gis spras pa sgo bzhi'i steng gi —266—

thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis btegs pa'i rta babs rim pa bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtser mor/ pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / gdugs dang/ ltasagayon du ri dwags pho mo dang / snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan lasogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho ser nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma bgyod pa'i lte bar glang po tshes btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ pad+ma dngazla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ hūX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa las/ gtso bo sgrub thabs ltar bskyed/ 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du shar du shaX las dpal be'u shaX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ lha mo pad+ma can dkar mo g.yas na dpal be'u 'dzin pa/ ltor paX las pad+ma paX gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'od ldan ma dmar mo g.yas na pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nubatutshaX las gdugs tshaX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ mdangs ldan ma sngon mo g.yas na gdugs 'dzin pa/ byang du shaX las dung shaX gis mtshan pa yongasasugyur pa las dri med ma ljang khu g.yas na dung 'dzin pa/ shar lhor tsam lasa'akhor lo rtsa gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ 'jigs byed ma dkaramogayas na 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu dh+waX las rgyal mtshan dh+waX gyis mtshan pa/yongs su gyur pa las gnas bcas ma sngon mo g.yas na rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/nub byang du kaX las bum pa kaX gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las dkar sham ma dmar skya g.yas na bum pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du maX las gser nya maX gyisamatshan pa yongs su gyur pa las yid gzhung ma ljang khu g.yas na gser nya 'dzin —267—

pa/ lha mo brgyad po thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ phyag g.yas pa rang rang gi phyag mtshan thugs kar gtod de 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yon khu tshur sta zur g.yon du brten pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/'dzum zhing yid du 'ong ba'i rnam pa can rin po che'i rgyan dang / dar sna tso spus kyi sham thabs kyas mdzes pa/ zla ba'i gdan dang rgyab yol can/'od zer dpagatu med pa 'phro bar bsam mo/ /de nas dzaXhūX baX hoX zhes brjod pas/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bodang ge nyes sumed par gyur bar bsam ste/ dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'o/ /de nas sngar bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltarasngags dang phyag rgyas gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zera'aphros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das mi 'khru/gas pa lha dgu'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la/ sangs rgyas dang byangachub sems dpa'i tsho gis kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaX zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngagasadang phyag rgyas spyan drangs par bsams la/ spos dang bcas pas/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ /tshur gshe/gas tshur gshe/gas bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /mchod pas bdag la dges paramadzod/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta yak+ṣi khyu sa pā ri wā ra e phya hi/ dzaXskyoX baX hoX pad+ma kam la ye stum/ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ spyan drangs pa'i bcom ldan 'das 'khorartedang bcas pa steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsams la/ mchod pa rnam pa lngasamachod/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bstan te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ud bha ba ya snyasmazhes pas lha thams cad mnyes par bsam ste ye shes pa spyan drangs pa'o/ /de nas dzaXhūX baX ho ༷ ༷—268—

spyan drangs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' rnams lha rang rang gi thugs kar bzhugs par dmigs la/ sems rtse gcig tu gtan nas/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdus sems can gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs bar bsams la/ gco bo la gzungs ci nus bzla/ 'khor rnams la/ oX maṅgalaX shri bta sa bā na ye swāhā/ oṃ ma ṅga laX pad+ma swāhā/ oṃ ma rgo laX tsha traX gas sma oX maṅgalaXshaX kha swāhā/ oṃ ma ṅga laX tsakra swāhā/ oṃ ma ṅga laX dh+wa dza snyam oX maṅgalaX ka la sha rdzahā.oṃ ma ṅga laX ma ta su swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas la/ dkyil 'khor brtan bzhugs byas te/ mdunabaskyed sgrub pa'o/ /de la mchod pa'i phyir gtso bo las cha gcig chad nas/ shar sgor gnas parabasams la/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis rlabs la/ thal mo sbyar nas/ mchod yon phal cher ma sgo yon bla re dang / /ma rdzo yon bko pa'i 'od zer rab h+phu ske /'di yon sna tshogs kun tu bkram byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po rgyal ba sras bcasarnamachod/ ces dang / pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i so so'i phyag rgya thos la/ oX sarba ta sprugata ak+ṣi khyu sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra titsā pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye guX zhes pas mchod yon dang / de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang sngags gong 'og thams cad 'dra bar byas lkame tog phal cher dang pur+sha/ bdug spos dang / dhu pe/ snang gsal/dang / ā lokedri chang dang / ga rje/ zhal zas dang / nai wi bya/ sil snyan phal cher dang / oX sarba ta thā ga ak+ṣi khyu sa pā ri wā ra sha rto pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye guX zhe༅dang rol mo ji snyed pa'i sgra bya zhing / dharma ra ṇi ta la sogs pa brjod/ de nas bkra shis rta ta/ brgyad 'bul ba ni/ mgon po thugs rje chen pos byin rlabs pa'i lha rdzas las grub rin chen dpal be'u mchog /rgyal ba sras dang bcas la dbul bar bgyi/thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ lko dang / pad skor sngon du 'gromaso—269—

so'i phyag rgya cas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣi khyu sa pā ri wā ra maṅgalaXsgrub d+ma bāX na hūṃ dza megha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye huX/ zhes dang de bzhin du tshigs bcan dag sngagasagong 'og thams cad 'dra bar byas la/ lha rdzas las grub rin chen pad+ma mchog ṣesadang / ma ṅga laX pad+ma zin chen gdugs mdzes mchog /dang /tsha traX ga /dung dkaramachog dang / shaX kha/ 'khor lo mchog dang / tsakra /rgyal mtshan mchog dang/ dha dza/ bum pa mchogo dang / ka la sha /gser nya mchoge dang / ma t+pa pū dza me gha sa mu dra sla ra ṇa sa ma ye huX/ de nas/ oṃ las rin po che sna bdun sprul te/ glosarba bid pū rapū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya/ ā brta ya ho/ zhes brjod cing / bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā gta asne bh+ya sapā ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pū dzi te huX/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/ /dbul zhing 'phongs pa rgyun bcad nas/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /ma ṇi rat+na: btsun mo rin chen 'di phul ba ga /tsharig mun pa rgyun bcad de/ khres rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wa ste rat+na: blon po rin wo 'di phul ba ga khyinang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab rmedzen zhing/ /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /ma lto 1 rat+na: /glang po rin be waṃ phulabs/ /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas/ /bla med theg par rab bzhon te/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hasti rat+na /rta mchog rin wo waṃ phul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog go shugasarna—270—

༷ ring/sna/'a zhing du she dzo shog/tu raX ga a shwa rat+na daltos she na 'ad da baX//nyan she sa ni zis rgyal she/phasakya rgal ༷ tshar bcad da//bsnyangs bral mchag ༷rde sa~Xg/'i she go ba~Xd cang she/de nas 'dod yon lnga 'bul te/kha dug cing ma si she yengadakyi nga she//phyags dus kun 'a brtse ni shā/ ༵chag/ du ma ye//mas/blas(dkya' ga/ skyes lha la bdag 'baX/ gya//'a bla mad grub pa dzi te stsal du gsal//༷ sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣa khyu sa pā ra wā ra rū pa ka ma gu ṇa pū ta huX/de bzhi du/phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i//yon to kho lo gosgra0tshe myo / lbo grub / rke rkar tsho rtse ni/ sa ra rnasnyan / ste 1 / rnams//mas ye shag (zha~X ༈gas dus ku/ na she bzhes shi dang/sna she nag sags she byad rna~Xs/oṃXgen ge:ba ye kau bye mchi ༵/sa kun na ༷( ༷ bcud lda/ ////lusaXmasardertas byed ro mchog/ ca na 'khri/rnams/'a blas bzhus ga ras phyagasarderngo spun na 'jam lte she sa zhes shi pa'/oX/ra rdzo/ku sa pa ri/ byad rnams//mas pa dzi bas shag sarba ta thā gta ak+ta bh+ya sapāwā ra spa ra she ka ma gu ṇa pū te huX/lko pas mchod do// 'ide nas rdo rje dril bu ༈na pas dbyangs snyan dzi bstod de/chos dbyings ye po yirdebyaX 'i sa bdag nyad/she/sku gsum mag she sa rjes wo she //'gra ba 'a she sgra~X ma sdu sngi swod pa/she/bcam srin mad ri bci/sa tshe ca ༵gnaswāb bzhi la/ da gron gas la 'dakyi dra//nya ma bya ༷ 'ad miX ba ba //mtshan/ dpas rgyan tre 2 'ad dra ba can//bca5ldan ga lda/

rdo rje skyil krung rab bcings nas//bdud 'dul mnyam bzhag steng na rdorje can//thor gtsug lha yi na bza' mchog mdzes pa//bcom ldan khyed gsungasngags zab rtag tu dus gsum mam//lan gcig/ bzlas pas las kun zad pa dang //mtshams med sbyong dang bar chad kun sel ba'i//bcom ldan khrigasabris lus la btags pa tsam gyis kyang //dus man 'chi spong snying rjes dud 'grosogs//'chi tshe rna bar bsgrags pas ngan 'gro bzlog/bcom ldan migangagi ched du ming smos brtse ba yis//brgya stong 'bum phrag gang rung bzlas brjod kyis//dmyal bar skyes pa'ang mod la thar mdzad pa//bcom ldan migazhan yang khrus dang brab sogs bya ba dang //mchod rten la sogs sdig chen sbyongabayis//sna tshogs thabs kyis thar pa'i bde ston pa//bcom ldan mi khyed thugs mkha' ltar spros kun nyer zhi yang //spangs rtogs mkhyen brtse'i nyi zla skar tshogs kyis//log blo'i sgrib sel dge legs kun mdzad pa zhi/bcotshaldan mi stobs sogs rgyal ba'i yon tan rin chen gyi//'byung dzinas 'gro ba'i re bskong dpag bsam shing //'phrin las phan bdes nam mkha' khyab mdzad pa'i//bcom ldan ye shes tshad med bzhi'i ngo bo nyid//'phags la༅rnam thar brgyad rnams rnam dag cing //bcom ldan 'phrin las bkra shas kun mdzad ma//bkra shis lha mo brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo//de ltar bstod pa'i dgoba'i 'gro ba kun//nyon mongs las kyi sgrib pa kun byang nas//gzungs sngagasaphan yon la sogs 'grub pa dang //tshogs gnyis mthar phyin byang chub mchonathob shog/ces pas snyod de 'das pa'i lha ma rdzo pa'i cho ga'o//de nas gtor ma rnamasachu

gtsang mas bran la/dang po phyogs skyong dang /gnyis pa 'byung po spyi la cha gsum ltar dbugagasum pa cha gsum ltar bgegs gtor sbyin/gtor ma phyi rol du dor la/khro bo'i sngags kyis mtshams bcad de/'jig rten pa gtor mas mchod pa'i cho ga'o//bzhi pa 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni dkyil 'khor gtso bor rang gi sngar mi 'khrugs pa'i dbang zhus pa'i bla mar mos la/'jug pa'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul te/dga' chen khyod bdagaston pa ste//slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol//byang chub rtsen po'i tshulabastan pa//mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo//dam tshig de nyid bdagalastsol//byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol//sangs rgyas chos dang dgo'adun te//skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol//thar pa chen po'i grong mchogatu//mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/zhes lan gsum brjod pas gsol ba btagadakon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi//sdig pa thams cad so sorabashags//zhes sogs bdag bskyed ltar rgyun bshags lan gsum byas la/skye( tsa tre/༷me ban+ta wa ra a ma na ya hūX/zhes dang /ras dmar pos mig dar bcings tsobs ma/a khaX lī rahuX/zhes me tog gi 'phreng ba blang /oX a mṛ te huX phaṭa kyis bgegs bsangs lgabu khyod rdesu yin ci la dga'//skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o//de yi bu lacizhig bya//sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go/de nas/snying gar kun rdzob byangasems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/de'i steng du don dam byang sa sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa bsams la/rdorje reg chi/chas bo yo gtsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi su ra te sa ma ya stuX/ho sidhi badz+ra ya tha su khaX/kho pas rtan yobasams la/rdo rje mgo bor bas ste/deng lha rwa 1 3 de bzhin gshegs pa thams/cang kyi

rigs su zhugs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes pas gsang bar gdams nas a khaX swe ra hūX/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi chung du zhugs par bsams/ oṃ na ma te huX/ oṃ na ma me hūX/ na mon ma phoX zhes lus po kho da gsum dang bas phyag byas la/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/rang mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i sku lus la/ mdun bskyed kyi lha thams cad kyithugs ka nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ye shes lnga'i rangabazhin huX gi rnam par byon nas lus la char bab pa bzhin zhugs nas/ snyingagar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ye shes sems dpa' hūX gi rnam parazhugs par bsam la/ de bzhin du a yig dmar po dpag tu med pa byunganyeb sbu'i bu ga nas sib sib thim pas/ sems rgyud ye shes lnga'i ngo bor byin gyis rlabs par mos la/ rdo rje dang dril bu gnyis ka lag pa g.yas kyis mgo bo'i steng du dkrol zhing /gzungs sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya a a a/ zhes bas/spyi bo za rdorjebazhug ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes brjod cing brtan par mos la/ oṃ pra tisnro badz+ra ho/ zhes pasadakyil 'khor la me tog phul nas/ oṃ pra ti gro hā stuX/ i maX satwa ma hā ba la/rdorje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ khyebs—274—

thams cad mthong gyur bas//rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu hū a/dmi 'khor la lta bar bskul ba'o//'jug pa'i cho ga'o//gnyis pa la dbang bskur ba dngos dang /mtha' rten sbyin pa gnyisalas/dngos gzhi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la//mchod chen dziltar stsal ba ltar//bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir//nam mkha'i ri rdo rje dengabadag stsol//zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab la/rang nyid dbang stegs kyi dbus na rdorje mi 'khrugs par gsal ba'i stong du gdugs dkar po g.yas su rgyal mtshan/g.yon du ba dan/phyogs kun tu rnga bo che dang /dung la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/rang gi snying ga nasa'od zer 'phros pas/dbang go lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khore gdangabacas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar/oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza de bzhin gshe/gas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag la mthon par dbang bskur ba stsal tu gsol/zhes gsolardeb btab pas/dbang lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas/sangs/rgyan/spyan/myam ki/gos dkar mo/sgrol ma ste rigs kyi yum bzhi'i phyag na bum pa dag byed bdud rtsi'i chus gtams pa bsnams nas dbang bskur ba'i las mdzad/ji ltarabaltams pa tsam gyis ni/lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/lha yi chi dgapa yis/de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/kwa ka ni'i mas tu rmas bta thāg ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hu/zhes brjod cing /bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las ngan sdig sgrib dag par bsam pa ni chu'i dbang ngo //de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya spyi sibatsā27

la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ud bha we swāhā/ zhes brjod cing / spyi phyag rgya borabazhag pa'i rkyen gyis mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsam pa ni cod pan gyi dbang ngo / /de ltar rang nyid bya ba'i rgyud kyi rdorje slob dpon chen por gyur pa la/ mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod nag bya ba'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'bor chen por zhugs/ chu dang cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba thob/nyon sgrib dang shes sgrib dag /chos can dang chos nyid gnas gyur/ gzugs kyi sku dang chos kyi sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba can du byas so/ /go da barberta ska5 bskyed dran par bya ste/ dngos gzhi'o/ /gnyis pa mtha' rten sbyin pa la/ khrus byab bsrung ba gsum gyi dang po ni/ 'di ni khrusamachog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ oṃ mthi laX shrī bat+pa bā na sarba pā paX shin+taX ku ru ye swāhā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /zin chen butshapa mang po spos kyi chu/ /yid long legs par bkang bas glu dang gi /rol morabacas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ oṃ ma sge laX pad+ma nas shin+taX ku ru ye grwa sma 'di ni spyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa/ /gtong ba dri yisalegs bsgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o/ /oṃ ma ṅga laX tsha treXtagashin+taX ku ru ye swāhā/ de nas tshig rkang dang po'i sbyin pa'i gnas su tshul khrims dang serasna'i gnas su khrims 'chal dang / gtong ba'i gnas su tshul khrims sbyar lka tshe mtho/laX shaX kha nas/ ku ru ye swāhā/ de bzhin du/ bzod pa dang khong khro/ oṃ ma ṅga laX tsakra nas/ ku ru ye swāhā/ brtson 'grus dang le lo/ oṃ ma ṅga laX dha dzanas ku ruye—276—

swāhā/bsam gtan dang rnam g.yeng /oṃ ma ṅga la ka la sha nas/ku ru ye snyusmashes rab dang shes 'chal/oṃ ma ṅga la ma t+pa sarba nas/ku ru ye swāhā zhes brjod cing /bum chu cung zad btung ba dang /gdong pa la byug pa'i tshul byas nas gzungs tshar gcinabarjod pa'i rjes su/sarba pā pa shin+ta ku ru ye swāhā/sarba bisna na sarba dz+wa re bh+ya ra sarba u pa dra be shin+ta ku ru ye swāhā/sarba gra he shin+ta sam kwa lan+t+ra du sa bo durasu ba ni dur ni mi ti sarba tsi ta smya ku lo shin+ta ku ru ye grwa hā/denas la ga pa g.yasakyis rma bya'i mjug sgros byab pa'i tshul du bya zhing /gzungs kyi mthar/sarba pā pa a pa na yeswāhā/de bzhi du sbyar te/sarba bighān sogs gong du brjod pa rnams kyi mthar/a pa ni ye swāhā/zhes brjod cing /de nas bgegs slar mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir/gzungs kyi mthar/sarba bisnan khyu rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/zhes brjod cing spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su rdo rje bas la bsrung ba bya'o//de nas spyi bor me tog cung zad cig gzhag la/rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing/ston mchog dam pa sogs sho lo ka gsum gyi mthar/nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs//nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing //nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa/khyibasamachog gsum gyis bde legs stsol//oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/gtso bo 1 sadziltar bka' stsal1 pa//de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi//zhes la ni gsum brjod/dbang thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rags tu maṇ+ḍal phul/deng nas brtsams te bdag dranadu/khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na/khyod kyi slob mar bzung ba dang/khoshas kyis kyang spyad du gsol//zhes lan gsum brjod de/bdag nyid 'a lcagacing dang blang ba'o//lnga pa gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu tshe 'das rjes su 'dzin na/sngar spyor ba'i skabs su dkyila'i khor gyi lho phyogs su sbyong stegs khru gang ba'i pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su/277

'khor lo dkar po rtsibs ba glo pa bri/de'i steng du rus pa'am/ming byang bzhag/sbyang ba'i yo byad dang /bye ma'am yungs kar la sogs gshin don la dgos pa'i yo byad la sogs pa thams cad bsham mo//de nas bdag 'jug yan rdzogs par bya/bzlas pa'i skabs rnams su bye rma las yu༅༅kar la sngags kyis brabs la bzhag/ go/de nas ming byang la sogs pa'i rten de/a mṛ tas bsangs/snya spre/stongardepa'i ngang las sbyong stegs kyi steng du/tshe 'das kyi ming gi yi ge dang po wo/ṇi las/tshelas 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba'i phung po dang /khams dang /skye mched thamasacad yongs su rdzogs pa gson po'i rnam pa ji lta ba bzhin du gyur par bltas la/rang gi snying ga'i huX dang tshe 'das kyi snying ga'i ṇi las 'od wos pa gatshe'adas kyi rnam shes khams gsum gang na gnas pa nas bkug par bsam/khamasagasum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ngag tu/rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang /chos kyi bden pa dang /dgo'adun gyi bden pa dang /gsang sngagasardedang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi bcom ldan 'das ngan song thamasacad yongs su sbyong ba thugs rje'i bdag po mi 'khrugs pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang /bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba/khams gsum skye gnas bzhi//gas drug gang na sa nas kyanga'adir mchis par gyur cig/oṃ ṭak+ki huX dzaXzhes pa gsum dang /bdag dang mdun bskyed kyi bcom ldan 'das ge sgor dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/tshe 'das la thim pas tshe 'bor ba thog ma med pa nas278

bsags pa'i sdig pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas rnam par shes pa a dkar po dri ma med par bsam mo/ /denas bgegs sbyang ba'i phyir/lteng༅ho la bskor zhing / oX sarba spre na maXsarba ta thā ga spyo/ bi shwa mu khebh+yaX sa bon khaX ud ga te spa ra ṇaX i maX ga ga na khaX gro sno daX ba li ta ye swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis zhibs sbyangs/ za brjod/ rdo rje gsor zhing / ting lo dang oṃ bu rten la bskor ba gsu༅gyis zhis/phyed nas sbyangs nas/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo la gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa labar du gcod cing / gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la bar chad byed pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad gtor ma 'di lam rngan/ tingalolam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnasapar gzhan du song shig /ces brdzod cing rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ huX ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo r+pā po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'du thab/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal/ /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyi gshegs su gsol/ /oX badz+ra kro dha rādzas pā ri wā ra e hre his spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma kam la ya stuX gyis gdan phug o.a baXpuṅge dhape/ ā lo ke /ga rnye/ ni li du/ shasta huX gis ma rdzo/ skyoX chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing/ /thabs la mkhas pas 'jig byed skur ston pa/ khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogasalaphyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang / /sku yi cha lugs—279—

za byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras/ /ma lusadabang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing / /sdig pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug can rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa/ /sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bskal ba me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyangabaskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyi sdang mig gis / /bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gtum chen dus mtha'i tshe ltaragazi brjid 'bar/ /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngaslapa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrogs/ khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyaga'atshal bstod/ /'jigs pa'i hū sgra nges sgrogs shing / /bgegs rnams ma lusa'ajoms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra laphyag 'tshal bstod/ /rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan blam dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / wo pa nas/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo la/ gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas des tshim par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i rdo rje 'bar zhing cher 'bar ba 'dis/ khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar dgas par bgyi'o/ /zhes dang / rten la gu gul gyis bdug /yungs kar gyis brab/ rol mo rtag tu bya/ swa khyu/ ni la —280—

sogs pa'i drag sngags mang du brjod pas/ bgegs dang bral bar bsam mo/ /de nas/ tshe'adas kyi sdig pa thams cad ka nag po'i rnam pas sna bug nas thon/ sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pas til la thim/ de'i g.yas su me dang / g.yon du chu gdor bsasdig sgrib thams cad sregs shing sbyangs pa bsams la/ o sarba pā pa da ha na badz+raye swāhā/ zhes brjod pas mer bsreg cing chur dor ro/ /de nas bye ma'am yungs kar la kā ka ni la sogs pa lha thams cad kyi sngags mang du bzlas/ de'i nus pa thams cad bstim la/ rus pa'am ming byang mdun du bzhag pal brab ske kā ka ni'i 'jug tu sarba na ra ka ga te he tu na hu phaṭa/ tshe las 'das pas ga kho byasapa'i sems can thams cad kyi dmyal bar skye ba'i rgyu las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad rtsa ba nas byang zhing dag par gyur cig /de bzhin du kā ka ni dad sa sgo pa te ga ga te he tu na hu phaṭa/ yi dwags su skye bo'i rgyu: de bzhi du tirla kag te he tun hū phaṭa/ dud 'gror skye ba 'a sogs gong bzhi sbyar zhing / de nas khrus bya stas rgyal bum pa thogs la/ thog mar dkyil 'khor me long bstan te/ ji lta bltams pa sogs dab /'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabasaye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ /oṃ yo ta thugata sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mngapo spos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /glu( sarba ta thā ga ta/ sogs kyis khrus gsog de dag sku 'a/mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /o hwa tra hrī a kā ya bi sgo( dha ni swāhā/ zhes pas sku phyi'o/ /de nas khrus byas pa'i chu de slar yang bus pe'i —281—

nang du blug la de nas bum chus nub gong ma rnams la me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba la bkru/tha ma la rten dngos su bkru ṣ+ka /'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu//ser sna'i drim spyongamadzad pa//gtong ba dri yis legs bsgos chu/khrus legs mdzad kyi khrusabya'o//de bzhi du tshig rkang dang po dang /gsum pa'i gnas su/tshul khrims/bzod pa/brtson 'grus/bsam gtan/shes rab rnams gzhug rkang pa gnyis 7kro ser sna'i gnas su/khrims 'chal/khong khro'i/le lo/rnam g.yeng /shes 'chal/rnamasabacug la/tshig bzhi pa lnga pa dang /chu bo drug gis khrus byas nas//bag chags rnamadrug sbyangs nas ni//gang la nyes pa mi mnga' zhing /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo//dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas//bag chag/sa rnam drug sbyangs/nasani//rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa/khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'//dri ma rnams drug dag pa yis//yon tan thams cad ldan pa dang //sangs rgyasathams cad mchod don du//dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o//zhes pho tshig rga pa dang /kāX ka ni/re spel zhing bkrus nas/mthar/tshe las 'das pa tshe go mo se/gtsobyas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi pha rol du phyin pa drug gi mi mthun pa'i sa saphyogs dag nas/pha rol du phyan pa' yon tan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig/'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum//'di dag 'jig rten dugagasum ste//sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'//sangs rgyas bden pa'i dug bcom mo//tshig rkang gsum pa dang bzhi par/bcom ldan dam chos sgro dmachosabaden pas 'phags pa'i dge 'dun dge 'dun bden sgro zhes sogs sbyar ma tshig bzhi pa gnyis brjod cing /dkon mchoX hwa gyi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis

tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i nyon mongs pa dug gsum gyi sgrib pa thams cad bcom nas dge ba gsum dang ldan par gyur cig /sa ni dug gi pha yin te/ /sa ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis/ /dug gsum sayi nang du song / /chu me rlud du 'don pa bsgyur ba'i tshig bzhi pa gsum brjod pa'i rjes gatshe las 'das pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi 'byung ba bzhi la brten nas skyes pa'i rnam rtog rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i chos nyid kyi ngang du thim nas sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig /ces bya ba dang / bum pa'i chu gtor/ dril bu gsil zhing / gang la so sna rnatshachags pa/ /rnam 'joms dri ma med mdzad cing / /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing / /chos rnams thams cad ston pa de/ khyed la: ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gang la bde ba mnga' mdzad des/ khyed la skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi/ /thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ khyed la: /gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi rten ci gyur ga /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/ khyed la: /gang zhig chos kun ye dron sus gyur/ /gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la/ /gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des/ khyed la: dpa 'bo chen po gang skyes pa/ /phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor zhing / /don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des/ khyed la:gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni/ /nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing / /sems can thams cad snab —283—

dga' des/khyed la byang chub snying por gshegs pa na//sa dag rnam drugagayos gyur zhing //bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/khyed la chos kyi phroralo bskor ba na//'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing /khrig pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/khyed la yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed//thams/cad chos kyas pham mdzad cing //tshogs rnams dbang du mdzad pa deg khyed wo sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad//brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang/'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni/khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig/sangs rgyasabasod nams mthu dag dang //lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis/khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa//don de de ring 'grub gyur cig/rkang gnyis khyed skabade legs shog/rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog/phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog/wo mo bde legs mtshan bde legs//nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing /khyed cag kun tu bde legasardegyur/khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig/tshe las 'das pa che ge mo se/tshwa byasapa'i skye rgu thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu bkra shisashing rgyal bar gyur cig/ces brjod la/de nas bu la sogs pa nye du yod na ming byang lo thi du bas cing /phyag byed du gtso la/gtso bo rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon//'gro bskyob pa'i don brtson pa//stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la//tshe 'das skyabasasumachi lags so//de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos//'khor ba'i 'jigs pa selob dang //byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang //de bzhin tshe 'das skyabs/sumachi//tshe 'das 'jigs pa che mthong nas//kun tu bzang la tshe 'das 'bul//84

'jam pa'i dbyangs la tshe 'das kyi/ /lus ni bdag gis dbul bar bgyi/ /thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba'i/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang / /nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod/ /sdig ldan 'di la skyab tu gsol/ /'phags pa namamakha'i snying po dang / /sa yi snying po dag dang ni/ /thugs rje'i bdaganyid thamasacad la/ /skyabs tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod/ /gang zhig mthong na gon na rje yi/ /pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams/ /skrag nas phyogs bcur 'byer byed pa/ /rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi/ /sngon chad khyod kyi bka' las 'das/ /da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas/ khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis/ /'jigs/pa myur du bsal du gsol/ /tshe las 'das pa tshe ge mo/ /zhes bgyi ba dus 'dinas bzung nas byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ brgyud ldan bla mthugasarjes can/ /lha jo bo dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang / dza gro yā 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba thugs rje'i bdag po mi 'khrugasapa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' nye ba'i sras brgyad dang bcas pa thams cad la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /sdig pa thamasacad sbyang du gsol/ lam bstan du gsol/ myur du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ spyo snying thag pa nas bsgo cigagasol ba 'debs par bsam mo/ /de nas gshin po la dbang mi bskur na 'og gi byang bu bsreg pa dang lam sbyang bstan sogs rdzogs par bya/ dbang bskur na skabs 'dir bya dgos pa gamaṇ+ḍalaphul nas rjes zlos byed par bsam zhing / dga' chen khyod bdag sogs nas dbang thamasacad rdzogs par bskur ro/ /de ltar dbang bskur bas tshe 'das lha'i rang bzhin du gyur pa la mchod —285—

yon la sogs pa sngags tsam gyis ma rdzo/gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sal sogasapasho lo ka gcig gis bsto 1 da la/lam sbyang bstan bya'o//yul kha cig na zas gtad dang/gos/lhamagatod pa sogs kyi lugs yod pa de ltar byed dgos byung na/sngar ltar mchod bstod 'gad sbyo/ rjes la/'dod yon sna tshogs pas tshe 'das lhar gyur pa mchod par bsam zhing /kha dog da—bsalegs sogs 'dod yon gyi tshigs cad brjod do//nub tha ma la byang bu sreg par byed na/chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsams la me sba ge/stong nyid ye shes 'bar ba'i me//tshe 'das sgrib pa'i bud shing dang//ge grordebaX sdug bsngal ma lus pa//ye shes snang bar 'bar gyur cig zhes pa/kwaX ka na brjod cing bsreg go/de nas lam sbyang bstan bya ste/nub gong ma rnams lam rdzo t+yā rjesari/nub tha ma la 'a bu bsregs pa'i rjes la bya mu dril bu bsil/me tog /ra/dkon mchogarden chen dpal zhang du//dkon mchog ran chen las byung ba 'a//dkon mchogarderin chen 'od zer gyis//rin chen 'phreng ba rnam dag pa//tshogs/kyi la5dngartsa ri mu pho ri)'a ba 'a lam//mthong 'a lam dang sgom pa lam//byang /ba bar chad med pa' lam/// na med pa'i khyad par lam//zu pa sgyu /par grol ba lam/dgal/oṃ/brten nas ga pa kun sbyangs te//'phags pa lam der 'gro bar shog ra sne ra sne/mahā ra sne/rat+na sam+bha we/rat+na kir sne/rat+na myal bi chu/sho dha ya/dri 6 pā paX nāX tra tha/(khi rnyi rol sdi bya/pad+ma 'dam 'a ma gos ltar//srid gsum — mas ma gos pa'// da pa' pad+ma las byung ba 'a//mngon par dga' b.raskyebar shog/oṃ pad+me pad+me/pad+ma paṃ bha we a bhi nan+da rte swāhā/zhes brjod nas rol mo bya ste/mngon par dga' bar skyes pa/ ༷sam/der skyes pa'i byang sems/rnying pa

rnams kyis phyis de la mchod par bsams la/ mchod cing rol mo bya'o/ /des kyangasangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod cing / ro lo tshe sto /deraskyes pa'i rgyu brtags pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi cho ga'i nus pa yin par shes te/rdzu 'phrul gyis 'dir 'ongs nas/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor la mchod cing rolamo byas la/ e ma sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas/ /e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs/ /gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid labazhag /ces ched du brjod par bsams la/ bdag gis kyang slar de la mchod pas mchod cing rol mo bya/ slar yang mngon par dga' bar song bar bsams la tshe tog dor/ de nas tshe 'das kyi don du smon lam rgyas par brjod cing / 'khor gsum mi dmigs pas rgyas btab ste/ gzhin po rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga'o/ /drug pa rjes kyi cho ga ni/ gshin don yin na lam sbyang bstan tshar ba'i rjes dang/slob mdabang bskur ba yin na/ dbang chog tshar ba'i rjes sam/ sgrub mchod rkyang pa yin na/ bdag 'byo/tshar ba'i rjes la mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ bsangs sbyangs/ byin gyis rlabs nas mdun bskyed la phul bar bsam zhing / ngag tu/ dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ khrigs yon myob mchos/ 'di dag /bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /o sarba tā thā ga ta ak+ṣi bha sa pā ri wā ra ar+gha pra titsā pū dzatshegha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye skyo/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad 'og ma gnyis 'drab lga chuskyes thang skyes yid las byung / /byang chub yan lag me tog 'di/ pu tshe lhan cig skyes dang sbyar las byung / /a kar la sogs bdug sposa'i de/ dhu pe/ rtsimar 'bru mar mar me 'di/ /mi shes mun pa sel ba'i phyir/ ā lo ke /tsan nag —287—

pur la sogs pa/ /lhan cig skyes sbyar dri mchog 'di/ ga rnye/ gzugs/sgra driroreg bya yis/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /bla med bdud rtsi'i zhal zasa'i de/ /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ ni wi du: de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /bdag gis dad pas 'bulalags kyis/ /ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol/ /sha p+ta zhes dang rol mo 'kha/de nas dril bu bsil zhing / nam mkha'i mdangs ltar kun nas gsal ba'i sku/ sogasabum bskyed kyi skabs ltar sho lo ka bzhi yis bstod la/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ wo 'dod pa'i don lagasol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum la sogs pa brjod pa'i rjes la/ gang yang bdag lho rtog te mug pas/ /legs spyad 'di la nyes pa gang / /gang phyir lus can skyabs gyurapa/ /de ni mgon pos bzod par gsol/ /gtso bo nus pa ma mji sa pas ma'abyor ma rnyed ma 'tshal bas/ /'dir ni bgyi ba gang bgyis pa/ /de dag thamasacad bzod par mdzod/ ces sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskang zhing nongs par bzod paragasol/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ma thob kyi bar du rgyal ba thams cad mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye bragatuyang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid la spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thamasacad dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad brtan par—288—

bzhugs su gsol/ bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la de ngosagrub ma yus par stsal du gsol/ zhes dang / o su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye snyasma zhes lan gsum gyis brtan par byas shig me tog gtor/ de nas dril bu gsil zhing / ston mo chog dmapa lha mos mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog/sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral: chos la phyag 'tshal: sems can gang de dag: tshogs kyi dam pa: dge 'dun phyag 'tshal: sems can: de dag:bdag cag 'khordo ra dang bcas pa thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las shin tu rgyal bar gyur cig /ces brjod la rol mo bya zhing me tog gtor rdo /slar yang bsngo ba smon lam rnam par dag pa btab la/ ras bris bkur bstodang bcas pas bsdus ladaben par bzhag /mchod rdzas dman pa rnams mgon med pa dang 'phongs pa rnams la sbyin/ gosardezung sogs mchod rten dang sangs rgyas kyi sku la phul nas las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /rabazab ngan song rgyun gcod cho ga'i tshul/ 'khrul med brgyud pa'i dgongs don ji bzhin du/ khyud 'grel mkhas pa'i ring lugs dpang bzhag nas/ nyung gsal go bde'i ngag gis rnam par rbakod//'di sbyar dge bas mar gyur 'gro ba kun/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas las rnam grol zhing/ tad byung byang chub spyod pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i zhabs drung skye bar shog /bcomoldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga nyung ngu rnam gsal zhes pa 'di yang brgyud pa gong ma'i gsung thor bu pa rnams/ gzhan phan gyi blos phyogs gcig tu bsdebs te/ btsun pa grol mchog gis yi ger bkod pa'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan par gyur cig/ //gcig zhus/// ma ṅga la//—289—

zur 'debs 'jug bde rnam gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs/bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga'i zur 'debs 'jug bde rnam gsal zhes bya ba/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo//gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i dri mas ma gos pa'i//me long ye shes gzugs snang lha yi sku//legs bzhengs mi 'khrugs mgon la gus btud nas//gang 'dir cho ga'i zur 'debs bshad kyis nyon/'dir bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga la ras bris dang rdul tshoni la brten pa gnyis las/dang po shes sla ba dang/nyin gcig la cho ga rdzogs pa'i dbang du byas te/de'i tshul kho bos nyung ngu rnam gsal du bkod zin la/gzhung de la bltos pa'i dbang du byas nas/'dir rdul tshon gyi phyogs brjod na don gnyis te/sngon du bsnyen pa dang /dkyil 'khor las kyi rim pa'o//dang po la gnyis/rnal 'byor dang bcas pa'i bzlas brjod dang /dus rgyun gyi bzlasabarjod do//dang po ni/khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/gnas dben tso/sangs rgyas kyi rten gyi spyan sngar ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa dang /gtor ma gsum 4zhams la/stan bde ba la 'dunasgemachod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te bdag nyid lhar bskyed pa nas mchod bstod kyi bar sngon du btang nas/rang gi snying ga na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshe/gas pa rigs lnga'i dbus kyi gtso bo mi bskyod pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du sngags kyi ye ge sprul 'khyil ba lta ja//9ḍi las 'od zer 'phros 'jig rten gyi

khams thams cad snang bar byas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ 'od zer slar 'dus te rangalathim pas bdag nyid kyi tshe rabs thog med nas bsags pa'i las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par bsams la/ sems ma yengs par bzlas brjod ci nusabya/ thun gtong ba'i tshe slar yang mchod bstod bsngo ba smon lam bya ste/ thun mtshams su bskor bdang / tshwa tshwa la sogs dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' bar bya zhing / sgod thun gyi mthar gtor mchagasum btang la/ phyogs skyong rnams bsnyen pa'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du sgrub khang gi phyogasardematshams su zhal phyir bstan nas bzhugs te bar chad bsrung ba'i las mdzad pa bsgom/ gtoramaganyis pa'i skabs su/ lha klu 'gyung po'i tshogs rnams sgrub pa po la dges shing bar chad bsrung bo'i bsam pa dang ldan pas rang gnas su bzhud par bsam zhing / gtor ma gsum pa'i skabs sga'abyung po gdug pa can rnams dpag tshad dam rgyang grags kyi bar du bskrad par bsam la mtshams gcod kyi sngags lan gsum bzlas/ rang nyid 'khod pa'i gnas khang rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba gur bla re phyi rol du ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+rarak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de ltar bsnyen bsgrub kyi bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du dkar gsum la brten pa'i gdan gcig gam gdan gnyis bya/ phyi dro'i kha zas/ sha chang sgog btsong la phug /rang gi kham 'phro rnamasaspangs/ snod mkhar ba dang lo ma dang lag mthil rnams su mi za/ de ltar gtsang sbra dang ldan pas 'bum phrag bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa'i tshul du bzlas te/ mthar grub na bcu che'i sbyin sreg bya/ mgrub na tsha tsha mang du btab/ thun gsum gyi rnal 'byor gyi sgo nas nyams su blang ba ste/ sngon du bsnyen pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /gnyis pa dus rgyun gyi bzlas brjod ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs brgyud —291—

bskul bas bsnyen pa'i rgyun de nyid mi nyams par bya ba'i phyir nyin re bzhin skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor mthar bsngo ba smon lam gyi bar du 'chag med kyi tshul gyis nyams su blangs pas/ las gcig las gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad byang bar 'gyur ba dang / mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa ma lus par zad par 'gyur ba sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa mdo las bshad do/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi rim pa la/ sa'i cho ga dang / sta gon dang / dngos gzho'i chogadang gsum gyi dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gang du bri ba'i gnas su cha gsum ltar gtor ma gsum bsham/ mchod pa lnga dang / yungs kar dang / gu gul la sogs pa'i yo byad rnams bshamasalkaslob dpon gyis bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas sngon du song nas/ gtor ma dang po phyogs skyongal phul ba'i mthar/ phyogs skyong 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sa'i phyogasa'i derabadag la stsal zhing dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga mthar phyin pa'i sdong grogs mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod de/ phyogs skyong las bslang ba'o/ /de nas gtor ma gnyis pa'abyung po spyi la phul la 'byung po'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis sa phyogs 'dir bdag la gnang zhing zhes sogs brjod pas bslang ste/ 'di gnyis ni zhi bas sa bslang ba'o/ /de nas bgegs ge torabasngos la gdon khyod rang gi gnas su song / zhes pa'i 'jug tu/ sa'i phyogs 'di nyid na gnas pa'i 'byung po gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba rnams dang / dkyil 'khorachen po sgrub pa la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren gyi rigs gang yod pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshims par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig /ces brjod la gtor ma sgo drung du dor ro/ khro tho'i sngagasabarjod cing rol mo drag du bya/ sa phyogs gu gul gyi bdug /yungs kar gyis brabs la bgegs —292—

rnams byer bar bsams pa ni drag pos bslang ba ste/sa bslang ba'i cho ga'o//de nas phyogs skyong dang 'byung po rnams gshegs su gsol/rang mi 'khrugs pa'i nga rgyal gyis kāX ka ni bzla bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi sa'i dbus su lag pa gnyis ka ba theg la/skye tshe bhu khaXzhes nyer gcig brjod pas/sa gzhi nam mkha'i rang bzhin du bsam/lkoX ha na ha na kro dha hūX phaṭa/ces ma bdu bzlas pas/sa gzhi rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsams te/sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangasoba'o//de nas kāX ka ni/bzla bzhin du de tsam byed pa'i sa gzhi mchod pa'i gzhi dang bcas pa dri bzang kyis chus byug/ga dar legs par bya ba ni las dang bya bas sbyang ba ste sa sbyang ba'i cho ga go/de nas slob dpon rdo rje dril bu'i 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'dug la/hūX badz+ra ahākhyu/a haX/zhes pas mi 'khru / gas pa'i nga rgyal gzung la/bdag gis sa'i phyogs 'dir/bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su spyong ba thugs rje'i bdag po mi 'khrugs pa'i dkyil 'khor bris pa sems can gyi don rgya chen po bya'o//zhes sems bskyed pa ni blos bzung go/de nas rjes chog tu bshad pa ltar byas la/bkra shis brjod de nub dang po'i cho ga'o//gnyis pastagon la spyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/sa chog byas pa'i gnas su thig chen brgyad tsam mam/'og nas 'byung ba ltar las thig rdzogs par btab la/lha'i gnas su dri'i thig le dang me rtagagotshom bu tshang bar bkod/sa lha'i tshom bu yang bkod la bzhag/mtha' skor du mchod pa dang gtor ma dang /bum pa dang /'og tu slob ma sta gon la dgos pa'i yo byad rnams kyang tshang bar bshams/de nas dpon slob rnams stan la 'khod de mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa dang /skyabs 'gro nasabi rtsams te bdag bskyed rdzogs par bya'o//gnyis pa la bzhi/sa lha sta gon/bum pa stagon/lhasta gon/slob ma stagon no//dang po ni sa'i lha ༷ rdom bu bsangs sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las

paX las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsal btab/ rang ni snyingaganas 'od zer 'phros/ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa spyan sprir/nas gdan la bzhugs par dmigs la/ sngar gyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khore gyi stengadu sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo dga' ba dang ldan pa'i thugs can phyag g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing / g.yon rin po che'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzen pa/ dar mdog dkar po'i na bzas stod g.yogs shing / dar kha dog sna tshogasapa'i shams thabs kyis mdzes par klubs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan du mas skulaspras pa zhal gyi pad+mo rab tu bzhad cing / pad zla'i gdan la phyed krung gis bzhugs pa klu dang sa bdag tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/ de la yeng pa rnamasakyis mchod par bsams la/ oṃ pri thi wi de bī sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra tismos twa zhesabarjod la pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i so so'i phyag rgya 4'a zhing rol mo'i bar du bya/ gtor mabasangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ pri thi lī de bī sa pā ri wā ra na maXsgyu yugata thāgata sbyo/ zhes sogs lan gsum dang / nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgyas gtor ma phul te/rdo rje drilabu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad paradu/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ sku kya sengagoskyobs pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis 'dud sdelas/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khore bri/ lan gsum gyi mthar/ dpal ldan blamagong ma rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thamasacad kyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag par bya ba'i ched du/—294—

sa'i phyogs 'dir bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba thugs rje'i bdag po mi 'khrugs pa'i lha tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob mal yangadabang bskur bar 'tshal na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang bdag la stsal du gsol/ sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal nas rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig /ces gnang ba sbyin pa bsam/ de nas mchod yon phul la/ tseX( badz+ra muX zhes brjod pas/ sa'i lha mos de nyid la thim par mos la sa lha'i mchod gtor rnams phyir bsal te/ sa sta gon no/ /gnyisapa bum pa sta gon ni cho ga'i bum bskyed kyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin bsgrub pa nyid yin no/ /gsum pa lha sta gon ni/ bsangs sbyangs bsrung 'khor gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed/tshom bre'i steng du cho ga gsum gyi lha dgu bskyed la/ bdag gtso bo dang tha mi dad du bya/ gnas gsum byin gyis rlabs/ ye shes lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi spyan drangs/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod/ dam tshig gi phyag rgyas mnyes par byas nas rang 'a bstim pa sogs ras bris kyi cho ga ltar bya zhing /mchod bstod rgyas par bya ba mdun bskyed ltar bsgrubs nas/ dkyil 'khor la lta zhing pus mo g.yas pa btsugs/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ nang par spyan drangs pe'i phyirasnyan gsan dbab ste/mi zhakhru/gas mgon po bcom ldan 'das/ /rigs sngags rgyal la phyaga'atshal lo/ /bdag ni brtse bar gyur nas su/ /slob ma rnams la brtseb dang/khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal/ /bcom ldan bdag ni gus par lags/ /de bas gnang ba mdzad pa rigs/ /—295—

sangs rgyas 'jig rten mgon brtse dang //byang chub sems dpa' dgra bcosadang //gsang sngags lha gzhan gang lags dang //'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang //gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang //gang yang lha yi spyan slang ri ba'i//sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams//bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol//bdag ming 'di zhes bya yis//sang ni dkyil 'khor bzang po'i ming //ngan song sbyong ba ci nus kyis//cho ga bzhin du bri lags na//bdagadang slob mar bcas rnams la//thugs ni brtse bar dgongs nas ga/lkogasapa thams cad dkyil 'khor du//byin gyi rlabs par mdzad du gsol//go ni gsum brjod pa'i mthar/dpal ldan bla ma nas/stsal du gsol/gyis sngar rgan bya/gtor ma cha gsum cho ga bzhin rjes su sgrubs te lha sta gon no//bzhi pa slob ma sta gon lkadakyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol du/mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma khrus byas/dang po phyag dnga'aju / ga pa'i yon phul nas/gral la 'kho 1 da la/gnyis pa thog mar myang 'das kyi bsams/pa brtan po bskyed du gtso pa'i phyir/rang gi bslab ldan 'khor bzhi po//theg chen blo can rnams la ni//de bzhin gshegs pa gsungs pa yi//yang dag cho ga rjesasuganang /kha cig gsang sngags sgrub don gnyer//dkyil 'khor du ni 'a rtsan para'agyur//de bzhin gzhan gyi bsod nams 'dod//gzhan dag 'jig/rten pha rol gzhol//blo bzang phal cher dad byas nas//'jig rten pha rol don gnyer 'jug/'jig rten 'di 'bras dor nas ni//'jig rten pha rol mas gnyer na//gang phyir tshe 'di bde blag 'grub//'di yis 'jig rten pha rolamin//de phyir 'jig rten pha rol gyi//don du yid ni brtan par gyig rgol༅rde296

don bshad la/sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi sems bskyed du gzhug go/gsumardepa rna ba gtad par bskul ba ni/rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/tshen tu bsam pa brtan po'i yid kyis nyon//brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems sogasadang //bde bar gshe/gas pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob//ces gdams/phro pa khyad par can gyi don zhu ba'i phyir du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste zhesasogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab bo//lnga pa spro ba bskyed pa ni/bu tshur sgo(snyen shig thegardechen po'i//gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni/khyod la yang dag bstan par bya//khyod ni tshul chen snod yin no//sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can//dus gsu5'byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams//rdo rje sngags kyi mthu yis ni//ye shes mnyamardemed yang dag brnyes//gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med pas//gang gis/shākya seng ge sogs//mchog rnams kyis ni bdud kyi sde//mi bzang chen po stobasar+sā bcom//'jig rten rjes 'jug rtogs nas ni//ga bor lo bskor nasamyangan 'das//de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir//bu yis blo gros snya gyis shigaces brjod la spro ba bskyed/drug pa rgyun bshags bya ba ni/mdun gyi nam mkhar sogs gsal btab la/bdag bskyed ltar rgyun bshags lan gsum bya'o//bdun pa dag pa lha'i ting nge 'dzin ni/slob ma rnams skad cig gis mi 'khrugs par bskyed nas/slob dpon gyis rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas te gnas gsum du gtugs la/kā kā ni/ni re brjod pas/tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum kun rtog ma lus pa bcom/nas/dag pa de gzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i mosapa bya'o//brgyad pa mchod pa ni/de ltar lhar gsal ba la dga' ston gyi tshul/gyi 297

mchod pa rnam pa lngas mchod/ dgu pa so shing sbyin pa ni/ so shing me tog gi rtse mo ༅ rnamasadri bzang gi chus byug cing / a mṛ tas bsangs/ kāX ka ni tshar gcig gis byin gyis rlabs te/slob ma la byin la/ kha shar ram byang du bltas te tshom bu'i maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du/ tseX( badz+ra ha sa ha zhes brjod cing 'dor du gzhug de'i rtse mor shar lho/ nub byang / steng 'og rnams su pha gi na zhirgyas dbang drag mkha' spyod sa 'og rnams 'grub cing mtshams rnams su bltas na bum pa bzang po la sogs pa dngos grub phran tshegs rnams 'grub la/ dkyil 'khor du ma lhung na dngos grub med par go bar bya'o/ /bcu pa kha dag par bya ba'i phyir khyod chu sbyin pa ni/ kāX ka ni/ bzlas te byin gyis bu'i bsapa'i dri bzang gi chu khyor bar lan gsum blud cing / oṃ hi bi shu khri sdo sarba dharma/ sarba bi kalpa a pa na ya hūX/ bcu gcag pa bsrung skud ni/ skud pa dmar po lus tshad dang mnyam par gsum sgril du byas pa la/ rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum bor te/ stong pa'i ngang las huX las byung ba skud pa dmar po slob ma'i lus tshad dang mnyam par/ rdo rje mdud pa gsukhogyis bsdams pa/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar chad bsrungs ba'i nus pa dngaldan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūX las 'od zer 'phros pas stagon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi srad bu dpag tu med par byon/ dam tshig gi srad bu la thim/ dzaXhuX baX hoX/ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas/ slob ma'i dpung pa g.yon parakāX ka ni brjod cing bcings la bum chus byug cing / oX budha mā ti rak+ṣa rak+ṣa grwa sma sarba budha a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭha te swāhā/ dha ra ka phya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru ku rus twa zhes ldod/ra ri gnyis pa ku sha byin pa ni/ dhi dang ha las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ rmi lam mi 'khrugs zhing gsal po 'byung ba'i nus ldan du byin gyis—298—

baXkau/sa chel/sheX ka muX mthar dhi zhes brjod cing chung ba lag pa g.yas pa dag ha/spyobarjad nga ba g.yan du sbyan na//4sheg4tshe ni mubacu gsum pa zab ma' chas/ bsha/da pa /'ad la gsan pas khyab paragada'//'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams//res 'ga' 'byung zhing mi 'byungazur sdus/ 'i bye sku de tsho ge dzog3nge'id/se/u dum wā ra 'a tag ra rdzo/na//brgya la~X na na sa 'ga' 'byung //gang sags song pa ma bem meng ngon nge//sa kyang ni shin tu lha rmyu par nug/gsangasngags spyad zi mnyam ( dan/ci/da rma~X kyang dkyi phya tu she/'a/skal ༷ gi ba s+t+ri ma sa/sngan chad ga pa ma pa//dal 'kha/ra 'ad 'dra mthang ba sdus/she/de dag thams na sos ci ga rna na/tsho/'a pa mtha' gas bzlas na niḍikyā//spyad tshul ga med na smas ༷gas/she/skyab rjo' gsang skyi kri rten 'tsho //kring ta dri/ me : na da no 'gyur/'i/spya) mchag 'a la gang sa//bla grardzushan tu da pa//da 'a kyas spya sdug bsngal sa//nge ring ba 'a ha 'gra dged bcad/gi/ba~Xganyid chen pa khyed rnams kyas/'i/de nga she pa mnyamakha' rnyad//gang rdo da rnams sa kyi ba kun//bdag nyad chen pa sras bcas/kyā//bstan pa 'a la khyed rnams sa//yongs ḍi bzung ste skye 'gyur ba//de kyis khyed rnams snrog chen lasaX//'di ni par skye ba nyad du 'gyur//theg pa wo pa ༷ra 'byung ba 'a//zhin gshegs shā dpal dang mu//gang la khyed rnams/'gra 'gyur ba//de ban gshegs rnyir ྅gyur gu yan/kho she spud/kau baX pa 'a ma brtag pa ༷/bu kye sngud dkyal rngo༈rder da//mthang sheragyas nyal cag dang //rma lam sgro 2 ༷ gang yan pa// kun nga la drang par

sme/sa/ /zhes brjod cing sngar byin pa'i shu ka che ba gdan dang / chung ba sngas kyi tshul du gyis la nyolacig byas la/ dran pa gsum gyis gdams pa bya ste/ mi ma yin gyi bar chang 'byung b.rabya ba'i don du rang lus mi 'khrugs par dran pa dang / gnyid kyi mun byi pasangab dang myos par mi 'gyur ba'i don du snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dngos po da ltar shes par 'gyur ba'i don du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang sems lha'i sa bon hu du dran par byas nas nyol cig /rmi lam gang mthong ba snga dro nga la smros shig /ces brjod/ rmi lam ngan na bsrung ba dang / bzang na spro ba skyed/ de nas rjes chog tu bshad pa ltar mchod bstod bya/ nongs pa bzod par gsol/ dngos grub blangs la/ o khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjesasumathun pa'i dngos grub shor stsal// /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang/ /slarayang 'byor na par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum dang / lko badz+ra mu zhes brjod nas/se gol gtogs la/ lha rnams sang 'byon par bzhed bzhin pa'i sgo nas gshegs par bsam/bkra shis kyi mtha' brten pa/ nub gnyis pa sta gon gyi cho ga'o/ /gsum pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma gzhug pe'i byab gnyis/ dang po la dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / sgrub pa'i cho ga gnyis/ dang po ni 'ig gi bri ba lgashar nub ma nor tshangs thig gdab/ /de yi phyed btsal mtshan ma bya/ /de steng shar nub mtho de'i bar/ /slar yang rtags bya de steng gzung / /mtho de'i tshad kyi 'ig skud kyis/ /g.yas go sgon gnyesasu bya rjes btsal/ /de steng tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ /shar nub lta bur mtshan ma bya/ /de dngadabus bar srad bu ni/ /phyogs bzhi mtshan ma'i steng gzung nas/ /zur bzhir bya rjes btsal b.rabya/ /de steng zur thig gnyis btab nas/ /dkyil 'bo ra che chung gang byed kyi/ /mda' thig gru—300—

—bzhin gdab par bya/ /zur bzhi gsum gtubs rim pa gsum/ /phyi ma phyed du bgo bar bya/ /cha chen gnyis ni 'byung ba 'gyur/ /nang ma dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /phyi ma phyed ga dbade'i phyi'ang phyed/ /rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu dang / /dra phyed shar bu mda' yab 'byung / /dbras su brgyad cha phyis bgo'o/ /sgo de'i bzhi cha cha chung yin/ /phyis pa'i rtsa thig rtse mo nas/ /gyen du cha chung bzhibatab la/ /'phred du gnyis dang steng du gnyis/ /sgo khyud sgo 'gram sgo logs 'grub/ /de phyir cha chung re re'i sar/ /'dod yon snam bu'i phyi thig nas/ /mda' yab rtse reg thigs gsum btag /mun snam ka ba ka rgyan yin/ /de bzhin g.yon la'ang shes par bya/ /de steng rta babs sgo tshad gnyis/ /sgo tshad dang po cha bzhir bgo /rta babs snam bu bzhi ma 'gyung / /phyi ma dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /pad+ma chos 'bo ra gdugs kyi sa/ /rta babs snam bu'i phyir mtha' ni/ /dang po ka rgyan mtha' dang mnyam/ /de nas cha phran re res thung / /pad+ma chos 'bor gdugs sogs ni/ /dkyila'akhor spyi dang 'dra bar bya/ /gu ṇa ha ri'i bskor tshul ni/ /snam bu gnyis pa'i phyi gdang/ khri lngas thig 'dzom pa nas bzung ste/ /cha phran gnyis kyi dbus ma bskor/ /snam bu dang po'i phyi thig dang/tshangs thig 'dzom pa'i g.yas g.yon tu/ /cha phran gnyis re phyin pa nas/ /cha phran gcig gisagayas g.yon bskor/ /de rnams nang du phyeng re bsgor/ /g.yas g.yon rwa yis bskor tshur ni/ /tshangs phyir gsum dang mda' phyir gcig /phyin te ka rgyan rtse nas bskor/ /de nas 'phred gnyesagyen du gcig /phyin te snga ma'i tshad kyis bskor/ /de yi phyi ru cha phran gnyis/ /pad+ma'i khor yunabaskor bar bya/ rdo ra cha phran gnyis pa dang / me'i sa cha chen gcig gis bskor/ /rtsa thig nang gi bya tshul ni/ /dbus nas zlum por bskor byas la/ /de'i nang ma cha gsum bgo sto/nang gi gsum chaltabar bskor/ /de yi phyi nas cha phran phyed/ /bskor ba de ni mu khyud do/ /phyi ma gnyis po pad+ma ste /gcus nas thig gdab 'dab brgyad bri/ zhes pa ltar ro/ /de ltar las kyi thig gis chad bye ba'i —301—

rjes thogs su/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su ras la sogs pa'i gzhi'i steng du/ rdul tshon sngon po la hūṃdakar po la oṃ/ ser po la tri/ dmar po la spyiX ljang khu la a bris la phyogs ma nor bar bo kod/ras kyi thig skud kha dog lnga pa ring ba dkyil 'bor gyi nyis 'gyur sbom phra sgo'i nyi shu cha'i tshad dang ldan pa rnams rdul tshon so so'i steng du kha dog dang mthun pa chun por gcus la bzhag pa'i mdun du nyer spyod lnga bshams la/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ a mṛ te huX phaṭa/ zhes brjod pas bgegs bsangs/ swabha was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dbus dngaphyogs kyi thig skud rdul tshon rnams pad zla'i steng du huX oṃ traX hiX.a rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas sa gnod dang/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ shar du rnam snang dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ lhor rin 'byung ser po g.yas mchog spyin dang / g.yon mnyam bzhagagi phyag rgya can/ nub tu 'od dpag med dmar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/byang du don grub ljang khu g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/thams cad kyang dar gyi na bza' dang / rin po che'i rgyan gyis bgyon pa/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/rdorje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od dang 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ /de na lor pa rgo gyisarlabs la/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas so so'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ sarba ta thugata ar+ghaX nasashabha pū dza tshe gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye hū ཾ ༷/ zhes brjod la drilas glo/la zhing/chosardesku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du sosor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ rang gi mig gnyisadza—302—

las nyi ma dang zla bar bsam la/ di lta di nyu aX ku sha dzaX zhes pa la 'ag la dza kho de/'bar ba'i lta stangs kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig tsho ni rigs lnga'i rang bzhin sbyan drangs la bstim nas oṃ badz+ra tsi drasawaya hūX zhes nyer gcig brjod pas byin gyis rlabs te/ slar yang mchod bstod/ zhu ba las byung pa'i rigs lnga'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin gyi rdul tshon dang ye shes kyi srad bur gyur bar bsam zhing / kāX ka ni lan gsum bzla/ de nas slob ma dang lhan cig tu/ oX a rgyo n+ya a nu ga te/ sarba dharma spa ra spa ra/ a nu pra bi ni sarba dharma a dun ta a nu prabi ni sarba dharma/ zhes brjod cing thig skud rnams dang po so sor bsgril/ de nas gcig tu chu la la yang kāX ka ni/ bzla zhing dri bzang gis phyug /rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgyas bzung ga skye rna badz+ras ma ya su traX ma ti kra ma huX/ zhes brgyad kyis byin gyis rlabs so/ /de nas rdo rje dril bu dang thig skud bzung la/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi bden bral dadagrogs dbang ldan du gnas pas/ huX badz+ra asnyed khyu a haX/ zhes pas slob dpon rang nyid mi'akhrugs pa'i nga rgyal gzung / ma ṅga la de bi zhes pas grogs bkra shis kyi lha mor mos lkadzaXdzaXdzaX zhes brjod cing thig sna gtad/ des kyang dzaXdzaXdzaX zhes brjod cing blang / gnyis char gyi g.yon pa'i khu tshur dril bu dang bcas pas thig skud nye ba'i thad kar bzung la/ phyogs thams cad mnyam pa nyid du bsams te/ slob dpon nub dang slob ma shar du song la/ lkoX badz+rasam ya su traX ma ti kra ma huX/ zhes brjod cing / slob dpon g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas thig skud kyi dbus nas gcus te sgra dang ldan par gdab cing / de'i tshe slob dpon gyi ngag nas brjod pa bzhin nam mkha' las kyang sgra byung bar bsams la/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bshin gshegs/ /'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegasaji —303—

gsol bar/ /thig skud sgra yis bskul ma 'debs/ /zhes brjod lka nam mkha' dngas gzhi la tshangs 'ig dang po gdab/ de bzhin du slob dpon lho dang slob ma byang du gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ slob dpon me dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas shar gyi rtsa thigadang / slob dpon rlung dang slob ma bden bral du gnas pas nub/ slob dpon rlung mtshams de nyid dang slob ma dbang ldan du gnas pas byang / slob dpon me dang slob ma bden bral du gnas pas lho/slob dpon me mtshams nyid du bzhugs nas/ slob ma rlung du gnas pas zur thig dang po dgaslob dpon bden bral dang slob ma dbang ldan du phyin la zur thig gnyis pa gdab ste/ dkyila'akhor spyi las 'byung ba ltar/ slob dpon dbang ldan du mi 'gro zhing slob ma me mtshams mi 'gro' sgo nas ye thig 'khrul mang du btab la/ de nas slob dpon nub sgor phyin nas rdo rje gtsug gtor gyi phyag rgya bcas nas/ skye( badz+ra be+e ga kra ma hu zhes brjod pa'i ye thig nam mkhar bteg lkadakyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'khod de rdo rje rigs kyi khro bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ mig gnyis hri las nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hu las khro bo'i rdo rjer mos la/ kro dha tiṣ+ṭha hrīzhes brjod la sgo bzhir bltas pas thar pa'i sgo'i bar chad bsal bar bsams la/ sgo phyi nangaṣ+kartsa thig dbye'o/ /ye shes kyi thig gis byin gyis rlabs pa'o /de nas slob dpon dbusasga'adug nas g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyis chon blangs la/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya ma ti kra mah+lazhes brjod cing rtsig pa rim pa lnga phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i pañca re kha lnga ldan du dbang ldan nas g.yas bsgor gyis sgo tshang gcig gi bar du bri/ de la mchod nas rin po che'i snod bkab la steng du rdo rje bzhag la bsrung / phyis sbrel ran pa dang snod bsal la/ ngan na phyirabazlog bya/ bzang na spro ba bskyed do/ /de nas slob ma sogs kyis bris ste/ nang gi pad+ma 'dab—304—

brgyad/ phyogs bzhi dmar la me rlung ser/ /dbang ldan sngo la bden bral ljang / zhes so gos kyilugs ltar bris la/ dbus su lha mtshan rdo rje sngon po/ shar du dpal be'u dkar go lhor rma dmar po/ nub tu gdugs sngon po/ byang du dung ljang gu/ shar lhor 'khor lo dkar go lho nub turgyal mtshan sngo skya/ nub byang du bum pa dmar skya/ byang shar du gser nya ljang gu ste lha so rbe'i kha dog mtshon par bya ba'i phyi'i mu khyud rdo rje'i gdung zlum sngon po la rdo rje ser pos mtshan pa bri/ dkyila'akhor phyogs mdog /'dod yon dmar po pha gu ser/ dra phyed gzhi sngon po la phreng ba ci mdzegamada' yab dang pu shu khra bo/ rta babs kyi ka ba phyogs mdog /ka rgyan mdzes tsho ni rta babs kyi snam bu dang po dmar po/ gnyis pa sngon po/ gsum pa ljang khu/ bzhi pa ser po/ glang po'i rgyab kyinangasngon po la dra phyed sna tshogs/ pad+ma dkar dmar/ chos 'khor ser po/ gdugs sna tshogs/ rdo rje'i rwa rnams phyogs mdog /khyams ljang khu/ khor yug gi pad+ma kha dog sna tshogs/ rdo rje'i gzhi sngon po'ardorje ser po de'i phyi rol me ri kha dog sna tshogs pa bri ste/ de ltar bri ba rnams tshar pa dag thig tshoskogyi lha lamachod bstod byas nas gshegs su gsol ba ni tshon gyis bri ba ste dkyil 'khor bri ba'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bsgrung pa ni/ bum pa 'bul ba sngon du song nas/ rdzu5tshon gyi mtharadri bzang pos sbags pa'i til dkar po'i mar khus kho ra khor yug tu phye ma med par byugs la/mtha' bskor du mchod pa dang gtor ma dang 'og tu dgos pa'i bum pa la sogs pa rnams kyang tshang bar bshams/ de nas dpon slob rnams stan la 'khod de mchod pa byin rlabs dang / skyabs 'gronas brtsams te bdag bskyed rdzogs par bya/ bum pa bzla ba ni sta gon gyi skabs su bsgrubs zin pas nub dang po la mi dgos la/ sgrub mchod sbrel mar byed na 'di'i skabs su bya zhing/de nasamadun bskyed sgrub pa'i phyir/ rdul tsho ni gyi dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs nas brtsams te/ bdagagatso bo dang tha mi dad kyi bar byas/ gnas gsum byin gyi rlabs pa dang gshegs su gsol bo'i ye —305— ri

shes sems dpa'i ngo bor bsam/ mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ mdun gyi namamakhar bzhugs pa la mchod pa lngas mchod/ dam tshig gi phyag rgyas mnyes par byas nas rang la thim pas/ lha dgu so so'i thugs kar pad zla'i steng du rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang pa re bsam/ de dag gi thugs kar yang pad zla'i steng du rang rang gi gzungs sngags kyi phreng ba sprula'akhyil ba lta bu de las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi spro bsdus bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib byang bar bsam zhing / gtso bo la kā ka ni dang / 'khor rnams la rang rang gi sngags rtsi spyosabazlas pa'i mthar/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad gshegs gsol ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan parabazhugs nas kyang bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba thugs rje'i bdag po mi 'khrugs pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas bdag sogs mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad yongs su sbyong ba dang / myur du 'khor ba dang ngan song nas 'don pa'i'aphrin las mdzode cig /ces brjod la dku g.yon du se gol gtogs/ /bdag nyid gtso bo las phye nas shar sgor 'khod de mchod bstod dang / gtor ma dang / bdag 'jug rnams glogamagasal nyid3sa 'byung ba ltar rdzogs par byas la grub na dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga lag len du tshul bzhin bya ste dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'o/ /gnyis pa slob ma 'jug pa'i bya ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba nas brtsams te rtogs bskyed kyi bar bdag 'jug bzhin byas la/ mtha' rten gyi skabs su/ thog mar migs bcad dang sngagasarnams spel nas khyus byed du gzhug cing / slar yang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i rdo rje glo ma'i de rnams kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shin+ta ku ru ye swāhā/ de ba'i na du sdig sgrib kyi —306—

rba tu/ nad gdon/ nye bar 'tshe ba/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chib/ 'khron dang gyikyadang mi gtsang ba/ byad dang byur dang skal ba ngan pa/ bkra mi shis pa/ mtshan monag mo/ /bdud kyi zhags pa/ gshin rje'i pho nya/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa'i gnod pa thams cad/ rgyal po dang the rang gi gnod pa/ klu dngas bdagagis gnod pa/ gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa/ btsan dang dmu'i gnon pa spyo tshan pa re re nas bzhug cing mthar/ mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shin+ta kuru ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing khrus byas la/ de nas byab pa ni/ rma bya'i mdongs kyi dkyil du zla ba la hū gi mtha' mar gzungs sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ desaslob ma rnams kyi nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad byabs par bsam zhing/sngar gyi shin+ta ku ru ni tshab tu a pa na ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing rma bya'i sgros byab bo/ /de nas bsrung ba ni/ lus kyi gnas bdun la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ rdo rje rgya gram re bzhag pas/ rdorje de las rdo rje de 'dra ba dpag tu med pa 'phros nas slob me'i lus go mtshams med pa'i rdo rjes bsdams par bsam zhing / a pa na'i tsha snaturak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes brjod la/ slar yang slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/ dus gsus bde gshe/gas rnams kyi byin rlabs dang / /gsang sngags rigs sngags rnams kyi nus mthu yis/ /'gro ba 'di la bdag gis bsrung zin gyis/ /'di la susakyang gnod pa ma byed cig /ces re re nas brjod pa'i mthar/ bkra shis kyi rdzas stosabasangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs te/ oṃ las byung ba'i bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad/ nā ba ma rnams kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'joms shing / tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad rgyas pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par —307—

bsams la/ rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin du slob ma'i lag tu gtad de/ me long ye shes rgya mtshotsāchen po yi/ ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te/ /rnam dag chos la thogs med longs spyod pa'i/ /bkra shis des ni sgrib pa dag gyur cig /sngon rbaco༅ldan 'das la gzugs kyi lha mo 'od 'chang mas tshe long phyag tu phul ba na bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyis rlabs pa de bzhin du deng 'dir yang tshe dang ldan pa 'di rnams me long gi rdzas la brten nas bkra shis par gyur cig /de bzhin du phrog ma rnams la yang 'dra bar byas la/ gi snya thogs la/ gi ha dug gsum 'joms pa nad kyi sman/ /sman mchog chos nyid rab tu rtogs gyur te/ /nyon mongs zug rngu med par gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang nad kun zhi byed shog /sngon bcos ldan 'das la glang po tshes srungs kyis gi ha phyag tu phul ba na/ sogs kyis sbyin/shothogs te/ zho ni kun gyi snying por gyur pa ste/ /snying po rnam dag ye shes legasardertogs nas/ /yon tan kun gyis dbyings su gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyangadug gsum zhi bar shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la zhing ba'i bu mo legs skyesams zho phyag tu phul ba na/ sogs kyis sbyin/ dur ba thogs la/ dur bas tshe ni 'phelabar byed pa ste/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe ni rab bsgrubs nas/ /nyon mongs skye shi rgyun chad gyur pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshe yang 'phel bar shog /sngon bco5ldan 'das la rtswa 'tshong khye'u bkra shis kyis rtswa dur ba phyag tu phul ba na/sogs kyis sbyin/ bil ba thogs la/ bil ba rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bcas pa'i cho se/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i spyod pa kun/ /byang chub snying po mchog tu gyurapa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang don kun grub gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'dasal—308—

lha myongs pas shing thog bil ba phyag tu phul ba na/ sogs kyis sbyin/dub rbogasalkadung ni chos kyi sgra rnams sgrogs pa'i tshul/ /ye shes rgya mtsho nyid du dag gyur te/chos rnams ma 'dres yongs su ston pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang tshig la dbangathob shog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis dung dkarapogayas su 'khyi)la ba phyag tu phul ba na/ sogs kyis sbyin/ li khri thogs ga 'i shekhridamar po dbang gi rang bzhin te/ /chos rnams ma lus dbang du bsdus nasakyang / /chos kyi rgyal srid rab tu brtan gyur pa'i/ /bkra shis des kyang khyod srid brtan gyur cig /sngon bcom ldan 'das la bram ze skar rgyal gyi bus li khri phyagatu phul ba na/sogs kyis spyin/ yungs kar thogs la/ yungs kar rdo rje'i rigs te thams cad du/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms par byed pa sto /mthu stobasayon tan phun sum tshogs pa yi/ /bkra shis des kyang bgegs rnams zhi b.rashog /sngon bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes grub pa'i rdzas yungs kar phyag tu phul ba na/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas su byin gyi rlabs pa de bzhin du/ /deng 'dir yang tshe dang ldan pa 'di rnams yungs kar gyi rdzasalabarten nas bkra shis par gyur cig /ces brjod do/ /de dag gis gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung snyam pa'i 'dun pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa sogs lan gsum/gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang / deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyis/ khyod kyi slob mar gzung ba dang / /cha shas kyis kyang spyad du gsol/ lan gsum brjod de/ slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i cho ga'o/ /de nas rjes cho go ltar bkra —309—

shis kyi bar du legs par bsgrub cing / sgrub mchod zhag mang po byed na/ rdul tsho ni gyi dkyila'akhor 'di nyid la ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su garber+sha5/ zhes sogs brjod/ nub tha ma lam dun bskyed kyi dkyil 'boralamachod bstod byas pa'i rjes su dngos grub blang / nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rdul tshon gyi lha rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i de grosagrub gnang / /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas ni/ /slar yang 'byon paramadzad du gsol/ badz+ra muX gshegs su gsol la/ chos thams cad bdag med pa'i don dran par byas la/ rdo rje'i rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bshig cing / lha'i gdan la sogs pe'i mtshan marnams kyang bsdus la rol mo dang bcas pas rdul tshon mtha' nas dbus su phyogs la/ tseX( a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharmā ṇaX/ a du nud pa sno twa da oṃ āXhūX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brdod la༅/ pa'am za ma tog sogs su rdul tshon bzhugs su gsol zhing / thig rjes rnams dri bzang gi chusngabyugs la mi mngon par bya zhing / me tog sil ma gtor te bkra shis rgya cher bya'o/ /ngan song rgyun gcod nyung gsal cho ga'i tshul/ /brgyud ldan gsung gi bcud bsdus 'thor ba bsdebs/ de yi zura'adebs gsal byed nyer 'kho 'di/ /'gro la phan pa'i bsam pas 'dir bkod do/ /'dir 'ag las byung rab dkar dge ba'i rgyun/ /dung dang kha ba'i dum bu brtsegs 'dra ba/ /bdag gyi rgyud la nges par thob pa des/ /'gro ba'i las sgrib mun pa sel gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das mi zhabrugs pa lha dgu'i cho ga'i zur 'debs 'jug bde rnam gsal zhes bya ba 'di yang / brgyud pa gong rme'i gsungs thor bur gnas pa rnams gzhan la phan pa'i blos phyogs gcig tu sdebs te/ btsun pa grol mchog gis nye bar bkod pa'o// // 'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan paragyur cig/ shu lha ma stu sarba dzā ga snya// zhus dag/—310—

las sgrib kun 'jom se sa bya ba bzhugs/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab mdzes in+d+ra nī la'i lhun po ltar/ /lta bas mi ngoms mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar ba/ /mi 'khrugs mgon la spyi bos btud byas nas/ /las sgrib kun sreg cho ga bshad kyis nyon/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs nas/ sngags kyi nus pa dbyung zhing lhag chad kha bskang ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg bya ba'i phyag len la/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ yid dang mthun zhing dben pa'i gnas su gza' tshes 'dzoms pa'i dus la/ sngar sa chog ma byas na nges par byed dgos la/ de'i tshul ni cho ga'i zur 'debs 'jug bde rnam gsal du bshad pa ltar yin zhing / sngar dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa rnying pa rnams su yin na phyags bdar dang rkyang nul bya/ dang po tshangs zur gyi thig gdab/ tshangs thig dbus nas sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad kyis zlum por bskor/ de nas sor bzhi bkyed nas zlum por bskor ba mu ran/ yang sor bzhi bkyed nas bskor ba kha khyer/ de'i steng du logs thig gru bzhir gdab ste/ de'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje/ kha khyer la rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phreng ba bri/ nang gi zlum po khengs par pad+ma'i gcus thig gdab/ de yang lte ba gsum cha/ 'dab ma gsum gnyis su byas pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la lha'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i thig le bkod/gnags kyi lci skam srog chags med pas thab kyi zlum bskor dang mthun par rgyar khyu gang / zabs su khru phyed de'i shar lhor me tshang 'cha'/ mchod rdzas ni rang gi g.yon/ thab kyi g.yas su mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer mchod lnga/ me lha'i gtor ma dang bcas pa legs par bshams/ bsreg rdzas —311—
