ni rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon du thog mar yam shing / de nas mar/ til nag /zas mchog /ma btsos ma grugs pa'i 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dur ba'i myu gu/ ku sha'o/ /de la yam shing ni/ 'o ma can gyi shing gi rtse mo'i cha las byung ba/ sboms su mthe bong ngam mthe'u chung gi tshad/ srid du khru gang ngam khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i tshad/ phan tshun ring thung mnyam pa/ gas chag dang rma med pa/rgyu ma rus ba/ ngo bo ma 'khyogs pa/ de'i rtse mo gnyis mar ram/ sbrang dzom/ 'o ma la sogs pas legs par byugs pa dang / g.yin yang yam shing khru phyed dang do pa ras kyi dkris pa mar la sbags pa'i gced 'de dang / 'ched sla ba'i rtsa skam po dang / rlud g.yab dang / 'phral la dgos pa'i bud shing dang / ku sha'i chun po brgyad dang bcas pa legs par bsham/ rang gi mdun du stegs bu'i steng du bsang chu ku sha'i 'thor yab dang bcas pa/ de'i rtsa bar rdo rje dril bu/ de gnyis kyi bar du gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la bzhag go /de nas sgrub pa pos rgyan dkar po brgyan pa/ zhi ba'i bsams pas gdan nang myongs can gyi steng du tsog bu'am/ skyil krung gis kha shar phyogs su phyogs pas 'dug ste/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i bar du byas la/ sbyin sreg la 'jug ste sbyor ba'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi las/ dang po thab dang yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa'i thog mar bsang chu bsgrub pa ni/ ku sha'i rtses bsang chu la gtor la/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā wasasbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las shaX las byung ba'i dung phor tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ huX zhu ba las byung ba'i bsang ba'i chu dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rdzas thams cad kyi ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ a mṛ te hūX phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar hūṃ ring por bdun nam nyer snyag brjod la/ me sbar ba ni cho ga byang zhing blo 'khobs che na 'dir dngos su sbar/ wo na 'dir ting nge 'dzin gyis sbar/ byon zan 'bul gong spo/ thab bskyed tshar ba'i rjes la dngos su sbar ro/ /—312—

de nas lag pa g.yas pas g.yas bskor gyis rim pa bzhin/ dang po mchod rdzas rnams la bsang chu gtor te bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs/ de nas yang bsreg rdzas rnams la bsang chu gtor te/bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i bsreg rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa zhi ba'i las 'grub par nus pa dang ldan par gyur/zhes brjod la/ rdo rje khu tshur las mdzub mo gnyis bshibs pa chos 'byung gi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ a grwahwas yam shing / oṃ shrī sruhwas mar/ oṃ dzi sruhwas 'bru rnams dang / oṃ ku ru ku ru grwahwas de las gzhan pa'i rdzas thams cad sbyang zhing byin gyis brlabs so/ /de nas thab la sngar shābazhin bsang chu gtor la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ba las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hu las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po/rgyar khru gang ba/ zabs su khru phyed pa/ kha khyer dang mu ran sor bzhi pa la rdo rje phreng bas zlum por bskor ba/ phyi rol du stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ nang lha rdzas kyi bud shing gis yongs su gang bar gyur/ de nas me grub pa ni bram ze'i rgyun bzhag gam/ mar me la sngar gyi gcad 'de sbal lag gnyis char gyis bzung/ kā ka ni/ bzla zhing thab la g.yas su lan gsum bskor la me tshang du bcug ste/ o badz+ra dz+wa la ra swāhā/ zhes brjod la/ rtswa skam cung zad bcug /yang sngags de nyid brjod cing mar blugs gzar gsum gyis me bus so/ /rlung g.yab kyis cung zad g.yab me legs par sbar te/ gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ 'bar ba'i me nang gi dbus su pa las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal btab/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas shar lto nas ra yig las byung ba'i me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs bar bsams/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya —313—

dang / oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaX zhes brjod/ lag pa g.yas pa mchog sbyin byas pa'i mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar gtad mdzub mo gung mo'i rgyab tu sbyar ba dbyug gu gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung nas g.yab/oṃ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /gzi brjid chen po me yi lha/ /'dod pa thams cad grub pa po/ /thugs rjes sems can don mdzad pa/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ asne ye/ mahā te dza/sarba karma pra swa dha ka ma hā bhu ta/ de bi ri ṣi dha dza ba to/ /ma gha hi ta a huX re/ a ha ra/ a smin ni hi to bha wa/ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ thab kyi shar lhor byon pa la me tog phul la/ skye( pad+ma ka ma la ye stuX/ zhes pas thab nang gi gdan la bzhugs par blos dmigs la/ sngar gyi/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ me lha dmar po rwa skyes kham pa la cho zhe pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas bgrang phreng dang / g.yon ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ gsus khyim che ba/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog can/ sma ra'i ag tshom dang / tshangs pa'i skud pa 'phyang ba/ sku la mdangs dang 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas te/ dam la bzhag par mos la/ oX badz+ra a na la mahā bhu ta dzā la ya/sarba dhi smin ku ru sarba du ni huX phaṭa/ kyis 'phrin las bcol/dri shu dzaXhūX baX hoXs ma ya stuX gyis dam la bzhag nas/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam la/ tseX( asne ye sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaX pra ru ye swāhā/ de bzhi du spo sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod rol ma'i bar gyis mchod/ shes rab chen pos bdag med thugs chud cing / /thugs rjes chen pos 'gro la yang dag gzigs/ /thabs la mkhas pas drang srong cha lugs ni/ /—314—

'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /tshangs dbang 'jig rten mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir/ /thugs rjes sprul pa'i sku sprul pa/ /rigs sngags grub pa'i drang srong tshul/ /nyon mongs sreg pa'i shes rab 'od/ /bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul zhabs dang ldan/ /thabs kyi sprul ba'i theg pa chibs /rig sngags gsung gi bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan lha rnye bsnams/ /chos kyi bdud rtsi yongs la bsil/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod/ /'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhes pas mchod bstod byas la/ sngar gyi ku sha'i wo po brgyad bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hu las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ zhi ba'i las 'grub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed do/ /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin/ 'dis bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gegs med cing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de nas rang gi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas/ oṃ badz+ra satwa a zhes brjod cing thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du snga ma snga ma'i rtse mo phyi ma phyi ma'i rtsa bas non par bkram mo/ /de nas byon zan 'bul ba ni 'og 'das pa'i me lha'i skabs su 'chad pa ltar shes par bya'o/ /'dir me bkra brtag pa mdor bsdus pa ni/ kha dog dkar zhing snum pa du ba chung zhing bung ba lta bu'i sgra snyan cung zad dang bcas pa ni zhi ba la bzang la/ du ba che zhing me stag 'phro ba me lce 'chad pa dri mi zhim pa ni ngan pas spo315—

bsang chu gtor/ oṃ a mra ta te hūṃ phaṭa ces dang / hūX ring po brjod pas bgegs bsrung ngo //de nas bsreg rdzas rnams lha sngags/ rdzas sngags/ las sngags gsum spel tshig dang bcas pas 'bul te/ rdzas sngags ni/ tso ( bo dhi bri k+ṣa ye swā hwas yam shing / skye( asni ye snya hwas mar/oṃ sarba pa paX da ha na badz+ra ye snya hwas til/ oṃ sarba saX bo dha ye snya hwas zas mchog /oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭha ye snya hwas 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra bi dza ye swā hwas so ba/ oṃ mahā bhe ga ye snya hwas nas/ oṃ mahā bā la ye snya hwas sran ma/ oṃ badz+re lha sma ri ye swā hwas gro/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe snya hwas dur ba'i myu gu/ oṃ a pra tī hā ta badz+ra ye swā hwas kun sha'i sngags so/ /de la rgyas par na/ lha sngags rdzas sngags las sngags gsum tshang ba nyid yin la/ yang myur bar 'dod na thog mar lha sngags ci rigs brjod la/ bar du rdzas sngags nyid la grangs kyi rmad 'dzin zhing / mthar las sngags kyang ci rigs bsham bur btags pas 'grub bo/ /de la zhu ba'i rdzas rnams lha'i zhal du sib sib phul bar bsam/ gong bu'i rdzas rnams phyag dang / dur ba dang ku sha dbu'i gtsug tor/yam shing ni 'od kyi dkyil 'khor du 'bul ba nyid yin te/ 'bul tshul dper mtshon na/ yam shing byang chub kyi shing du mos la/ oṃ asna ye bo dhi bṛ k+ṣa ye bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shin+taX ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes brjod ku sha'i bar kun la rigs 'gre/ de nas me lha la bsang chu gtor zhing / oṃ ar+ghaX swāhā zhes mchod yon phul te mar blug gzar gang thab tu blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raX zhes brjod pas/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam la/ gsum pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha mchod pa la/ slar yang me de nyid/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swabha was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'bar ba'i me nang du paX las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar glang po ches btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma —316—

dang zla ba'i gdan/ phyogs dang mtshams kyi 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i gdan/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa 'khor ra dang bcas pa spyan drangs bar bsams nas/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis/ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs bcom ldan 'das/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /mchod pas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ak+ṣi khyo sa pā ri wā ra e phya hi/ zhes pasaspyan drangs zhing / spyan drangs pa'i mi 'khrugs pa 'khor bcas thab nang du byon par bsam nas/dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog in+d+ra ni la ltar sngo ba: zhes pa nas/rdo rje skyil krung gi bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis gtso bo gsal bto/ shar du lha mo pad+ma can: go pa nas/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'o/ /zhes pas lha mo rnams gsal btang/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bstan pas mnyes par bsams la/ mdun bskyed kyi bcom ldan 'das lha dgu'i ljags hu las byung ba'i rdo rje gcig pa dbus rwa sbubs can du gnas pa dgang blugs kyi kha la ra bsams nas/gzar bu gnyis pus mo gnyis kyi bar du bcug ste/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung la/ kā ka ni lan gsum dang / lha mo brgyad kyi sngags so so rnams lan re brjod pa'i mthar/ oṃ asna ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing / blugs gzar gyis dgang gzar bkang la/ gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar te thabs la g.yas su bskor la/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du phul bar bsam la/ oṃ asna ye bidha bi ju bi shu rje/ mahā shrī ha bya ka bya/ bha ha ya na ya zhes pa'i mthar/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa —317—

nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad shin+taX ku ru ye swāhā/ bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig tu byon zan phul la/ slar yang mchod pa rnams byin gyis bsas nas/ thal mo sbyar te/ thugs kyi dbang phyug cho se dbyings ye shes dngos/ /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs mgon po 'khor bcas rnams/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di bzhes la/ /bdag dang 'gro la dngos grub stsal du gsol/hūX badz+ra ak+ṣi khyu ar+ghaṃ pra ca swāhā/ che ma ṅga la shrī bat+pa ye ar+ghaX pra tismo swāhā/ paX ma ṅga la pad+ma ar+ghaX pra tismo swāhā/ oṃ ma ṅga la tsha tre ga ar+ghaX pra ca swāhā/ shaX ma ṅga la shaX kha ar+ghaṃ pra ca swāhā/ rtsa ma ṅga la tsakra ar+ghaX pra ca swāhā/ khyu ma ṅga la dh+wa dza ar+ghaX pra ca swāhā/ kaX ma rgo la ka la sha ar+ghaṃ pra ca swāhā/ maX ma ṅga la mat+na ya ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ zhes brjod cing pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i phyag rgya cas la/ lha re re bzhi dbul/de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang sngags gong 'og thams cad 'dra bar byas la/ lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog dang / pu spre/ bdug spos dang / dhu pe snang gsal dang / ā lo ke /dri chab dang / ga rnye/ zhal zas dang / ne wi du/ rol mo dang / sha lta/ zhes lha re re bzhin phul ba'i mthar rol mo ji snyed pa'i sgra bya kho / dharma ra ṇa la sogs pa brjod/ de nas bkra shis rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon rnam lnga dang bstod pa'i bar cho ga'i gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar byas la de nas bsreg rdzas rnams lha sngags kyi rjes la/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha'i skabs ltar tshar gcig phul nas/ slar yang grangs kyi ngo bo til 'ba' zhig la 'dzin no/ /de yang myur bar 'dod na lha sngags rdzas sngags las sngags gsum mam bzhi'am bdun la sogs pa ji ltar 'os pa'i mtshams su spel tshig sbyar la bzung ngo / /deng bar skabs su yam shing dang mar 'bul lo/ /me'i rgyun ma chad tsam gyi bud shing yang chud par bya'o/ /mar mi ldugs pa'i dus su —318—

gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la rdo rje dril bu'i bar du gzhug go /de nas slar yang mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs te/ cho ga'i gzhung gi rjes chog gi skabs ltar mchod bstod byas pa'i rjes su dngos grub blang / yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pas lhag chad kha bskang / ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa: sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ mthar mdun bskyed la gshegs skyems su mar dgang gzar bdun tshan gsum byon zan skabs ltar phul nas/ hāX khyed kyis: sogs dang / badz+ra muX thabs nang gi ye shes sems dpa' rang sba zhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol lo/ /bzhi pa slar yang 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa la/ oX asne dz+wa la raX/ zhes brjod cing mar blug gzar gang thab tu blug pa'i rkyen gyis/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa las/ skad cig gis rang gi gzugs su byon par dmigs la/ yam shing nas ku sha'i bar bsreg rdzas rnams ji ltar 'byor ba gsum mam lnga'am bdun la sogs phul ba'i mthar gong bzhin mchod bstod byas nas/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs byin gyis rlabs te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ tseX( asna ye sa pā ri wā ra na maXsarba ta thā ga ta smyo/ zhes sogs btags pa gsum mam lngas gtor ma phul te/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'khru/ba sgo rdzog /ces pas 'phrin las bcol/ gshegs skyems su mar dgang blugs bdun tshan gsum phul nas/ gong gi 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur ba'i skabs ltar bsang chu gtor/ mchod yon phul la/ spyan drangs pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i thad kar phyir bkyed de/ oX bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /bsgrub phyir bzhud cig —319—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/byin za khyod/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi 'dod pa thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ asna ye ya ti ru zhes brjod pas/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshe/gas par bsams/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams byas la spyod lam la 'jug go/gsum pa rjes ni me ma shi bar du/ gzhan reg tu mi 'jug cing mi dkrug /long yod na 'o ma'i chus bkrus la thal ba snod gtsang mar bsdus te/ chu'i nang na gnas pa'i srog chags mang po la phan gdags pa'i phyir rgya mtsho chen por 'bab pa'i chur dor/ thab kyi nye 'khor dri zhim po'i chus blugs te las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /yang 'di nyid kyi sgo nas ro bsreg pa'i cho ga bya bar 'dod tshul gnyis te/ de la ro mchog gnas kyi tshul du spyong ba ni/ rang gi bla ma'am/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen ngo la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha spyan 'dren pa'i tshe/ bla ma'am dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po de nyid kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes dang tha mi dad pa'i bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la/ bsreg rdzas rnams 'bul ba'i tshe/yul de nyid rang gi bla ma yin na/ bdag sogs gdul byar gtogs pa rnams kyi las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad shin+ti ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes pa dang / chos 'brel med pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu la/ yul de nyid kyi gdul byar gyur pa'i sems can thams cad kyi las ngan sdig sgrib thams shin+ta ku sa zhes blos dpyad nas 'bul lo/ /gnyis pa ro yon bdag gi tshul du sbyong ba ni/ thog mar las sgrib rnam sbyong gi gzungs nas 'byung ba ltar gī ka ni'i gzungs gser dngul lam/ ma 'byor na snag tshas bris la/ rten de nyid kyi mgo la gdags/cho ga'i gzhung nas 'byung ba ltar sbyang khus brab gsum sogs lho sgo'i cho ga yang yang du bya/ bsreg chog dngos gzhi'i tshe bsreg rdzas rnams byin gyis rlabs nas/ tshe las 'das pa'i phung —320—

khams skye mched dang / bsreg rdzas rnams tha mi dad pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ zhes dang / dngos ga sto tshe/ bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba thugs rje'i bdag po mi 'khrugs pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas tshe las 'das pa che ge mo/ zhes bya ba'i 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad yongs su sbyong ba dang / myur du 'khor ba dang ngan song las 'don pa'i 'phrin las mjodi cig /ces bsreg rdzas re re'i 'jug tu yang sbyar zhing / cho ga bzhin bsgrubs pa'i chus rus pa yang yang bkrus la mthar tsha tshe'i cho ga dang / mchod rten gyi cho ga yang lag len las 'byung ba bzhin bsgrubs te/ 'gro ba'i ngan song gi gnas 'gegs pa'i thabs mchog tu gyur pa/ rgyal ba'i bka' yang dag pa'i tshad ma la nan tan du bya bar rigs so/ /rmad byung rgyud sde kun gyi rtsa ba'i mchog /bya ba'i rgyud kyi shing rta chen po'i srol/ /dza tā ri pa'i gzhung gi rjes 'brangs nas/ /ma nor sbyin bsreg cho ga gsal bar byas/ /'dir 'bad dge ba las byung me 'od kyis/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i las nyon kun bsregs nas/ /chos dbyings rnam par mi rtog thab khung du/ /gzung 'dzin snang ba'i 'bud shing sreg gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga las sgrib kun 'joms zhes bya ba 'di yang / brgyud pa gong ma'i gsungs thor bur gnas pa rnams gzhan la phan pa'i blos phyogs gcig tu bsdebs te btsun pa grol mchog gis nye bar bkod pa'o// // zhus dag/ bkra shis//—321—

skye( snya sti/ gtang ma cha gsum du grags pa'i lag len la/ cho ga'i rim pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang / rgyud sde'i dbye bas bya spyod kyi lugs dang rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs gnyis te/gsum la gnyis kyis phye bas rgyud gzhung khungs ma rnams kyi bstan tshod la yang rtsa ba'i dbye ba drug tu 'byung zhing / bod snga ma rnams kyi lag len ni mi gcig pa mtha' yas pa'ang yod la/ de dag las skabs 'dir rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lugs cho ga bsdus pa ni 'di ltar bya ste/ 'bras yos bcas shing til dang bcas/ /'bras tshan 'bras bu dag dang bcas/ /sran chan bcas shing la du dang / /snum 'khur la sogs bza' ba rnams/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi rgyu la/ gtor ma dang po dang gnyis pa lcog zlum dkar gtor re dang / gsum pa bgegs gtor dbus su shu lu g.yas g.yon du ting lo changs bur bcas pa'am/ mtheb kyu ting lo changs bu can byas kyang rung ste/ sha chang la phug sogs kyis kyang brgyan no/ /bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas gtor ma'i cho ga bya ste/ zhi drag la khyad par med do/ /mchod yon dang bcas pa'i nyer spyod lnga yang 'grub na tshar gsum bsham/ de tsam ma 'grub na tshar gcig bsham la kha gsos kyin mthar bgegs gtor gyi gtor snod du blugs pa yin/ shin tu bsdu na mchod pa de rnams yid kyis sprul pa ste/ 'on kyang dmigs pa la brtan pa thob pa yin na ma gtogs/ mchod yon la sogs pa dngos su bsham dgos so/ /mchod pa byin rlabs ni spro na logs su bya la/ bsdu na gtor ma'i byin rlabs dang lhan cig dmigs pas chog go /de la dang po phyogs skyong gi gtor ma ni/ rdo rje gnod spyin gyi phyag rgya dang / o badz+ra yak+ṣa hu/ rdo rje me'i phyag —322—

rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañja ra ṇa huX phaṭa/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya 'debs tshul dang / oṃ a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharma ṇaX a du nu skyen twa ta/ zhesapas byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ yang na/ oṃ a mṛ te huX phaṭa dang / su bhā wa dang / a kā ro gsum gyis byin rlabs byas kyang rung ste phyi ma 'di bya spyod kyi dkyil 'khor la cho ga rnal 'byor rgyud sogs rgyud sde gong ma dang mthun rung du bkral ba rnams dang sbyar na legs so/ /rang gi mdun du bhāX las byung ba'i gzhal med khang lha'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ rdo rjes g.yab stsong dril gsil dang bcas/huX mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang / shwakya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang //bdag cag rnams la phan btags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba dbang dang ldan/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas yi dam bskyil po che/ /lha dang drang srong yi dwags srin po klu/ /rig ga dzin rgyal po dang ni gnod sbyin bdag /de dag so so'i dbang po'i skur ston zhing / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba bzhugs su 'tshal/ /bstan pa rgyas pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyi gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e hre hi da sha di ga lo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ye swāhā/ e hre hi/ zhes pa lan mang du brjod/shin tu bsdu na/ oṃ da sha di ga lo ka pa la a dhi pa ti sa pā ri wa ra gro hā daX ar+ghaX gā hā/ de bzhin du pu rmiX nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ cung rgyas pa la dga' na/ oṃ in+d+ra ya swāhā/ oṃ asne ye swāhā/ oṃ ya mā ya swāhā/ lkoX ni ri tu ya swāhā/ oṃ wa ru ṇa ya swāhā/h+ma( bā ya be+e swāhā/ skye( ku be rā ya swāhā/ glu( i shā na ya swāhā/ i sto pra smi ṇi swāhā/ glu( —323—

sdo khu rmi ya swāhā/ tso rna tsan+d+ra ya swāhā/ tsho( bā su dha ri rī swāhā/ glu( na gwa khyu swāhā/ h+ma( a su ra khyo swāhā/ gro hā da ar+gha swāhā/ zhes mchod yon phul de bzhin du/ pu spre nas sha lta'i bar gyis nyer spyod 'bul/ de nas dril stabs dang cas/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me ste sreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po:shar lho me lha'i mchod cing ja gshin rje be con 'chang pa'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po lto phyogs: mchod cing : bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i:lho nub: mchod cing : zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /klu yi: nub phyogs:mchod cing : rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin: nub byang : mchod cing : gnod spyin lag na stug tho thogs/ /nor srungs: byang phyogs mchod cing : dbang dang lda myo/ pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /ཿnga po byang shar: ma rdzo cing :steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang / /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar lhar bcas la/ /mchod cing : 'og gi klu dang sa yi lha/ /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang / /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ zhes pas bstod/ skye( in+d+ra ye swāhā/ nas/ a su ra khyu swāhā/ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta snre/ bi shwa mu khe khyu sarba thā kha spru yin te sa spa ra ṇa i ma ga ga na kha/ gro sna da bā li ta ye swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis gtor ma btabs/ de nas tshigs bcad kyis 'bul ba ni/ dril thabs dang bcas/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor ra dang bcas/ /gtor ma phul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol/ /me dang gshi/na rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang / /—324—

dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang / /steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang / /lha rnams kun dang sa yi klu rnams dang / /ri yi lha dang gsang ba'i tshogs 'dus la/ /so sor gtor ma phul ba rnams/ /rab tu dges pa yis ni bzhes nas kyang / /rang rang phyogs su legs par zhugs nas su/ /rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen mdun dang / /nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs cig tu/ /me tog phreng ba dri dang byug pa dang / /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag bzhes te btung zhing gsol nas su/ /bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ ces so/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces tshon las gzhol/ chos rnams gang dag rgyu las byang / /de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pas bstan/ /rgyu la 'gog pa gang yin pa/ /dge sbyong chen pos 'di skad gsungs/ /sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing / /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /ngag gi sdom pa legs pa yin/ /yid gyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ /thams cad du ni sdom pa legs/ /thams cad srung ba'i dge sbyong dag /sdug bsngal kun las nges par grol/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyogs pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ khyu dang las las kun tu byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /oṃ da sha di ga lo ka pā la sa pā ri wā ra ru ma rdzo pa rnams gtor sgod du —325—

mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/blug la phyir btang ngo / /gnyis pa 'byung po spyi'i gtor ma ni/ gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas/dril thabs dang cas pas rdo rje g.yab cing / lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul/ /nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po/ /dri za srin po gdon gyi tshogs rnams dang / /gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas rnams la/ /bdag gis pus mo sa ma gtsugs nas ni/ /thal lo sbyar nas khyod la gsol 'debs kyis/ /gsan nas phan bdag slad du 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ e rkye hi lo ka ka rā ya/ sarba bhu ta ga ṇi sa pā ri wā ra/sa mā ya swāhā/ e hre hi/ lan mang du brjod/ oṃ sarba bhu ta ga ṇi sa pā ri wā ra gro hā da ma ar+gha nas shaga'i bar gyis mchod/ spro na dril gsil dang cas pas sde brgyad so so'i bstod pas bstod/ bsdu na/ mthu ldan rang gi dam tshig la gnas pa/ /sa chu bar snang sa 'og mkha' la spyod/ /'jig rten rnams la 'phel zad las byed pa/ /sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs la bstod par bgyi/ /oṃ de wa nā ga yak+ṣa ga na dha dha a su ra ga ru ṭa kin ra ma ho ra ga ma nu smri a nu ma bya sa pā ri wā ra na ma sarba sogs btags pa lan bdun sogs kyis gtor ma stabs/ de nas tshigs bcad kyis 'bul ba ni/'gyung po gang dag ri rab steng gnas dang / /dga' ba'i tshal dang lha yi gnas rnams dang / /shar nub ri dang nyi zla'i khyim rnams dang / /ri bo kun la gang dag gnas pa dang / /chu bo kun dang chu yi mdo rnams dang / /rin chen gling na lhag par gang gnas dang / /mtsho dang rdzing bu ldings ka chu ngogs dang / /g.ya' chu sil ma can na gnas pa dang / /grong dang phyugs lhas grong khyer stong pa dang /khang stong dag dang lha yi khang pa dang / /gtsug lag khang ngam grong khyer gnas —326—

dag gam/ /dka' thub gnas dang glang chen bres dang ni/ /rgyal po'i dkor khang dag na gang gnas dang / /lam srang bzhi mdo dag dang sum mdo dang / /gang dag lam po che dang shing gcig drung / /dur khrod chen po nags tshal chen po dang / /seng ge dred dang gcan gzan gnas dag dang / /'brog chen 'jigs su rung bar gang gnas dang / /gang dag gling mchog dag na gnas pa dang / /lhun po dur khrod dag na gnas pa rnams/ /rab tu dges te mgu bar gyur nas su/ /me tog phreng dang dri dang bdug pa dang / /bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na/ /'di dag bzhes te btung zhing bsnams nas su/ /las de rnams kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ ces so/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis tshon las gzhol/ chos rnams gang dag rgyu las byung : sogs gong bzhin nam/ de bzhin gshegs pa rtag tu skye med chos/ /chos rnams thams cad bde bar gshegs dang 'dra/ /byis pa'i blo can mtshan mar 'dzin pa ni/ /'jig rten dag na med pa'i chos la spyod/ ces pas chos pond/ oṃ sarba bhu ta ga ṇi sa pā ri wā ra ca zhes mchod pa gnyis pa gtor ma gnyis par btab la phyir btang ngo / /gsum pa bgegs gtor ni/ gong bzhin byin rlabs byas la/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas te/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' sangs rgyas chos kyi: dge 'dun gyi5 gsang sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyi: dpal mgon dam pa —327—

chos skyong ba'i srungs ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ bgegs kyi rigs gang yod pa thams cad phan pa bde ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas skad cig thang cig yud tsam 'di nyid la/ gtor ma len pa'i gnas su mchis par gyur ciga.oṃ ṭak+ki hu dza oṃ gung ka ri gung ka ri snya hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi snya hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ gro ste dam ar+gha snya hā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ shaga'i bar gyis mchod/ sngags gsum po de'i mthar/ na ma sarba sogs btags pa lan bdun sogs kyi gtor ma bsngos/ gang zhig mtshan mor rgyu ba yi/ /'byung po rnams dang sha za dang / /srin po sha rjen za ba dang / /sems can rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas pa/ /de dang de la gtor ma ni/ /bza' ba sha chang la phug bcas/ /'bras chan 'bras bu mang po yi/ /gtor ma 'di yis mgu bar byos/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang / /sems can kun la phan pa'i yid/ /de ring phan chad skyes par gyis/ /rgyan gyis brgyan par byas kyang chos spyod cing / /dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod/ /'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ni/ /dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze'ang de/ /mtsho ni chas mi 'jigs gang yang med/ /'tsho ba'i zas la kun kyang 'du/ /'chi ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem/ /rang gi lus la dpe long la/ /gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig /chen po'am chung ngu gang yang rung / /lus la mngon par gnod gyur pa'i/ /nad de rab tu phyung ma sgo la/ /gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/ /de ltar bdag gi ci nus pas/ /mchod dang gtor ma phul ba yis/ /dam tshig gnas la gnas nas su/ /bdag gis 'dod pa bskang bar —328—

————rdemadzod/ /rtag tu dam tshig la gnas shing / /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gis/ /nad de rab tu phyung mdzod la/ /gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/ zhesapa tsam mam/ spro na 'di ltar/ bdag gis de ring khyod ma sna de kyi/ /song cig bgegs chen 'gro bar gyis/ /phyin chad de ltar ma byed cig /khyod kyi stobs dang rtsal mthong gi /khyod ni gegs kyang byed par nus/ khyod ni lha yi sprul pa ste/ /khyod ni gegs byed mi nus min/ /sngon chad mchod skyin ma thob pa/ /de ring bdag gis khyod mchod kyis/ /me tog phreng ba spos dang dri/ /mar me gtor ma 'di khyer la//bgegs kyi dbang po 'gro bar gyis/ /sngon gyi lan chags yod na yang / /mchod spyin 'di yis bral bar gyis/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi mthu dag dang / /dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa yis/ /gnod par gyur na mi legs kyi/ /gegs byed khyod ni da songs shig /ces brjod cing / mchod pa gtor mar bto la phyi rol du dor/ oṃ nga ni sum+bha hū/ gro hā gro hā hu/ grihā pā ya gro hā pā ya hū/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bi du rā dza hū phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'am bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags ring thung gang rung brjod cing mtshams bcad do/ /'di dag las rol mo'i sngags dang 'phrin las bcol la spro na rol chen yang bya la/ gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba zhes pa man chad la rnga tshigs byed pa'ang yod do/ /bgegs gtor gyi mtha'i tshams rngams kyi skabs 'dir/ lha zhi ba'i rnal 'byor kho na la gnas pas kyang nges par rung mod kyi/ rang nyid zhi bar gsal ba yin na thugs ka nas khro bo spro ba sogs kyi dmigs pa byed pa 'ga' zhig/ gi lag len du yang snang ba/ rnam pa gsal ba tsam yin la/spyir 'di ni bgegs la gtor ma sbyin pa tsam yin pa dang / mtshams gcod kyang rang nyid la srung ba'i don yin zhing / 'dre 'dul byed pa'i skabs ma yin pa go bar bya'o/ /mjug tu smon lam dang —329—
ma byams pa kun dga' la sogs pas bskul ba'i ngor/ tā ra nā thas nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su smras pa'o// // bkra shis// dge'o//

sde'i dgongs don zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /oṃ snyu sti/ lha yi lha mchog rgyal ba shākya thub/ /rgyal po'i khab kyi bya rgod phung por bzhugs/ /dgra bcom dge 'dun byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs/ /srid gsum che dgu'i tshogs kyis zhabs la gshugs/ /de tshe shā ri'i bu yis gsol btab nas/ /'gro la phan phyir chos kyi sgron me spar/ /bdag kyang dang ba'i yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /yang dag smon lam 'di dag 'grub par shog /'di nas shar phyogs logs su stong gsum stong / /'das pa'i pha rol mngon par dga' ba zhes/ /yon tan gzhal du med pa'i zhing khams yod/ /bdag cag zhing der chos la spyod pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'jug pa dang / /spyod pa mchog dang spro ba chen po dang / /sems mchog bskyed dang go cha bgo ba dang / /yon to brjod pa'i tshul la 'jug par shog /sngon tshe rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan chen pos/ /phar phyin drug las brtsams te chos 'khor bskor/ /de tshe mchog tu gyur ba'i dge slong zhig /byang chub spyod pa mchog la dam bca' mdzad/ /gnod sems mi skye rkyen gyis mi 'khrugs pas/ /de nas brtsams te rgyal sras gnas skabs dang / /da lta rgyal bar gyur kyang mi 'khrugs zhes/ /bla na med pa'i mtshan mchog don ldan gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa'i —331—

gnas skabs de nyid la'ang / /snying nas gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo//mgon po khyed ltar dam bca' smon lam 'debs/ khyed kyi mdzad spyod rjes su bdag slob shog /g.yo sgyu med cing bden pas sems bskyed la/ khro dang gnod sems 'khrug pa thams cad spangs/ /nam yang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems mi 'bral/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags la sogs nyon mongs spangs/ /srog gcod la sogs mi dge'i sems dang bral/ /rtag tu bla med byang chub yongs su bsngo/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin bgyid pa dang / /sangs rgyas yid byed 'bral med sgom par shog /tshe rabs kun tu rab tu byung nas kyang / /'dod chung chog shes sbyangs pa'i yon tan ldan/ /chags pa med pa'i spobs pas dam chos ston/ /bag med le los nyal ba nam yang med/ /rtsa ltung spangs shing khyim gyi las mi bskyed/ /bud med brdzun dang gzhan skyon brjod pa dang / /gzhan gnod dpa' skong la sogs mi bgyid cing / /bden don spyod tshe ngan spyod spong bar shog /tha na tso smrig tshun la'ang mchod rten dang / /blo ldan kun la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed/ /dam chos nyan par brtson zhing lha gzhan spangs/ /chos dang zang zing rtag tu snyoms par gtong / /srog la'ang mi lta g.yin gyi sdug bsngal sems/ /rmi lam du'ang tshul khrims 'chal ba spangs/ /gang na nyes lhung sgra yang mi grags pa'i/ /zhing mchog yongs su dag pa sgrub par shog /mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i myu gur gyur pa na/ /rnam pa de 'dra'i smon lam go cha mdzad/ /dam bca' 'di 'dra ldan pa'i rgyal sras rnams/ /bla med byang chub nye zhes rgyal bas bsngags/ /bden pa'i mthu las 'jig rten khams kyang g.yos/ /kye ma sngon med seng ge'i sgra chen —332—

zhes/ /'jig rten kun tu bsngags pa lan brgyar brjod/ /bdag cag rnams kyang de bzhin spyod par shog /rgyal gzhan sangs rgyas mdzad pa mdzad pa na/ /'od kyi snang bas 'jig rten kun khyab ste/ /sdug bsngal kun zhi ngo mtshar dpag med 'byung / khyed ni thugs bskyed tsam na'ang de dang mtshungs/ /bskal pa bzang po'i sems dpa' stong la sogs/ /'phags mchog bgrang yas las kyang ches lhag ces/ /slob pa'i dus na'ang sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags/ /bdag kyang mgon po khyed dang mtshungs par shog /bcom ldan mi 'khrugs rgyal po'i byang chub shing / /gnam 'phang du ni dpag tshad 'bum yod la/ /rin chen sna bdun las grub de las ni/ rab tu snyan pa'i chos sgra mtha' yas 'byung / /bskal pa chen po 'bum phrag bcu yi bar/ /bcom ldan 'tsho zhing bzhes la chos kyang ston//phyi rjes bstan pa'ang yun tshad de tsam gnas/ /de 'dra'i rgyal ba rtag tu mthong bar shog /byang chub brnyes par 'gyur ba'i zhag bdun sngon/ /'gro kun dga' bdes khyab cing nyon mongs bral/ /bla med ye shes brnyes tshe khams gsum g.yo/ /kun gyi phyag 'tshal mchod pa dpag yas phul/ /dpag tshad brgya yi tshad can nor bu'i gdugs/ /rtag tu dbu gtsug steng gi nam mkhar gnas/ /stong gsum chen po'i 'jig rten khams de ni/ /sku yi 'od zer kho nas rtag tu khyab/ /zhing khams de na ngan 'gro bdud las dang / /mu stegs can dang 'thab rtsod 'ching ba med/ /rgas dang nad dang rgud pa yongs med cing / /bud med skyon dang mi gtsang dngos po med/ /nyan thos rnams kyang theg chen tshul la bsten/ /bden pa mthong ba'i mod la dgra bcom thob/ /dge slong dge 'dun bkod pa mtha' —333—

med cing / /byang chub sems dpa'i 'dus pa tshad med de/ /de dag re re'i yon tan bgrang las 'das/ /bdag dang mtha' yas 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /tshogs mchog dam pa de 'dra'i nang chud nas/ /chos kyi sgo yi ting 'dzin thob par shog/mdog bzang sa gzhi 'jam la reg na bde/ /mtho dman med cing lha yi nor bus spras/ /gser gyi pad+ma mang pos rab tu khebs/ /sdong dum tsher ma pam grog la sogs spangs/ /gos dang rgyan rnams dpag bsam shing las 'byung / /'bad rtsol med par rin chen snod rnams su/ /ro brgya ldan pa'i kha zas 'dod bzhin 'byung / khyim rnams thams cad gzhal med khang pa ste/ khri dang mal gdan yo byad du mas khyab/ /rdzing bu gser gyi bye ma brdal ba las/ /mya ngan med pa'i ljon pas yongs su bskor/ /de dag skyes bu'i 'dod la rjes su 'byung / /'jam po'i rlung ldang tsha grang sdug bsngal med/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi rgyal po las/ /gtso 'khor gzhan med thams cad snyoms par bde/ /nyo tshong zhing sogs las la mi 'ju ga ste/ /ji ltar yid la bsam pa de ltar 'byung / /gser gyi ta la'i nags kyis phyogs kun khyab/ /yid 'ong sgra dang dri zhim kun tu 'thul/ /glu gar rol mos brtse yang bag yod ldan/ /mgon khyod spyod yul gshegs na zhabs kyi rjes/ /rin chen chu skyes 'dab stong ldan pa 'byung / /pad+ma de yang mchod yul chen por 'gyur/ /'dzam bu gling nas sum cu rtsa gsum bar/ /gser dngul biḍar+ya yi them skas can/ /de la lha dang mi rnams bde bar rgyu/ /ji ltar lha bzhin de ltar mi yang bde/ /lha rnams 'dzam bu gling pa rnams la smon/ /dbang sgyur bdud kyi 'jig rten zhes grags na'ang / /yang dag lam —334—

la zhugs pa kho na yin/ /'gro ba thams cad bco me ldan mi 'khrugs pa/ /rtag par mchod la brtson zhing chos kyang nyan/ /thams cad kun nas nyon mongs shas chung zhing / /sdig pa'i las dang nyes lhung dri mas dben/ /'dod pa'i dga' ba las kyang chags bral thob/ /mngal gnas khang bzang lta bur zhag bdun bde/ /nyan thos rnams kyang rnam 'phrul zad mi mnga'/ /sems pa rnams kyi rnam thar bsam mi khyab/ /zhing khams mchog de'i chos kyi 'byor bas ni/ /zhing gzhan thams cad zil gyis gnon par 'gyur/ /thugs rje lda na pa spos kyi glang po ni/ /da lta skyob pa mchog gi rgyal tshab lags/ /mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i phyi rjes su/ /zhag bdun lon nas chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur/ /lha mi'i ston pa gser gyi pad+ma zhes/ /stobs bcu ldan pa mi 'khru / gas ji lta ba/ /thugs rje'i 'phrin las bsam mi khyab par 'gyur/ /mgon po de ni mnyes par byed gyur cig /bcom ldan khyod kyi mdzad spyod ji lta bar/ /byang chub spyod pa sgrub par dam 'cha' zhing / /mi 'khrugs nyid dang lhan cig 'grogs pa'i phyir/ /pha rol phyin pa drug la spyod pa dang / khyod sku dam chos gsung ba'i rnam pa dang / /dge slong dge 'dun dran dang rgyal sras kyi/ /dge 'dun rjes su dran nas yongs su bsngo/ /de dag mngon dga'i zhing du skyes bar gsungs/ /rgyal tshab dam pa'i mtshan thos smon lam 'debs/ /phyogs bcu'i zhing khams dag par sgrub pa dang / /gzhan dag zhing der smon lam 'debs su 'jug /mi 'khrugs zhing gi mdo sder spyod pa dang / /glang po'i khri dang pad+ma la bzhugs pa'i/ /sku gzugs stong phrag sgrub par byed pa sogs/ khyed sku bgrang yas dge 'dun tshogs kyis —335—

bskor/ /mngon sum mthong nas zhing der 'gro bar gyur/ /sangs rgyas bden pa'i tshig gis de skad gsungs/ /'gro ba kun kyang rnam pa de lta bus/ /bsod nams dge ba'i tshogs la rab zhugs nas/ /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing la spyod par shog /bdag cag deng nas skye ba thams cad du/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i dpal la longs spyod cing / /rnam gsum sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams drungs phyung nas/ /mi 'khrugs mgon po'i go 'phang thob par shog /ji srid de ma thob kyi bar du yang / /mi mthun phyogs kyi bar chad kun zhi zhing / /dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston mchog rol bas/ /'gro kun bla med bde la 'god par shog /ces pa mngon par dga' ba'i zhing gi smon lam mdo sde'i dgongs don zhes bya ba 'di yang don gnyer mang pos bskul pa'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nges par brjod pa'o// // ma ṅga la/—336—

dpe sgrig 'gan 'khrar pa/ tshangs ngo//mdun shog mdzes 'god pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/spe5 ྅ra de/ shul bzhanas la5/rdeb re brgyad pa ༄tsho// /jo nang tā ra na tha'i sa sung 'bum/( 2(27745)dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang bis bsgrigs/:krung tho'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram/pe cin ma'o rin tsho'o khra par 'debs kung sis dang ra btab/spyi 'o 2008lo'i zla 4par par gzhi dang po bsgribasaspyi lo2008lo'i zla 4par par thengs dang ngo btabadapar grangs 0001——— 150༷152sku978—7—80253—013—3sko2 51—— —— ———————rde —— — ——— gsung 'bum cha tshang ( nge/ba 1—45 yod ) la rin sgor/ 9 10 00
